chapters.title: Chapter 851: Ganged Up The Demons
paragraphs: Naelith's body was curvy and voluptuous, her face alluring with a slightly mischievous smile. Her eyes were a bright green, matched by her black and green hair. She wore a lacy green bra with a gold choker adorned on top, a sheer black thong, and fishnet stockings covering her lower body. Eight large, greenish-blue and black octopus-like tentacles extend from behind her, almost as if they're part of her body.
"It's me." Balena wanted to approach Naelith, but Zhang Fei [1] suddenly grabbed her hand and pulled her behind him.
Zhang Fei [1] then released his aura to suppress Naelith and all the octopus demons in the place, forcing them to lie face down on the floor.
After all, all the demons in the Blue Water Realm were just ordinary demons and not demon cultivators like Balena, rendering them unable to move under the pressure of Zhang Fei [1]'s aura.
"Ugh!" Naelith and the octopus demons stared at Zhang Fei [1] in shock. "Who... who are you? Why... why are you treating us like this?"
"Fei."
"Do you believe me, Balena?"
"Yes."

"If you believe me, leave this matter to me." Zhang Fei [1] summoned the demon extermination sword, which immediately vibrated in joy. It couldn't wait to slaughter the demon, but he tightly held its hilt. "Be patient, Hei'an and Guang'an. They are not evil demons, and they are controlled by those two demons."
Balena immediately turned to Zhang Fei [1]. "Are those two demons really controlling them?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] walked over to Naelith and crouched down beside her. "Where are the two demons holding Balena's parents captive? If you tell me now, I will free you from their control, but I will kill you if you dare lie to me."

Naelith and the others trembled upon hearing Zhang Fei [1]'s threat, and they immediately told him the truth. "They... they forced her parents and others to locate the entrance to the Sunken Empire's ruins! They... they also killed some of them, like Drake, Mistveil, and some others."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] turned his head to Balena. "Do you know about Drake and Mistveil?"

"Drake is a one-eyed shark fiend, and he used to be the leader of the opposition party. Mistveil, a serpent turtle, was once the leader of my family and others' party. They were two of the strongest demons in this realm in the past, but I didn't expect the two demons to kill them." Balena then asked Naelith. "Where are Nyxxora, Sythrix, and the others?"
"They... they should be there along with your parents and the others."
Balena nodded slightly. "Can you free them from the control of the two demons, Fei?"

"Let me try it first." Zhang Fei [1] immediately used the soul manipulation ability to forcefully pull their souls out of their bodies, and he found black marks inside their souls. "As expected, one of the demons used slave marks against them, but his slave marks were too weak for the current me. However, the demon will immediately notice if I remove his slave marks from their souls, and he will come here directly, so I will send you back to the training space first."
"Are you sure you can face the two demons on your own?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled in response. "Balena, your husband is not an ordinary cultivator, okay? Chao Mojie and Mo Xieshen are strong, but I'm sure I can face them. Don't worry about me, and I will bring you back to this realm after I have dealt with them."
"All right."

Zhang Fei walked out of the training space at the same time as his first clone sent Balena in; he also summoned his second and third clones to help them deal with the two demons, especially since both of them were too powerful.

After they gathered, Zhang Fei and his three clones immediately removed the slave marks inside Naelith's and the others' souls. "Fortunately, my soul power has already been broken through to the intermediate stage of the heavenly soul level; otherwise, I wouldn't be able to remove the slave marks inside their souls, and they would die if I forcefully removed them."

Zhang Fei hurriedly returned their souls into their bodies, but he immediately knocked them unconscious. Thereafter, he and his three clones left the underwater building and flew out of the ocean because fighting underwater would be troublesome, and his three clones immediately entered the invisible state.

"This is the first time I didn't get any quests in a demon realm, so this realm is useless for me." As Zhang Fei expected, one of the demons immediately appeared in front of him. Based on the system scan, he is Mo Xieshen.

"Who the hell are you? Why are you interfering in my affairs by removing my slave marks from them?" Mo Xieshen was cautious because Zhang Fei was wearing the concealment ring given by Shang Yingyue, making the demons unable to detect his cultivation.
Zhang Fei responded to Mo Xieshen by slashing the demon extermination sword at him, and a crescent light Qi shot out from his sword, striking the demon directly.

Mo Xieshen was momentarily shocked to see a demon using the light element, but he effortlessly dispelled Zhang Fei's attack. "Hahaha! I originally thought you were a powerful demon, but you turned out to be just a weakling who deliberately hid your cultivation by using a concealment artifact to deceive others."
"Is that so?" Zhang Fei asked with a light smirk. "Yu Xue and Huan Ying originally thought like you, but they looked down on me too much, and I absorbed them alive."

"Bullshit!" Based on the power of his previous attack, Mo Xieshen did not believe that Zhang Fei could kill Yu Xue and Huan Ying, especially since both demons' cultivation was at the 5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm. "I will kill you."
"Guah!" Three powerful attacks suddenly struck Mo Xieshen's back at the same time, sending him flying towards Zhang Fei, who immediately thrust the demon extermination sword at him.

Mo Xieshen immediately grabbed the blade of the demon extermination sword to stop Zhang Fei's attack, but he made a fatal mistake in doing so. After all, the demon extermination sword was the sword that Xereth was looking for, and it was specially created to kill demons like him.
In that instant, the demon extermination sword absorbed Mo Xieshen's demon power, and Zhang Fei channeled his dark flames into the sword, burning his palm.

"Argh!" Mo Xieshen screamed in pain as he let go of the sword, but his palm became scorched and blistered. 'What the fuck with his sword? How can it absorb my demon power? Moreover, where did the previous three attacks come from? All three are quite strong and contain light elements!'
"Thinking too much in battle, aren't you?" Mo Xieshen turned back to attack him, but Zhang Fei quickly slashed the demon extermination sword, cutting his arm straight away.
*Splurt*
"Guah!" Mo Xieshen screamed in pain and flew away from Zhang Fei. He immediately pressed on his cut arm to stop the bleeding.

Zhang Fei's three clones, who were still in the invisible state, immediately attacked Mo Xieshen from behind. Three swords made of light elements pierced his back and chest, causing him to spurt black blood from his mouth.
*Splurt*
In a state of pain, Mo Xieshen was shocked by Zhang Fei, who suddenly teleported in front of him.
Zhang Fei slashed the demon extermination sword toward Mo Xieshen's neck, but the male demon suddenly disappeared, causing his attack to hit his afterimage.

Mo Xieshen reappeared behind Zhang Fei with his hand already transformed into a demon claw, and he thrust it toward his back, but his attack hit the illusion. 'This bastard! He has the same technique as me!'
Zhang Fei reappeared a little far away in the air and looked at Mo Xieshen with a faint smile. "Your ability is not bad, but you are too slow."
*Splurt*

"You-Guah!" Mo Xieshen spat out a mouthful of black blood from his mouth again as the three swords made of light elements pierced his back. He immediately swung his remaining arm backward, but he hit empty air. More and more black blood flowed from his back and chest, especially after the three swords disappeared. 'Fuck! Who exactly were the three people who attacked me? How could they appear and disappear so quickly? If the situation continues like this, I will die at the hands of that little bastard.'
Chao Mojie noticed Mo Xieshen's situation, and he immediately appeared by her side. "What happened to you? How did your condition get this bad?"
"That bastard did this to me." Mo Xieshen pointed at Zhang Fei, who was still standing in the air with a calm expression.

Chao Mojie looked at Zhang Fei, but he immediately noticed something unusual about the demon extermination sword in his hand. "Crap! That kid is the person Fa Ling is referring to, and that black sword is the sword our lord is looking for."
"What?" Mo Xieshen let out a low cry as he glared at the demon extermination sword. "Are you sure that sword is the one our lord is looking for?"

"I can't be wrong! He's not a demon, but a human! Let's attack him together!" Chao Mojie immediately released darkness from his body in order to limit Zhang Fei's vision, but he knew nothing about him or his abilities.
"Hellflame incantation." Immediately, dark hell flames spread out, dispelling Chao Mojie's darkness, followed by four loud roars.
*Roar...*
Mo Xieshen and Chao Mojie were struck by fear and confusion, which was the effect of the demon king's roar unleashed by Zhang Fei and his three clones.
"Damn it!" Chao Mojie and Mo Xieshen shook their heads vigorously to shake off their effects, but Zhang Fei immediately slashed the demon extermination sword at them. "Move!"
Chao Mojie pushed Mo Xieshen to the side before he himself shifted to the side to avoid the incoming attack.
However, a bright white circle with many symbols had already appeared above them, and Zhang Fei immediately waved his hand down. "Exorcismus!"

Countless light rays quickly rained down toward Chao Mojie and Mo Xieshen, but the two demons immediately countered them with their darkness. However, Zhang Fei's light element had already reached the peak stage, and he strengthened it using his light elemental law, making it extremely potent against darkness.
"Shit!" Chao Mojie and Mo Xieshen immediately fled as soon as their darkness disappeared, causing those light rays to plunge into the ocean.
Since Mo Xieshen's condition had weakened, Zhang Fei targeted him first, and his three clones surrounded Chao Mojie to prevent him from helping his friend.
"Guah!" Chao Mojie was instantly overwhelmed by the attacks of the three invisible clones. "What the hell!"
Mo Xieshen decided to run away as soon as Zhang Fei flew toward him, but he didn't forget to contact Xereth, informing his lord about him and the demon extermination sword.
Zhang Fei deliberately let Mo Xieshen do that in order to preoccupy and confuse Xereth, and he would think twice about attacking the Xianjin Realm.
[Master, stop wasting time and capture that demon now.]
Zhang Fei gave a light nod and teleported behind Mo Xieshen, and he immediately used the Yin-Yang Absorbing Shackle to seal the demon's cultivation, causing him to panic.
"Shit!" Mo Xieshen cursed as he fell into the sky due to his sealed cultivation, but he made a last-ditch effort to attack Zhang Fei using his demon abilities.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei's speed was simply too fast for Mo Xieshen, and he immediately chopped off his remaining arm.
*Slash*
"Guah!"
Zhang Fei directly grabbed Mo Xieshen's head and used all three of his absorption abilities at once. He directly absorbed the demon's cultivation, demon power, and life force.
"Argh!" Mo Xieshen groaned in pain as soon as Zhang Fei did that.
Chao Mojie, who was watching that from a distance, immediately flew toward them. However, Zhang Fei released the demon extermination sword from his hand, and the sword quickly shot towards the demon.

Chao Mojie suddenly took out a black chain and threw it toward the demon extermination sword to capture it. However, Zhang Fei [1] quickly came out of the invisible state and fended off the black chain using the moonlit whisper sword, shocking the male demon.
Feltia [2] also came out of the invisible state, grabbed the demon extermination sword, channeled his light qi into it, and slashed it toward Chao Mojie.
"Fuck!" Chao Mojie repelled Feltia [2]'s attack, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] appeared behind him with light sword Qi in his hand, and he thrust it at the demon's back directly. "Guah!"

After Zhang Xiaolong [3] sealed Chao Mojie's cultivation using another Yin-Yang Absorbing Shackle, Feltia [2] quickly thrust the demon extermination sword into the demon's chest, and it penetrated all the way to his back.
*Splurt*
"Argh!" The demon extermination sword instantly absorbed Chao Mojie's demon power. "Argh!"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked back because there were many demons moving towards them at high speed, but he was not too worried about them. He immediately opened the portal to the training space, and five of his women quickly walked out of it.

Murong Qianying, Fei Qinyuan, Shang Yaolin, Xian Xianqin, Zhou Shenxin, and Yun Xinyue moved together to stop the demons from the Blue Water Realm. With their cultivation in the Seven Divine Realms, it was too easy for them to stop ordinary demons like them.
"Don't kill them."
After they immobilized the demons from the Blue Water Realms, Murong Qianying and the others immediately moved to Zhang Fei's side, watching him absorb Mo Xieshen dry.
[You gained 30,000,000 demon essences from Mo Xieshen.]
[You gained 25,000,000 Qi from Mo Xieshen.]
[Congratulations! The host's cultivation broke through to 3 Star Heaven Realm.]
*Rumble... Rumble...*

Quickly, the sky above them became dark with many lightning flashes up there. Zhang Fei immediately released the Yin-Yang Absorbing Shackle from Mo Xieshen's corpse, summoned Lei Que, and the two of them flew straight into the sky to face the lightning tribulation.

The demon extermination sword in Feltia [2]'s hand continued to absorb Chao Mojie's demon power. He and the other two clones wanted to absorb the demon's demon power and cultivation, but their main body was undergoing his lightning tribulation, and he didn't have the pill to stabilize his cultivation yet, so they didn't do so.
"Hey, Qianying! This kid hasn't broken through to the Heavenly Realm for long, right?" Fei Qinyuan inquired as she gazed up at the sky.

Murong Qianying nodded at her. "Zhang Fei broke through to the 1-Star Heaven Realm about two weeks ago, and he broke through to the 2-Star three days ago. He was able to stabilize his cultivation quickly because Lin Jingxia gave him some Nine Revolutions Pills, so his breakthrough this time should be no problem."

"This kid has gone mad! He used shortcuts to increase his cultivation too many times." Fei Qinyuan then looked at Zhang Fei's three clones, but she could see they weren't doing anything, and only his sword was absorbing Chao Mojie's power. "Will he also use that demon as a sacrifice to increase his strength?"
"I think so." Murong Qianying nodded in response. "Let's wait for his breakthrough to complete."
In a few minutes, they could hear Zhang Fei's screams mixed with Lei Que's shrill screams from behind the clouds, indicating that his lightning tribulation had begun.

Meanwhile, Feltia [2] had already pulled the demon extermination sword out of Chao Mojie's body, especially since the sword was already satisfied absorbing his demon power. Despite this, the male demon was still alive; only he was in an extremely weak condition.

At the bottom of the sea, a giant beast lay in the ruins of the Sunken Empire. The Abyssal Leviathan Demon had long noticed Zhang Fei's presence and his battle with the two demons. It opened its giant eyes and looked towards the surface of the sea. "Master, is he the person you were referring to back then? He was much weaker than the two demons, but he was able to defeat them, and he killed one of them."

chapters.title: Chapter 852: Two Breakthroughs
paragraphs: [Ding]
[Congratulations! The host's Heavenly Body Tempering Technique has been upgraded to the diamond body.]
[Congratulations! The host's Heavenly Lightning Body Cultivation Technique has been upgraded to the perfection stage.]

Along with the appearance of the two notifications, the sky in the Blue Water Realm became bright again, indicating that Zhang Fei's breakthrough was over. "After eleven breakthroughs, my heavenly lightning body cultivation technique finally reached the perfection stage. The last time my heavenly body tempering technique broke through was seven months ago when I broke through to the Earth Realm. This way, my overall body strength and overall raw strength increased a lot, and I still have my enhanced condition ability, so the percentage of both will increase even greater."

[Master, your heavenly body tempering technique can still break through once more; your body strength will increase by another 15%, and your raw strength will also increase by 10% at that time. I think it's time for you to learn another body technique so you will become even stronger, and no cultivator in the three mortal realms will be able to fight you.]

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with that. "Since I have the fire element, I think it's better if I learn a fire body cultivation technique, and I can improve it more easily than a normal body cultivation technique. Unfortunately, there is no such technique in the system shop, so I have to look for it elsewhere, but where can I get it?"

[Why don't you try looking for him in the Sky Dragon Realm? The flame dragons in that realm probably have a body cultivation technique with the fire element as the foundation, so you can try asking them about that.]

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei then sent Lei Que the thunderbird to rest in the beast space, especially since his lightning tribulation just now was quite strong. "How much Qi do I need to break through to the 4-Star Heaven Realm, Mei?"
[I'll show you, Master.]
[Cultivation]
[Demon Rank]
- Duke Rank [Demon Essence: 169,100,000/180,000,000]
[Beast Rank]
"Three and a half million more, huh?" Zhang Fei was satisfied with that. "My demon rank will also advance to archduke rank with eleven million demon essences."

[Master, you should not absorb Chao Mojie's cultivation for now, especially since you don't have Nine Revolutions Pills anymore. If you want to increase your demon rank, the easiest way is to slaughter the demon beasts in this realm, and their amount of demon essence should be much greater than the demon beasts in the Nine Hells Darkland Realm.]
Zhang Fei didn't want to do that, especially since he didn't have any problems with the demons in the Blue Water Realm.
[Ding]
[Mapping of the area of the Blue Water Realm has been completed; the host can check the entire area via the map.]
"Mei, look for the entrance to the Sunken Empire's ruins."
[I'm working on it, Master.]
Zhang Fei immediately descended from the sky to the side of Murong Qianying and the others. "I'll send you guys back there."
"Are you sure you can handle everything yourself?" Murong Qianying asked.
Fei Qinyuan also asked him. "Are you going to absorb that demon now?"

"The situation in this realm is under control, and the demons have been freed from Mo Xieshen's slave mark, so there will be no more problems." Zhang Fei then looked at Chao Mojie. "I will not absorb him for now, and I will move him to the Nine Hells Darkland. After I stabilize my foundation, I will absorb him directly."

After Zhang Fei sent Xian Xianqin and the others back to the training space and took Balena out of there, his first clone took Chao Mojie to the Nine Hells Darkland at once to complete the daily quests. His second clone returned to the phoenix realm again to cultivate in the icy lake, and his third clone returned to the Xianjin Realm before cultivating in his room.

[Master, I have found the entrance to the Sunken Empire's ruins; it is in the underwater cave. However, there is a concealment formation at the mouth of the cave, and the formation is above high-grade level, so no one noticed it.]
Hearing that, Zhang Fei immediately brought Balena to that place, but they saw a few confused demons in the area not far from the Sunken Empire's ruins.
"Father! Mother!" Balena shouted as soon as she saw her parents in the crowd of demons.
The two demon whales immediately turned towards Balena. "Daughter? Is it really you?"
"Yes!" Balena immediately pulled Zhang Fei toward her parents before hugging them both. "Father! Mother! I missed you so much!"
Balena's parents immediately hugged her back, and the three of them cried together.

A while later, Baena's mother let go of their hugs, groped her face, and wiped her tears. "Where have you been these hundreds of years? You suddenly disappeared without a trace, and we've been searching for you for a long time, but we've been unable to locate you. We thought you were dead, but you are still alive and well."

"Mother." Balena called out softly before explaining to her parents the situation she experienced back then, causing both of them to sigh heavily. Even so, they were relieved that their daughter was still alive, and they could feel that she had become so strong.
Balena's father patted her head. "All is well that you are back now."

"Father! Mother! I want to introduce you two to someone." Balena pulled Zhang Fei to her side. "His name is Zhang Fei, and he freed me from those demons. Besides, he also got rid of those two demons, so you can all be free from their control."
Both of them looked at Zhang Fei, but they felt that there was something strange about him. "You're not an aquatic demon, right?"
"I am a lust demon lord, and I disguise myself as an aquatic beast so I can move freely underwater."
Balena's father nodded in understanding. "Thank you for saving my daughter and us. My name is Nymor, and my wife is Druka."
"Zhang Fei, thank you for bringing our daughter back to our side." Druka sincerely said.
Zhang Fei shook his head. "You two don't need to thank me. After all, Balena is my woman, and I promised her to bring her back here."
"Eh?" Nymor and Druka turned to Balena, asking for confirmation.
Balena smiled seeing them like that. "Father! Mother! We haven't done that yet, but we have been living together ever since he freed me, and I have long decided to accept Zhang Fei as my man."
"Balena, you can talk to them first, and I will enter the ruins to meet the Abyssal Leviathan Demon." Nymor wanted to stop him, but Zhang Fei had already entered an invisible state and left them.
"Does Zhang Fei really know the entrance to the ruins, daughter?" Druka asked as she looked at the distance.
Balena stole a glance at the other demons first before saying to her mother. "Let's go back to our house first, and I will explain things to the two of you."
"Let's go home; you have to tell us everything."

Since they had been under Mo Xieshen's influence for so long before, the other demons still looked confused by their situation. They decided to return to their respective residences, thinking things over.

Zhang Fei had already arrived at the cave that Mei had mentioned earlier, but he wouldn't have been able to detect the entrance if it were not for the system and the map, especially since the concealment formation was too high level.

Zhang Fei quickly swam through it until he reached the end, and he immediately arrived at the Sunken Empire. However, his jaw dropped as soon as he saw the place, especially since it still looked majestic. Even though it was now in ruins, he could still see numerous valuable items scattered around, including gold, precious metals, jewelry, and many others.

[Master, there is a low-level water elemental seed in the throne room, but it is guarded by the Abyssal Leviathan Demon, so you have to defeat the demon beast first to be able to take it. However, your chances of defeating it are very slim because it is not an ordinary demon beast but a mythical rank demon beast, and it is much stronger than you.]
Zhang Fei inwardly sighed, summoned the demon extermination sword, and swam towards the throne room directly. When he arrived there, he saw the Abyssal Leviathan Demon already waiting for him.

The Abyssal Leviathan Demon is a colossal, ancient sea beast. Its body is not only large but also extremely long, with midnight blue scales. Its eight serpentine fins are like sharp blades, and its black eyes are like endless black orbs. A crown of horned coral and dark kelp twists upon its head, and its maw can swallow entire warships.
'Scan the beast, Mei.'

Gender: Male

Physique: Demonic Serpent
Master: None

Zhang Fei swallowed his saliva after reading the demon beast's status. 'Shit! This guy is the strongest demon beast I have ever met! I would never be able to defeat him if we had to fight underwater.'
"Keep your sword away, kid."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "I can't do that because you are too strong, and you can kill me easily in this sea."
"I don't want to fight with you, and I'm here waiting for your arrival."
Zhang Fei was even more confused by that. "Did your late master order you to wait for me here? How did he know I would be coming here?"
"My late master is one of the ten ancient demons in our realm, and he has an ability that no other demon has."
"Don't tell me that your late master has the ability to foresee the future." Serpentra did not answer Zhang Fei. "Why did your late master ask you to wait for me?"
"You are the one destined to unite all races, and you will bring peace back to this universe."

"Honestly, I'm sick of hearing about it." Zhang Fei replied with a soft sigh. "Many people have said that I am destined to unite all races, but I have never wanted to do that, and I only want a peaceful life for those closest to me."
"Do you think you can have peace if the universe is not at peace?"
"No." Zhang Fei answered with a shake of his head.

"Whether you want it or not, you must be a peacemaker for this universe if you want the people on your side to live in peace. Honestly, I have always questioned my late master's words until today, but your fight with the two demons made me realize that you were destined for that. Unfortunately, you are still too weak now, and your path to becoming the peacemaker is tough and steep."

Zhang Fei nodded to him. "I know I'm still too weak, but I will continue to work hard to become strong, and I will stand at the peak of this universe in the future, surpassing those who have stood at the top since ancient times, like you."
"Hahaha! I like your spirit, kid. However, talking is easier than doing, and you will face many steep obstacles in achieving your ambition."

Zhang Fei raised both hands. "I'm still young, and my path is still long, so all possibilities are still available before me. I've only been a cultivator for a little over a year, but I've already reached this stage. By the time I reach your age, I might already be at the pinnacle of this universe."

"If I hadn't witnessed your fight with those two demons, I would say that you were a braggart. However, you were able to defeat them with various cunning means, and your sword was of great help to you because it was created solely for killing demons. In the future, if you go to my realm and fight with the people there, everything you have relied on all this time will be for naught, and you will die in their hands. Therefore, you must prepare yourself as best as possible before you go there, or you will just be a helpless rabbit amidst the siege of powerful people."

"I appreciate your advice." Zhang Fei then pointed to the water element seed. "Since your late master asked you to wait for me, and you yourself know that I am still too weak, I would like to ask for your help."
"If you want me to be your contract beast, you should forget about your wishes, especially since you are not yet worthy to be my master."

Zhang Fei shook his head. "I just want to ask two small favors from you. First, I want to ask for a few drops of your origin bloodline for my wife. Second, I want the water elemental seed above you so I can obtain the water element."
Serpentera immediately pushed the water elemental seed toward Zhang Fei. "The seed is useless to me, so you can have it. As for my origin bloodline, I can't give it to just anyone."

"How about you meet my wife first?" Serpentra narrowed his eyes at Zhang Fei. "Lin'er is much weaker than me, but I can guarantee that her proficiency in the water element is exceptionally high, and you will not regret giving a few drops of your origin bloodline to her."
"Bring her here."
Zhang Fei immediately opened the portal to the training space, and Zhang Lin walked out of it a moment later. "Wow! A giant snake!"
"Little girl, I will eat you alive if you dare call me a snake again! I am Serpentera, the mighty Abyssal Leviathan Demon."
"Hehe." Zhang Lin giggled. "I don't mean to look down on you, but it's a fact that you are a giant snake."

Serpentera's face darkened after hearing that, but he immediately ignored it. "Tch! If you weren't his wife, I would have swallowed you alive! Come! Show me your talent in the water element! If I deem you worthy, I will give you a few drops of my origin bloodline."

"Sure!" Zhang Lin immediately proved her ability in the water element by splitting the seawater in the place in two, and she pushed them to both sides. She then controlled the seawater and created several things from the water, but she then tried to use the effects of the Leviathan's tears to command Serpentra.
For a brief moment, Serpentera felt that he was forced to obey Zhang Lin's command, but the effect immediately disappeared because of his superiority.
"What did you do to me just now?"

"That is one of my abilities." Serpentera didn't seem to believe Zhang Lin's answer. She then demonstrated her abilities by controlling several small aquatic beasts around them, and they moved based on her command. "See? As long as they are aquatic beasts, they will obey me. I tried it on you before, but you were too strong for me, so the effect only lasted a split second."
Serpentera then asked Zhang Fei. "What did you give her that she could do that?"
"A Leviathan's tear."
"Hmm?"
"I got it from a merchant, and it has been fused with Lin'er, so she can do that kind of thing."

"I don't know how that item can exist in the three mortal realms, but it has the same effect as one of my abilities. Since she can do that, I will give her a few drops of my origin bloodline, and the effect of her abilities will be even more potent."
"Eh?" Zhang Lin was surprised to hear that. "Are you really going to give me a few drops of your origin bloodline?"
Serpentera answered Zhang Lin by lifting one of his fins, and a lump of blood appeared on it.
"This blood is my origin bloodline."
However, Zhang Fei immediately stopped Serpentera. "Wait a minute! We won't do it that way, and I need some of your body parts to do something else for Lin'er."

chapters.title: Chapter 853: Zhang Lin's Transformation
paragraphs: "Are you fucking kidding me? How are you going to help your wife become a demonic beast like me?"

Zhang Fei shook his head at Serpentera. "I can't explain to you in detail, and I can't do it in this place. Please give me some of your body parts, such as your skin, nails, hair, and some others. Once Lin'er becomes a demonic beast, I will bring her back here, and my words will be proven. She also carries the water dragon bloodline, so if you are willing to assist her, you will have an exceptional successor."

"If you didn't mention it, I wouldn't have noticed it. I can indeed sense the dragon aura from this little girl, so it's true that she has the dragon bloodline." Serpentera's body suddenly glowed before shrinking and turning into a human.

Serpentera's human form was extremely tall, around 7'1" (2.16 m), with skin as pale as the deep ocean, giving off a distant and oppressive impression. His long, flowing hair, the color of ink in the starlit depths, trailed behind him, floating unnaturally beneath the water. His eyes were pitch black, without sclera or irises.

He wore a robe woven from deep-sea silk, a coat of translucent, scale-like fabric that shimmered like wet obsidian. Coral ornaments circled his shoulders and wrists, and a dark jade pendant—resembling a screaming face—hung on his chest.

According to Zhang Fei's request, Serpentera cut off a little of his hair, nails, skin, and some others. "Before you turn your wife into my successor, I must warn you that your actions will bring disaster to her, especially if you take her away to the Paradise Realm in the future. My late master and I have too many enemies there, and I am the only one of my kin left. If they find out that she is my successor, they will hunt her down and forcibly contract her. Moreover, our main enemy is not just anyone; that guy is the strongest demonic beast."

"The Primordial Nihility Beast, right?" Serpentera was momentarily shocked to hear that name from Zhang Fei's mouth. "I can't reveal the truth because of my promise to someone, but I know that primordial beast is after you. He sent Taotie to hunt you and your late master because he couldn't come down himself, and he also wanted to capture the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast that your late master hid in my home realm."

Serpentera released a heavy sigh. "I don't know how you know all that, but you're right about everything. The Primordial Nihility Beast is the strongest demonic beast, and his main opponent is the Primordial Genesis Beast. The war between the two primordial beasts started after they were born and became strong, but another beast managed to stop their war. Not all beasts wanted the war, be they the demonic beasts or the righteous beasts. We could not oppose them, especially since their influence was absolute. The war may indeed be over now, but it will never truly end, and it will start again someday in the future."

"I know." Zhang Fei remembered his conversation with the will of the universe. "The Ten-Tailed Fox stopped their war, but I don't understand how he could do that, especially since the two primordial beasts should be stronger than him. The only way to completely end the war is to kill them both, which is obviously impossible given their overwhelming power."

"To tell you the truth, many demonic and righteous beasts have tried to stop the war between them. Unfortunately, they only threw their lives away in vain, including my kin and the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast race, which led to the near extinction of our races." Serpentera then handed over all his body parts and origin bloodline to Zhang Fei. "You don't need to think about all those things for now, especially since your abilities are still far from sufficient to participate in all of them. You can go now and turn your wife into my successor, and I will wait here to see the results."
After he informed Balena of this, Zhang Fei immediately brought Zhang Lin back to the training space, leaving Serpentera dumbfounded.

"That kid obviously doesn't have the void element, but he can create such a space. Moreover, no one in the three mortal realms knows about the two primordial beasts, yet he knows about them, and he also knows about many other things." Serpentera returned to his demonic beast form and curled up in the throne room, but he then used his Qi to collect all the treasures in the Sunken Empire there. "Let me wait for the results."

After they arrived at the pavilion, Zhang Fei immediately took out the science capsule with Zhang Lin lying inside. He immediately inserted every part of Serpentera's body into the ten holes, followed by his origin bloodline. 'Start the process now, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
"Will Lin'er experience any significant changes after becoming a demonic beast, Fei'er?" Qing Yi posed this question as she observed her second daughter inside the capsule.

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Just like Ru Xue, Lin'er will experience physical changes, but I'm sure her changes won't be too significant, and only a few parts of her will change. I don't think it's a big deal, especially since she can use the transformation technique to return to her human form."
"Yeah, you're right." Qing Yi replied with a slight nod.
Xereth, who was on his way to Feng Yichen's place, was annoyed after listening to Mo Xieshen's message.

"I didn't expect that brat and the damn sword to be in the upper realms, and he seemed to have a certain goal in the Blue Water Realm. Could it be that he intends to capture the Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast? How strong is he really? How could he kill that idiot?" Xereth then looked at a certain distance. "The realm should be in that area, and I can get there in three days. However, Zichen is in critical condition, and it would be a loss for me if he died, so I have to save him first. I should go to his place first, and I'll take her to that realm after she recovers. I hope that brat is still in that realm when I arrive; I will kill him and take the sword from him."
After that, Xereth accelerated his speed because Feng Yichen's location was quite far from his current location, and he was also eager to get the demon extermination sword.

Balena is enjoying her time with her family, but she still can't believe that her parents decided to have two other children after she disappeared. However, she is pleased that they haven't forgotten about her, even though she disappeared for so long.
"Where's Zhang Fei? Why isn't he here yet?" Druka asked her daughter.
Since she couldn't possibly tell her parents about the training space and such, Balena told them that Zhang Fei was doing something in the Sunken Empire's ruins.
Nymor then asked. "How did Zhang Fei find the entrance to that place? For thousands of years, we have been looking for the entrance, but we have never managed to find it."

"Father, Zhang Fei is not an ordinary demon, but he is a demon cultivator. In fact, I have become a demon cultivator like him, and he taught me to become one." Balena's revelation shocks Nymor and Druka. "He is no ordinary cultivator, and it is not difficult for him to find the entrance. However, you two should not think about going to that place, especially since there is a powerful demon beast living there. If you go there, it will kill all of you outright."
"What kind of demon beast are you referring to?"

"An ancient demon beast, the Abyssal Leviathan Demon." Nymor and Druka gasped in shock when Balena said that. "The demon beast is a powerful cultivator who has lived more than a million years, and its strength is much higher than Zhang Fei's. However, I believe he will be fine because he is not a reckless person, and he will immediately run away if he is in danger."
"How can that beast live there?"

"A deceased powerful demon cultivator deliberately placed the demon beast there to protect it, especially since the demons who destroyed the old empire were hunting it." Balena's parents put on a serious look after she said that. "His name was Xereth, and he had disappeared for a long time. However, he has reappeared now, and he has started causing trouble in various realms. What exactly happened in this realm? Could you please share when those two demons began to have control over you? What about the new empire?"

Nymor immediately explained to his daughter about the arrival of the two demons in their realm, which occurred several years after Balena's disappearance. "Since then, our kingdom no longer exists, and we have become their slaves. If you and Zhang Fei didn't come here, we would probably be their slaves for the rest of our lives."

"I see." Balena nodded in understanding. "Even though I regret the destruction of our kingdom, I think it is much better because you no longer have to worry about the fate of this realm, and you can focus on your personal lives."
"Are you going to stay here?"

Balena answered her mother with a shake of her head. "Zhang Fei is my future husband, so I will stay by his side, and I will follow him wherever he goes. For now, we just need to wait for him to come back, and I will talk to him about all of you."
"All right, let's wait for him."
Several hours passed quickly in the outside world, and three notifications appeared in Zhang Fei's mind.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels sent to the inventory.]

Zhang Lin's black hair turned blacker, like ink. However, her eyes were different from Serpentera's pitch-black eyes, especially since her eyes turned blackish blue with vertical pupils like a dragon's eyes, making her gaze quite intimidating. 'Scan her, May.'

Demon Rank: Lesser

- Darkness [Lower Stage]

Physique: Demonic Dragon Serpent Physique
Partner: Zhang Fei
'As expected, her physique transformed into a dragon serpent.' Zhang Fei then helped Zhang Lin out of the capsule. "Are you satisfied with the results?"

Zhang Lin stretched out both hands and opened her palms. The darkness element appears on her left palm, and the water element appears on her right palm. "My water element is significantly stronger, but my darkness element is still in the initial stage. Moreover, I gained some of Serpentera's abilities; his abilities are important for my mastery of the water element, so I'm satisfied."
"Lin'er, return to your human form; your appearance is very scary, especially your eyes." Qing Yi suddenly spoke.

Hearing that, Zhang Lin took a mirror to see her new appearance, and she was a little surprised after seeing her eyes. "Hehe! My new appearance is scary, but I like my new eyes. By the way, let's meet Serpentera again, Big Brother."

Serpentera immediately returned to his human form as soon as the two appeared in front of him, and he nodded in satisfaction after observing Zhang Lin's changes. "Show me your beast form, little girl."
"Sure."

Zhang Lin's demonic beast form is as enormous as Serpentera's demonic beast form. Her body is long and serpentine like a sea serpent, yet muscular and broad like a dragon. Her scales are midnight black with a subtle shimmer of deep blues. Her head is long and narrow with an angular structure. Her maw is filled with rows of sharp teeth.

Zhang Lin's blackish-blue eyes are surrounded by rings of pale bioluminescence. Her horns are not similar to dragon horns at all, but they are fan-shaped and fringed. Unlike most dragons, her wings are large, webbed fins, like a manta ray. Her tail is long like a whip, with a barbed tip.
Zhang Lin's demonic beast form left Serpentera stunned for some time. "What the hell is this? Why is her beast form different from mine?"

"Lin'er is an Abyssal Leviathan Dragon." Serpentera looked at Zhang Fei in shock. "Honestly, I don't know how she became like this, but her water dragon bloodline affected her transformation. As a result, she became a new race, a mix between your race and the water dragon race."

Serpentera nodded in understanding. "Since this little girl is a mix of my race and the water dragon race, it means she is the only one of her kin in this universe. If the Primordial Nihility Beast finds out about her existence, he will send his subordinates to hunt her down, and Taotie is usually the one who carries out that task. Therefore, you have to protect her better, or they will catch her and devour her."

"Lin'er is my little sister and wife; I will definitely protect her with all my strength." Zhang Fei then informed Serpentera. "Taotie assigned Xereth to hunt you down, and he already knows of your presence in this realm. I have already eliminated his two subordinates, so he will probably come here himself. His arrival will bring disaster to this realm, so I think you should move out."

"You don't have to worry about me, especially since that demon is not my opponent. As long as Taotie or the others don't descend here, I can still defeat anyone who comes to hunt me down." Serpentera then floated in front of Zhang Lin and touched his forehead, imparting several techniques to him. "Though our races differ, you are my heir because my blood runs in you, and you must master those techniques. Once you master them, you will be the ruler of the sea; no humans or beasts will be able to match you in the water."
Zhang Lin nodded at him. "Thank you, Grandpa Serpentera."

Sepentera's lips twitched because Zhang Lin called him as such, but he was pleased in his heart, especially since he was the last of his kin. "Are you going to use the water elemental seed now? If you use it yourself, your chances of getting the water element are slim. However, you are fortunate because I am an ancient aquatic demon beast, and I can help you get the element."
"Please help me to get the water element."
Serpentera then looked at the pile of treasures in that place. "Before we start, you should keep them all, especially since they will be useful for you and your wives."

Zhang Fei unhesitatingly stored all the treasure into the system's inventory, and he sat down immediately after. He then swallowed the low-level water elemental seed, triggering several notifications.
[Ding]
[Water elemental seed was detected.]
[The process of absorbing the water elemental seed begins.]
[The chance for the host to obtain the water element is 20%.]
Serpentera flicked his finger and shot his Qi toward Zhang Fei, which immediately entered his body through his chest.
[The chance for the host to obtain the water element has increased to 100%.]

The last notification made Zhang Fei smile in satisfaction, and Serpentera immediately spoke to Zhang Lin. "Now, return to your human form and form your darkness core first. After that, you can start studying the water and darkness elemental laws, and I will guide you to learn both."
Zhang Lin immediately returned to her human form, sat on Zhang Fei's side, and tried to form her darkness core.

paragraphs: "Master." Zhang Fei [5], who was contemplating matters related to Chao Mojie, turned to Tian Jianxia. "I received information that my two ancestors moved our race to another realm, but the two of them did not stay with them, and they went to another realm again."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [1] was surprised to hear that. "Which realm does your race live in now? Do they know the destination of Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing?"

Tian Jianxia informed him directly. "The Whitebone Beast Realm is where they went, but I don't know its exact location. As for our ancestors' destination, no one knows, especially since the two of them didn't tell anyone."

Since Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing decided to move their race members, Zhang Fei [1] was certain that Xereth had already attacked their realm, but he believed he would not stay in the Heavenly Moon Realm for too long. Moreover, he used Mo Xieshen to inform the demon of his presence in the upper realms, and he would probably come after him soon.

"Master, my brother and his group canceled their trip to the middle realms, and they are heading to the Whitebone Beast Realm now." Tian Jianxia's information disappointed Zhang Fei [1], especially since he wanted to capture those heavenly foxes. "Our ancestors were certain that Xereth would target our race's members, so they asked them to return."

Zhang Fei [1] contacted Tian Jiyuan, who was staying in the Sky Jade Realm. Unfortunately, the male heavenly fox also did not know the exact location of the Whitebone Beast Realm, but he ordered him to seek information from the other heavenly fox races.

Zhang Fei [1] then looked at Chao Mojie again, and he decided to draw his soul out of his body before giving him the demon slave mark. If the demon was in his prime condition, he wouldn't have been able to do that. However, the demon extermination sword had absorbed a lot of his demon power, which weakened him. "Contact Xereth now, and I want to know his next destination."

Chao Mojie helplessly nodded and contacted his lord directly. He told Xereth about the situation in the Blue Water Realm earlier, and he also told him that Mo Xieshen died at the hands of Zhang Fei [1].

Xereth asked how he managed to escape, and Chao Mojie told him that he was searching for the entrance to the Sunken Empire, but Mo Xieshen warned him about Zhang Fei [1] and the demon extermination sword, forcing him to escape straight away.
Xereth ordered Chao Mojie to wait for him at his current location, and he would meet him after picking up Feng Yichen.
After that, Chao Mojie informed Zhang Fei [1] that Xereth was going to Feng Yichen's location, causing him to frown.

Although he didn't want to deal with Xereth yet, Zhang Fei [1] thought it was a good opportunity to do something to the demon, especially since his fourth clone was heading to Feng Yichen's location together with Feng Yao.

Since the daily quests were finished, Zhang Fei [1] decided to go into the training space. He asked Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu to train together with Murong Qianying and Fei Qinyuan, and he himself went to the pavilion to help all his partners.
"Can you speed up this flying artifact?" Zhang Fei [4] asked Feng Yao. "We must reach that realm before Xereth, and I will use Feng Yichen to monitor him."

"We don't need to rush, especially since we're already close to Feng Yichen's location, and we'll arrive there at midnight. If your information is correct that Xereth previously attacked the Heavenly Moon Realm, he won't arrive at that realm before us, so we still have time to capture that dark phoenix." Feng Yao then observed Zhang Fei [4]. "You have recently obtained the ice element, but you are in the process of obtaining the water element now."

Zhang Fei [4] rubbed his nose and told Feng Yao about Serpentera. "I think I'm lucky because that old demon is not hostile to me, and he helped me obtain the water element. Moreover, he passed his bloodline to my little sister, turning Lin'er into the Abyssal Leviathan Dragon."
"Your luck keeps coming and going." Feng Yao then warned him. "Lin'er is the only Abyssal Leviathan Dragon in this universe, so you must protect her, especially when you go to the Paradise Realm."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded, then asked. "Hey, did you and Huo Ling come from the realm beyond the Paradise Realm?"
[Master, how did this kid know about that?] Huo Ling asked in shock.
Feng Yao herself was shocked by Zhang Fei [4]'s question, but she didn't show it in her expression. "Did the will of the universe tell you that?"

"Not really." Zhang Fei [4] shook his head in reply. "I asked the will of the universe about it, but it didn't give me an answer. However, I am not stupid, and its silence convinced me that the realm beyond the Paradise Realm does exist. Your response further confirmed my suspicion, so I hope you can tell me the truth."
"It does exist."
"As expected."

Feng Yao let out a soft sigh. "Actually, the realm cannot be said to be beyond the Paradise Realm, and the two are connected to each other. However, a powerful barrier prevents cultivators from the Paradise Realm from going there, especially since there is only destruction there."
"Destruction?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him. "There are no living creatures in that realm now, mainly because it was completely destroyed, including the air. The elemental laws that protected it have also disappeared, and the elements there have become unstable as a result, making it uninhabitable."

Zhang Fei [4] was shocked to hear that, but he remembered the images he saw in the final room in the Era of the Beginning. "I saw many things when I first arrived in that mysterious place, and one of the paintings there showed the destruction of that realm, which was the work of all the living races. However, I previously thought that it had been destroyed long ago, so I didn't expect that it still existed to this day. Did you and Huo Ling really come from that realm?"
"You will know our true identities after you go to the Paradise Realm." Feng Yao then pointed at his chest. "If you can't wait, improve your cultivation quickly and go there early."
Zhang Fei [4] smiled bitterly, especially since Feng Yao always kept things hidden from him. "I will summon my three partners here, and I will help them increase their cultivation."
"Sure."
Zhang Fei [4] then went to one of the rooms in the flying artifact before summoning Ilsath, Orith, and Zilvora.
Feng Yao looked at the room and muttered. "After today, he will have six elements, and the number of his elements will continue to increase in the future."
In the Sunken Empire, Zhang Fei's body was covered in a water bubble, and several whirlpools danced around him.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the water element.]
[The host's water element has reached the lower stage.]

In a few minutes, a water vortex emerged from the ocean and soared high into the air, shocking all the aquatic demons from the Blue Water Realm. After all, none of them had ever managed to enter the Sunken Empire, but an unusual phenomenon emerged from that place.

Those aquatic demons immediately moved towards that place again, especially the leaders of each race, except for Balena's parents. Unfortunately, they still couldn't detect the presence of the concealment formation, even though it was not far from their sight, preventing them from entering the place.

After a while, the water vortex gradually shrank and formed a translucent blue ball, which became clearer with each passing second. Soon, it was completely formed, and it quickly entered the ocean before entering Zhang Fei's body.
[Ding]
[The host successfully formed the peak grade water element core.]
Zhang Fei didn't stop, and he immediately learned the water elemental law, especially after Serpentera shared the method with him.

'This kid succeeded in forming his water core in one try— and a perfect one.' Serpentera then looked at Zhang Lin, who had just succeeded in forming her darkness core, but it was only upper rank. 'This little girl is not bad, but her talent is still below that of her husband.'

Just like her brother, Zhang Lin started to study the darkness law, but she had no difficulty in learning it, especially since Zhang Fei had taught her for a long time. After she mastered it, she began to study the water elemental law, and Serpentera guided her by speaking into her mind directly.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon aura.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels.]
Once again, the day changed along with the appearance of the three notifications. Zhang Fei stretched out both hands, and the seawater around him moved in response to his gestures.
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host has mastered the initial stage of the water elemental law.]
After the notification appeared, Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes and pulled back his hand, causing the water around them to calm down again.
"Your speed in forming your core and mastering the elemental laws is truly impressive." Serpentera spoke.

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh before answering her. "I have formed several elemental cores and mastered several elemental laws, and I can say that the water element is much easier than the other elements, so it is not difficult for me to do it."

"How many elements do you actually have?" Zhang Fei used his water element and created an air bubble around him before using all six elements simultaneously, shocking Serpentera. "What a freak! You were born and raised in the three mortal realms, but you have six elements. Moreover, almost all of your elements are in conflict with each other, such as light against darkness, fire against water and ice, and only your wind element does not conflict with them."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "I originally only had the elements of light, darkness, and fire. However, the wind fairy helped me obtain the wind element, the ice phoenix helped me obtain the ice element, and you helped me obtain the water element. My next target is the lightning element, and I have found the location of its seed. However, the lightning in that place is still too strong for me, so I will wait until my cultivation breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms."

"If you manage to obtain the lightning element, your attacks will become even more deadly, especially if you combine it with your water element." Serpentera suddenly raised her eyebrows, especially since Zhang Fei brought his fire and ice elements together. "Hey, kid, you—"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed as the Hellflame Ice Lotus appeared on his palm. "I've combined these two elements several times, and I've fully mastered it."

"What a crazy technique!" Serpentera shouted. "If the cultivators in the Paradise Realm see this lotus technique of yours, many of them will scramble to recruit you, but many of them will also try to kill you. Fire and ice are like oil and water, and the two can never be combined, yet you manage to combine them and form a new technique."
Zhang Fei dispelled the lotus and thought of something. His wind element appears in his left hand, and his water element in his right hand. "What will happen if I combine these two elements?"

"The wind element is not always related to speed, and it also has destructive power that is no less powerful than lightning or fire elements. Moreover, you can use the wind element for area attacks, and it can also serve as a shield." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Serpentera. "The water element can be said to be one of the softest elements, just like the light element. However, when used correctly, it can be lethal, capable of destroying hundreds or even thousands of warships in a single swipe. By the way, I've taught my water techniques to your wife, so you can learn them from her."
"Thank you." Zhang Fei then asked him. "Do you have a way to return to the Paradise Realm?"

Serpentera thought for a moment before nodding. "Instead of thinking about that, you should focus on reaching the Seven Divine Realms first. Once you reach that stage, you can come to me again, and we will discuss your chances to pass through that passage at that time."
"Is the passage really that difficult to pass?"
"Use all your strengthening techniques."
Zhang Fei was confused by that, but he immediately did as Serpentra wished. However, the ancient demon beast immediately struck his abdomen, causing him to roll back several times.
After he stabilized himself, Zhang Fei immediately shouted. "Fuck! You should have told me first if you wanted to attack me."

"Hahaha!" Serpentera laughed in satisfaction at Zhang Fei's reaction. "Your body is strong enough for a cultivator from the three mortal realms, but it's not enough to face the pressure in the passage, so you will never be able to get through it with your current body strength."
Zhang Fei released a heavy sigh. "All right then, I will improve my cultivation and body cultivation first, and I will see you again when I feel ready."
"Yeah."
Sometime later, Zhang Lin had successfully studied the water elemental law, and Zhang Fei immediately sent her back to the training space before leaving the Sunken Empire.
Serpentera instantly returned to his beast form and curled up. "Xereth, huh? Let's see if he dares to come to this realm, and I'll eat him alive if he does come here."
Zhang Fei had arrived at the Balena family residence and found her speaking with her family. She immediately asked him about her family's chances of becoming demon cultivators like her.
[Master, Balena's parents have cultivation veins, but her two siblings do not.] Mei informed Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei then told this to Balena, making her a little disappointed. "Can you do something for them like you did for Huang Rong and the others?"

"I can't." Zhang Fei shook his head in reply. "They are demon beasts from birth, so we can't use the same method for them. The only way for them to become demon cultivators is to implant other people's cultivation veins into their bodies, but the chances of finding one that suits their bodies are too slim."
Nymor immediately said to his daughter. "All right, you don't need to think about us. Moreover, we enjoy our lives more in this realm, and we want to spend the rest of our lives here."
"But—"

"Your father is right." Druka also spoke to her. "We are too old now, so we want to enjoy our old age. Moreover, we don't have the passion to be demon cultivators in the first place, so you don't need to think about that. Honestly, I want you to stay here with us, but your path is different from ours now. You have also chosen Zhang Fei as your future husband, so you can go with him to explore this universe, and we will always wait for you to come back here."
Balena inwardly sighed and asked Zhang Fei. "Can I stay in this realm for a while?"

"Sure." Zhang Fei immediately agreed. "You guys have been separated for hundreds of years, so you can stay with them for now. However, I will return to our place to stabilize my cultivation, especially since I want to break through to the 4-Star Heaven Realm as soon as possible."

After he spent some time with Balena's family, Zhang Fei immediately returned to the pavilion in the training space, and he helped Zhang Lin to increase her demon power while stabilizing his cultivation.

Meanwhile, Feng Yao's flying artifact had already approached a realm, and she released a small fire phoenix, which immediately flew into it. She then spoke to Zhang Fei [4]. "It will lead us to Feng Yichen."

chapters.title: Chapter 855: Meet Ji Changlan
paragraphs: Feng Yichen, who was resting inside the cave, was shocked by an explosion at the entrance. Soon, the small fire phoenix flew into it, and it immediately attacked her.
"Shit!" Feng Yichen counterattacked using her dark flames, but it dispelled her attacks and slammed into her body directly. "Argh."

In a few moments, Feng Yao had appeared in front of Feng Yichen, followed by Zhang Fei [4] behind her. The phoenix princess immediately waved her hand, and several flame chains instantly bound the Dark Phoenix, starting from her hands, legs, neck, and waist.
"You bitch!" Feng Yichen cursed as she spat at Feng Yao.

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled and moved in front of Feng Yichen before sealing her cultivation. "You are not my opponent in your prime condition, let alone in your weakest condition. However, I didn't come here to kill you, especially since you are still valuable to Zhang Fei [4]."
Feng Yichen's face turned ashen because of that, especially when she saw the strange smile on Zhang Fei [4]'s face. "Don't come near me! What... what are you going to do?"
Zhang Fei [4] didn't listen to Feng Yichen, stood in front of her, and touched her forehead. "I certainly won't miss the opportunity to obtain a beast contract as powerful as you, right?"
"No!" Feng Yichen shouted as she tried to shake Zhang Fei [4]'s hand away. "Don't! Don't do this! I don't want to be anyone's contract beast!"
'Do it, Mei.'
[Aye, sir~]

The next second, a white light appeared on their foreheads, and the light was so bright that it blinded them. A few minutes later, the white light disappeared, and a white fox symbol appeared on Feng Yichen's forehead. A dark phoenix symbol also appeared on Zhang Fei [4]'s forehead, followed by two notifications in his mind.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the fourth beast contract.]
[The beast feature has been upgraded to level four.]

Zhang Fei [4] didn't stop there, and he decided to replicate Feng Yichen's soul before merging it with his. This way, the Dark Phoenix will always be bound to him, whether dead or alive, and she will never be able to betray him.
After Zhang Fei [4] finished, Feng Yao immediately let go of Feng Yichen and unsealed her cultivation, causing her to fall to the ground and hatefully stare at the two of them.
Feng Yao tilted her head at Zhang Fei [4]. "There are two strong beasts left, and I think it's time for you to tame one of them first."

"I will face Tianguo soon, and I will make that black dog my next beast contract." Zhang Fei [4] then squatted in front of Feng Yichen, and he gave her three bottles of pills. "I know you resent me for forcing you to work for me, but I won't mistreat you. Xereth is strong, but you know he's a slave to the beast cultivator in the Paradise Realm, and if you follow him, you're no better. Furthermore, I possess items he lacks, including these pills. The first bottle contains my basic pills, the second bottle contains healing and recovery pills, and the third bottle contains six types of beast pills. After you swallow my basic and beast pills, you will realize that following me will be much more beneficial for you. By the way, I won't be taking you with me for now, and I want you to keep an eye on Xereth for me so I can decide my next move against him."

After he said that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately stood up and led Feng Yao out of the cave, leaving Feng Yichen to lament her fate. The Phoenix Princess immediately took out her flying artifact again, and the two left the realm at full speed. At first, he wanted to wait for Xereth to arrive in that realm, but he changed his mind, and he wanted to get the Earth Flames to increase his flame power.

Feng Yichen's expression looked desperate and full of sorrow after she was forced to become Zhang Fei [4]'s contract beast. She then opened the bottle containing healing and recovery pills, but their grade shocked her. She then opened the other two bottles, which shocked her further. "Superior grade pills? How can a weak cultivator like him have so many such high-grade pills?"

Feng Yichen immediately swallowed some healing and recovery pills, especially since her condition was too weak because of her fight with Feng Yao back then. After her condition recovered enough, she immediately swallowed the basic pills one by one, and their effect amazed her, especially since they repaired and enhanced her foundation.

After that, Feng Yichen swallowed the six beast pills, and their effects further amazed her. The Beast Talent Pill helped her improve her talent, and the Beast Advancement Pill gave her the opportunity to evolve beyond the mythical rank. The Beast Body Tempering Pill made her body stronger, the Beast Vitality Pill and the Beast Soul Pill increased her vitality and soul power, and the Beast Bloodline Pill made her bloodline stronger and purer.

"Where did he get all these pills? None of them are ordinary, and all of them have amazing effects." Feng Yichen fell into contemplation, thinking about her situation, especially about her new status as a contract beast. She then contacted Xereth and asked for his location, and he told her that he would arrive at her location in three days. She was confused when he told her about Zhang Fei [4] and the demon extermination sword. "How could he be in the Blue Water Realm if he had just left this realm? Could he have used a clone to kill Mo Xieshen? How could a clone be a match for him? Sigh! All our plans went awry just because of a single cultivator! Moreover, the fire phoenix seemed to come from that realm, or else she wouldn't be that strong."
Zhang Fei [4] and Feng Yao stood side by side at the front end of the flying artifact. "How long will it take us to arrive at the Scorching Earth Realm?"
"About two weeks or so."

"I see." Zhang Fei [4] let out a soft sigh as he couldn't wait to get the Earth Flame. "Do you know the location of the Whitebone Beast Realm? I received information that Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing moved their race members to that realm, but the two of them didn't stay there and went to another realm instead. Therefore, I thought of going to that realm while they were absent, and I wouldn't have to deal with them."

"Aren't your thoughts too simple?" Feng Yao responded with a faint smile. "The Heavenly Fox Race won't weaken without Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, and they are still strong without them. You might be able to fight against cultivators at the Divine Ascendant Realm with the help of your speed and clones, but you can only do so if there are only a few of them. That fox race has many beasts at the Divine Ascendant Realm, and some of them have reached the Divine Ascension Realm. Moreover, I already told you that I won't help you anymore, and the others won't find trouble with them either. If you go there alone, you will suffer your first defeat in the upper realms, so you should forget about your intention to fight them with your current strength."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "All right, I will not be hasty to face them, and I will face them after I break through to the Seven Divine Realms."

"That's good." Feng Yao then told him. "If my guess is correct, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing should be on their way to the Sovereign Heaven Realm right now. Therefore, you will meet them there if you go to that realm to look for the Sky Flames, but you don't need to worry because they won't dare to act recklessly there even with their current strength. There are many ancient people in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and their strength has already surpassed cultivators outside their realm, so you can't underestimate them."

Zhang Fei [4] had already heard about the strength of the people in the Sovereign Heaven Realm from the will of the universe, so he was not too surprised by it. "Do you think there are cultivators in the Five Celestial Realms there?"

"No." Feng Yao immediately denied that. "Ever since the three mortal realms separated from the Paradise Realm, no cultivator has managed to break through to that stage. Summon your partner and help them increase their cultivation, especially since you will need their help in the future."
"All right." Zhang Fei [4] immediately walked away as he summoned Orith, Ilsath, and Zilvora.
[You shouldn't have said that, Master. That kid is too arrogant with his abilities, so you should let him experience defeat for the first time.]

Feng Yao responded to Huo Ling with a shake of her head. "Zhang Fei [4] will experience his first defeat in the near future, and it will change his view of the true cultivation world. If he falls into depression and cannot accept his defeat, he will never be worthy of going to the Paradise Realm, let alone going to our realm. If he succeeds in overcoming his defeat and improving his mindset, he will become stronger overall, and he will be ready to face the situation there."

[All this time, that kid has always been proud of his speed, but his speed will become useless once he goes to the Paradise Realm, and he will face too many deadly challenges there. With his current strength and mindset, he won't be able to do anything against those people, and they will force him to hide like a weak rat.]

Feng Yao felt helpless listening to Huo Ling's words, especially since she was much more arrogant than Zhang Fei [4]. "The matters in the three mortal realms will reach their culmination soon, and we will go to the Paradise Realm at that time."
A few hours later.

Since only one black demon statue was left, Cheng Gaoji and Gong Ren worked together to get rid of it as soon as possible. This way, Xereth would not be able to invade their realm from within, giving them more time to devise a strategy to stop him.

On the map, Zhang Xiaolong [3] found Ji Changlan, the leader of the blacksmith union, at the shop. Since Lin Moxian and the others were busy with their affairs, he decided to go see the old man, especially since he needed forging materials to forge the earth-grade equipment.
Do you want to join our organization, kid?" Ji Changlan promptly inquired as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] entered his room.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sat in front of Ji Changlan. "Senior, I appreciate your offer, but I would rather not join any organization. Actually, I came here to discuss the blacksmith organization in the Divine Flame Realm, especially since that organization is under you."
"Your refusal disappoints me, kid." Ji Changlan replied with a disappointed look. "What do you want from that organization?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Ji Changlan about his desire to bring Jiang Shen and the others into his organization. "I have discussed the matter with them before, but that old man asked me to talk to you first. "Hmm?" Ji Changlan thought for a moment before making another offer. "How about we split the organization into two? All the blacksmithing matters for that organization will still be under my control, but they can join you to take care of other things. Additionally, our two organizations will collaborate with each other, and I think our cooperation will benefit both parties."
"What kind of cooperation do you want?"
Tap... Tap...

Ji Changlan lightly tapped his finger on the table. "Since you want to open many shops in the lower and middle realms, I will supply your shops with forging materials and finished equipment. Naturally, I will not ask for space in your shop for free, and we will split the sales proceeds 90:10."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought it wasn't bad, especially since he didn't have time to look for forging materials. Moreover, forging equipment took a long time, and he couldn't possibly supply all the shops. "Senior, your offer is interesting, but the benefits to my side are too small. If you are willing to split it 50:50, I will accept your offer."
"What if it's 80:20?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "60:40 is my final offer, and if you are willing to accept it, we will start working together. There are too many planets in the lower and middle realms, and you don't have the human resources to take care of them all, or you would have done it yourself long ago. My people will take care of all those matters, and I will also provide all the places, so you don't have to bother with all that."

"All right, I accept your offer; 60:40, then." Ji Changlan decided to accept it because he lacked the human resources to manage everything, and his organization would still maintain full control over the much larger market in the upper realms compared to the lower and middle realms. "How about we discuss the details after the situation in this realm is calmer?"
"Sure." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took out a piece of paper and gave it to Ji Changlan. "Senior, are these materials available in your store?"

Ji Changlan immediately read the list of forging materials one by one. "Most of them are available in my shop, but I don't have some of them, like the Verdant Vine Alloy, the Molten Heart Crystal, the Heavenly Star Mithril, and the Dragonbone Iron. I can ask my people in the Jiangong Realm to send them here, but it will take some time for them to arrive in this realm."

"Please ask them to send these materials here as soon as possible." Ji Changlan nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3] and contacted his people immediately. "Oh! I also need dozens of luminous Qi crystals, especially since Old Cheng needs them to forge my weapon."
"What kind of weapon requires the luminous Qi crystal?" Ji Changlan asked in confusion.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] simply smiled at that, especially since he didn't want others to copy his weapon. "I'm sorry, but that weapon is my special weapon, and I won't show it to anyone. If you copy it and sell it, it will be a loss for me."

Ji Changlan nodded in understanding. "All right, I will contact you immediately once my people arrive in this realm with those materials, but their prices are definitely not cheap, so you better prepare your jewels."
"I know."

Ji Changlan leaned back in his chair after Zhang Xiaolong [3] left, thinking about his weapon. "Tch! That kid is deliberately making me curious! I'm going to find Cheng Gaoji now and ask him about that weapon!"
