chapters.title: Chapter 856: Zhu Shanniang
paragraphs: After he left Ji Changlan's shop, Zhang Xiaolong [3] strolled around the trading area to observe the situation in that area, especially the habits of the realm's residents. Unfortunately, the area was not as crowded as usual, especially after Zhe Wuming declared an emergency situation in the realm.
As for the Xiong Clan's shop, it was closed because Zhe Wuming had sealed the shop, but he didn't do anything to the goods inside.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to go to the area where all the restaurants gathered, but he met Wang Yourou, who was deliberately looking for him. "What are you doing here?"
"Didn't you already know my reason?" Wang Yourou turned the question around.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head in response. "I don't have time for you now, so you can come back in a few days."
"Humph." Wang Yourou snorted softly. "Where are you going now?"
"I want to look around the restaurant area to confirm something." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nonchalantly replied to her.
"I will accompany you there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow at Wang Yourou. "I'm hungry, so I want to go there."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then put on a playful smile and leaned closer to Wang Yourou. "Tell me, have you fallen in love with me?"
"No!" Wang Yourou exclaimed and immediately ran away. "Let's go! I'm really hungry!"
'This woman!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately followed her.

Later, they reached the restaurant area, but many were closed because the owners hid in their respective clans. Wang Yourou bought many snacks there, making Zhang Xiaolong [3] feel amused by her behavior, especially since she acted like a child while enjoying them.
"Do you want some?" Wang Yourou asked, handing him some snacks.
"You can enjoy them yourself." Zhang Xiaolong [3] refused her, and he then looked towards an abandoned building on one side. "Do you know the owner of that building?"

"Hmm?" Wang Yourou turned towards the building Zhang Xiaolong [3] was referring to. "If I'm not mistaken, the owner of that building is the Ying Clan. Back then, they had a restaurant, but they closed it after their head chef died. Since then, no one has used the building again, and it remains abandoned to this day. Are you planning to open a restaurant in this realm?"

"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a light nod. "My grandmother's dishes are the best, and diners consistently fill all my restaurants in several realms. Since I need many jewels, I want to open a restaurant in this realm, and I will bring the main chef of my restaurant here."
"Do you have samples of the dishes?" Wang Yourou curiously asked.

"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled and pinched her cheeks, but Wang Yourou immediately swatted his hand away. "You're such a glutton, you know that? You're holding a lot of snacks, but you're still thinking about other food."

Wang Yourou pouted her lips in response, making Zhang Xiaolong [3] itch to kiss her. "I've liked food, and I'm always interested in trying new foods. Moreover, we are cultivators, and we can burn all the fat in our bodies, so I don't have to worry about getting fat."

"I don't have samples of them, but I can ask my grandmother to prepare them." Wang Yourou's eyes sparkled like stars after Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that, making him sigh softly. He immediately contacted his grandmother and asked her to cook some dishes. "She's preparing them now, and you can taste them later."

"Haha." Wang Yourou softly laughed before asking. "Are you interested in buying that building? If you want that building, I will accompany you to the Ying Clan, and you can negotiate the price yourself."
"Sure." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately agreed with that, so Wang Yourou right away led him to leave the restaurant area.

Suddenly, Zhang Xiaolong [3] sensed a cold and hostile gaze toward him, and he immediately opened the map to check. He wasn't too surprised to find its owner, especially since Feng Jiu had already told him about that person. 'Zhu Sanniang, the vermilion bird, huh? I don't know about the matter between her and the heavenly fox race, but I hope she doesn't bother me.'
Unfortunately, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hope was in vain, especially since Zhu Shanniang suddenly appeared in front of them.

Zhu Shanniang was a beautiful woman, with long red hair adorning her head. Her facial features were soft yet striking, with red eyes that added a mysterious allure to her face. Her appearance was graceful in her red and gold clothes, which seemed to be a mix of traditional and armor-like attire, with an ornament and gemstone around her chest area.
Zhu Shanniang possessed a curvaceous but well-proportioned figure, with a narrow waist, prominent bust, and graceful posture. Her body conveys both strength and feminine elegance.

Despite her high cultivation, Wang Yourou was still frightened by the hot and blazing aura emanating from Zhu Shanniang's body, and she immediately hid behind Zhang Xiaolong [3]. 'Tch! The vermilion bird is much scarier than the phoenix.'
Unlike her, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not the least bit daunted by Zhu Shanniang's aura; instead, he released his own aura and mixed it with his killing intent, causing her to frown. 'Scan her, Mei.'
Name: Zhu Shanniang
Gender: Female
Race: Vermilion Bird
Rank: Mythical Beast
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm
Element: Fire [Peak Stage]
Elemental Law: Fire [Half Perfection Stage]
Core: Fire Core [Upper Rank]
Physique: Vermilion Physique
Special Physique: Crimson Flame Body
Partner: None
Like: Zhu Hong
Dislike: Heaven Fox Race
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked her. "Why are you blocking our way, Senior?"
"Are you really a heavenly fox?" Zhu Shanniang asked as she released more of her aura to further intimidate Zhang Xiaolong [3].

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still relaxed facing Zhu Shanniang, and he activated his demon eyes while disguising them so the woman in front of him would not notice that his eyes had turned blood red.
'What the hell is this? Why do I suddenly feel afraid of him?' Zhu Shanniang muttered as she trembled slightly.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] answered her right away. "I am indeed a heavenly fox, but I am not one of them, and I became a heavenly fox for a certain reason."
"Do you think I'm a stupid woman you can lie to?" Zhu Shanniang narrowed her eyes at him.

[You obtained 1 ancient map.]

[Heaven-Earth Essence Bead: This bead is formed naturally at the point of convergence of heaven and earth Qi, accelerating the owner's Qi absorption.]

Zhang Fei then tried to absorb Qi from the air, and the results surprised him quite a bit because the bead helped him absorb Qi faster. Not only did the bead distribute Qi evenly throughout his body, but it also equally distributed it into his six cores. 'This bead is really good! Zhang Fei took the ancient map, but it was too worn to be difficult to read, so he returned it to the system's inventory. 'Mei, scan the map and reorder the images.'
[Yes, Master.]

paragraphs: Three days had passed.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels sent to the inventory.]
For the past three days, Zhang Xiaolong [3] barely did anything except stabilize his cultivation in his room at Cheng Gaoji's residence.

Since Zhang Xiaolong [3] was too immersed in his activities, Lin Moxian and the others did not disturb him, and they helped their seniors to prepare everything to face Xereth, who could come at any time.
Wang Yourou had always come to Zhang Xiaolong [3] in the past three days to ask for new dishes, but she could only resign herself to waiting for him to wake up.

Although Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s cultivation was still not completely stable, it was already half stable, especially since his main body and the other four clones had never stopped to stabilize it for the past three days.

[Master, according to my estimation, your body cultivation level will break through to the Meridian Cleansing Stage in one to two months as long as you continue to use the Yang Tempering Liquid to temper your body. It will increase your Qi circulation, physical strength, and endurance even further. Once you break through to the Bone Forging Stage, your skeleton will become much stronger and less easily broken.]

'Let's reach the Meridian Cleansing Stage before thinking about the Bone Forging Stage.' After all, his body cultivation level is much more difficult to improve than his cultivation and soul level, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] is not too hasty to think about the stage that is still far away.
*Knock... Knock...*
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the door, finding Feng Jiu standing there. "Did something happen, Empress Feng?"

"Nothing serious happened in the past three days, but Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji have successfully removed the last black demon statue." Feng Jiu then informed him of something else. "The Nameless One will activate the main barrier today, so this is your last chance to leave this realm. If you don't leave now, you won't be able to leave for quite some time, and I think it will be a loss for you, especially since you can do other things instead of staying here."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding at that. "Actually, I don't have much else to do right now, so it doesn't matter if I stay or go. My fourth clone is on his way to the Scorching Earth Realm with your daughter, and my fifth clone is on his way to the Sky Dragon Realm with Senior Xishui."
"If you want to stay, I won't force you to leave." Feng Jiu then asked him. "How do you feel about my daughter? Do you like her?"

"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed awkwardly at her questions. "Empress Feng, what man wouldn't be interested in your daughter? Feng Yao is beautiful and sexy, and most importantly, she is a powerful woman. However, she is not an ordinary woman due to her past memories, and I have a challenging time understanding her thoughts at times. Sometimes, I feel she is within my reach, but other times she seems too far away, making it difficult for me to connect with her."

Feng Jiu nodded her head repeatedly. "My daughter has always been like that since she was born, and I often have difficulty understanding her thoughts. You are the only man who has ever been that close to Yao'er, and she is even willing to help you so much. I will root for you to get my daughter, and I will be thrilled to have a son-in-law like you."
"Let's talk about this matter in the future, Empress Feng." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked back. "Has Feng Yao told you about her new plan?"
"Yes." Feng Jiu explained further. "Yao'er has already told me about it, and she has decided to take me and my husband to the Paradise Realm after the Xereth matter has passed."

"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was momentarily taken aback. "What about the phoenix race and the phoenix realm if the three of you go to the Paradise Realm? Is Feng Yao also planning to take Feng Shen and Feng Xueying to go there?"

Feng Jiu informed him directly. "Yao'er doesn't plan to take them to the Paradise Realm, and she wants them to stay behind to protect our realm after we leave. As long as Xereth doesn't make a mess in the three mortal realms, they will definitely be able to protect our realm, so we don't need to worry about it."
"What about the Nameless One?" Feng Jiu shook her head at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Honestly, Feng Yao's sudden decision surprised me, but she seems to have already planned some things for that realm."

"Hehe." Feng Jiu chuckled and patted his shoulder. "If you miss my daughter, you should improve yourself as soon as possible. Although you have many clones, you should forget about other things and focus on your cultivation. That way, you can go to the Paradise Realm sooner, and the two of you will reunite there."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his nose. "For now, my main body is focused on my cultivation and other things, and he will never come out of my private space again. After the matter with Xereth and some of my other matters are finished, we will enter seclusion again."
"That's good." Feng Jiu then turned to leave. "I'm going to meet the Nameless One and the others now."

After Feng Jiu left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] sat on his bed again and activated the Mind Connect to communicate with Feng Yichen, and the Dark Phoenix informed him that Xereth was about to arrive at her location.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] ordered Feng Yichen to do something, but he did not cut off their communication, and he waited for the demon to arrive at her location.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly remembered Gong Ren and the Earth, and he hurriedly left his room to meet the old man. However, the old man was still at Xie Wuming's place, so he waited in his residence while stabilizing his cultivation. 'Since there are so many powerful cultivators in this realm, let them take care of everything, and I will focus on myself.'
Feng Yichen, who was cultivating in the cave, immediately opened his eyes as soon as he received a voice message. She hurriedly left the cave and waited for Xereth, who arrived a few moments later.

Since the Mind Connect was still connected to Feng Yichen, Zhang Fei and all his clones could see Xereth clearly. However, the demon extermination sword in his body was vibrating violently, and it was eager to kill the demon.
"Hmm?" Xereth raised an eyebrow as he examined Feng Yichen's body. "Has your condition fully recovered now?"

Feng Yichen nodded. "My condition has fully recovered since yesterday, but I don't think we need to go to the Blue Water Realm. I'm sure that kid already knows about your strength from Mo Xieshen, and I believe he won't be waiting for you there. Instead, you can send Fa Ling and some other demons there, and we'll go take care of some other things, like the Abyssal Realm. If we keep failing, that guy will punish you, and we might die at his hands."

Xereth's expression turned unpleasant once Feng Yichen mentioned their failure, but he was eager to get the demon extermination sword, especially since it could kill him. "There was a slight change in our plans because Long Jiutian disappeared, and some of my statues were sent into the void by the Nameless One."
Feng Yichen was shocked after hearing that, but she immediately guessed that Zhang Fei and Feng Yao were the masterminds behind the incident.

"Besides, Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian disappeared from their realm, and they also moved their race members to another realm. I have ordered Mo Zhuo and several demon leaders to look for them, but I'm sure they won't be able to find the foxes in a short time." Xereth's information shocked Feng Yichen further, especially since all their plans collapsed one by one. "Xue Yuemozi has also contacted me, but those idiots from the Blackthorn Abyss Realm still haven't managed to find the whereabouts of Alder and his daughter."

Feng Yichen then asked him. "So, where are we going now? It will take us a few days to arrive at the Blue Water Realm, but I still think that there is no point in us going there because that kid must have already left that realm. Moreover, the Abyssal Realm is closer than this realm, so I think our best option is to go there to seize the Nine Yin Soul Banner first."

"All right, we will go to the Abyssal Realm now, and we will go to the Blue Water Realm after we get the Nine Yin Soul Banner." Xereth immediately flew away from the place, followed by Feng Yichen, who flew behind him.
'Hey! What is the Nine Yin Soul Banner?' Zhang Fei suddenly asked her.

Feng Yichen explained it to him directly. 'The Nine Yin Soul Banner is an ancient demon artifact woven from the silk of Yin Ghost Spiders and inked with the blood of nine ancient demons. After that, it was sunk into the depths of the Nether Yin Abyss for ten thousand years to undergo a ritual, and the ritual used countless demon souls as sacrifices.'
'What an evil artifact!' Zhang Fei let out a low cry. 'What is the function of the banner?'

'The Nine Yin Soul Banner has several functions, such as binding soul seals, forcibly sealing the soul of a defeated cultivator into one of the nine soul seals, and strengthening the banner. The Yin Domain suppresses divine senses and weakens the soul defenses of enemies within its range. The best function is that we can summon up to nine soul wraiths, each born from the trapped soul of a powerful living being in each seal. You can use these wraiths in battle or for soul hunts, as they retain fragments of their past abilities.
'Who is the owner of the Nine Yin Soul Banner? How could it be in the Abyssal Realm?' Zhang Fei questioned her again.

Feng Yichen inwardly sighed before explaining. 'According to the news, the first owner of the Nine Yin Soul Banner was the Heavenly Fiend Demon God. In the past, he fought with a powerful female cultivator from the Radiance Domain, and she managed to defeat him. She managed to snatch the banner from his hands and threw it into the three mortal realms, and it was found by the first Demon Emperor of the Abyssal Realm. Since then, it was in their hands, and it helped them become the best demon realm in the upper realms.'

Feng Yichen's answer shocked Zhang Fei, especially since Nalan Yushu said that the Heavenly Fiend Demon God was the third strongest after the Celestial Demon God and the Asura Demon God. As for the female cultivator from the Radiance Domain, he suspected that she was related to the golden-haired woman, especially since her light element was extremely pure and strong.

'I heard from Feng Shen that you managed to steal the totem after you transformed into the dark phoenix, and I need it to accomplish something. Feng Yichen felt a dilemma about telling Zhang Fei the truth, but she had no other choice but to tell him the consequences of their souls merging. 'According to the legend, the Divine Phoenix Totem was created from the corpse and essence of the first fire phoenix, and it was bathed in true phoenix flames for hundreds of thousands of years. If a fire phoenix race manages to get it and become its master, he or she will gain the strength of the first fire phoenix.'

'The strength of the first fire phoenix?' Zhang Fei naturally remembered the phoenix statue in the second room of the Era of the Beginning, but he did not expect that the Divine Phoenix Totem was created from its corpse.

Feng Yichen nodded slightly. 'The current fire phoenixes are feared by many living beings because our flames can incinerate many things, but the power of the first fire phoenix is beyond common sense. Just a spat of its flames can destroy a realm, and its flames can also burn the souls of living beings, preventing them from being reincarnated.'
'Did you succeed in becoming the master of the Divine Phoenix Totem?' Zhang Fei inquired in a serious tone.

'No.' Feng Yichen replied disappointedly. 'For hundreds of thousands of years, there has never been a fire phoenix who succeeded in becoming its master. After I snatched it from them, I tried to subdue it, but it refused me. Instead, it attacked me and worsened my injury, and it disappeared on its own afterward. I have searched for it in various realms with high fire intensity, but I have never managed to find it. I went to the Phoenix Realm to capture Feng Shen and Feng Xueying as well as to look for the banner there, but you and Feng Yao stopped me.'
'Is there a possibility that the totem returned to the Phoenix Realm by itself?'
'Yes.'
Zhang Fei then asked her again. 'Is there any advantage for me if I succeed in subduing the totem?'

Feng Yichen answered immediately. 'According to legend, if another living being manages to obtain the totem and become its master, he or she will gain all the abilities of the first fire phoenix. If fire cultivators obtain it, the power of their fire will increase significantly.'

'In that case, I will look for the totem in that realm, and I will try to subdue it if I manage to find it.' Feng Yichen chose not to comment on that, and Zhang Fei immediately cut off their connection after he gave her a few orders. 'Sigh! I don't know if he'll be able to find the banner, but I hope he won't.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried to open the portal to the training space, and it turned out that the giant dome did not prevent him from opening it. He then opened a gate, which also appeared in front of him. 'Haha! I thought I couldn't open both, but it turns out the giant dome doesn't affect them. This way, I don't have to worry about anything, and I can escape whenever I want.'
"Have you been waiting for me long?" Gong Ren asked as he landed in front of him.

"Not really." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then explained to Gong Ren about the devices he needed to clean up air pollution on Earth. In addition, he shared some of his memories with the old man, particularly those related to Earth's pollution. "As you can see, the pollution there is too bad, and it prevents the Qi from returning. That's why I hope you can help me create the devices, and I will use them to clean the air there."
Gong Ren nodded in understanding before posing a question. "Wouldn't it be better if there was no Qi in that realm? No Qi, no cultivators, and no chaos there."

"You're wrong, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a shake of his head. "Even without Qi, the situation in that realm has never been peaceful, and wars continue to occur in various countries. Those people are too greedy, and the nature in that realm is getting worse as time goes by. Since I rely on that realm for the long term, I want to take action to prevent its destruction."
"Let's go in."

Feng Jiu informed him directly.

"What about the Nameless One?" Feng Jiu shook her head at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Honestly, Feng Yao's sudden decision surprised me, but she seems to have already planned some things for that realm."

"If you miss my daughter, you should improve yourself as soon as possible.
Although you have many clones, you should forget about other things and focus on your cultivation.
That way, you can go to the Paradise Realm sooner, and the two of you will reunite there."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his nose.
"For now, my main body is focused on my cultivation and other things, and he will never come out of my private space again.

"That's good." Feng Jiu then turned to leave.
"I'm going to meet the Nameless One and the others now."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly remembered Gong Ren and the Earth, and he hurriedly left his room to meet the old man.

chapters.title: Chapter 858: The Sky Dragon Realm
paragraphs: "So, how big is the planet?"
"About 317 million square miles."

Gong Ren nodded in understanding before leaving for the back room, but a few minutes later, he returned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], carrying hundreds of palm-sized devices with him. "At first, I thought your planet was as big as this realm, but it turned out to be so small, and all these devices are more than enough to help you clean the air on such a small planet. You only need to spread them in the sky, and they will automatically absorb the pollution. The air will be completely clean in a month, but I can't guarantee whether the Qi will return."

"A month?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised to hear that the process was so fast, especially since he initially thought that it would take several months or even years. "How many devices do you use in this realm, Senior?"

"A million." Gong Ren then explained to Zhang Xiaolong about the devices, including the materials used to make them. "No modern weapons can damage these devices, and they can only be destroyed by cultivators like us. Since there are no cultivators in that realm, you don't need to be afraid that they will be damaged. As for their cost, you don't need to think about it, especially since the information about Xereth that you gave us is far more valuable than these devices. If that demon comes to this realm and destroys it, too many people will suffer losses."
"Thank you, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stored all devices in the system's inventory.

Gong Ren immediately spoke of something else. "Cheng Gaoji told me about your weapon, but the weapon he created for you is still not perfect, and I will help you perfect it. Once it is perfect, its explosive power will increase several times, especially when you use the fire element through it."
"Thank you for that, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was overjoyed because of Gong Ren's intentions. "Since I have obtained these devices, I will spread them in the sky of my planet now."
"Let's go then; I will meet Cheng Gaoji at his residence."
Thereafter, the two went to Cheng Gaojie's residence, and Gong Ren met the old man. Zhang Xiaolong [3], on the other hand, returned to his room and continued to stabilize his cultivation.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] and his partners were already standing in the sky on Earth. However, he was furious because all countries were cutting down the trees that Janette and Lillea had grown on a large scale.
"Master, the people on this planet are simply too stupid." Han Xuenai said those words while shaking her head.

Luo Yu also spoke. "Most humans are indeed stupid and annoying, and they can never appreciate nature. Janette and Lillea have taken great pains to accelerate the growth of those trees, and they have also created many new trees to improve nature, but they have started to destroy everything again."
"Fei, if I were you, I would destroy all their strange equipment, and they wouldn't be able to harm nature anymore." Gu Yan chimed in.

Huan Ya then asked him. "Why don't you just take over this realm, Master? With your current strength, you can suppress these morons, and you can force them to submit to you. If they are unwilling to submit to you, you just need to kill them."
"Huan Ya!" Xi Zihua and the others shouted at her.
Huan Ya turned to them. "What?"

"What, your ass!" Yan Luan'er then explained. "These people are just ordinary humans who don't have any power, so it's unethical for cultivators like us to kill them. Moreover, Zhang Fei's bad karma is already too much, and his bad karma will increase even more if he kills ordinary humans like them, which will make his lightning tribulation even stronger."

Shi Yue suddenly had an idea. "Fei, I think you can control their leaders instead of killing them. This way, you can order them to carry out all your orders, and their subordinates shouldn't dare refuse them, right?"

"Unfortunately, the situation on this planet is different from the cultivation realms, and most of the countries on it will change leaders every few years." Zhang Fei [1] then distributed those devices to them and explained how to operate them. "All right, you guys don't need to mind their actions and help me spread these devices in the sky now. After that, I will go to the Blue Water Realm to pick up Balena, and we will go straight to the Demon Purgatory Realm."

They quickly spread worldwide to install the devices, which was easy with their current cultivation. After they finished, Zhang Fei [1] directly sent them back to the training space, but he didn't return with them, and he went to all the warehouses in several countries to take stock of those earth items for all his shops.

After he was done, Zhang Fei [1] went to the Blue Water Realm, and he found Balena with her parents and two siblings. He then took her away from that realm, and their next destination was the Demon Purgatory Realm, which was Wang Yin's home realm.

Meanwhile, Xereth and Feng Yichen have arrived at the Abyssal Realm, but the barrier is blocking them. Even so, they can see the Demon Emperor and ancient demons of the realm from behind the barrier, and their expressions are very calm without the slightest worry that the two of them will succeed in breaking their barrier.

Their expressions made Xereth furious, and he immediately unleashed his strength to attack the barrier. His attack caused the realm to experience a violent tremor in all corners, but the barrier did not crack at all, let alone break. "What the hell is this barrier? How is it capable of withstanding the full force of my attack?
"Let me try it." Feng Yichen crossed her arms over her chest, and her body was quickly enveloped in dark flames. She then shot her dark flames toward the barrier, and they quickly enveloped it.
Feng Yichen and Xereth could hear cracking sounds from the barrier, but it automatically repaired itself, making the cracks that appeared quickly close again.

The Demon Emperor and his subordinates laughed smugly from behind the barrier. "I knew you two were strong, especially you, Xereth. Unfortunately, this realm has changed a lot since you killed my fourth predecessor, and you will never be able to break our barrier."

"You bastard! If I manage to break this barrier, I will absorb all your power, and I will slaughter all the demons in this realm!" Xereth furiously shouted as he launched another attack on the barrier, but the result was still the same, and the barrier remained intact.
"Haha." The Demon Emperor laughed at him. "You can try, but your efforts will only be in vain."
Xereth turned to Feng Yichen, who nodded at him. The two of them immediately unleashed their full strength, combined it, and attacked the barrier at the same time.
The Demon Emperor and his subordinates tensed as many cracks appeared, but their tension disappeared as soon as those cracks closed again.

Even so, Feng Yichen and Xereth did not stop attacking the barrier, and both took out several artifacts to help them, but all their efforts were fruitless. 'Do you think someone from the Paradise Realm came down here and helped them create this barrier?'

'I think so.' Feng Yichen replied with a nod. 'This barrier is too powerful for the three mortal realms, and its power surpasses the barrier in the Phoenix Realm. However, I cannot understand that person's reason for coming down here and helping these demons.'
'Did that person intentionally help them to protect the Nine Yin Soul Banner?' Xereth asked with a frown.

'Your guess is probably correct, especially since the banner belongs to the Heavenly Fiend Demon God.' Feng Yichen then asked. 'Should we go to another realm first? No matter how hard we attack this barrier, we won't be able to break it.'

Xereth thought for a moment before retracting his strength, and he glared at the Demon Emperor and his subordinates. "You guys are lucky today! I will come back and destroy the barrier! All of you will die in my hands at that time!"
"Keep dreaming."
"Tch!" Xereth clicked his tongue. "Let's go, Yichen! We will go to the Blue Water Realm to find that brat and capture the Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast."
"Yeah." The two immediately sped away, leaving the Abyssal Realm.
After Xereth and Feng Yichen left, one of the demons asked the Demon Emperor. "Should we tell Morgana about the destination of the two of them, Emperor?"
"No need." The Demon Emperor refused with a shake of his head. "Since Morgana can tell us that they came here, I'm sure she already knows their destination, so we don't need to think about it."
"How could Morgana do that, Emperor?" Another demon asked.

"Hmm?" The Demon Emperor raised his eyebrows as he also felt strange about it. "Perhaps someone told Morgana about them, and she relayed that information to us. If my guess is correct, that person might be as strong as the mysterious demon who created this barrier for us."
"Why don't you try asking Morgana about that person, Emperor?"

The Demon Emperor gave a light nod. "I will ask Morgana about the person's identity, but I am not sure she will reveal it to me. Since they are gone, we must go back now, but some of you must stay to guard."
"Yes, Emperor."

"We have entered the upper realms now, Zhang Fei. Normally, it would take us two days to arrive at the Sky Dragon Realm, but we can arrive there tonight at my peak speed."

"Senior, return to your human form." Feng Xishui looked up at Zhang Fei [5]. "I will use my movement technique, and we will arrive at the Sky Dragon Realm much faster, but I need your aura protection."
Feng Xishui returned to his human form, enveloped them with his aura, and told Zhang Fei [5] the direction to the Sky Dragon Realm. "Are you sure you can do it?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] immediately placed a few Qi recovery pills into his mouth before carrying Feng Xishui away using his Nine Cloud Steps and teleportation ability.

Beneath the floating island, vast plains and oceans stretched from north to south and west to east, which were inhabited by humans and several other races.

Feng Xishui suddenly spoke to him. "According to legend, the Sky Dragon Realm was the homeland of the true dragons in the past, and the land was blessed by the ancestor of all kinds of dragons, the five-clawed golden dragon. However, this realm underwent significant changes after their ancestor and several powerful dragons disappeared, which led to the decline of the dragon races. The remaining dragons in this realm were weaker than their ancestors, leading to invasions by other beast races, including my phoenix race."
"Since when did humans and other races live in this realm, Senior?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.

"I don't know exactly when they started inhabiting this realm, but this realm is one of the most harmonious in our universe. Humans, beasts, demihumans, and natural races live in peace here, but the other races live in the lower area." Feng Xishui then pointed to the floating island. "All right, please lead the way, Senior."

Moreover, you can see for yourself that there are so many members of other races here, except for the demon race, which makes this island densely populated."
Zhang Fei [5] then looked at several tall buildings scattered in various areas, and there was a statue of a different beast on each peak, indicating the beast race that lived inside.

"My phoenix race and the vermilion bird race live in the south, and our two sects are also located close to each other." Feng Xishui then guided Zhang Fei [5] to the southern area while posing a question. "Have you met Zhu Shanniang?"

"Tch!" Zhang Fei [5] clenched his teeth in frustration, recalling Zhu Shanniang. "I met that woman three days ago, and she was quite arrogant. She blocked my way and tried to suppress me with her aura, even though we didn't know each other. Although her cultivation is much higher than mine, I am not afraid of her. However, I also don't want to find trouble with her because the situation in the Xianjin Realm is unstable, or I will use my abilities against her."
Feng Xishui naturally wasn't surprised by that. "Zhu Shanniang's sister lives in this realm, and she leads their vermilion bird clan here."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] turned to him with a raised eyebrow.

"Zhu Lingyao is not as beautiful as Zhu Shanniang, but her cultivation is higher than hers. In fact, her strength rivals that of Zhu Hong, and she holds the position of second-in-command within their race." This surprised Zhang Fei [5], prompting Feng Xishui to question him. "Do you want to meet her? She's not as grumpy as her sister, and she's quite nice. Unfortunately, she was born with disabilities, and she can't talk because she doesn't have vocal cords."

"Let's talk about her later." Zhang Fei [5] then turned to a building with a golden dragon statue on top. "My main purpose in coming here is to look for the flame dragons, especially since I need the dragon flames to improve one of my techniques. However, we should rest for the night, and we will try to go see them tomorrow."
"All right."
A while later, they had arrived at the residence of the Phoenix Race, and Feng Xishui immediately asked the members of his race who were holding charge to prepare a room for Zhang Fei [5].

Since Zhang Fei [5] was using his half-fox form, the members of the phoenix race did not mind his presence. Moreover, Feng Xishui told them that he was Feng Yao's best friend, so they treated him very well.

sentences.text: "So, how big is the planet?"
"About 317 million square miles."
Gong Ren nodded in understanding before leaving for the back room, but a few minutes later, he returned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], carrying hundreds of palm-sized devices with him.
"At first, I thought your planet was as big as this realm, but it turned out to be so small, and all these devices are more than enough to help you clean the air on such a small planet.
You only need to spread them in the sky, and they will automatically absorb the pollution.
The air will be completely clean in a month, but I can't guarantee whether the Qi will return."
"A month?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised to hear that the process was so fast, especially since he initially thought that it would take several months or even years.
"How many devices do you use in this realm, Senior?"
"A million." Gong Ren then explained to Zhang Xiaolong about the devices, including the materials used to make them.
"No modern weapons can damage these devices, and they can only be destroyed by cultivators like us.
Since there are no cultivators in that realm, you don't need to be afraid that they will be damaged.
As for their cost, you don't need to think about it, especially since the information about Xereth that you gave us is far more valuable than these devices.
If that demon comes to this realm and destroys it, too many people will suffer losses."
"Thank you, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stored all devices in the system's inventory.
Gong Ren immediately spoke of something else.
"Cheng Gaoji told me about your weapon, but the weapon he created for you is still not perfect, and I will help you perfect it.
Once it is perfect, its explosive power will increase several times, especially when you use the fire element through it."
"Thank you for that, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was overjoyed because of Gong Ren's intentions.
"Since I have obtained these devices, I will spread them in the sky of my planet now."
"Let's go then; I will meet Cheng Gaoji at his residence."
Thereafter, the two went to Cheng Gaojie's residence, and Gong Ren met the old man.
Zhang Xiaolong [3], on the other hand, returned to his room and continued to stabilize his cultivation.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] and his partners were already standing in the sky on Earth.

"Master, the people on this planet are simply too stupid." Han Xuenai said those words while shaking her head.
Luo Yu also spoke.
"Most humans are indeed stupid and annoying, and they can never appreciate nature.
Janette and Lillea have taken great pains to accelerate the growth of those trees, and they have also created many new trees to improve nature, but they have started to destroy everything again."

"These people are just ordinary humans who don't have any power, so it's unethical for cultivators like us to kill them.

Shi Yue suddenly had an idea.

"Unfortunately, the situation on this planet is different from the cultivation realms, and most of the countries on it will change leaders every few years." Zhang Fei [1] then distributed those devices to them and explained how to operate them.
"All right, you guys don't need to mind their actions and help me spread these devices in the sky now.

They quickly spread worldwide to install the devices, which was easy with their current cultivation.

After he was done, Zhang Fei [1] went to the Blue Water Realm, and he found Balena with her parents and two siblings.
He then took her away from that realm, and their next destination was the Demon Purgatory Realm, which was Wang Yin's home realm.
Meanwhile, Xereth and Feng Yichen have arrived at the Abyssal Realm, but the barrier is blocking them.

Even so, they can see the Demon Emperor and ancient demons of the realm from behind the barrier, and their expressions are very calm without the slightest worry that the two of them will succeed in breaking their barrier.
Their expressions made Xereth furious, and he immediately unleashed his strength to attack the barrier.
His attack caused the realm to experience a violent tremor in all corners, but the barrier did not crack at all, let alone break.
"What the hell is this barrier?

The Demon Emperor and his subordinates laughed smugly from behind the barrier.
"I knew you two were strong, especially you, Xereth.
Unfortunately, this realm has changed a lot since you killed my fourth predecessor, and you will never be able to break our barrier."
"You bastard!

If I manage to break this barrier, I will absorb all your power, and I will slaughter all the demons in this realm!" Xereth furiously shouted as he launched another attack on the barrier, but the result was still the same, and the barrier remained intact.
"Haha." The Demon Emperor laughed at him.
"You can try, but your efforts will only be in vain."
Xereth turned to Feng Yichen, who nodded at him.
The two of them immediately unleashed their full strength, combined it, and attacked the barrier at the same time.
The Demon Emperor and his subordinates tensed as many cracks appeared, but their tension disappeared as soon as those cracks closed again.

Even so, Feng Yichen and Xereth did not stop attacking the barrier, and both took out several artifacts to help them, but all their efforts were fruitless. 'Do you think someone from the Paradise Realm came down here and helped them create this barrier?'

No matter how hard we attack this barrier, we won't be able to break it.'
Xereth thought for a moment before retracting his strength, and he glared at the Demon Emperor and his subordinates.
"You guys are lucky today!
I will come back and destroy the barrier!
All of you will die in my hands at that time!"
"Keep dreaming."
"Tch!" Xereth clicked his tongue.
"Let's go, Yichen!
We will go to the Blue Water Realm to find that brat and capture the Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast."
"Yeah." The two immediately sped away, leaving the Abyssal Realm.

"Should we tell Morgana about the destination of the two of them, Emperor?"
"No need." The Demon Emperor refused with a shake of his head.
"Since Morgana can tell us that they came here, I'm sure she already knows their destination, so we don't need to think about it."
"How could Morgana do that, Emperor?" Another demon asked.
"Hmm?" The Demon Emperor raised his eyebrows as he also felt strange about it.
"Perhaps someone told Morgana about them, and she relayed that information to us.
If my guess is correct, that person might be as strong as the mysterious demon who created this barrier for us."
"Why don't you try asking Morgana about that person, Emperor?"
The Demon Emperor gave a light nod.
"I will ask Morgana about the person's identity, but I am not sure she will reveal it to me.
Since they are gone, we must go back now, but some of you must stay to guard."
"Yes, Emperor."

chapters.title: Chapter 859: Visit Blazing Phoenix Sect
paragraphs: [Ding]
[Mapping of the area of the Sky Dragon Realm has been completed; the host can check the entire area via the map.]

Zhang Fei [5] immediately walked out of the room, jumped onto the roof, and checked the entire area of the floating island via the map. 'Dragon, Phoenix, Vermilion Bird, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, Qilin, Golden Crow, Golden Fox, Nian, and the last one is Kun Peng.'

[Are you interested in getting some women from the mystical beast race, Master? Your beast form used to develop the fastest compared to your demon form and cultivation, but it was inferior to the others.]
"Cough... cough..." Zhang Fei [5] choked when he heard that.
[Master, you evolved into six tails half a year ago, remember?]

[Since then, your beast form's development has been too slow, mainly because the number of female beasts by your side is too few and too weak. Therefore, you must find many female beasts to help you, Master. The female beasts in this realm are powerful enough to help you evolve into seven tails; thus, you must take advantage of your time here to woo some of them, and you can find one female from each of those races.]

Zhang Fei [5] sighed. 'Mei, I just arrived in this realm today, okay? I want to evolve into a seven-tailed form, but these female beasts are mythical and much stronger than me. If I act carelessly, they will beat me and kill me.'

[Humph!] Mei snorted in his mind. [Since you can defeat Mo Xieshen and Chao Mojie, you can also defeat those female beasts. Moreover, you have your enhanced demon touch and hormone manipulation; they will immediately fall on their knees and bow down to you if you use either on them.]

'Are you stupid, Mei?' Zhang Fei [5] replied with a shake of his head. 'I previously ganged up on Mo Xieshen and Chao Mojie, so I managed to defeat them. There are millions of beasts on this floating island, and my heavenly fox bloodline is useless against them because they are mythical beasts, so I will be the one to die if they gang up on me.'
*Thud*
Zhang Fei [5] turned his head to the young man, who had just landed a little distance away beside him. "Am I bothering you, brother?"
"No." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I was just looking around the area of this floating island."
"Oh." The young man immediately sat beside Zhang Fei [5]. "My name is Feng Wushen."
"Zhang Fei."
"I've heard your name from Elder Xishui." Feng Wushen then asked. "Are you really our princess's best friend?"

Zhang Fei [5] momentarily raised an eyebrow as he glanced at the map, but Feng Wushen's name remained green there. "My relationship with Feng Yao is excellent, and she has helped me several times. Why do you ask that?"

"No particular reason." Feng Wushen then informed him. "Elder Xishui has other matters tomorrow, so he asked me to guide you around the city, and he also asked me to bring you to our sect to meet Sect Master Feng Qingmeng."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding before posing the question. "Do you know any juniors from the Dragon Clan, Brother? I want to meet them, especially the flame dragon."

Feng Wushen nodded at him. "Actually, there are two people from the dragon clan in our sect, and they are learning alchemy under the guidance of Elder Feng Shanxi. However, those guys are quite proud, so you have to defeat them first, or they won't be willing to meet you."
"Do you know their alchemist rank?"

"Long Taiyuan is an emperor-rank alchemist, and Long Zhenxia is an ancestor-rank alchemist. As for Elder Shanxi, she is a saint-rank alchemist." Feng Wushen then asked him. "Are you also an alchemist, brother?"

"I am a king-level alchemist, so my skills are below theirs. I don't know if I can defeat them in alchemy, but I will try first." Zhang Fei [5] remembered his conversation with Zhuang Qiaoming a few days ago. "Brother, are there any other alchemists with a higher rank than Elder Shanxi in this realm? Can you tell me what the highest-grade pills are in this realm?"

"Our phoenix race has many capable alchemists, but they have already returned to the Phoenix Realm, and Elder Shanxi is the best alchemist in our sect. As for the other clans, only the dragon clan and the vermilion clan had a saint-rank alchemist, Long Qichao and Zhu Weiqing." Feng Wushen took out several bottles of pills and handed them to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately opened and examined them. "Most of the pills in this realm are either intermediate- or advanced-grade, with only a few being of superior grade. The price of superior-grade pills is quite exorbitant, mainly because of their rarity. Additionally, the superior-grade pills are only sold on this floating island, and the races living in the lower land don't have them."

'No wonder Zhuang Qiaoming immediately looked for me as soon as he heard about my pills from Huo Jiguang; it turns out the alchemy market in this realm is too poor. If I sell my pills in this realm, I can make huge profits from them, but I don't know for sure the financial strength of the residents of this realm, especially those who live in the lower land.' Zhang Fei [5] returned the pills to Feng Wushen. "Why don't they sell their pills in the lower land? Since they accept other races in their sect, it shouldn't be a problem if they help those people develop, right?"

"Arrogance and pride." Zhang Fei [5] immediately understood the meaning behind Feng Wushen's answer. "There are many people from various races who have successfully joined these sects, but they are the best among them. Their leaders only care about the talented and don't want to waste time and resources on the untalented."
"Since they don't want to open an alchemy shop in the lower land, it's fine if someone else opens a shop there, right?"
"Are you thinking about opening a shop there, Brother?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "Zhuang Qiaoming, the patriarch of the Zhuang Clan, came to me a few days ago. He told me that there weren't many high-grade pills in the lower land, and he asked me to open my shop in this realm."

"Brother, I can't answer that, and you can discuss this matter with Sect Master Qingmeng tomorrow." Feng Wushen then stood up. "I won't bother you any longer, and you can contact me once you are ready to go there tomorrow morning."
"All right." After Feng Wushen left, Zhang Fei [5] returned to his room and began to stabilize his cultivation.

In the morning, Zhang Fei [5] immediately contacted Feng Wushen after he was ready, and the male phoenix led him to the Blazing Phoenix Sect first.
Upon arriving at the sect, Feng Wushen took Zhang Fei [5] to see Feng Qingmeng as requested by Feng Xiushi.

Feng Qingmeng is an elegant young woman with a delicate beauty. Ornate golden hairpieces shaped like phoenix wings adorn her long, flowing dark hair. She has fair, soft, refined facial features—gentle black eyes with a calm gaze, a slender nose, and rose-colored lips that curve into a faint smile.

Her figure is slim and refined, with a graceful posture that reflects both confidence and poise. She wears a red hanfu-style dress with golden embroidery and open-shoulder sleeves, which flatters her slender arms, neckline, and well-proportioned chest. The outfit is detailed yet subtly seductive, with layered fabrics that accentuate her form without being overly revealing.
"Sect Master."
Feng Qingmeng turned to them, but her attention immediately fell on Zhang Fei [5]. "I've been waiting for you since Xishui informed me about you last night. Wushen, please leave us and wait outside."
"Yes, Sect Master."
'Scan her, Mei.'
Name: Feng Qingmeng
Gender: Female
Race: Phoenix
Rank: Mythical Beast
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm
Element: Fire [Peak Stage]
Elemental Law: Fire [Perfection Stage]
Core: Fire Core [Intermediate Rank]
Physique: Phoenix Bird
Partners: None
Like: Feng Jiu, Feng Yao, and Feng Shanxi.
Dislikes: Feng Shen, Long Huotian, Long Honglian
'5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, huh? I knew the Phoenix Race members were powerful, but I didn't expect there to be so many of them.' Zhang Fei [5] inwardly muttered.

"Please sit down." Zhang Fei [5] immediately sat opposite Feng Qingmeng. "Xishui told me that Zhuang Qiaoming came to you and asked you to open the shop in the lower land, and I have no problem with that. However, our phoenix race is not the only owner of alchemy shops in this realm, but the dragon and vermilion clans also have some shops. Before opening your shop in the lower land, you need to talk to them first, especially Long Qichao and Zhu Weiqing. If you succeed in convincing them, I will help you to set up your shop there."

"The beast races in this realm are so arrogant, huh?" Feng Qingmeng raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei [5]'s remark. "Aren't my words true? Are they afraid that the other races will surpass them? 'Feel and memorize the process, and you will no longer have difficulty concocting such a pill in the future.' The teenage girl nodded to Zhang Fei [5], and her eyes stared intently at her furnace, examining its interior with her senses.

Feng Shanxi and Feng Qingmeng, who were standing in the distance, did not stop Zhang Fei [5]. Instead, they also used their senses to examine the teenage girl's furnace, and they could see that all the ingredients inside had begun to fuse to form the pill.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately walked out of the room, jumped onto the roof, and checked the entire area of the floating island via the map. 'Dragon, Phoenix, Vermilion Bird, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, Qilin, Golden Crow, Golden Fox, Nian, and the last one is Kun Peng.'

"Our phoenix race has many capable alchemists, but they have already returned to the Phoenix Realm, and Elder Shanxi is the best alchemist in our sect.

As for the other clans, only the dragon clan and the vermilion clan had a saint-rank alchemist, Long Qichao and Zhu Weiqing." Feng Wushen took out several bottles of pills and handed them to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately opened and examined them.
"Most of the pills in this realm are either intermediate- or advanced-grade, with only a few being of superior grade.
The price of superior-grade pills is quite exorbitant, mainly because of their rarity.
Additionally, the superior-grade pills are only sold on this floating island, and the races living in the lower land don't have them."
'No wonder Zhuang Qiaoming immediately looked for me as soon as he heard about my pills from Huo Jiguang; it turns out the alchemy market in this realm is too poor.

If I sell my pills in this realm, I can make huge profits from them, but I don't know for sure the financial strength of the residents of this realm, especially those who live in the lower land.' Zhang Fei [5] returned the pills to Feng Wushen.

Since they accept other races in their sect, it shouldn't be a problem if they help those people develop, right?"
"Arrogance and pride." Zhang Fei [5] immediately understood the meaning behind Feng Wushen's answer.
"There are many people from various races who have successfully joined these sects, but they are the best among them.
Their leaders only care about the talented and don't want to waste time and resources on the untalented."
"Since they don't want to open an alchemy shop in the lower land, it's fine if someone else opens a shop there, right?"
"Are you thinking about opening a shop there, Brother?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him.
"Zhuang Qiaoming, the patriarch of the Zhuang Clan, came to me a few days ago.
He told me that there weren't many high-grade pills in the lower land, and he asked me to open my shop in this realm."
"Brother, I can't answer that, and you can discuss this matter with Sect Master Qingmeng tomorrow." Feng Wushen then stood up.
"I won't bother you any longer, and you can contact me once you are ready to go there tomorrow morning."
"All right." After Feng Wushen left, Zhang Fei [5] returned to his room and began to stabilize his cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 860: Emperor Rank Alchemist
paragraphs: The young alchemists lining up on all four sides of the teenage girl were jealous of her, especially since Zhang Fei [5] was helping her, and some of them hoped that he would also teach them.
Sometime later, they smelled a strong aroma coming from the teenage girl's furnace. She became excited to smell the aroma, indicating that her pills were about to be formed.

Based on information from Mei, the teenage girl is Ning Zhuan'er, and she is a 17-year-old human. Even though she is still young, her cultivation is at the 1-Star Core Realm, which means she is a genius.
'Pull your fire element back.' Ning Zhuan'er immediately followed Zhang Fei [5], who also retracted his Qi out of her body. 'Now open the lid.'
Ning Zhuan'er took a deep breath and opened the lid of her alchemy furnace, but she fell unconscious after she looked at the pills inside, confusing the young alchemists around them.
'Haha.' Zhang Fei [5] inwardly laughed as he supported Ning Zhuan'er. 'She was too excited and shocked to see the pills that she fell unconscious.'
[How could she not be shocked, Master? She is an apprentice-rank alchemist, and her alchemy almost failed before.]
Feng Shanxi hurriedly approached them, and she used her Qi to take out the five pills in Ning Zhuan'er's alchemy furnace.
"Five superior-grade pills!"
The screams of the young alchemists attracted the attention of the other alchemists, including Long Taiyuan and Long Zhenxia, who were performing alchemy on the other side.

The other alchemists immediately looked at Zhang Fei [5], and they wondered about his identity, especially since they had never seen him in their sect before. Moreover, concocting five superior-grade pills in one furnace is not an easy matter, and few alchemists can do it; even Feng Shanxi can't do it.

"Focus!" The young alchemists immediately returned their focus to their alchemy process as soon as Feng Shanxi said that. She then looked at Zhang Fei [5] and spoke. "How can you reverse the process? Zhuan'er's alchemy was bound to fail if you didn't help her, especially since she made a mistake in the process, and one of the herbs was almost destroyed."

Zhang Fei [5] picked up an herb on the table and used the plant manipulation ability that he mimicked from Lillea long ago. Instantly, the herb grew by itself, shocking Feng Shanxi and the other alchemists.
"The wood elements." Feng Shanxi muttered in a daze.
Zhang Fei [5] simply smiled. "Her herb was almost destroyed before, but I reversed it, allowing her to continue the process."
"I see." Feng Shanxi nodded in understanding. "Are you really a king-rank alchemist?"
"Do you think a king-rank alchemist can't concoct superior-grade pills?" Zhang Fei [5] turned the question around.

"No." Feng Shanxi shook her head. "Concocting superior-grade pills has nothing to do with our alchemist ranks, and an apprentice-rank alchemist can do it as long as they have great talent, like my princess."

"Unfortunately, there are not many talented alchemists in this realm, and the availability of superior-grade pills in this realm is too little or even rare." Zhang Fei [5] said this as he stole glances at the other alchemists, particularly Long Taiyuan and Long Zhenxia. "At first, I wanted to open my alchemy branch shop in this realm, but I changed my mind because of the ridiculous rules."

Unlike the calm Feng Shanxi, Long Taiyuan and Long Zhenxia were offended by Zhang Fei [5]'s words. Since their alchemy process was at a critical stage, they suppressed their anger and focused on their alchemy first.
Feng Shanxi released a soft sigh. "This realm is not our home realm, and we are forced to create such rules to maintain stability and harmony."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at her response. "Don't talk about stability and harmony, especially since both are just illusions in this realm. All of you are afraid of being outcompeted by other races, so you guys are restricting the circulation of pills in this realm to prevent that."
"Zhang Fei." Feng Qingmeng walked over to them. "You—"

"Are you offended by that fact?" Zhang Fei [5] posed the question, shaking his head. "Compared to this realm, my home realm is much more stable and harmonious. Not a single resident of my realm tries to hinder the development of others; power in my realm is evenly distributed. By the way, do Empress Feng and Feng Yao know about the situation in this realm?"
"No." Feng Qingmeng and Feng Shanxi shook their heads.

"As expected." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly had another idea. "I originally wanted to help you because I have a favorable relationship with the phoenix race, but I changed my mind now. I will only help you if you report the situation in this realm to Empress Feng or Feng Yao; otherwise, you can forget about it."
"We—"
"Hey, Brat! You're too cocky!" Zhang Fei [5] looked at Long Taiyuan, who was walking towards them. "You are just a newcomer to our realm, and you have no right to comment on our rules."

Zhang Fei [5] softly snorted. "Is it me, or are you the cocky one? You are an emperor-rank alchemist, but you can't concoct superior-grade pills, and you can only concoct two advanced-grade pills in one furnace."
"You—"
"How about we make a bet?"
"Hmm?" Long Taiyuan raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei [5]. "What kind of bet do you want?"

"You are an emperor-rank alchemist, and you should be able to concoct rank 5 pills. As for me, I am a king-rank alchemist, but I will bet with you to concoct rank 5 pills." Zhang Fei [5] immediately showed them the five basic pills, making them shocked and drooling. "If I lose, you can have my pills. If you lose, you have to pay me ten million blue jewels, and I also want your dragon flames."
"What the fuck? How could your pills be that expensive?" Long Taiyuan asked in a high voice. "Moreover, you are a human, and I will never give you my dragon flames."
"Is an emperor-rank alchemist like you afraid of betting with me?" Zhang Fei [5] asked mockingly.
"You—" Long Taiyuan swallowed his words as soon as Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his half-fox form, and his six white tails danced behind his hips. "A fox race?"
Zhang Fei's [5] half-fox form instantly enchanted the female cultivators present in the room, including Long Zhenxia, Feng Qingmeng, and Feng Shanxi.
"That's right." Zhang Fei [5] casually replied. "You should be ashamed, you know that? You are a flame dragon, yet you can't smell my beast scent when I use my human form."
"Tch!"

"My pills may be expensive for you, but the people in the Xianjin Realm are willing to pay ten million blue jewels for a set of them, especially since my pills are much more potent than others." Zhang Fei [5] then asked. "So, do you dare to bet with me?"
*Thud*
Long Zhenxia suddenly landed by their side after she completed her alchemy. "I will bet with you, and I will give my dragon flames if I lose to you."

A thick braid of Long Zhenxia's long crimson hair drapes over her shoulders, softening her confident posture. Her red eyes carry both heat and fierceness, framed by delicate lashes. She looks beautiful, bold, and not to be underestimated. Her figure is voluptuous with soft curves—refined yet feminine. Her bust is full and prominent, accentuated by the fitted red gown that wraps around her with delicate embroidery and sheer lace sleeves. The off-shoulder design shows off her smooth shoulders and collarbones, giving her a subtle sensuality without being too bold.
"Sister, you—"

"Said nothing." Long Zhenxia spoke to Zhang Fei [5] again. "Since you are still a king-rank alchemist, I will give you the opportunity to concoct the rank 5 pill two hours earlier than me, and I will start my alchemy after that."
"Haha! You underestimate me too much, and I don't need that to defeat you." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Shanxi. "Do you have a rank 5 pill recipe that she hasn't concocted before?"

Feng Shanxi directly took out a parchment and seven kinds of herbs. "True Fire Refining Pill is a rank 5 pill, and its benefit is that it enhances the purity of the flame used in forging and pill-concocting. Since you don't know anything about this pill, you two can read and understand it first, and you can start your alchemy when you are ready."
"You can read it first." Zhang Fei nodded, read the document for a few minutes, and then handed it to Long Zhenxia. "Are you sure you've understood everything?"
"You better think about yourself, or you will lose to me." After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] immediately went to an empty spot and sat down before taking out an alchemy furnace.

Long Zhenxia immediately took her furnace from her previous spot. She then sat down beside Zhang Fei [5], and she read the pill recipe first. Unfortunately, she still doesn't realize that she has fallen into his trap from the start, especially since she doesn't know anything about him.

Zhang Fei [5] and the other four clones immediately used the first technique of the Divine Alchemy Method to simulate the process of concocting the pill. In the pavilion, Zhang Fei also learned and simulated the process of concocting the pill, and the flow of time in there greatly helped them, which accelerated their understanding of the concoction process.

Once they understand it, they use the second and third techniques— the repeating simulation technique and the combining simulation technique. They concocted the pills in their minds through several concoction processes at once, and they repeated them over and over again.

Zhang Fei [5] decided to duplicate the herbs before putting them into the system inventory, and he waited for Long Zhenxia to finish first.

The other alchemists had already completed their pills; some succeeded and some failed. They then focused their gazes on Zhang Fei [5] and Long Zhenxia, waiting for the competition between them to begin.

Ning Zhuan'er, who had previously fallen unconscious, finally woke up. She was confused by the silence in the room, but she realized the situation once she saw Zhang Fei [5] and Long Zhenxia sitting next to each other. She was a bit surprised when she saw his half-fox form, and her eyes sparkled in admiration.
Since the herbs were available, Zhang Fei immediately took them and duplicated more of them. After that, he started to concoct the pill using the Heaven Creation Furnace.
About thirty minutes later, Long Zhenxia had finished studying the recipe. "Are you ready?"
"Let's get started."
"Yeah."

Zhang Fei [5] controlled the seven herbs and prepared them all at once. After that, he used his fire element in low heat to purify all herbs, ensuring no impurities remained, especially from the Molten Earth Sand and Nine Flame Spirit Vine.
Unlike Zhang Fei [5], Long Zhenxia prepared her herbs one by one, so she was truly shocked by his speed in preparing his herbs. Long Taiyuan and Feng Shanxi were also shocked when they saw that.

Once everything was ready, Zhang Fei [5] immediately heated his alchemy furnace, and he kept the flame steady at medium heat. He then put the Scarlet Sun Lotus and the Blazing Meridian Root into the furnace, and he slowly dissolved them into their base essences.

Zhang Fei [5] added a Fire Essence Crystal into the mixture after the two herbs had completely dissolved. He controlled it carefully, or his flame would spike and cause combustion. An hour later, he added the Molten Earth Sand and the Flame Spirit Vine, gradually mixing them together.

Once it was stable, Zhang Fei [5] sprinkled the Vermillion Bird Feather Ash as a binding catalyst. He did not immediately add the last ingredient into his furnace, and he waited for all the herbs to blend perfectly.

Although she was shocked and panicked by Zhang Fei's [5] alchemy speed, Long Zhenxia still maintained her calm and focus. After all, the quality of their pills, not the speed of their alchemy, determined their victory.

'This kid is not only fast; he goes through all the processes precisely, and his control over his fire element is too skilled even for a cultivator at my level. 'Do you think we should change that rule?'
'We should discuss it with the others first, and we will meet them after this.'
'All right.'

On the side of the two women, Long Taiyuan stood with a serious expression and both fists clenched. Watching Zhang Fei [5] perform his alchemy made him realize the difference in their abilities, and he was sure he would lose to him if they really competed against each other.

[Ding]
[The Alchemy feature is upgraded to level 5.]
[New items available.]
Zhang Fei [5] breathed a sigh of relief, pulled his fire element back, and opened the lid. He then took the five pills inside his furnace and smiled with satisfaction.
"Five superior-grade pills!"

The shout caused Long Zhenxia's concentration to waver slightly, and the heat of her flames increased. She quickly calmed herself down and stabilized her flames. However, she was aware that she would lose to Zhang Fei [5], especially since she had no confidence in concocting five superior-grade pills in one furnace.

[Hehehe! This woman will definitely be shocked if she finds out you tricked her, Master. She doesn't know anything about you, but she dares to challenge you in alchemy. Unfortunately, that male dragon didn't join the bet with you, so you'll only get ten million blue jewels.]

'It doesn't matter to me.' Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Long Zhenxia. 'The important thing is that I will get her dragon flames after this, and my flame power will increase to 300%. Not to mention, my other clone is on his way to finding the Earth Flame, which will increase my flame power by another 100%. If Gong Ren has refined my weapon, and I fuse my fire element into it, its explosive power will definitely be terrifying. Unfortunately, the Sky Flames are in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and I still need some time to go there'.
About an hour later, Long Zhenxia finished her pills and immediately took them from her furnace, but she only managed to concoct three advanced-grade pills, which meant her defeat.
Long Zhenxia let out a disappointed sigh and turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "I lost this match."
"Honestly, your alchemy skills are not bad, but you still have a lot to do to improve yourself." Zhang Fei [5] then extended his hand to Long Zhenxia. "Time to pay the bet."

"You are just a newcomer to our realm, and you have no right to comment on our rules."

You are an emperor-rank alchemist, but you can't concoct superior-grade pills, and you can only concoct two advanced-grade pills in one furnace."
"You—"
"How about we make a bet?"
"Hmm?" Long Taiyuan raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei [5].
"What kind of bet do you want?"
"You are an emperor-rank alchemist, and you should be able to concoct rank 5 pills.

"If I lose, you can have my pills.

"What the fuck?

"Moreover, you are a human, and I will never give you my dragon flames."
"Is an emperor-rank alchemist like you afraid of betting with me?" Zhang Fei [5] asked mockingly.
"You—" Long Taiyuan swallowed his words as soon as Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his half-fox form, and his six white tails danced behind his hips.
"A fox race?"
Zhang Fei's [5] half-fox form instantly enchanted the female cultivators present in the room, including Long Zhenxia, Feng Qingmeng, and Feng Shanxi.
"That's right." Zhang Fei [5] casually replied.
"You should be ashamed, you know that?

"Tch!"

"So, do you dare to bet with me?"

Long Zhenxia suddenly landed by their side after she completed her alchemy.

Her figure is voluptuous with soft curves—refined yet feminine.
Her bust is full and prominent, accentuated by the fitted red gown that wraps around her with delicate embroidery and sheer lace sleeves.
