chapters.title: Chapter 861: Obtained Dragon Flames
paragraphs: [You obtained 10,000,000 blue jewels.]
'Hey! This female dragon is not only beautiful and sexy; she's also wealthy.' Zhang Fei [5] muttered in his heart. "Please give your dragon flames now."
"Sister—"
"A bet is a bet, and I've already lost it." Long Zhenxia opened her palm, and her deep red dragon flames appeared above it.
Zhang Fei [5] also released his flames, and Long Zhenxia immediately shot her dragon flames at his flames.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the dragon flames. Fire count: 3.]
[The host's fire strength has increased by 300%.]
Zhang Fei [5] opened his other palm, and his flames spread out into three. The flames were crimson-colored, blackish-white, and deep red.
Long Zhenxia and Long Taiyuan were confused about the blackish-white flames, which were the soul flames. "Where did you get the blackish-white flames?"
"I got the soul flames in another realm."
"Did you get the soul flames from the Nine Hells Darkland?" As she observed the flames, Feng Qingmeng questioned him.

Feng Shanxi also spoke. "I've heard of the soul flames, and they are formed from the souls of living creatures who died in the Nine Hells Darkland. Based on news from outside, those demons searched for the soul flames for thousands of years, but they never succeeded in finding them."

"The demons have been searching for the soul flames for a long time, but they were only searching in places visible to their eyes. Meanwhile, the flames were previously hidden deep underground, and they were protected by a powerful soul demon." Zhang Fei [5] quickly cleared out his furnace and the remaining herbs, and he kept the five superior-grade True Fire Refining Pills. "The Nine Hells Darkland is a demon realm, but my light element is much stronger than the demon aura there. I managed to find their hideout and defeat the demon, and I absorbed the flames to increase my flame power."
"Do the souls in the soul flames not affect you?"

"Before I absorbed the flames, I purified the wandering souls inside using my light element first, and several people with light elements also helped me with that. Otherwise, I wouldn't be here in such a normal condition, right?" Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Long Zhenxia. "Thank you for your dragon flames, and my flames are much stronger now, which will really help me in alchemy."

Long Zhenxia shook her head slightly. "Can you teach me your alchemy technique? Our match just now made me realize that my ability in alchemy is still too low, and I want to become a better alchemist."

"No." Zhang Fei [5]'s refusal disappointed Long Zhenxia. "All my techniques are my family heirlooms, and I will only teach them to my wife. If you are keen to learn my alchemy technique, you must be one first."
Long Zhenxia and everyone who heard that were stunned, including Ning Zhuan'er, whom Zhang Fei [5] helped before.
Unlike them, Long Taiyuan was furious because of his words, but Zhang Fei [5] quickly released a bit of his killing intent and enveloped him with it, suffocating him.
"Hah... Hah..." Long Taiyuan fell to his knees and gasped for air after Zhang Fei [5] withdrew his killing intent.

Zhang Fei [5] patted Long Taiyuan's shoulder. "Unlike a dragon in a cage like you, I have killed countless people, and I have fought with many cultivators who are stronger than all of you. You should think twice if you want to fight me, or I will skin you alive, and I will use your body parts for my purposes."
Long Taiyuan trembled, his eyes dilated in fear, and his beast instincts told him not to mess with Zhang Fei [5].
Zhang Fei [5] then walked out of the room as he looked at Feng Wushen. "Let's go look around the city, Brother. I want to buy some things I might not have, especially herbs."
"All right, I will take you to the market district." Feng Wushen nodded in reply.
Ning Zhuan'er immediately ran after them. "Senior brothers, please wait for me."
Feng Qingmeng and Feng Shanxi exchanged glances for a moment before leaving the room. "You guys can rest now, and we will continue the alchemy class tomorrow."

After they cleaned up their equipment, the alchemists hurriedly left the room. Many of them were disappointed that Zhang Fei [5] left so soon, especially since they had wanted to ask for his guidance on alchemy.

After she cleaned everything up, Long Zhenxia helped the frightened Long Taiyuan up. "You should stay away from that kid and don't do anything stupid, Brother. His cultivation is far below ours, but my beast instinct tells me that he is stronger than us, and we will die if we fight with him."
"I know, sister." Long Taiyuan replied with a serious nod, as his fear of Zhang Fei [5] still had not disappeared.
Long Zhenxia nodded slightly and left her brother. 'Sigh! I will meet that kid later, and I hope he is willing to give me some pointers on alchemy.'
Long Taiyuan also left the room, but he did not return to his room in the Blazing Phoenix Sect, and he returned to his dragon clan to hide.
Ning Zhuan'er walked beside Zhang Fei [5] with her head lowered with embarrassment, and she repeatedly squeezed the hem of her sleeves.
"Where are you from, Ning Zhuan'er? Are you a native of this realm?" Zhang Fei [5] softly asked.
"Eh?" Ning Zhuan'er looked up at him with surprise. "How do you know my name, Senior Brother?"
"It wasn't difficult to find out your name." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a wink. "My name is Zhang Fei, and I am a rogue dual cultivator."
Ning Zhuan'er was even more surprised when she heard that. "Are you really a rogue dual cultivator, Senior Brother Fei?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "I once joined the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and it was a dual cultivation sect. I'm no longer interested in joining any sect now, and I rather enjoy my free, unfettered life."

Ning Zhuan'er then explained. "Senior Brother Fei, my home realm is the Desolate Star Realm, and it is not far from this realm. Elder Shanxi found me in my home realm, and she brought me to this realm after she saw me performing alchemy."

"Do you realize that you are a genius?" Ning Zhuan'er blinked her eyes repeatedly at Zhang Fei [5]. "You are 17 years old, and you managed to reach the 1-Star Core Realm in just a year. You are still an apprentice alchemist, but your alchemy skills are already good. It's just that you get nervous too easily, and it messes up your concentration. Becoming an alchemist is not difficult, but it is not easy either, and a calm mind is the main key. Therefore, you must learn to control your emotions and stay calm during alchemy, and you must always pay attention to each process carefully. If you can do all that, I believe you will become a master alchemist in the future."
Ning Zhuan'er nodded in response. "I will try to do it, Senior Brother Fei."
"I believe you can do it, Zhuan'er."
Feng Wushen, who was walking beside them, suddenly spoke. "Brother, I feel that you are different from before, and you are so relaxed now."

"It is okay to be arrogant, especially when we are facing arrogant people like them, but vice versa." Zhang Fei [5] then turned toward the location of the Vermilion Sect. "I don't know what Feng Qingmeng and Feng Shanxi will do next, but I hope they can persuade the others to change that ridiculous rule, and I will open my alchemy shop on this island if they can do it."
"Aren't you afraid that Long Qichao and Zhu Weiqing will find trouble with you?"

Zhang Fei [5] answered Feng Wushen with a shake of his head. "If they want to find trouble with me and gang up on me, I just need to leave this realm. Once I become stronger than them, I will return to this realm to settle accounts with them."

"Haha." Feng Wushen laughed at that. "My father always said that running away is not a cowardly act, and it is a tactic to buy time and prepare a better strategy, especially when we are facing a strong enemy."

"Your father is right, and I always use such a strategy when I encounter enemies beyond my capabilities. When I am sure I can defeat them, I will attack them back, and I will kill them down to their roots." Ning Zhuan'er and Feng Wushen shuddered after Zhang Fei [5] said that. "Let's speed up."
Meanwhile, Feng Qingmeng and Feng Shanxi had arrived at the Vermilion Sect, and they immediately met the female sect master.
'Why are you two suddenly here, Qingmeng and Shanxi?'

The woman leisurely sits in her chair, and her body exudes confidence and maturity. Her long crimson hair flows freely down her back, slightly tousled to frame her refined face. Burning red eyes gleam with intelligence and quiet power, giving her a commanding presence. Her body is tall and alluringly curvaceous. Her chest is full and shapely, emphasized by the corset-style bodice of her deep crimson gown. Her narrow waist, bare shoulders, and delicate collarbone add a touch of sensual charm to her figure. Unfortunately, she has obvious limitations, especially since she can only speak through voice transmission due to the lack of vocal cords.

The two women immediately sat in front of him, and Feng Shanxi answered her. "Zhu Lingyao, we are here to discuss something important with you, particularly regarding the alchemy market in this realm."

'Hmm?' Zhu Lingyao looked at the two women questioningly, prompting them to explain the situation, especially about Zhang Fei [5]'s arrival and purpose. After she listened to their explanation, she immediately used her senses to search for him in the market district. She found him along with two others inside one of the herb shops, but the system repelled her senses as soon as she tried to examine him, causing her to frown. 'That kid can prevent me from examining him.'

Feng Qingmeng then told her. "At first I didn't understand why my empress and princess admired him so much, but we had already witnessed his alchemy skills before we came here, and he is the best young alchemist I have ever met. He is a king-rank alchemist, but he can concoct 5 rank pills just by reading the recipe for a few minutes, and he even concocted five superior-grade pills in one furnace."

"Before I absorbed the flames, I purified the wandering souls inside using my light element first, and several people with light elements also helped me with that.

"It wasn't difficult to find out your name." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a wink.

Ning Zhuan'er was even more surprised when she heard that.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded.

Becoming an alchemist is not difficult, but it is not easy either, and a calm mind is the main key.

Ning Zhuan'er nodded in response.

"I believe you can do it, Zhuan'er."
Feng Wushen, who was walking beside them, suddenly spoke.

"If they want to find trouble with me and gang up on me, I just need to leave this realm.
Once I become stronger than them, I will return to this realm to settle accounts with them."
"Haha." Feng Wushen laughed at that.
"My father always said that running away is not a cowardly act, and it is a tactic to buy time and prepare a better strategy, especially when we are facing a strong enemy."
"Your father is right, and I always use such a strategy when I encounter enemies beyond my capabilities.
When I am sure I can defeat them, I will attack them back, and I will kill them down to their roots." Ning Zhuan'er and Feng Wushen shuddered after Zhang Fei [5] said that.

chapters.title: Chapter 862: Beast Clans' Leaders
paragraphs: Drap... Drap... Drap...
"Move!"
"Don't block the way!"

The people in the market district moved aside; they saw the group of people from the dragon clan running in a hurry. Furthermore, all of them were wearing warrior robes and were fully armed, which confused the onlookers.
They saw a middle-aged man and a middle-aged woman leisurely walking behind the people, and they recognized the two as the head guards of the dragon clan, Long Jishan and Long Yingwu.
As they saw the group from the dragon clan, especially Long Jishan and Long Yingwu, the people began to whisper and question their purpose in bringing so many warriors with them.
A while later, people from the dragon clan lined up on two sides in front of a herb shop, making the people in the area even more curious about their purpose.

"Hahaha!" A loud laugh broke out from inside the herb shop, startling everyone present. Zhang Fei [5] led Feng Wushen out from inside, with Ning Zhuan'er hiding behind the male phoenix. "I had guessed that one of the two clans would come to me, but I didn't expect that your dragon clan would send so many people to welcome me."

The onlookers immediately recognized Feng Wushen and Ning Zhuan'er from their attire, but they could not recognize Zhang Fei [5]. They inwardly wondered when they realized that his cultivation was too low to face the people from the dragon clan, who had all reached the Seven Divine Realm. Not to mention, Long Jishan and Long Yingwu are elders of the dragon clan.
"Are you Zhang Fei [5]?" Long Jishan asked.
"I am." Zhang Fei [5] calmly replied. "What do you guys want from me?"
Long Jishan informed him directly. "Follow us to meet our patriarch."
"I refuse." Zhang Fei [5]'s refusal caused people to gasp. "I still have many other matters, so I don't have time for your patriarch."
"You—"

"If you think you can use force on me, you should reconsider." Zhang Fei [5] immediately unleashed his killing intent to the maximum, forcing the guards of the dragon clan to fall to their knees. Even Long Jishan and Long Yingwu subconsciously took a few steps back, and the trembling of their bodies was clearly visible to the eyes of the audience. "I came to this realm not to look for trouble, but you came to pressure me. If you want to fight with me, I will fulfill your wishes."
Swoosh... Swoosh... Swoosh...

In a few moments, ten people appeared in the sky above them, and they came after they sensed Zhang Fei [5]'s killing intent, two of whom were Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao. Their arrival forced the onlookers to flee from the scene, but many of them were watching the situation from a distance.

Zhang Fei [5] did not falter or withdraw his killing intent in the presence of the ten patriarchs and matriarchs of the ten beast clans. He crossed his hands behind his waist, looked at them one by one, and listened to Mei report their strength. All of them had reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, except for Zhu Lingyao, who had reached the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm.

"Brother Wushen, please take Zhuan'er away and bring her to the phoenix clan." Feng Wushen nodded and took Ning Zhuan'er away with him directly. Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to them. "I was aware that my actions would provoke you guys, but I did this to protect myself. I was enjoying my time with my two friends, but these people from the dragon clan suddenly came to me, and they wanted to use force on me."
"Did you order them to force this kid, Long Aotian?" Feng Qingmeng asked the patriarch of the dragon clan.
"No." Long Aotian immediately denied it. "I've received reports about this kid, but I haven't made any decisions about him, and I think Long Qichao sent them to him."

"I don't care who among you sent these people, but I don't like it when people try to pressure me, especially when there's nothing wrong between us." Long Aotian and the others frowned when they heard that, and the dragon clan's patriarch tried to dispel Zhang Fei [5]'s killing intent but ended up failing. "Old man, I'm not as weak as you think, and you can go down if you want to free them."

"Hahaha." One of them suddenly burst out laughing. "Old Long, this kid has big guts, and his cultivation does not show his true strength, especially since his killing intent is stronger than old generations like us."

"I agree with Dai Baihu." An old man with a black shell on his back joined in. "Despite this kid's low cultivation, I can't accurately assess his true strength because of his overwhelming killing intent."

A golden-haired woman wearing a golden dress suddenly slid down, landing before Zhang Fei [5]. She propped her chin and looked at him with a faint smile. "I like you, kid. You're still young, and your cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms, but you can stand tall in our presence. Would you like to join my Golden Crow clan?"
"Hey, kid! Don't join her, and you can join my white tiger clan instead." Dai Baihu said those words as he landed on the ground.

The other patriarchs and matriarchs also followed the two, except for Long Aotian, the patriarch of the dragon clan. All of them also invited Zhang Fei [5] to join their beast clans, except for Feng Qingmeng, as he already had a close relationship with the phoenix clan.
Zhu Lingyao just stood there without saying anything, but her eyes moved up and down as she watched Zhang Fei [5] closely, and no one knew what was on her mind.
"I apologize, but I must decline your offer, seniors." Zhang Fei [5] respectfully replied, especially since they didn't look for trouble with him.
"Ahh!" The woman let out a soft cry while pressing her chest. "Your rejection broke my heart, kid. Don't you want to consider my offer first?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "I prefer a free and unfettered life, so I will not join anyone. Furthermore, I wouldn't have come here if someone hadn't invited me, as this realm is too far from the Xianjin Realm."
"Oh?" The woman was slightly surprised. "Who invited you to come to this realm? By the way, I am Yan Jinwu, the matriarch of the Golden Crow Clan."

"Zhuang Qiaoming from the lower land invited him to our realm." Yan Jinwu and the others turned to Feng Qingmeng, who immediately explained to them Zhang Fei [5]'s reasons for coming to their realm. "Zhu Weiqing, Feng Shanxi, and I met Long Qichao earlier to discuss this matter. He refused to make an exception for him, but I didn't expect that he would send these guys to force him."
After hearing all that, they turned to Long Aotian, who finally decided to descend from the sky. "Kid, I'm down now, so please take back your killing intent from them."
"Sure."

"Return to our clan." Long Aotian ordered the people from his clan as soon as Zhang Fei [5] withdrew his killing intent, and they hurriedly fled from there. "How about we discuss this matter in my dragon clan?"
"No." Zhang Fei [5] refused immediately. "If you want to discuss this matter, we can do it in the Phoenix Clan."

Feng Qingmeng smiled faintly as they looked at her. "You guys don't have to look at me like that, especially since I didn't say anything. This kid has a close relationship with my princess, and my empress also likes him."
Yan Jinwu suddenly embraced Zhang Fei [5]'s shoulders. "Are you thinking of wooing the Phoenix Princess, kid?"
"Which man wouldn't fall in love with Feng Yao, Senior?" Zhang Fei [5] responded with a confident smile.

"Haha." Yan Jinwu laughed upon hearing that. "Your taste in women is too high; do you know that? Among all the young generations of our beast races, Feng Yao stands out as the most exceptional. We believe that she will surpass all the beasts in the universe in the future, and she will be our leader at that time."

Zhang Fei [5] chose not to comment on that, especially since they only knew Feng Yao according to what she wanted, and they didn't know the true her. "Let's go to the Phoenix Clan, and we'll talk there."

A while later, they had gathered in the main hall of the Phoenix Clan, and Zhang Fei [5] directly spoke to them. "All of you are mythical beasts, and you guys have more advantages than other races. Why do you have to maintain such rules? Are you guys afraid that those people will surpass your beast races? Don't you have confidence in your abilities? I know the rules in this realm have been around for a long time, but they should be able to be changed for the benefit of many people, including your younger generations, right?"
"What do you know about us beast races, kid? You are an ordinary human, so you don't know how difficult it is for us beast races to cultivate." The others agreed with Dai Baihu.

"Do you guys really think that I am an ordinary human?" They frowned at Zhang Fei [5], except for Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao. Their expressions changed to surprise as soon as he turned into his complete fox with six tails. "Presumably, your beast instincts have already dulled, and you didn't recognize my beast aura when I was in my human form."
The matriarch of the golden fox race, Huli Haohao, immediately approached Zhang Fei [5]. She walked around him and took a close look at his fox form.

"Senior, your guess is correct that I am a heavenly fox." Zhang Fei [5]'s revelation shocked Huli Haohao and the others, especially since the fox race had always lived in their circles and did not want to blend in with the other beast races, let alone help humans. He then transformed back into his human form and posed a question. "Since you've seen my beast form, you don't need to doubt my knowledge of the beast races, right? I understand how difficult it is for beasts to cultivate, but we still have many advantages over other races. Unlike you guys, I'm not afraid that they will rival or even surpass me, and I just need to work harder to prevent that."
"Why do your views conflict with those of your ancestors? Aren't you afraid they will punish you?" Huli Haohao asked him.

"Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are not my ancestors, but I would rather not discuss it with you." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer confused them. "Let's get to the point. I came to this realm at Zhuang Qiaoming's invitation, but I also have my own goals. If you allow me to open a shop on the lower land, I will also open one on this island. This way, your beast races will get the same resources as them, so you shouldn't have to be afraid of them surpassing you."

Huli Haohao and the others seemed to be thinking about it seriously, but Long Aotian was different from them, and he immediately put forward a condition to Zhang Fei [5]. "I don't mind if you want to open your shops in both places, but my dragon clan will control both of them, and we will split the profits, 50:50."
Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao massaged their foreheads, and the others sharply glared at Long Aotian due to his greed.
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed mockingly in response. "You have the audacity to ask for such a thing, huh, old man? You should be ashamed of yourself! You are so old, but you are so greedy!"
"How dare you!" Long Aotian wanted to stand up from his seat, but Ma Kuangyu immediately moved to press him down, causing his chair to shatter and him to fall to the floor. "Guah."

Zhang Fei [5] smiled and confidently answered him. "Senior, I will return your jewels double if their effects are not as I said."

Unlike them, Zhang Fei [5] sat leisurely on the chair with a broad smile on his face, especially since he needed many jewels to pay Ji Changlan. Drap...

"Move!"
"Don't block the way!"
The people in the market district moved aside; they saw the group of people from the dragon clan running in a hurry.
Furthermore, all of them were wearing warrior robes and were fully armed, which confused the onlookers.
They saw a middle-aged man and a middle-aged woman leisurely walking behind the people, and they recognized the two as the head guards of the dragon clan, Long Jishan and Long Yingwu.
As they saw the group from the dragon clan, especially Long Jishan and Long Yingwu, the people began to whisper and question their purpose in bringing so many warriors with them.
A while later, people from the dragon clan lined up on two sides in front of a herb shop, making the people in the area even more curious about their purpose.
"Hahaha!" A loud laugh broke out from inside the herb shop, startling everyone present.
Zhang Fei [5] led Feng Wushen out from inside, with Ning Zhuan'er hiding behind the male phoenix.
"I had guessed that one of the two clans would come to me, but I didn't expect that your dragon clan would send so many people to welcome me."
The onlookers immediately recognized Feng Wushen and Ning Zhuan'er from their attire, but they could not recognize Zhang Fei [5].
They inwardly wondered when they realized that his cultivation was too low to face the people from the dragon clan, who had all reached the Seven Divine Realm.
Not to mention, Long Jishan and Long Yingwu are elders of the dragon clan.
"Are you Zhang Fei [5]?" Long Jishan asked.
"I am." Zhang Fei [5] calmly replied.
"What do you guys want from me?"
Long Jishan informed him directly.
"Follow us to meet our patriarch."
"I refuse." Zhang Fei [5]'s refusal caused people to gasp.
"I still have many other matters, so I don't have time for your patriarch."
"You—"
"If you think you can use force on me, you should reconsider." Zhang Fei [5] immediately unleashed his killing intent to the maximum, forcing the guards of the dragon clan to fall to their knees.
Even Long Jishan and Long Yingwu subconsciously took a few steps back, and the trembling of their bodies was clearly visible to the eyes of the audience.
"I came to this realm not to look for trouble, but you came to pressure me.
If you want to fight with me, I will fulfill your wishes."
Swoosh...
Swoosh...
Swoosh...
In a few moments, ten people appeared in the sky above them, and they came after they sensed Zhang Fei [5]'s killing intent, two of whom were Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao.
Their arrival forced the onlookers to flee from the scene, but many of them were watching the situation from a distance.
Zhang Fei [5] did not falter or withdraw his killing intent in the presence of the ten patriarchs and matriarchs of the ten beast clans.
He crossed his hands behind his waist, looked at them one by one, and listened to Mei report their strength.
All of them had reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, except for Zhu Lingyao, who had reached the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm.
"Brother Wushen, please take Zhuan'er away and bring her to the phoenix clan." Feng Wushen nodded and took Ning Zhuan'er away with him directly.
Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to them.
"I was aware that my actions would provoke you guys, but I did this to protect myself.
I was enjoying my time with my two friends, but these people from the dragon clan suddenly came to me, and they wanted to use force on me."
"Did you order them to force this kid, Long Aotian?" Feng Qingmeng asked the patriarch of the dragon clan.
"No." Long Aotian immediately denied it.
"I've received reports about this kid, but I haven't made any decisions about him, and I think Long Qichao sent them to him."

"I don't care who among you sent these people, but I don't like it when people try to pressure me, especially when there's nothing wrong between us." Long Aotian and the others frowned when they heard that, and the dragon clan's patriarch tried to dispel Zhang Fei [5]'s killing intent but ended up failing.
"Old man, I'm not as weak as you think, and you can go down if you want to free them."
"Hahaha." One of them suddenly burst out laughing.
"Old Long, this kid has big guts, and his cultivation does not show his true strength, especially since his killing intent is stronger than old generations like us."
"I agree with Dai Baihu." An old man with a black shell on his back joined in.

"Hey, kid!

The other patriarchs and matriarchs also followed the two, except for Long Aotian, the patriarch of the dragon clan.
All of them also invited Zhang Fei [5] to join their beast clans, except for Feng Qingmeng, as he already had a close relationship with the phoenix clan.
Zhu Lingyao just stood there without saying anything, but her eyes moved up and down as she watched Zhang Fei [5] closely, and no one knew what was on her mind.
"I apologize, but I must decline your offer, seniors." Zhang Fei [5] respectfully replied, especially since they didn't look for trouble with him.
"Ahh!" The woman let out a soft cry while pressing her chest.
"Your rejection broke my heart, kid.
Don't you want to consider my offer first?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly.
"I prefer a free and unfettered life, so I will not join anyone.
Furthermore, I wouldn't have come here if someone hadn't invited me, as this realm is too far from the Xianjin Realm."
"Oh?" The woman was slightly surprised.
"Who invited you to come to this realm?

"Zhuang Qiaoming from the lower land invited him to our realm." Yan Jinwu and the others turned to Feng Qingmeng, who immediately explained to them Zhang Fei [5]'s reasons for coming to their realm.
"Zhu Weiqing, Feng Shanxi, and I met Long Qichao earlier to discuss this matter.
He refused to make an exception for him, but I didn't expect that he would send these guys to force him."
After hearing all that, they turned to Long Aotian, who finally decided to descend from the sky.
"Kid, I'm down now, so please take back your killing intent from them."
"Sure."
"Return to our clan." Long Aotian ordered the people from his clan as soon as Zhang Fei [5] withdrew his killing intent, and they hurriedly fled from there.
"How about we discuss this matter in my dragon clan?"
"No." Zhang Fei [5] refused immediately.
"If you want to discuss this matter, we can do it in the Phoenix Clan."
Feng Qingmeng smiled faintly as they looked at her.
"You guys don't have to look at me like that, especially since I didn't say anything.
This kid has a close relationship with my princess, and my empress also likes him."
Yan Jinwu suddenly embraced Zhang Fei [5]'s shoulders.
"Are you thinking of wooing the Phoenix Princess, kid?"
"Which man wouldn't fall in love with Feng Yao, Senior?" Zhang Fei [5] responded with a confident smile.
"Haha." Yan Jinwu laughed upon hearing that.
"Your taste in women is too high; do you know that?
Among all the young generations of our beast races, Feng Yao stands out as the most exceptional.
We believe that she will surpass all the beasts in the universe in the future, and she will be our leader at that time."
Zhang Fei [5] chose not to comment on that, especially since they only knew Feng Yao according to what she wanted, and they didn't know the true her.
"Let's go to the Phoenix Clan, and we'll talk there."
A while later, they had gathered in the main hall of the Phoenix Clan, and Zhang Fei [5] directly spoke to them.

Are you guys afraid that those people will surpass your beast races?
Don't you have confidence in your abilities?
I know the rules in this realm have been around for a long time, but they should be able to be changed for the benefit of many people, including your younger generations, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 863 863: Make Huge Profits
paragraphs: "So, how do you feel after taking those pills, Old Dai? Do you feel any changes in yourself?"

Dai Baihu nodded to Yuwen Xingzuan before releasing his aura, and the results surprised everyone. "My meridians, dantian, bones, and soul have become stronger. My Qi absorption has also become much faster than before, as has the Yang Qi in my body. If our members also take his pills, I'm sure many of them can compete with the members of our main clans, and they can join them in the future."

"Please sell me your pills, kid." The matriarch of the Nian Clan, Nu Qichen, handed a bag containing eleven million blue jewels to Zhang Fei [5]. "You must have special pills for female cultivators, right?"

"Naturally." Zhang Fei [5] handed his basic pills and the Yin Purifying Pill to Nu Qichen. Thereafter, the other patriarchs and matriarchs also bought his pills, including Feng Qingmeng. However, he did not sell them to Long Aotian because of his previous ridiculous request, asking for 50 percent of his shop's sales. 'Haha! I earned ninety-nine million blue jewels from these people, and I will earn even more if I succeed in opening two shops in this realm.'
Furious with Zhang Fei [5]'s treatment of him, Long Aotian immediately left the Phoenix Clan, making Yan Jinwu and Yang Langin laugh.

Zhu Lingyao immediately warned Zhang Fei [5]. 'I know you treated Long Aotian like that because you were furious with him and the Dragon Clan, but you must always be careful of them. Even though we also live here, this realm is their ancestral realm, and they still hide many secrets here. He will take action against you, whether directly or indirectly, so it's crucial to be ready for every scenario.'

"Senior Lingyao, you are much better than your temperamental sister, Zhu Sanniang." No one was surprised to hear that name from Zhang Fei [5]. "I am unaware of the enmity between her and the heavenly fox, but I am aware that revenge has blinded her mind and heart. She regards all members of that race as her enemies, whether they are guilty or not."
"Hey, your words make me feel strange, kid. You yourself are a heavenly fox, but you speak as if you were not one of them." Wang Guzhe said this.

"As I said before, I am not part of the heavenly fox race." Zhang Fei [5]'s response made them wonder even more about his true identity and relationship with the fox race, but he had no intention of explaining to her the truth. Instead, he walked up to Zhu Lingyao, stood in front of her, and took her hand, leaving everyone stunned. "I've heard about you from Senior Xishui, and you are indeed such a beauty. Are you willing to be my partner, Senior?"
'This kid's shamelessness is sky-high!'

Zhu Lingyao pulled her hand back directly. 'Zhu Hong told me that you are a shameless man, but I didn't expect you to be this bold by asking me to be your partner, especially since we don't know each other. Moreover, I'm over ten thousand years old, so I'm too old for you.'

"Hehe! You may be over ten thousand years old now, but you still look so young." Zhang Fei [5] responded with a chuckle. "We are cultivators, and we can live for tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years, so there is no such thing as too old or too young for us. We don't know each other yet, but that's okay since we've had plenty of time to get acquainted. Additionally, I'm much more experienced than these male seniors, so I'm sure I can make you happy."

Wang Guzhe immediately protested. "Hey, brat! How could you possibly be more experienced than us? You weren't even born when we started roaming this universe, and we've been alive for over ten thousand years now."

"Old Wang, you don't understand what I mean." Wang Guzhe raised his eyebrows in response to Zhang Fei [5]. "I may be less experienced than you in cultivation, but I am more experienced when it comes to women."
"What do you mean by that?"

Yan Jinwu patted Wang Guzhe's shoulder. "Old Wang, this kid said clearly that you are inexperienced with women, especially since you are an old virgin. Unlike you, he has dozens of women by his side, as evidenced by the many different Yin Qi in his body."
"Cough... Cough..." Wang Guzhe coughed with a red face. "Who said I'm an old virgin? Many women are crazy about me, and I've slept with some of them in the past."

"Whatever you say, Old Wang." Yan Jinwu then spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Kid, we will all support you to open your shops on this island and the lower land, but you must settle your affairs with Long Aotian and his Dragon Clan first. Otherwise, they will do everything possible to destroy you and your shops, which will also mess up the situation here."

"You have to listen to Old Yan, kid." Huli Haohao joined in to advise Zhang Fei [5]. "All of us have high self-esteem as mythical beasts, but Long Aotian and his Dragon Clan's self-esteem is much higher than ours. This realm is their ancestral land, and they have many advantages here, so you must not make a rash decision to fight them head-on."
Dai Hubai released a soft sigh before telling Zhang Fei [5]. "Kid, be careful of the one hidden on the peak behind the thunderclouds."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] opened the map and checked the mountain peak, but it couldn't detect anything up there. "What's hidden there, Old Dai?"
Dai Hubai shook his head before answering. "I haven't seen it myself, but my beast instinct tells me there's something dangerous hidden up there."

"I feel the same way as Old Dai, Kid." Yuwen Xingzuan also spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "As you already know, I am a Kun Peng beast. I am the ruler of the sea, but I am not inferior to the Roc Bird Beast in the sky. However, I cannot reach that place because of the presence of that mysterious thing, and it repeatedly suppresses me when I try to check the area from the sky."
"I don't know what it is, but I suspect it is the dragon race's blood life. Zhang Fei [5] looked at Nu Qichen. "Did you know that the five-clawed golden dragon once lived in this realm?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Nu Qichen. "The five-clawed golden dragon is the ancestor of all dragon races, but he disappeared for no apparent reason, and several powerful dragons also disappeared with him. The Dragon Clan has declined since then, and those in this realm can't reach their level."

"Legend has it that the five-clawed golden dragon lived on the mountain peak, and the thunderclouds were left behind by him." Huli Haohao's words made Zhang Fei [5] fall into thought, and he asked Mei to search for information about the golden dragon in the system. "To this day, the mountain peak is a sacred place for the Dragon Clan, and they do not allow anyone to go there. If we insist on going there, we will face a massive attack from the Dragon Clan."

Feng Qingmeng also informed Zhang Fei [5]. "The other nine beast races, including my Phoenix Race, are strong. However, our overall strength is still below that of the Dragon Clan, so we choose not to find trouble with them."
"Are they stronger than Senior Feng Shen and Senior Feng Xueying?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.

Feng Qingmeng shook her head in response. "The two ancestors of my Phoenix Race have lived longer than the dragon race in this realm, and their strength has already surpassed them. If they come here, Long Aotian and his race will not dare to do anything in their presence, especially Ancestor Xueying."
'However, our ancestors would never come to this realm, and they were more focused on themselves within our main clans.' Zhu Lingyao added.
Zhang Fei [5] cupped his hands toward them. "Thank you for your advice, seniors. I know the Dragon Clan is powerful, and I will never underestimate them."

Thereafter, they left the Phoenix Clan directly, including Feng Qingmeng, who had to return to the Blazing Phoenix Sect. However, Zhang Fei [5] restrained Zhu Lingyao from leaving directly, and he gave her another two pills. "Senior, I really want you as my partner, so I hope you are willing to consider it. As for these two pills, just treat them as our meeting gift."
'Why do you insist on wanting me to be your partner?'
Zhang Fei [5] smiled at Zhu Lingyao. "You are powerful and beautiful, so it's natural that I want you, right?"
'Aren't Yan Jinwu, Huli Haohao, Nu Qichen, and Feng Qingmeng also beautiful? Why don't you want them to be your partners?'
Zhang Fei [5] pointed at Zhu Lingyao's chest. "The answer is in your soul, Senior."
'Hmm?' Zhu Lingyao looked at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion.

"Since you've heard about me from Zhu Hong, you should know that I'm Master Hun's disciple, right?" Zhu Lingyao nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "Even though I'm not yet as skilled as my master in the soul cultivation path, I have an ability that allows me to see everyone's souls. They are beautiful, but their souls are not as good as yours. They harbor many hidden desires within their souls, and many of them are not good things."

Zhu Lingyao stared at Zhang Fei [5] for a while before letting out a soft sigh and turning to leave. 'If you want me to be your partner, you have to prove your seriousness, but I have to tell you that it won't be easy to get my heart.'
After Zhu Lingyao disappeared, Zhang Fei [5] immediately entered the invisible state and left the Phoenix Clan before flying to the mountain peak.

When he arrived there, Zhang Fei [5] felt a strong pressure from behind the clouds, and the thunderclouds immediately attacked him. Fortunately, he had experienced too many lightning tribulations before, and their attacks were not too painful for him.
Ma Kuangyu suddenly came out of Zhang Fei [5]'s soul sea. "These thunderclouds are abnormal, and they were created from an ancient artifact hidden behind them."
"An ancient artifact?"

"Yes." Ma Kuangyu nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "If I still had my body, I could help you get through these thunderclouds. My soul is indeed stronger than all the souls of living beings in the three mortal realms, but my soul will not be able to get through them. Even if I join forces with Nalan Yushu, we still won't be able to get through them. If you want to get through them, you can infiltrate the Dragon Clan, or you can take the lightning elemental seed and get the lightning element first."
"Do you think I'm capable of retrieving the lightning elemental seed now?"

Ma Kuangyu shook his head in response. "Your chance of obtaining the lightning elemental seed with your current cultivation is only 5 percent, and those lightning bolts will shatter your body into pieces if you force yourself to retrieve it."

"So, the only way for me to get past these thunderclouds is to infiltrate the Dragon Clan, especially since they have a secret path to get there." Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself while looking up. "I think I have a way to infiltrate there, but I need someone's help for that, especially since I don't have much information about them yet."
"Long Zhenxia is your best choice."

"Yeah." Ma Kuangyu immediately entered his soul sea again, and Zhang Fei [5] returned to the Phoenix Clan, thinking about the best way to infiltrate the Dragon Clan. Additionally, he released the demon eye's orb and used it to monitor Long Aotian.

After she returned to her Vermilion Sect, Zhu Lingyao immediately swallowed the two pills Zhang Fei [5] gave her, which were the Beauty Restoring Pill and the Youthful Retaining Pill. Sometime later, a large amount of foul-smelling black liquid filled her body, forcing her to use her Qi to get rid of it.

Once the process was complete, Zhu Lingyao immediately took off her red dress and stood in front of the mirror, shocked by her new appearance. She touched her fair skin, which had become much smoother and firmer, and all the old scars on her body had disappeared completely. The most important thing was that her face had become much younger, and her appearance was so similar to her youth.

'Unbelievable! How did that kid get pills with such effects? I heard that Li Jingxia has been concocting such pills for a long time, but she has never succeeded in doing so. If he sold the two pills in his shop, both male and female cultivators would scramble to get their hands on them, and they would be willing to pay any price.' Zhu Lingyao immediately used the transformation technique and changed herself back to her old form, especially since her current form would cause great trouble for Zhang Fei [5]. 'That kid is actually not bad, but he should be more careful with his actions, especially when he is facing people like Long Aotian. He humiliated him to that extent; that old man wouldn't possibly let this matter just like that, and the problems between them might escalate soon.'
In the Dragon Clan, Long Aotian sat in the head seat in the main clan, and all the senior members of the clan were gathered there, including Long Qichao.
"Why did you suddenly gather us all, Brother?" Long Qichao asked.
Long Aotian glared at him before posing the question. "Did you order Long Jishan and Long Yingwu to capture that kid?"

"Yes." Long Qichao immediately admitted it. "That kid is an insignificant person, and he came to our realm to disrupt our rules. Therefore, I sent them to capture him, and we can punish him accordingly."

"What a fool!" Long Aotian shouted before pointing at Long Jishan and Long Yingwu. "Ask them what happened before! Because of your stupidity, our Dragon Clan was publicly humiliated by him, and he also humiliated me in front of the other leaders!"
"Hmm?" The two quickly explained the situation to Long Qichao, leaving him shocked. "Impossible! How could that brat do such a thing?"
"Impossible, you small brain!" Long Aotian shouted furiously. "Since that kid humiliated our Dragon Clan, we must make him pay for his humiliation."
"What should we do to deal with that brat, Patriarch?" A middle-aged woman asked.
Long Aotian immediately decided. "Get rid of him regardless of the cost! If the Phoenix Race wants to protect him, we will wage war on them, and we will forcefully chase them out of this realm!"
"Huh?" All the senior members of the Dragon Clan were shocked by Long Aotian's decision. "What does that kid have to do with the Phoenix Clan, senior? Why should we wage a war against them?"

"You all have little brains!" Long Aotian cursed. "That kid has a special relationship with the Phoenix Clan, and they will protect him if we attack him. Thus, you should be prepared to go to war with them, even if it will disrupt stability in our realm. Now leave and prepare everything!"
"Yes, Patriarch."
In the pavilion, Zhang Fei sat alone in the garden while looking at several items in the system. 'Do you think the place indicated by the ancient map is in the Paradise Realm, Mei?'

[Master, I think all the miscellaneous items you got from the system have nothing to do with the three mortal realms, including this ancient map. Since Feng Yao came from that realm, I think you can ask her about them, and she might be able to give you clear clues about them.]

'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei then closed the system and stood up. "Since Long Aotian wants to attack me, I must take quick action against them, and I will carry out a preemptive attack against them."

sentences.text: "So, how do you feel after taking those pills, Old Dai?
Do you feel any changes in yourself?"
Dai Baihu nodded to Yuwen Xingzuan before releasing his aura, and the results surprised everyone.
"My meridians, dantian, bones, and soul have become stronger.
My Qi absorption has also become much faster than before, as has the Yang Qi in my body.
If our members also take his pills, I'm sure many of them can compete with the members of our main clans, and they can join them in the future."
"Please sell me your pills, kid." The matriarch of the Nian Clan, Nu Qichen, handed a bag containing eleven million blue jewels to Zhang Fei [5].
"You must have special pills for female cultivators, right?"
"Naturally." Zhang Fei [5] handed his basic pills and the Yin Purifying Pill to Nu Qichen.
Thereafter, the other patriarchs and matriarchs also bought his pills, including Feng Qingmeng.
However, he did not sell them to Long Aotian because of his previous ridiculous request, asking for 50 percent of his shop's sales. 'Haha!
I earned ninety-nine million blue jewels from these people, and I will earn even more if I succeed in opening two shops in this realm.'
Furious with Zhang Fei [5]'s treatment of him, Long Aotian immediately left the Phoenix Clan, making Yan Jinwu and Yang Langin laugh.
Zhu Lingyao immediately warned Zhang Fei [5]. 'I know you treated Long Aotian like that because you were furious with him and the Dragon Clan, but you must always be careful of them.
Even though we also live here, this realm is their ancestral realm, and they still hide many secrets here.
He will take action against you, whether directly or indirectly, so it's crucial to be ready for every scenario.'
"Senior Lingyao, you are much better than your temperamental sister, Zhu Sanniang." No one was surprised to hear that name from Zhang Fei [5].
"I am unaware of the enmity between her and the heavenly fox, but I am aware that revenge has blinded her mind and heart.
She regards all members of that race as her enemies, whether they are guilty or not."
"Hey, your words make me feel strange, kid.
You yourself are a heavenly fox, but you speak as if you were not one of them." Wang Guzhe said this.

"As I said before, I am not part of the heavenly fox race." Zhang Fei [5]'s response made them wonder even more about his true identity and relationship with the fox race, but he had no intention of explaining to her the truth.
Instead, he walked up to Zhu Lingyao, stood in front of her, and took her hand, leaving everyone stunned.
"I've heard about you from Senior Xishui, and you are indeed such a beauty.
Are you willing to be my partner, Senior?"
'This kid's shamelessness is sky-high!'

Zhu Lingyao pulled her hand back directly. 'Zhu Hong told me that you are a shameless man, but I didn't expect you to be this bold by asking me to be your partner, especially since we don't know each other.
Moreover, I'm over ten thousand years old, so I'm too old for you.'
"Hehe!
You may be over ten thousand years old now, but you still look so young." Zhang Fei [5] responded with a chuckle.
"We are cultivators, and we can live for tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years, so there is no such thing as too old or too young for us.
We don't know each other yet, but that's okay since we've had plenty of time to get acquainted.
Additionally, I'm much more experienced than these male seniors, so I'm sure I can make you happy."
Wang Guzhe immediately protested.
"Hey, brat!
How could you possibly be more experienced than us?
You weren't even born when we started roaming this universe, and we've been alive for over ten thousand years now."
"Old Wang, you don't understand what I mean." Wang Guzhe raised his eyebrows in response to Zhang Fei [5].
"I may be less experienced than you in cultivation, but I am more experienced when it comes to women."
"What do you mean by that?"
Yan Jinwu patted Wang Guzhe's shoulder.
"Old Wang, this kid said clearly that you are inexperienced with women, especially since you are an old virgin.
Unlike you, he has dozens of women by his side, as evidenced by the many different Yin Qi in his body."
"Cough...
Cough..." Wang Guzhe coughed with a red face.
"Who said I'm an old virgin?
Many women are crazy about me, and I've slept with some of them in the past."
"Whatever you say, Old Wang." Yan Jinwu then spoke to Zhang Fei [5].
"Kid, we will all support you to open your shops on this island and the lower land, but you must settle your affairs with Long Aotian and his Dragon Clan first.
Otherwise, they will do everything possible to destroy you and your shops, which will also mess up the situation here."
"You have to listen to Old Yan, kid." Huli Haohao joined in to advise Zhang Fei [5].
"All of us have high self-esteem as mythical beasts, but Long Aotian and his Dragon Clan's self-esteem is much higher than ours.
This realm is their ancestral land, and they have many advantages here, so you must not make a rash decision to fight them head-on."
Dai Hubai released a soft sigh before telling Zhang Fei [5].
"Kid, be careful of the one hidden on the peak behind the thunderclouds."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] opened the map and checked the mountain peak, but it couldn't detect anything up there.
"What's hidden there, Old Dai?"
Dai Hubai shook his head before answering.
"I haven't seen it myself, but my beast instinct tells me there's something dangerous hidden up there."
"I feel the same way as Old Dai, Kid." Yuwen Xingzuan also spoke to Zhang Fei [5].
"As you already know, I am a Kun Peng beast.
I am the ruler of the sea, but I am not inferior to the Roc Bird Beast in the sky.
However, I cannot reach that place because of the presence of that mysterious thing, and it repeatedly suppresses me when I try to check the area from the sky."
"I don't know what it is, but I suspect it is the dragon race's blood life.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Nu Qichen.
"Did you know that the five-clawed golden dragon once lived in this realm?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Nu Qichen.
"The five-clawed golden dragon is the ancestor of all dragon races, but he disappeared for no apparent reason, and several powerful dragons also disappeared with him.
The Dragon Clan has declined since then, and those in this realm can't reach their level."

"Legend has it that the five-clawed golden dragon lived on the mountain peak, and the thunderclouds were left behind by him." Huli Haohao's words made Zhang Fei [5] fall into thought, and he asked Mei to search for information about the golden dragon in the system.
"To this day, the mountain peak is a sacred place for the Dragon Clan, and they do not allow anyone to go there.
If we insist on going there, we will face a massive attack from the Dragon Clan."
Feng Qingmeng also informed Zhang Fei [5].
"The other nine beast races, including my Phoenix Race, are strong.
However, our overall strength is still below that of the Dragon Clan, so we choose not to find trouble with them."
"Are they stronger than Senior Feng Shen and Senior Feng Xueying?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.
Feng Qingmeng shook her head in response.
"The two ancestors of my Phoenix Race have lived longer than the dragon race in this realm, and their strength has already surpassed them.
If they come here, Long Aotian and his race will not dare to do anything in their presence, especially Ancestor Xueying."
'However, our ancestors would never come to this realm, and they were more focused on themselves within our main clans.' Zhu Lingyao added.
Zhang Fei [5] cupped his hands toward them.
"Thank you for your advice, seniors.
I know the Dragon Clan is powerful, and I will never underestimate them."
Thereafter, they left the Phoenix Clan directly, including Feng Qingmeng, who had to return to the Blazing Phoenix Sect.
However, Zhang Fei [5] restrained Zhu Lingyao from leaving directly, and he gave her another two pills.
"Senior, I really want you as my partner, so I hope you are willing to consider it.
As for these two pills, just treat them as our meeting gift."
'Why do you insist on wanting me to be your partner?'
Zhang Fei [5] smiled at Zhu Lingyao.
"You are powerful and beautiful, so it's natural that I want you, right?"
'Aren't Yan Jinwu, Huli Haohao, Nu Qichen, and Feng Qingmeng also beautiful?
Why don't you want them to be your partners?'
Zhang Fei [5] pointed at Zhu Lingyao's chest.
"The answer is in your soul, Senior."
'Hmm?' Zhu Lingyao looked at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion.
"Since you've heard about me from Zhu Hong, you should know that I'm Master Hun's disciple, right?" Zhu Lingyao nodded at Zhang Fei [5].
"Even though I'm not yet as skilled as my master in the soul cultivation path, I have an ability that allows me to see everyone's souls.
They are beautiful, but their souls are not as good as yours.
They harbor many hidden desires within their souls, and many of them are not good things."

Zhu Lingyao stared at Zhang Fei [5] for a while before letting out a soft sigh and turning to leave. 'If you want me to be your partner, you have to prove your seriousness, but I have to tell you that it won't be easy to get my heart.'
After Zhu Lingyao disappeared, Zhang Fei [5] immediately entered the invisible state and left the Phoenix Clan before flying to the mountain peak.
When he arrived there, Zhang Fei [5] felt a strong pressure from behind the clouds, and the thunderclouds immediately attacked him.
Fortunately, he had experienced too many lightning tribulations before, and their attacks were not too painful for him.
Ma Kuangyu suddenly came out of Zhang Fei [5]'s soul sea.
"These thunderclouds are abnormal, and they were created from an ancient artifact hidden behind them."
"An ancient artifact?"
"Yes." Ma Kuangyu nodded at Zhang Fei [5].
"If I still had my body, I could help you get through these thunderclouds.
My soul is indeed stronger than all the souls of living beings in the three mortal realms, but my soul will not be able to get through them.
Even if I join forces with Nalan Yushu, we still won't be able to get through them.
If you want to get through them, you can infiltrate the Dragon Clan, or you can take the lightning elemental seed and get the lightning element first."
"Do you think I'm capable of retrieving the lightning elemental seed now?"
Ma Kuangyu shook his head in response.

"Your chance of obtaining the lightning elemental seed with your current cultivation is only 5 percent, and those lightning bolts will shatter your body into pieces if you force yourself to retrieve it."
"So, the only way for me to get past these thunderclouds is to infiltrate the Dragon Clan, especially since they have a secret path to get there." Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself while looking up.
"I think I have a way to infiltrate there, but I need someone's help for that, especially since I don't have much information about them yet."
"Long Zhenxia is your best choice."

Additionally, he released the demon eye's orb and used it to monitor Long Aotian.
After she returned to her Vermilion Sect, Zhu Lingyao immediately swallowed the two pills Zhang Fei [5] gave her, which were the Beauty Restoring Pill and the Youthful Retaining Pill.
Sometime later, a large amount of foul-smelling black liquid filled her body, forcing her to use her Qi to get rid of it.
Once the process was complete, Zhu Lingyao immediately took off her red dress and stood in front of the mirror, shocked by her new appearance.
She touched her fair skin, which had become much smoother and firmer, and all the old scars on her body had disappeared completely.
The most important thing was that her face had become much younger, and her appearance was so similar to her youth.
'Unbelievable!
How did that kid get pills with such effects?
I heard that Li Jingxia has been concocting such pills for a long time, but she has never succeeded in doing so.

chapters.title: Chapter 864 864: Forgotten Places
paragraphs: In the Phoenix Realm, Feltia [2] was upset after he searched the realm for the location of the Divine Phoenix Totem without success. "Where could the totem be hiding? Feng Yichen was sure that the totem returned to this realm, but I have already searched almost the entire area to no avail. Do you detect any hidden places in this realm, Mei?"
[Master, the only area you haven't checked is the Phoenix Palace. However, you won't be able to enter there without Feng Jiu's or Feng Tian's permission, so you have to meet one of them first.]

Feltia [2] shook his head slightly. "If I tell them that I want to look for the Divine Phoenix Totem there, they won't be willing to let me in, and they will order their race members to look for it there."
[Well? The Divine Phoenix Totem is a treasure belonging to the Phoenix Race, so it's natural that they would want to obtain it, right?]
"Yeah." Feltia [2] then flew to the icy lake. "I feel my ice elemental law will break through to the intermediate stage soon, so I'll improve it first, and I'll look for the totem again later."
Upon arrival, Feltia [2] looked at Zhang Yue, who was immersed in his cultivation. He didn't disturb his big sister and dove directly into the icy lake.

Zhang Fei [4] left the three female demons resting in the room and went to meet Feng Yao on the flying artifact's hull. "Do you know anything about the Temple of Forgotten Flames and the Forgotten Land?"

"Hmm?" Feng Yao turned to Zhang Fei [4] and stared at him for a while. "I don't know where you got the information about those two places, especially since Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu shouldn't know about either of them, but I can tell you that they are connected to each other, and both places are much older than the Paradise Realm. If you manage to find the Forgotten Land, you will find the Temple of Forgotten Flames."
"Older than the Paradise Realm?" Zhang Fei [4] was shocked. "Doesn't that mean that people from the Forgotten Land are much stronger than the cultivators there?"
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him. "They're strong because they're direct descendants of the ancients; you'll see for yourself if you go there and meet them."
"The ancients, huh?" Zhang Fei [4] mumbled. "Do you know the way to that place?"

"I know, but I won't tell you about it, and you have to find your own way to get there. Only a few people in the Paradise Realm know about the Forgotten Land and the way to get there." Feng Yao's answer disappointed Zhang Fei [4], but he knew that the place was still far from his reach. "If you can go to that place and meet the mysterious merchant who appears once every hundred years, you can buy many valuable items from that person. However, you need a special token, and you have to pass several tests to get it."

Zhang Fei [4] smiled faintly because he had obtained the Spirit Merchant Token from the system, and he also obtained the Golden Auction Token for attending the auction at that place. "What mysteries lie within the Temple of Forgotten Flames?"
"Sigh." Feng Yao released a soft sigh. "I've visited the Temple of Forgotten Flames, but it was completely empty."

Zhang Fei [4] was perplexed by this, as the system gave him 1/6 of the map that led to the Temple of Forgotten Flames, and Murong Mengying found another part of the map at the Sun Tower. He believed the system would never give him anything useless, so he was sure there was something hidden there.

Huo Ling suddenly came out of Feng Yao's body and glared at Zhang Fei [4], making him smile bitterly at her attitude. "The Temple of Forgotten Flames was built by a primordial living being, and it became the home of the Primordial Flames."
"Primordial living beings and primordial flames." Even though he had seen many things in the Era of the Beginning, Zhang Fei [4] was still shocked to hear these two.

Huo Ling then continued. "The primordial flames were the lifeblood of the Forgotten Land, and they were also the source of power for living beings with fire elements. Unfortunately, the flames disappeared several million years ago, and no outsiders came to that place again after that. As time went by, that place became a forgotten place, and the people there had forgotten about the flames."

Huo Ling's words made Zhang Fei [4] realize several things. "Did the people from the Forgotten Land seal their place on purpose? Even though the flames have disappeared, that place is ancient. There are some intriguing things there too, so they shouldn't forget about that place, right?"

"They didn't seal their place, and it disappeared from the public by itself." Zhang Fei [4] immediately suspected that the will of the universe had purposely hidden the place from the public after the primordial flames disappeared. "That place reappeared after some cultivators from the Paradise Realm accidentally found their way there, but they hid the route from the public, so only a handful of people knew about it."

"Thank you for all that information, Huo Ling." The female fire spirit didn't say anything and entered Feng Yao's body again, making Zhang Fei [4] a little annoyed. "I don't know what happened to the primordial flames or how they disappeared, but I'm sure there's something hidden in the Temple of Forgotten Flames. Once I become strong and ascend to the Paradise Realm, I'll go look for those two places."

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled at Zhang Fei [4]'s determination. "I don't know how you can be so sure there's something hidden there, but I'll wait for you to solve all the mysteries. So, are you having trouble on the Sky Dragon Island?"

"Did Feng Qingmeng tell you anything?" Feng Yao responded to Zhang Fei [4] with a smile. "I wasn't looking for trouble with them, but Long Aotian and his Dragon Clan came and looked for trouble with me. That old man thought your Phoenix Clan would protect me from them, and he ordered his clan members to prepare for war with your clan."

Feng Yao shook her head. "Even Long Qiang, the patriarch of the main Dragon Clan, and his ancestors don't dare to find trouble with my Phoenix Clan. Yet, a fool like Long Aotian wants to go to war with us, which means he seeks death and destruction for the branch Dragon Clan. By the way, you don't need to worry about them; instead, concentrate on that old man. Feng Xishui will take care of his members if they truly want to go to war with us."
"Won't that affect your Phoenix Clan's relationship with the main Dragon Clan?"

Feng Yao shrugged her shoulders. "You may not know this, but my Phoenix Clan has always been at odds with the Main Dragon Clan. Long Qiang's ancestors were powerful, but Feng Shen and Feng Xueying managed to defeat them in the past, and their injuries should not have been fully recovered."
"What happened between the two clans?"

"The pride of the dragons." Zhang Fei [4] raised his eyebrows. "The dragons are the most arrogant among all the mystical beasts, and they think that they are the strongest among us, especially because of the existence of the five-clawed golden dragon. As a result, they attempted to subjugate other mystical beast races, but they were met with crushing defeats from several races, including from my Phoenix Clan. Since then, Long Qiang and his dragon clan have not dared to attack us, and we have not retaliated against them either. Since Long Aotian thought he could defeat us, I will let Feng Xishui teach him a lesson that he will never forget for the rest of his life."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Feng Yao. "In that case, I will focus on Long Aotian and Long Qichao, and Senior Xishui can take care of the rest of them."
"What are your plans for those two men?"
"You'll find out soon." Zhang Fei [4] immediately left Feng Yao and returned to his room.
[Master, how did that kid know about those two places?] Huo Ling suddenly asked.

"There are many secrets inside him, and one of them tells him about the two places. You don't need to dwell on this matter, and we will know the answer in the future." Feng Yao immediately contacted Feng Xishui, asking him to prepare for action if the Dragon Clan dared to attack their Phoenix Clan. She also reached out to several others for additional support.
Somewhere in the Sky Dragon Realm, Feng Xishui smiled to himself as he downed a bottle of wine.
"Why are you suddenly smiling to yourself?" A young man with fiery red hair posed the question.

Feng Xishui pointed at the Dragon Clan. "Look over there, Feng Yongheng. Those giant worms looked for trouble with our princess's lover first, but they didn't want to repent for their mistake. Instead, they planned to wage a war with our Phoenix Clan if we helped her lover, and she asked me to take care of them."

"Hahahaha!" Feng Yongheng laughed out loud. "Long Aotian will be furious if you call him a giant worm in front of him! Speaking of that kid, he is quite interesting, and his alchemy skills surpass Feng Shanxi, but I find it difficult to believe that our princess chose him as her lover."

"I also found it difficult to believe at first, but I've been with that kid for a while now." Feng Xishui took another bottle of wine and downed it before continuing. "Have you ever met a cultivator at his level who was able to face a cultivator at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm?"
"Hmm?" Feng Yongheng raised his eyebrows in disbelief, prompting Feng Xishui to explain to him about Zhang Fei [4]'s fight with Da Xiongmao and the other natural races. "Is all that true?"

Feng Xishui nodded at him. "That kid couldn't kill them directly because of the sheer difference in their strengths, but his abilities and speed allowed him to defeat them. If he breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms in the future, I believe he will surpass all the cultivators in the upper realms, and he will no longer have any opponents at that time. He will make a move against Long Aotian soon, so help me prepare our people. We will respond if the Dragon Clan attacks us."
"Let's go."

In the Blazing Phoenix Sect, Feng Qingmeng also received orders from Feng Yao. She immediately gathered all the elders of the sect, including Feng Shanxi. She then informed them about their princess's order.
"Are we really going to war with the Dragon Clan, Sect Master?"

"Aren't our princess's orders clear, Feng Xun?" Feng Qingmeng asked back. "However, we will not move immediately, and we will only move if the Dragon Clan invades our clan, so I want all of you to prepare from now on. As for our members in our residence, Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng will prepare them. Leave now and prepare everything."
"Yes, Sect Master."

Almost all of them immediately moved to carry out the order, but Feng Shanxi remained in the room. "This realm has been peaceful for so long, but the arrival of that kid changed the situation in a single day, and our princess was even willing to go to war with the Dragon Clan for him."

"All of this happened because of Long Qichao's foolishness." Feng Qingmeng replied with a soft sigh. "If he hadn't sent Long Jishan and Long Yingwu to suppress that kid, he wouldn't have humiliated the Dragon Clan in public, and the way he treated Long Aotian earlier showed that he was vengeful. By the way, the effects of his pills are beneficial to us, so you have to meet him at our residence to get them, though they are priced at eleven million blue jewels."
"All right, I will meet him after I take care of some things."

After Feng Shanxi left, Feng Qingmeng went to the side of the window, watching the situation on the floating island from her room. "What will happen next? Will the Dragon Clan disappear from this realm?"

Zhang Fei [5], who was cultivating in his room, immediately opened his eyes. He then left his room, but he found Ning Zhuan'er waiting in front of him. "Were you waiting for me?"
"Yes, Senior Brother." Ning Zhuan'er answered softly. "I wanted to ask you about alchemy, but you were busy cultivating, so I waited here."
Zhang Fei [5] then sat in front of Ning Zhuan'er. "What do you want to ask me?"
Ning Zhuan'er immediately asked him several questions, and Zhang Fei [5] patiently answered each one. "Is it okay if I fail?"

"Zhuan'er, I failed many times when I first learned alchemy." Zhang Fei [5] then took Ning Zhuan'er's hand, causing her to blush. "Failure is a process for achieving success, so it doesn't matter if you fail too many times. However, you should not be disappointed by your failure, especially since it will drag you down. Instead, use your failures to motivate and learn from them, and you will be able to become a skilled alchemist.
"Uhm." Ning Zhuan'er shyly nodded. "So, what should I do now?"

Zhang Fei [5] then took out his furnace and several bundles of herbs, and he also shared a pill recipe with Ning Zhuan'er. "These herbs are the ingredients for concocting the pill, but you should study the recipe first. Once you are sure you understand the recipe, you can use them to concoct the pill. You don't need to focus on making the highest-grade pill; just attempt to make it without worrying about its grade. Once you have successfully concocted it once, you can try to concoct it again to get a better grade, and you will continue to do so until you have successfully concocted the best one."
"I understand, Senior Brother." Ning Zhuan'er immediately closed her eyes and read the pill recipe in her mind. 'Five Elemental Pills? Where did senior brother Fei get this recipe from?'

"Are you interested in taking Zhuan'er as your disciple?" Feng Shanxi inquired, observing the girl closely.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Zhuan'er's talent in cultivation and alchemy is excellent, so I thought of taking her with me. However, she is your disciple, so I cannot do it without your consent."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately received the bag and handed two bottles of pills to Feng Shanxi, making her smile with joy. "Zhenxia wants to talk to you about alchemy, so I'll leave her here."
