Long Zhenxia bit her lower lip and squeezed her hands together. "Are you willing to teach me if I accept your conditions?"

sentences.text: In the Phoenix Realm, Feltia [2] was upset after he searched the realm for the location of the Divine Phoenix Totem without success.
"Where could the totem be hiding?
Feng Yichen was sure that the totem returned to this realm, but I have already searched almost the entire area to no avail.
Do you detect any hidden places in this realm, Mei?"
[Master, the only area you haven't checked is the Phoenix Palace.
However, you won't be able to enter there without Feng Jiu's or Feng Tian's permission, so you have to meet one of them first.]
Feltia [2] shook his head slightly.
"If I tell them that I want to look for the Divine Phoenix Totem there, they won't be willing to let me in, and they will order their race members to look for it there."
[Well?
The Divine Phoenix Totem is a treasure belonging to the Phoenix Race, so it's natural that they would want to obtain it, right?]
"Yeah." Feltia [2] then flew to the icy lake.
"I feel my ice elemental law will break through to the intermediate stage soon, so I'll improve it first, and I'll look for the totem again later."
Upon arrival, Feltia [2] looked at Zhang Yue, who was immersed in his cultivation.
He didn't disturb his big sister and dove directly into the icy lake.
Zhang Fei [4] left the three female demons resting in the room and went to meet Feng Yao on the flying artifact's hull.
"Do you know anything about the Temple of Forgotten Flames and the Forgotten Land?"
"Hmm?" Feng Yao turned to Zhang Fei [4] and stared at him for a while.

"I don't know where you got the information about those two places, especially since Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu shouldn't know about either of them, but I can tell you that they are connected to each other, and both places are much older than the Paradise Realm.
If you manage to find the Forgotten Land, you will find the Temple of Forgotten Flames."
"Older than the Paradise Realm?" Zhang Fei [4] was shocked.
"Doesn't that mean that people from the Forgotten Land are much stronger than the cultivators there?"
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him.
"They're strong because they're direct descendants of the ancients; you'll see for yourself if you go there and meet them."
"The ancients, huh?" Zhang Fei [4] mumbled.
"Do you know the way to that place?"
"I know, but I won't tell you about it, and you have to find your own way to get there.
Only a few people in the Paradise Realm know about the Forgotten Land and the way to get there." Feng Yao's answer disappointed Zhang Fei [4], but he knew that the place was still far from his reach.
"If you can go to that place and meet the mysterious merchant who appears once every hundred years, you can buy many valuable items from that person.
However, you need a special token, and you have to pass several tests to get it."
Zhang Fei [4] smiled faintly because he had obtained the Spirit Merchant Token from the system, and he also obtained the Golden Auction Token for attending the auction at that place.
"What mysteries lie within the Temple of Forgotten Flames?"
"Sigh." Feng Yao released a soft sigh.
"I've visited the Temple of Forgotten Flames, but it was completely empty."
Zhang Fei [4] was perplexed by this, as the system gave him 1/6 of the map that led to the Temple of Forgotten Flames, and Murong Mengying found another part of the map at the Sun Tower.
He believed the system would never give him anything useless, so he was sure there was something hidden there.
Huo Ling suddenly came out of Feng Yao's body and glared at Zhang Fei [4], making him smile bitterly at her attitude.
"The Temple of Forgotten Flames was built by a primordial living being, and it became the home of the Primordial Flames."
"Primordial living beings and primordial flames." Even though he had seen many things in the Era of the Beginning, Zhang Fei [4] was still shocked to hear these two.
Huo Ling then continued.
"The primordial flames were the lifeblood of the Forgotten Land, and they were also the source of power for living beings with fire elements.
Unfortunately, the flames disappeared several million years ago, and no outsiders came to that place again after that.
As time went by, that place became a forgotten place, and the people there had forgotten about the flames."
Huo Ling's words made Zhang Fei [4] realize several things.
"Did the people from the Forgotten Land seal their place on purpose?
Even though the flames have disappeared, that place is ancient.
There are some intriguing things there too, so they shouldn't forget about that place, right?"

"They didn't seal their place, and it disappeared from the public by itself." Zhang Fei [4] immediately suspected that the will of the universe had purposely hidden the place from the public after the primordial flames disappeared.
"That place reappeared after some cultivators from the Paradise Realm accidentally found their way there, but they hid the route from the public, so only a handful of people knew about it."
"Thank you for all that information, Huo Ling." The female fire spirit didn't say anything and entered Feng Yao's body again, making Zhang Fei [4] a little annoyed.
"I don't know what happened to the primordial flames or how they disappeared, but I'm sure there's something hidden in the Temple of Forgotten Flames.
Once I become strong and ascend to the Paradise Realm, I'll go look for those two places."
"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled at Zhang Fei [4]'s determination.
"I don't know how you can be so sure there's something hidden there, but I'll wait for you to solve all the mysteries.
So, are you having trouble on the Sky Dragon Island?"
"Did Feng Qingmeng tell you anything?" Feng Yao responded to Zhang Fei [4] with a smile.
"I wasn't looking for trouble with them, but Long Aotian and his Dragon Clan came and looked for trouble with me.
That old man thought your Phoenix Clan would protect me from them, and he ordered his clan members to prepare for war with your clan."
Feng Yao shook her head.
"Even Long Qiang, the patriarch of the main Dragon Clan, and his ancestors don't dare to find trouble with my Phoenix Clan.
Yet, a fool like Long Aotian wants to go to war with us, which means he seeks death and destruction for the branch Dragon Clan.
By the way, you don't need to worry about them; instead, concentrate on that old man.
Feng Xishui will take care of his members if they truly want to go to war with us."
"Won't that affect your Phoenix Clan's relationship with the main Dragon Clan?"
Feng Yao shrugged her shoulders.
"You may not know this, but my Phoenix Clan has always been at odds with the Main Dragon Clan.
Long Qiang's ancestors were powerful, but Feng Shen and Feng Xueying managed to defeat them in the past, and their injuries should not have been fully recovered."
"What happened between the two clans?"
"The pride of the dragons." Zhang Fei [4] raised his eyebrows.
"The dragons are the most arrogant among all the mystical beasts, and they think that they are the strongest among us, especially because of the existence of the five-clawed golden dragon.
As a result, they attempted to subjugate other mystical beast races, but they were met with crushing defeats from several races, including from my Phoenix Clan.
Since then, Long Qiang and his dragon clan have not dared to attack us, and we have not retaliated against them either.
Since Long Aotian thought he could defeat us, I will let Feng Xishui teach him a lesson that he will never forget for the rest of his life."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Feng Yao.
"In that case, I will focus on Long Aotian and Long Qichao, and Senior Xishui can take care of the rest of them."
"What are your plans for those two men?"
"You'll find out soon." Zhang Fei [4] immediately left Feng Yao and returned to his room.
[Master, how did that kid know about those two places?] Huo Ling suddenly asked.
"There are many secrets inside him, and one of them tells him about the two places.

You don't need to dwell on this matter, and we will know the answer in the future." Feng Yao immediately contacted Feng Xishui, asking him to prepare for action if the Dragon Clan dared to attack their Phoenix Clan.
She also reached out to several others for additional support.
Somewhere in the Sky Dragon Realm, Feng Xishui smiled to himself as he downed a bottle of wine.
"Why are you suddenly smiling to yourself?" A young man with fiery red hair posed the question.
Feng Xishui pointed at the Dragon Clan.
"Look over there, Feng Yongheng.
Those giant worms looked for trouble with our princess's lover first, but they didn't want to repent for their mistake.
Instead, they planned to wage a war with our Phoenix Clan if we helped her lover, and she asked me to take care of them."
"Hahahaha!" Feng Yongheng laughed out loud.
"Long Aotian will be furious if you call him a giant worm in front of him!
Speaking of that kid, he is quite interesting, and his alchemy skills surpass Feng Shanxi, but I find it difficult to believe that our princess chose him as her lover."
"I also found it difficult to believe at first, but I've been with that kid for a while now." Feng Xishui took another bottle of wine and downed it before continuing.
"Have you ever met a cultivator at his level who was able to face a cultivator at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm?"
"Hmm?" Feng Yongheng raised his eyebrows in disbelief, prompting Feng Xishui to explain to him about Zhang Fei [4]'s fight with Da Xiongmao and the other natural races.
"Is all that true?"
Feng Xishui nodded at him.
"That kid couldn't kill them directly because of the sheer difference in their strengths, but his abilities and speed allowed him to defeat them.
If he breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms in the future, I believe he will surpass all the cultivators in the upper realms, and he will no longer have any opponents at that time.
He will make a move against Long Aotian soon, so help me prepare our people.
We will respond if the Dragon Clan attacks us."
"Let's go."
In the Blazing Phoenix Sect, Feng Qingmeng also received orders from Feng Yao.
She immediately gathered all the elders of the sect, including Feng Shanxi.
She then informed them about their princess's order.
"Are we really going to war with the Dragon Clan, Sect Master?"
"Aren't our princess's orders clear, Feng Xun?" Feng Qingmeng asked back.
"However, we will not move immediately, and we will only move if the Dragon Clan invades our clan, so I want all of you to prepare from now on.
As for our members in our residence, Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng will prepare them.
Leave now and prepare everything."
"Yes, Sect Master."
Almost all of them immediately moved to carry out the order, but Feng Shanxi remained in the room.
"This realm has been peaceful for so long, but the arrival of that kid changed the situation in a single day, and our princess was even willing to go to war with the Dragon Clan for him."
"All of this happened because of Long Qichao's foolishness." Feng Qingmeng replied with a soft sigh.
"If he hadn't sent Long Jishan and Long Yingwu to suppress that kid, he wouldn't have humiliated the Dragon Clan in public, and the way he treated Long Aotian earlier showed that he was vengeful.
By the way, the effects of his pills are beneficial to us, so you have to meet him at our residence to get them, though they are priced at eleven million blue jewels."
"All right, I will meet him after I take care of some things."
After Feng Shanxi left, Feng Qingmeng went to the side of the window, watching the situation on the floating island from her room.
"What will happen next?
Will the Dragon Clan disappear from this realm?"

chapters.title: Chapter 865: Golden Dragon Shrine
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] immediately stood up, pulled Long Zhenxia into his embrace, and traced her figure, especially her waist. "I am a lover of women, and I will not refuse a woman like you. However, I do not like women who have no self-respect and want to use any means to fulfill their ambitions, including sacrificing their bodies. Among all my official wives, there is only one woman who has the same thoughts as you, but her situation is different from yours."
"Huh?" Long Zhenxia looked at Zhang Fei [5] with repeated blinks. "Do you really have that many wives?"

"I have dozens of official and unofficial women." Zhang Fei [5] replied in a casual manner, leaving Long Zhenxia dumbfounded. "I'm a dual cultivator, so it's natural that I have so many women by my side, right?"

Long Zhenxia did not answer Zhang Fei [5] as she was shocked by the number of his women; never before had she met a man who had so many women. Even her patriarch only had three wives, even though he was so powerful.
Zhang Fei [5] released Long Zhenxia. "Go back and reconsider your decision."

"What's the difference between me and that woman? Why did you accept her but reject me?" Long Zhenxia asked in a bitter voice; she had already lowered her dignity and begged Zhang Fei [5], but he rejected her.

"My wife used to live in a chaotic realm, unlike you, who lived in a peaceful environment under the protection of powerful people. Many members of her race died at the hands of dictators in her realm; she herself almost died in their hands. Fortunately, she met my big sister, and she saved her. At first, I would rather not accept her because she wanted to take advantage of me, but I changed my mind after I witnessed her situation with my own eyes, and I also saved her remaining race members." Long Zhenxia nodded understandingly, but Zhang Fei [5]'s next words shocked her. "Furthermore, Long Aotian and your Dragon Clan are my enemies now, and you are a part of them. I can accept you and teach you my alchemy techniques, but your status as their member does not rule out the possibility that you will betray me, and I will not risk my safety to get you."
Long Zhenxia trembled a bit strongly. "What... what actually happened? Why... why are you enemies with my Dragon Clan?"

"Go back to your clan, and you can ask them for the answer." Long Zhenxia stared at him for a while before turning to leave, but Zhang Fei [5] said something else to her. "If you can prove that you will never betray me, and if you can help me with something about your Dragon Clan, I will consider accepting you."
Long Zhenxia stopped at her spot and turned to Zhang Fei [5] with a cold gaze. "Do you think I will betray my clan and help you attack them?"

"I don't need your help to fight them, especially since I already have plenty of help. Moreover, I hate traitors the most, and I will never accept you if you betray them." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer confused Long Zhenxia. "I want to know the secret path to the mountain peak, and it should be an easy task, right?"

"Only the seniors of my Dragon Clan know about the secret passage, and they keep it hidden from a junior like me, so I can't tell you about it. Even if I knew about the secret passage, I still wouldn't tell you about it, especially since you are my clan's enemy." After she said that, Long Zhenxia hurriedly left the Phoenix Clan, but Zhang Fei [5] shot something at her, which entered her body without her realizing it.
[Why don't you just accept Long Zhenxia and use her as you please, Master?]
Zhang Fei [5] did not answer Mei and looked at Ning Zhuan'er, who had already opened her eyes and was looking at him in astonishment. "Did you hear my conversation with Long Zhenxia just now?"
"Uhm." Ning Zhuan'er replied with a slight nod. "Are you really going to be an enemy of the Dragon Clan, Senior Brother? They are powerful, and they will gang up on you."

"I never look for trouble with anyone, but the Dragon Clan was hostile to me from the start due to their fear and greed." Zhang Fei [5] then sat in front of Ning Zhuan'er again. "Do you want to be my disciple, Zhuan'er? Previously, Feng Shanxi came here, and she gave me permission to take you as my disciple."
"Huh?" Ning Zhuan'er was shocked and excited by that. "Did...did Elder Shanxi really allow me to be your disciple, Senior Brother Fei?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "You can confirm this matter to Feng Shanxi if you wish."
"No need, I believe you, Senior Brother Fei."
Ning Zhuan'er wanted to stand up and pay her respects to him, but Zhang Fei [5] stopped her. "There is no need for such a formality with me, and you can address me as Big Brother from now on."
"Big Brother." Ning Zhuan'er called out in excitement.
Zhang Fei [5] decided to share the Divine Alchemy Method with her, which shocked her. "Learn the technique first, and you can start your alchemy after that."

Ning Zhuan'er was once again shocked after learning the grade of the technique, but she quickly calmed her mind and studied it seriously. 'Big Brother Fei gave me such an amazing technique, so I must not disappoint him, and I will become a great alchemist to help him.'
[Master, do you want to take Zhuan'er as your disciple or your woman?] Mei asked in a teasing tone.

Zhang Fei [5] simply smiled in response to Mei's questions, and he looked at Ning Zhuan'er with a satisfied smile. 'Lingxue, Ying'er, and Qing'er are Li Jingxia's disciples now. The alchemist goddess gave them a lot of knowledge about alchemy, so I will let Zhuan'er study with them later.'

Long Zhenxia had just arrived at the Dragon Clan, but she saw many of her clan members on strict guard, and many of them were busy preparing weapons and armor for war. 'What exactly has happened here? Why are they so strict and busy? Are they going to war with another clan?'

Long Zhenxia then rushed to the area where her family lived, but she found her parents having a serious discussion, and her brother was also with them. "Sister, our patriarch is preparing to go to war with the Phoenix Clan."
"The Phoenix Clan?" Long Zhenxia was shocked to hear that. "Why does our patriarch want to go to war with them?"
"Zhang Fei." Long Taiyuan directly told Long Zhenxia about the situation. "Our patriarch suspects that the Phoenix Clan will protect him, so he will go to war with them if they really do that."
Long Zhenxia let out a heavy sigh before sitting by their side. "Are you two also going to participate in this war, Father and Mother?"

"Xia'er, we are members of the Dragon Clan, and we cannot disobey our patriarch's order." Long Xiaogang replied with a heavy sigh. "Long Qichao was too reckless in sending our men to capture that kid, and the matter became even more complicated when he fought back and humiliated our men in public. That kid even humiliated our patriarch in front of the other leaders of the other beast clans, which deepened the problems between us."

Long Zhenxia's mother, Long Xinran, then spoke. "Xia'er, I know you are serious about your alchemy, but our patriarch has already prohibited everyone from going to the Phoenix Clan or the Blazing Phoenix Sect. Therefore, you have to stay in our residence for the time being, and you can go to our Golden Dragon Sect if you want to practice alchemy."

Long Zhenxia frowned when she heard that, especially since she had never liked the environment in the Golden Dragon Sect, and she chose to join the Blazing Phoenix Sect because of Long Qingcao. "I won't go to our sect, or that old bastard will try to molest me again, Mother."
"All right, you don't need to go to our sect and do your alchemy here."
After that, Long Zhenxia returned to her room, but her mind kept thinking about her conversation with Zhang Fei [5] earlier.

Meanwhile, the demon eye's orb floated slowly and followed Long Aotian, who was walking towards the back area of the Dragon Clan. Several people followed behind him, including Long Qichao, Long Jishan, and Long Yingwu.

Before long, they arrived at the back area of their clan, and there was a teleportation portal there. Long Aotian immediately activated the portal and led them into it, and the demon eye's orb followed them right before the portal turned itself off.
In a few moments, they arrived at the mountain slope, and Long Aotian pressed a rock in that area, revealing a hidden room with a staircase leading to the top.
"Let's go in." Long Aotian led his clan members up the staircase, followed by the demon eye's orb.

Not long after they entered, Zhang Fei [5] appeared at that place, and he checked the rock that Long Aotian had pressed earlier. "No wonder the other leaders couldn't find the entrance; it turns out they hid it here."

Zhang Fei [5] activated his invisibility, pressed the stone, and carefully climbed the staircase. The inside of the mountain was quite wide, with crystal stones illuminating both sides, and he also saw many valuable materials on the two walls, tempting him to dig them out.

"How could their ancestors build this kind of place? Additionally, the materials on these walls are extremely valuable and ancient, and I can sell them at sky-high prices in my shop." Zhang Fei [5] then took out a hongxi dagger and dug a blackish-red rock out of one of the walls. "This Bloodfire Obsidian contains strong fire qi essence, and not only can it be used for forging, but it can also be used to help fire cultivators strengthen their fire elements."
[Master, I think you can use one of your clones to dig up these materials, and you can get a lot of jewels if you sell them in the Red Sun Realm or the Xianjin Realm.]

"After my ice element reaches the intermediate stage, Feltia [2] will come here to dig them up, and those foolish Dragon Clan members won't notice my actions." Zhang Fei [5] dug out another stone, which was purple with lightning flashes in it. "What is this stone, Mei?"

[According to the system, it is the naturally formed Heavenstorm Thunderite, and it contains the essence of heavenly tribulation lightning. It can help lightning cultivators to increase their lightning power, and it can also absorb lightning bolts that attack you.]
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5]'s eyes lit up. "Do you think I can use this stone to deal with the lightning bolts in Cywanwood Mountain, Mei?"

[I think it can be done, Master. However, the lightning bolts in Cyanwood Mountain are too powerful, and the lightning elemental law strengthens them even further. Thus, you will need a lot of these stones if you want to use them for that, especially since the capacity of each stone is not as large as you imagine. If the stones are not destroyed by then, you can give them to all your women with lightning elements, and their strength will increase quite significantly.]

"All right, I will let Feltia [2] dig up as many of these Heavenstorm Thunderites as possible, and I will try to use them to take the lightning elemental seed in the Cyanwood Mountain." After that, Zhang Fei [5] continued his journey to the top.

After several hours of climbing, Zhang Fei [5] finally saw the peak of the mountain, but he did not leave the secret passage and observed the people from the Dragon Clan using the demon eye's orb. However, the scenery outside surprised him, especially the existence of the shrine.

The shrine was enormous, and it was built using celestial gold. Its walls were carved with swirling dragon motifs that seemed to move when lightning arced across the sky, and it radiated an aura of overwhelming majesty. A giant statue of a Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, with its head resting on the roof of the temple and its body encircling the temple. Its eyes, inlaid with golden crystals, glowed faintly as if watching everyone who entered the place.

'So, it's true that this golden dragon once lived here, huh?' Zhang Fei [5] immediately pulled the demon eye's orb back as soon as he detected an unusual aura from within the shrine, especially after Long Aotian opened the shrine's gate.

Zhang Fei [5], who was still in the invisible state, immediately transformed into his complete fox form. He shrunk his body and hid his other five tails, and he also modified his body in such a way by using his body modification ability in case Long Aotian and the others detected his presence.
After that, Zhang Fei [5] left the secret passage and teleported in front of the shrine's gate before following the people from the Dragon Clan into it.

In the front hall of the shrine, Zhang Fei [5] saw various kinds of dragon statues lined up neatly on both sides, such as a white dragon with six wings, an azure dragon, a yellow dragon, and many others.

Zhang Fei [5] was not interested in all of the dragon statues, but there was one dragon statue that caught his attention, especially since it was a black dragon with glowing red eyes. However, the black dragon statue did not stand on either side of the room but was forced to lie down in the middle of the front hall, and golden chains bound its body.

The black dragon's obsidian-black scales are streaked with glowing crimson, as if molten fire flows just beneath its skin. Horns curve like jagged blades from its skull, and its glowing eyes blaze with pure hatred and ancient power. Its snarling maw reveals rows of dagger-like teeth, ready to tear everything. Even though it was just a statue, it exuded an oppressive aura, and its aura felt like the weight of a thousand curses. 'Mei, look for data about this dragon in the system! This black dragon is definitely not an ordinary dragon, and it seems to be the enemy of these dragons.'
[I'll try it, Master.]

Zhang Fei [5] then followed those people into the inner hall of the shrine, and he saw another Five-Clawed Golden Dragon statue, but it was much smaller than the one outside, and it curled up on a golden throne. Below, hundreds of small dragon statues of various races were lined up neatly, and all of them bowed their heads to their leader.

After they stood in front of the throne, Long Aotian instantly transformed into his white half-dragon form, and he had six wings like the white dragon statue in the outer hall. Long Qichao and the others followed him, but their half-dragon forms were different.

Zhang Fei [5], on the other hand, was lying leisurely on a large log under the roof. He checked the identities of the people one by one. 'Long Aotian is a sky dragon, huh? Long Qichao is a flame dragon, Long Jishan is a thunder dragon, and Long Yingwu is a rain dragon. How many jewels will I get if I sell their body parts, Mei?'
[Master, you are completely crazy! If you kill them and sell their body parts, then all the dragon races in the universe will hunt you down, which will only add to your problems.]
'I'm just asking, okay?'
[Humph! I know your thoughts, and you intend to sell their body part!]
'Hahaha.' Zhang Fei [5] laughed in response, but he saw Long Aotian take out a small golden vessel. 'What are they going to do exactly?'

sentences.text: Zhang Fei [5] immediately stood up, pulled Long Zhenxia into his embrace, and traced her figure, especially her waist.
"I am a lover of women, and I will not refuse a woman like you.
However, I do not like women who have no self-respect and want to use any means to fulfill their ambitions, including sacrificing their bodies.
Among all my official wives, there is only one woman who has the same thoughts as you, but her situation is different from yours."
"Huh?" Long Zhenxia looked at Zhang Fei [5] with repeated blinks.
"Do you really have that many wives?"
"I have dozens of official and unofficial women." Zhang Fei [5] replied in a casual manner, leaving Long Zhenxia dumbfounded.
"I'm a dual cultivator, so it's natural that I have so many women by my side, right?"
Long Zhenxia did not answer Zhang Fei [5] as she was shocked by the number of his women; never before had she met a man who had so many women.
Even her patriarch only had three wives, even though he was so powerful.
Zhang Fei [5] released Long Zhenxia.
"Go back and reconsider your decision."
"What's the difference between me and that woman?
Why did you accept her but reject me?" Long Zhenxia asked in a bitter voice; she had already lowered her dignity and begged Zhang Fei [5], but he rejected her.
"My wife used to live in a chaotic realm, unlike you, who lived in a peaceful environment under the protection of powerful people.
Many members of her race died at the hands of dictators in her realm; she herself almost died in their hands.
Fortunately, she met my big sister, and she saved her.

At first, I would rather not accept her because she wanted to take advantage of me, but I changed my mind after I witnessed her situation with my own eyes, and I also saved her remaining race members." Long Zhenxia nodded understandingly, but Zhang Fei [5]'s next words shocked her.
"Furthermore, Long Aotian and your Dragon Clan are my enemies now, and you are a part of them.
I can accept you and teach you my alchemy techniques, but your status as their member does not rule out the possibility that you will betray me, and I will not risk my safety to get you."
Long Zhenxia trembled a bit strongly.
"What... what actually happened?
Why... why are you enemies with my Dragon Clan?"
"Go back to your clan, and you can ask them for the answer." Long Zhenxia stared at him for a while before turning to leave, but Zhang Fei [5] said something else to her.
"If you can prove that you will never betray me, and if you can help me with something about your Dragon Clan, I will consider accepting you."
Long Zhenxia stopped at her spot and turned to Zhang Fei [5] with a cold gaze.
"Do you think I will betray my clan and help you attack them?"
"I don't need your help to fight them, especially since I already have plenty of help.
Moreover, I hate traitors the most, and I will never accept you if you betray them." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer confused Long Zhenxia.
"I want to know the secret path to the mountain peak, and it should be an easy task, right?"
"Only the seniors of my Dragon Clan know about the secret passage, and they keep it hidden from a junior like me, so I can't tell you about it.

Even if I knew about the secret passage, I still wouldn't tell you about it, especially since you are my clan's enemy." After she said that, Long Zhenxia hurriedly left the Phoenix Clan, but Zhang Fei [5] shot something at her, which entered her body without her realizing it.
[Why don't you just accept Long Zhenxia and use her as you please, Master?]
Zhang Fei [5] did not answer Mei and looked at Ning Zhuan'er, who had already opened her eyes and was looking at him in astonishment.
"Did you hear my conversation with Long Zhenxia just now?"
"Uhm." Ning Zhuan'er replied with a slight nod.
"Are you really going to be an enemy of the Dragon Clan, Senior Brother?
They are powerful, and they will gang up on you."
"I never look for trouble with anyone, but the Dragon Clan was hostile to me from the start due to their fear and greed." Zhang Fei [5] then sat in front of Ning Zhuan'er again.
"Do you want to be my disciple, Zhuan'er?
Previously, Feng Shanxi came here, and she gave me permission to take you as my disciple."
"Huh?" Ning Zhuan'er was shocked and excited by that.
"Did...did Elder Shanxi really allow me to be your disciple, Senior Brother Fei?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"You can confirm this matter to Feng Shanxi if you wish."
"No need, I believe you, Senior Brother Fei."
Ning Zhuan'er wanted to stand up and pay her respects to him, but Zhang Fei [5] stopped her.
"There is no need for such a formality with me, and you can address me as Big Brother from now on."
"Big Brother." Ning Zhuan'er called out in excitement.
Zhang Fei [5] decided to share the Divine Alchemy Method with her, which shocked her.
"Learn the technique first, and you can start your alchemy after that."

Ning Zhuan'er was once again shocked after learning the grade of the technique, but she quickly calmed her mind and studied it seriously. 'Big Brother Fei gave me such an amazing technique, so I must not disappoint him, and I will become a great alchemist to help him.'
[Master, do you want to take Zhuan'er as your disciple or your woman?] Mei asked in a teasing tone.
Zhang Fei [5] simply smiled in response to Mei's questions, and he looked at Ning Zhuan'er with a satisfied smile. 'Lingxue, Ying'er, and Qing'er are Li Jingxia's disciples now.
The alchemist goddess gave them a lot of knowledge about alchemy, so I will let Zhuan'er study with them later.'

Long Zhenxia had just arrived at the Dragon Clan, but she saw many of her clan members on strict guard, and many of them were busy preparing weapons and armor for war. 'What exactly has happened here?
Why are they so strict and busy?
Are they going to war with another clan?'
Long Zhenxia then rushed to the area where her family lived, but she found her parents having a serious discussion, and her brother was also with them.
"Sister, our patriarch is preparing to go to war with the Phoenix Clan."
"The Phoenix Clan?" Long Zhenxia was shocked to hear that.
"Why does our patriarch want to go to war with them?"
"Zhang Fei." Long Taiyuan directly told Long Zhenxia about the situation.
"Our patriarch suspects that the Phoenix Clan will protect him, so he will go to war with them if they really do that."
Long Zhenxia let out a heavy sigh before sitting by their side.
"Are you two also going to participate in this war, Father and Mother?"
"Xia'er, we are members of the Dragon Clan, and we cannot disobey our patriarch's order." Long Xiaogang replied with a heavy sigh.
"Long Qichao was too reckless in sending our men to capture that kid, and the matter became even more complicated when he fought back and humiliated our men in public.
That kid even humiliated our patriarch in front of the other leaders of the other beast clans, which deepened the problems between us."
Long Zhenxia's mother, Long Xinran, then spoke.
"Xia'er, I know you are serious about your alchemy, but our patriarch has already prohibited everyone from going to the Phoenix Clan or the Blazing Phoenix Sect.
Therefore, you have to stay in our residence for the time being, and you can go to our Golden Dragon Sect if you want to practice alchemy."
Long Zhenxia frowned when she heard that, especially since she had never liked the environment in the Golden Dragon Sect, and she chose to join the Blazing Phoenix Sect because of Long Qingcao.
"I won't go to our sect, or that old bastard will try to molest me again, Mother."
"All right, you don't need to go to our sect and do your alchemy here."
After that, Long Zhenxia returned to her room, but her mind kept thinking about her conversation with Zhang Fei [5] earlier.
Meanwhile, the demon eye's orb floated slowly and followed Long Aotian, who was walking towards the back area of the Dragon Clan.
Several people followed behind him, including Long Qichao, Long Jishan, and Long Yingwu.
Before long, they arrived at the back area of their clan, and there was a teleportation portal there.
Long Aotian immediately activated the portal and led them into it, and the demon eye's orb followed them right before the portal turned itself off.
In a few moments, they arrived at the mountain slope, and Long Aotian pressed a rock in that area, revealing a hidden room with a staircase leading to the top.
"Let's go in." Long Aotian led his clan members up the staircase, followed by the demon eye's orb.
Not long after they entered, Zhang Fei [5] appeared at that place, and he checked the rock that Long Aotian had pressed earlier.
"No wonder the other leaders couldn't find the entrance; it turns out they hid it here."
Zhang Fei [5] activated his invisibility, pressed the stone, and carefully climbed the staircase.
The inside of the mountain was quite wide, with crystal stones illuminating both sides, and he also saw many valuable materials on the two walls, tempting him to dig them out.
"How could their ancestors build this kind of place?

Additionally, the materials on these walls are extremely valuable and ancient, and I can sell them at sky-high prices in my shop." Zhang Fei [5] then took out a hongxi dagger and dug a blackish-red rock out of one of the walls.
"This Bloodfire Obsidian contains strong fire qi essence, and not only can it be used for forging, but it can also be used to help fire cultivators strengthen their fire elements."
[Master, I think you can use one of your clones to dig up these materials, and you can get a lot of jewels if you sell them in the Red Sun Realm or the Xianjin Realm.]

"After my ice element reaches the intermediate stage, Feltia [2] will come here to dig them up, and those foolish Dragon Clan members won't notice my actions." Zhang Fei [5] dug out another stone, which was purple with lightning flashes in it.
"What is this stone, Mei?"
[According to the system, it is the naturally formed Heavenstorm Thunderite, and it contains the essence of heavenly tribulation lightning.
It can help lightning cultivators to increase their lightning power, and it can also absorb lightning bolts that attack you.]
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5]'s eyes lit up.
"Do you think I can use this stone to deal with the lightning bolts in Cywanwood Mountain, Mei?"
[I think it can be done, Master.
However, the lightning bolts in Cyanwood Mountain are too powerful, and the lightning elemental law strengthens them even further.
Thus, you will need a lot of these stones if you want to use them for that, especially since the capacity of each stone is not as large as you imagine.
If the stones are not destroyed by then, you can give them to all your women with lightning elements, and their strength will increase quite significantly.]

"All right, I will let Feltia [2] dig up as many of these Heavenstorm Thunderites as possible, and I will try to use them to take the lightning elemental seed in the Cyanwood Mountain." After that, Zhang Fei [5] continued his journey to the top.

[Reward: 100 purple jewels sent to the inventory.]
After several hours of climbing, Zhang Fei [5] finally saw the peak of the mountain, but he did not leave the secret passage and observed the people from the Dragon Clan using the demon eye's orb.
However, the scenery outside surprised him, especially the existence of the shrine.
The shrine was enormous, and it was built using celestial gold.
Its walls were carved with swirling dragon motifs that seemed to move when lightning arced across the sky, and it radiated an aura of overwhelming majesty.
A giant statue of a Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, with its head resting on the roof of the temple and its body encircling the temple.
Its eyes, inlaid with golden crystals, glowed faintly as if watching everyone who entered the place.

'So, it's true that this golden dragon once lived here, huh?' Zhang Fei [5] immediately pulled the demon eye's orb back as soon as he detected an unusual aura from within the shrine, especially after Long Aotian opened the shrine's gate.
Zhang Fei [5], who was still in the invisible state, immediately transformed into his complete fox form.
He shrunk his body and hid his other five tails, and he also modified his body in such a way by using his body modification ability in case Long Aotian and the others detected his presence.
After that, Zhang Fei [5] left the secret passage and teleported in front of the shrine's gate before following the people from the Dragon Clan into it.

In the front hall of the shrine, Zhang Fei [5] saw various kinds of dragon statues lined up neatly on both sides, such as a white dragon with six wings, an azure dragon, a yellow dragon, and many others.
Zhang Fei [5] was not interested in all of the dragon statues, but there was one dragon statue that caught his attention, especially since it was a black dragon with glowing red eyes.
However, the black dragon statue did not stand on either side of the room but was forced to lie down in the middle of the front hall, and golden chains bound its body.
The black dragon's obsidian-black scales are streaked with glowing crimson, as if molten fire flows just beneath its skin.
Horns curve like jagged blades from its skull, and its glowing eyes blaze with pure hatred and ancient power.
Its snarling maw reveals rows of dagger-like teeth, ready to tear everything.
Even though it was just a statue, it exuded an oppressive aura, and its aura felt like the weight of a thousand curses. 'Mei, look for data about this dragon in the system!
This black dragon is definitely not an ordinary dragon, and it seems to be the enemy of these dragons.'
[I'll try it, Master.]

Zhang Fei [5] then followed those people into the inner hall of the shrine, and he saw another Five-Clawed Golden Dragon statue, but it was much smaller than the one outside, and it curled up on a golden throne.
Below, hundreds of small dragon statues of various races were lined up neatly, and all of them bowed their heads to their leader.
After they stood in front of the throne, Long Aotian instantly transformed into his white half-dragon form, and he had six wings like the white dragon statue in the outer hall.
Long Qichao and the others followed him, but their half-dragon forms were different.
Zhang Fei [5], on the other hand, was lying leisurely on a large log under the roof.
He checked the identities of the people one by one. 'Long Aotian is a sky dragon, huh?
Long Qichao is a flame dragon, Long Jishan is a thunder dragon, and Long Yingwu is a rain dragon.
How many jewels will I get if I sell their body parts, Mei?'
[Master, you are completely crazy!
If you kill them and sell their body parts, then all the dragon races in the universe will hunt you down, which will only add to your problems.]
'I'm just asking, okay?'
[Humph!
I know your thoughts, and you intend to sell their body part!]
'Hahaha.' Zhang Fei [5] laughed in response, but he saw Long Aotian take out a small golden vessel. 'What are they going to do exactly?'

chapters.title: Chapter 866: Golden Dragon's Avatar
paragraphs: Long Aotian and all the members of the Dragon Clan dripped their dragon blood essence into the small golden vessel, and they also channeled their dragon Qi into it.

The small golden vessel flashed a few times before floating above the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon statue, and it landed directly above the statue's head. A while later, a golden pillar shot out from the statue toward the sky, followed by a dragon roar full of dignity and authority.
*Roar*
The dragon's roar echoed throughout all corners of that realm, and the cultivators from the lower land could hear it, causing panic to sweep across the entire Sky Dragon Realm.

After hearing the dragon's roar, the leaders of the other mythical beast races left their respective places, but they couldn't locate the source, and they flew around the tall mountain in search of it.

In the inner hall of the shrine, the avatar of the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon shot out from the statue, and its giant figure filled the entire room. Its shimmering golden scales glow like molten sunlight. Its body exuded a divine grace, casting a warm, golden light.

"Hmm?" The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar looked at the people with its golden eyes. "Why did you summon my avatar? I don't feel any danger in this realm, and the Calamity Demon Dragon is still sleeping in my seal beneath this mountain."

Zhang Fei [5] was shocked to hear that. 'So my guess was right, huh? The black dragon is indeed still alive, especially since I didn't see its statue in the second room of the Era of the Beginning. However, I didn't expect that it was a Calamity Demon Dragon, and it was sealed in this realm. Since the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon couldn't kill it, their strength should be equal.'

"Hmm?" The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar suddenly turned toward Zhang Fei [5] and snorted, knocking him from his original position. "You can come out; I know you're using invisibility, little fox."

Long Aotian and the others were shocked to hear that, and they were even more shocked when Zhang Fei [5] appeared on his little fox. Long Qichao wanted to move to capture him, but the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon's avatar stopped him.

"Don't do anything to it." The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar used its aura and lifted Zhang Fei [5] before him. "How can a young fox like you enter my shrine? I've seen all kinds of foxes, but I've never seen your kind before."

Zhang Fei [5] was relieved that the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar couldn't see through his disguise. Since he was disguised as a little fox, he didn't reply to the dragon and put on a scared look instead.

"No need to be afraid of me; I won't hurt you." The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar turned to Long Aotian and the others again. "What is your reason for summoning my avatar? I have already told your ancestors not to summon me as long as the Calamity Demon Dragon is still trapped in my seal."

Long Aotian cupped his hands and lowered his head slightly. "Ancestor, a heavenly fox has humiliated our Dragon Clan, and the Phoenix Clan is protecting him. I summoned your avatar to ask for your blessing to wage a war against them, and I hope you can lend a little of your strength to us so that we can win this war."
"Hmm?" The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar narrowed its eyes at Long Aotian. "You deserve to be humiliated by summoning my avatar just for a trivial matter."

Unlike Long Aotian and the others who froze after they heard that, Zhang Fei [5] was laughing out loud in his heart. They thought of asking their ancestors for help in fighting the Phoenix Clan, but the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar insulted them instead.

Long Aotian explained directly. "Ancestor, this may be a trivial matter to you, but the current Phoenix Clan is much stronger than us. Several thousand years ago, they managed to defeat the main Dragon Clan, and our ancestors still haven't recovered to this day. We can't afford to lose to them again, so I was forced to summon your avatar, and I hope you are willing to help us repay the humiliation they gave us in the past."

"If all of you can't defeat the Phoenix Clan with your own strength, you guys don't deserve to be members of my Dragon Clan." Long Aotian wanted to refute, but the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar directly suppressed them, forcing them to kneel. "We dragons are dignified beasts, and we never beg anyone, including our kin. In my eyes, you guys are cowardly dragons, and I will cripple your cultivation if you insist on asking for my help to take care of your trivial matters. Leave now before my patience runs out, and never return as long as the Calamity Demon Dragon is not free from my seal."
'Crap! The ancestor is furious!' Long Aotian and the others hurriedly left the place after the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar withdrew its aura.

"Sigh! I have long ascended from the three mortal realms, and my descendants in the three mortal realms have become losers. They can't even settle a trivial matter by themselves, embarrassing my Dragon Clan." The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "Now tell me who you really are."
Zhang Fei [5] blinked his eyes repeatedly, pretending not to understand the meaning behind the question from the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar.

"Kid, I have lived for millions of years, and there is no beast I have not seen. I do not know how you disguised yourself, but I know your appearance is not your true form, and I suspect that you are the one who is looking for trouble with those foolish descendants of mine."

'Tch! An old creature like this guy is indeed difficult to deceive, but this dragon is not as bad as I imagined.' Zhang Fei [5] restored his body and transformed into his half-fox form. "Unfortunately, you're wrong about that, Old Dragon. I'm not looking for trouble with those idiots, and I came to this realm just to open my shop, but they came to me to look for trouble with me."
"A heavenly fox, right?"
"That's right."

"Explain to me your situation with them." Zhang Fei [5] then informed the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar about the matter between him and the Dragon Clan. "The old dragons from my Dragon Clan are as arrogant as them, including me, but we have the ability to back up our arrogance. Those descendants of mine are cowardly dragons, but they dare to act arrogant, and they even gang up on a weak beast like you."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "At first, I thought you would help them, but instead, you insulted them and chased them away. Since you won't intervene in this matter, I won't be afraid of them."

The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar let out a soft sigh. "You should ignore pathetic cowards like them and focus on yourself, especially since the three mortal realms are not the end of our journey."

"The Paradise Realm, right?" The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar was surprised to hear that from Zhang Fei [5]. "I have some acquaintances from that realm, and I will go there in the future. However, there are so many people on my side, so I want to gather a lot of cultivation resources for us to procure before we go there, and one of them is to open a shop in this realm. By the way, my name is Zhang Fei, Old Dragon."
"Long Wuzhao." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly remembered an item and took it out immediately before showing it to him. "Oh? Where did you get this Celestial Dragon Token?"
Zhang Fei [5] told him directly. "An old friend of mine, Tianshi Shengjie, gave it to me. Since you are the ancestor of all dragons, the celestial dragons are also your descendants, right?"

"So, you are the man in the ten-tailed fox's prophecy." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Long Wuzhao in surprise. "I was the one who sent Little Shengjie to the three mortal realms to look for the fox's successor, but I didn't expect her to find you so soon."

"I know the reason you are looking for me, but I am not interested in it yet, especially since I am still weak." Zhang Fei [5] then asked Long Wuzhao. "What's the deal with the Calamity Demon Dragon? Why did you seal it under this mountain? Why didn't you kill it directly?"

"Like Yang and Yin, my birth represented Yang, and Long Zhaihuo's birth represented Yin. All of his powers were related to destruction, and his calamity tribulation techniques were terrifying." Long Wuzhao shot out his golden qi slightly, and several screens made of it appeared before them. "In the past, our strengths were equal, but I was never truly able to defeat him. Even with the help of the other ancient beasts, I still couldn't kill him."

Those Qi screens showed so much destruction caused by the Calamity Demon Dragon, and many realms were destroyed because of him. Zhang Fei [5] was horrified and amazed at the same time, and all the destruction gave him an idea of the immense strength of the Calamity Demon Dragon.

Long Wuzhao spoke to Zhang Fei [5] again. "All the events you saw happened several million years ago, long before I ascended to the Paradise Realm. When the time came for me to ascend, I could not possibly let Long Zhaihuo destroy the three mortal realms, so I tried to create a sealing formation to seal him. With the help of all the ancient beasts, I succeeded in creating it, and we used it to seal him in this realm. To prevent other living creatures from discovering his existence, we deliberately placed this mountain above his seal, and I built this shrine to monitor him."
"Is Long Zhaihuo still alive now?"

Long Wuzhao nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "Long Zhaihuo is still alive inside my seal, but he is much weaker than in the past. Despite this, he is still capable of bringing great calamity to the three mortal realms, so we cannot let him go free. He must have a lot of hatred in his heart, and he will destroy everything if he is freed from my seal."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] agreed with that. "If I were in Long Zhaihuo's position, vengeance and hatred would definitely fill my heart and mind, and I would destroy everything in front of me if I managed to break free. Did you place other formations in the seal room?"

"Yes." Long Wuzhao then warned Zhang Fei [5]. "You'd better put away your idea to go to Long Zhaihuo's seal room, or his hatred will affect you, and you will become more evil than him, especially with the cursed demon heart in your body."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Long Wuzhao in surprise. "How did you know the demon heart was in my body?"

"I killed the demon, so I'm familiar with his aura." Long Wuzhao's answer shocked Zhang Fei [5]. "I wanted to destroy his heart, but someone stole it from me. I've been looking for the culprit for a long time but failed, and I didn't expect that it was in your body now. If you weren't the ten-tailed fox's successor, I would kill you along with the heart."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed wryly. "I guess I'm lucky? Can you please teach me how to control this cursed demon heart?"

"The only way for you to control the cursed demon heart is to not lose your humanity, so you must continue to maintain your humanity." Long Wuzhao dispelled all the Qi screens. "My time is up, so I will leave now, and I will wait for you in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Long Wuzhao. "I will definitely meet you there after I ascend to the Paradise Realm."
"Farewell for now, Zhang Fei." Long Wuzhao immediately disappeared from that place.

Since there was nothing there, Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to the outer hall and stood in front of the statue of the Calamity Demon Dragon. "If this dragon was that strong in the past, why didn't the old fox kill him? The will of the universe tells me that his strength is on par with the two primordial beasts, so he should be able to kill him."
[Master, the ten-tailed fox could predict your birth, so I think he has a special plan for the Calamity Demon Dragon, and he deliberately left him for you.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow.

[The Calamity Demon Dragon is as powerful as the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, and if you can inherit his power, you will become as strong as him. Moreover, Long Zhaihuo has been sealed under this mountain for a long time, and his strength has weakened a lot, so I think you can absorb his strength. However, we cannot ignore Long Wuzhao's warning. I fear that his hatred and resentment will affect your cursed demon heart, turning you evil.]
Zhang Fei [5] pondered for a moment before departing from the shrine, heading directly to the secret passage and descending the staircase.
Outside the mountain, the other leaders of the mythical beasts gathered in the air, and their attention was still focused on several areas of the mountain.
"Have any of you managed to find the entrance?" Yan Jinwu asked the others.

All of them shook their heads in response. Dai Hubai then spoke to them. "I don't know what Long Aotian did on the mountain, but the dragon roar earlier was definitely not that of an ordinary dragon, and my bloodline was trembling in fear because of it."

"The source of the roar came from the sky, and legend has it that the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon once lived there in the past." Wang Guzhe spoke while looking towards the mountain top, but the thunderclouds blocked his view.
Huli Haohao also looked in that direction. "Do you guys think the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon still lives there and the previous roar belongs to it?"
"Impossible." Yuwen Xingzuan objected with a shake of his head. "If the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon was still on the mountain peak, we would have been able to sense its aura long ago."

"I agree with Xingzhuan." Nu Qichen joined in. "For millions of years, the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon has never appeared in the upper realms, and the Dragon Race has always believed that it has already ascended to the higher realm."
"Isn't the higher realm just a myth? People from our main clans have tried looking for it, but their efforts have never been fruitful." Feng Qingmeng spoke.

'The higher realm really does exist, and Feng Yao knows the way to go there.' All of them immediately turned to Zhu Lingyao. 'My sister told me that our cousin and the others went to a tower in the middle realms a few months ago, and Empress Feng said that the tower was the key to going to the higher realm. However, they have not found out the truth, and they have left halfway, especially since the Xianjin Realm is facing great danger.'
"What kind of tower is that?"

Zhu Lingyao told them directly. 'The Sun Tower, and it is located in the Blossom Heaven Realm, one of the planets in the middle realms. If you are interested, you can try going to that realm to challenge the tower, but you must bring a lot of people to do so.'

"I can't go anywhere for now, especially since Long Aotian is thinking of waging a war with my Phoenix Clan." They were not surprised by Feng Qingmeng's revelation, considering the Phoenix Clan's relationship with Zhang Fei, and he humiliated the Dragon Clan. "I'll go back now."

After Feng Qingmeng left, the other leaders also returned to their respective places, except for Zhu Lingyao. She stood there alone and stared at the location of the entrance to the secret passage. 'I previously detected that kid's presence there, and the entrance should be in that area.'
