Its body exuded a divine grace, casting a warm, golden light.
"Hmm?" The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar looked at the people with its golden eyes.
"Why did you summon my avatar?
I don't feel any danger in this realm, and the Calamity Demon Dragon is still sleeping in my seal beneath this mountain."
Zhang Fei [5] was shocked to hear that. 'So my guess was right, huh?
The black dragon is indeed still alive, especially since I didn't see its statue in the second room of the Era of the Beginning.
However, I didn't expect that it was a Calamity Demon Dragon, and it was sealed in this realm.
Since the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon couldn't kill it, their strength should be equal.'
"Hmm?" The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar suddenly turned toward Zhang Fei [5] and snorted, knocking him from his original position.
"You can come out; I know you're using invisibility, little fox."
Long Aotian and the others were shocked to hear that, and they were even more shocked when Zhang Fei [5] appeared on his little fox.
Long Qichao wanted to move to capture him, but the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon's avatar stopped him.
"Don't do anything to it." The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar used its aura and lifted Zhang Fei [5] before him.
"How can a young fox like you enter my shrine?
I've seen all kinds of foxes, but I've never seen your kind before."
Zhang Fei [5] was relieved that the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar couldn't see through his disguise.
Since he was disguised as a little fox, he didn't reply to the dragon and put on a scared look instead.
"No need to be afraid of me; I won't hurt you." The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar turned to Long Aotian and the others again.
"What is your reason for summoning my avatar?
I have already told your ancestors not to summon me as long as the Calamity Demon Dragon is still trapped in my seal."
Long Aotian cupped his hands and lowered his head slightly.
"Ancestor, a heavenly fox has humiliated our Dragon Clan, and the Phoenix Clan is protecting him.
I summoned your avatar to ask for your blessing to wage a war against them, and I hope you can lend a little of your strength to us so that we can win this war."
"Hmm?" The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar narrowed its eyes at Long Aotian.
"You deserve to be humiliated by summoning my avatar just for a trivial matter."
Unlike Long Aotian and the others who froze after they heard that, Zhang Fei [5] was laughing out loud in his heart.
They thought of asking their ancestors for help in fighting the Phoenix Clan, but the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar insulted them instead.
Long Aotian explained directly.
"Ancestor, this may be a trivial matter to you, but the current Phoenix Clan is much stronger than us.
Several thousand years ago, they managed to defeat the main Dragon Clan, and our ancestors still haven't recovered to this day.
We can't afford to lose to them again, so I was forced to summon your avatar, and I hope you are willing to help us repay the humiliation they gave us in the past."

"If all of you can't defeat the Phoenix Clan with your own strength, you guys don't deserve to be members of my Dragon Clan." Long Aotian wanted to refute, but the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar directly suppressed them, forcing them to kneel.
"We dragons are dignified beasts, and we never beg anyone, including our kin.
In my eyes, you guys are cowardly dragons, and I will cripple your cultivation if you insist on asking for my help to take care of your trivial matters.
Leave now before my patience runs out, and never return as long as the Calamity Demon Dragon is not free from my seal."
'Crap!
The ancestor is furious!' Long Aotian and the others hurriedly left the place after the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar withdrew its aura.
"Sigh!
I have long ascended from the three mortal realms, and my descendants in the three mortal realms have become losers.
They can't even settle a trivial matter by themselves, embarrassing my Dragon Clan." The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon turned to Zhang Fei [5].
"Now tell me who you really are."
Zhang Fei [5] blinked his eyes repeatedly, pretending not to understand the meaning behind the question from the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar.
"Kid, I have lived for millions of years, and there is no beast I have not seen.
I do not know how you disguised yourself, but I know your appearance is not your true form, and I suspect that you are the one who is looking for trouble with those foolish descendants of mine."
'Tch!
An old creature like this guy is indeed difficult to deceive, but this dragon is not as bad as I imagined.' Zhang Fei [5] restored his body and transformed into his half-fox form.
"Unfortunately, you're wrong about that, Old Dragon.
I'm not looking for trouble with those idiots, and I came to this realm just to open my shop, but they came to me to look for trouble with me."
"A heavenly fox, right?"
"That's right."
"Explain to me your situation with them." Zhang Fei [5] then informed the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar about the matter between him and the Dragon Clan.
"The old dragons from my Dragon Clan are as arrogant as them, including me, but we have the ability to back up our arrogance.
Those descendants of mine are cowardly dragons, but they dare to act arrogant, and they even gang up on a weak beast like you."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled.
"At first, I thought you would help them, but instead, you insulted them and chased them away.
Since you won't intervene in this matter, I won't be afraid of them."
The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar let out a soft sigh.
"You should ignore pathetic cowards like them and focus on yourself, especially since the three mortal realms are not the end of our journey."
"The Paradise Realm, right?" The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon avatar was surprised to hear that from Zhang Fei [5].
"I have some acquaintances from that realm, and I will go there in the future.
However, there are so many people on my side, so I want to gather a lot of cultivation resources for us to procure before we go there, and one of them is to open a shop in this realm.
By the way, my name is Zhang Fei, Old Dragon."
"Long Wuzhao." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly remembered an item and took it out immediately before showing it to him.
"Oh?
Where did you get this Celestial Dragon Token?"
Zhang Fei [5] told him directly.
"An old friend of mine, Tianshi Shengjie, gave it to me.
Since you are the ancestor of all dragons, the celestial dragons are also your descendants, right?"
"So, you are the man in the ten-tailed fox's prophecy." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Long Wuzhao in surprise.
"I was the one who sent Little Shengjie to the three mortal realms to look for the fox's successor, but I didn't expect her to find you so soon."
"I know the reason you are looking for me, but I am not interested in it yet, especially since I am still weak." Zhang Fei [5] then asked Long Wuzhao.
"What's the deal with the Calamity Demon Dragon?
Why did you seal it under this mountain?
Why didn't you kill it directly?"
"Like Yang and Yin, my birth represented Yang, and Long Zhaihuo's birth represented Yin.

All of his powers were related to destruction, and his calamity tribulation techniques were terrifying." Long Wuzhao shot out his golden qi slightly, and several screens made of it appeared before them.
"In the past, our strengths were equal, but I was never truly able to defeat him.
Even with the help of the other ancient beasts, I still couldn't kill him."
Those Qi screens showed so much destruction caused by the Calamity Demon Dragon, and many realms were destroyed because of him.
Zhang Fei [5] was horrified and amazed at the same time, and all the destruction gave him an idea of the immense strength of the Calamity Demon Dragon.
Long Wuzhao spoke to Zhang Fei [5] again.
"All the events you saw happened several million years ago, long before I ascended to the Paradise Realm.
When the time came for me to ascend, I could not possibly let Long Zhaihuo destroy the three mortal realms, so I tried to create a sealing formation to seal him.
With the help of all the ancient beasts, I succeeded in creating it, and we used it to seal him in this realm.
To prevent other living creatures from discovering his existence, we deliberately placed this mountain above his seal, and I built this shrine to monitor him."
"Is Long Zhaihuo still alive now?"
Long Wuzhao nodded at Zhang Fei [5].
"Long Zhaihuo is still alive inside my seal, but he is much weaker than in the past.
Despite this, he is still capable of bringing great calamity to the three mortal realms, so we cannot let him go free.
He must have a lot of hatred in his heart, and he will destroy everything if he is freed from my seal."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] agreed with that.
"If I were in Long Zhaihuo's position, vengeance and hatred would definitely fill my heart and mind, and I would destroy everything in front of me if I managed to break free.
Did you place other formations in the seal room?"
"Yes." Long Wuzhao then warned Zhang Fei [5].
"You'd better put away your idea to go to Long Zhaihuo's seal room, or his hatred will affect you, and you will become more evil than him, especially with the cursed demon heart in your body."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Long Wuzhao in surprise.
"How did you know the demon heart was in my body?"
"I killed the demon, so I'm familiar with his aura." Long Wuzhao's answer shocked Zhang Fei [5].
"I wanted to destroy his heart, but someone stole it from me.
I've been looking for the culprit for a long time but failed, and I didn't expect that it was in your body now.
If you weren't the ten-tailed fox's successor, I would kill you along with the heart."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed wryly.
"I guess I'm lucky?
Can you please teach me how to control this cursed demon heart?"
"The only way for you to control the cursed demon heart is to not lose your humanity, so you must continue to maintain your humanity." Long Wuzhao dispelled all the Qi screens.
"My time is up, so I will leave now, and I will wait for you in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Long Wuzhao.
"I will definitely meet you there after I ascend to the Paradise Realm."
"Farewell for now, Zhang Fei." Long Wuzhao immediately disappeared from that place.
Since there was nothing there, Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to the outer hall and stood in front of the statue of the Calamity Demon Dragon.
"If this dragon was that strong in the past, why didn't the old fox kill him?
The will of the universe tells me that his strength is on par with the two primordial beasts, so he should be able to kill him."
[Master, the ten-tailed fox could predict your birth, so I think he has a special plan for the Calamity Demon Dragon, and he deliberately left him for you.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow.
[The Calamity Demon Dragon is as powerful as the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, and if you can inherit his power, you will become as strong as him.
Moreover, Long Zhaihuo has been sealed under this mountain for a long time, and his strength has weakened a lot, so I think you can absorb his strength.
However, we cannot ignore Long Wuzhao's warning.
I fear that his hatred and resentment will affect your cursed demon heart, turning you evil.]
Zhang Fei [5] pondered for a moment before departing from the shrine, heading directly to the secret passage and descending the staircase.
Outside the mountain, the other leaders of the mythical beasts gathered in the air, and their attention was still focused on several areas of the mountain.
"Have any of you managed to find the entrance?" Yan Jinwu asked the others.
All of them shook their heads in response.
Dai Hubai then spoke to them.
"I don't know what Long Aotian did on the mountain, but the dragon roar earlier was definitely not that of an ordinary dragon, and my bloodline was trembling in fear because of it."

"The source of the roar came from the sky, and legend has it that the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon once lived there in the past." Wang Guzhe spoke while looking towards the mountain top, but the thunderclouds blocked his view.
Huli Haohao also looked in that direction.
"Do you guys think the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon still lives there and the previous roar belongs to it?"
"Impossible." Yuwen Xingzuan objected with a shake of his head.
"If the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon was still on the mountain peak, we would have been able to sense its aura long ago."
"I agree with Xingzhuan." Nu Qichen joined in.
"For millions of years, the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon has never appeared in the upper realms, and the Dragon Race has always believed that it has already ascended to the higher realm."
"Isn't the higher realm just a myth?
People from our main clans have tried looking for it, but their efforts have never been fruitful." Feng Qingmeng spoke.

'The higher realm really does exist, and Feng Yao knows the way to go there.' All of them immediately turned to Zhu Lingyao. 'My sister told me that our cousin and the others went to a tower in the middle realms a few months ago, and Empress Feng said that the tower was the key to going to the higher realm.
However, they have not found out the truth, and they have left halfway, especially since the Xianjin Realm is facing great danger.'
"What kind of tower is that?"
Zhu Lingyao told them directly. 'The Sun Tower, and it is located in the Blossom Heaven Realm, one of the planets in the middle realms.
If you are interested, you can try going to that realm to challenge the tower, but you must bring a lot of people to do so.'

"I can't go anywhere for now, especially since Long Aotian is thinking of waging a war with my Phoenix Clan." They were not surprised by Feng Qingmeng's revelation, considering the Phoenix Clan's relationship with Zhang Fei, and he humiliated the Dragon Clan.
"I'll go back now."
After Feng Qingmeng left, the other leaders also returned to their respective places, except for Zhu Lingyao.
She stood there alone and stared at the location of the entrance to the secret passage. 'I previously detected that kid's presence there, and the entrance should be in that area.'

chapters.title: Chapter 867: Calamity Demon Dragon
paragraphs: As she expected, Zhu Lingyao saw Long Aotian's group leaving the secret passage. Their expressions were unsightly, especially after the incident with Long Wuzhao earlier.
Long Qichao immediately asked. "What should we do now, Brother? I'm not sure we can win against the Phoenix Clan if the ancestor is not willing to help us."
"Return." Long Aotian hurriedly went to the teleportation portal and led them back.
Following their departure, Zhu Lingyao landed there and looked for the key to open the entrance. As soon as she located it, she opened it and stepped inside.

'The ancestor they are referring to is definitely the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, but I'm sure it's not his real body, and it's probably just his avatar or something else.' Zhu Lingyao didn't climb but instead watched the stairs descend. 'What kind of place is it down there? This place is much more ancient than I expected, so I must not act rashly. I can feel a terrifying and deadly aura from down there.'
Zhu Lingyao then sat there while waiting for Zhang Fei [5], especially since she was sure he was up there, and she would rather not waste her energy meeting him up there.
Several hours later.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels.]
Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the entrance, but he was a little surprised to find Zhu Lingyao waiting for him. He lifted her up and embraced her waist. "Did I keep you waiting long, my love?"
'I'm not your lover.' Zhu Lingyao gently pushed Zhang Fei [5] back. 'Did you meet the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon up there?'
"I met and talked to his avatar."
'As I expected.' Zhu Lingyao then asked. 'Do you want to go downstairs?'

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "I want to go, but you can't follow because it's too evil down there. Long Wuzhao sealed the thing down there before he ascended to the higher realm, making it filled with hatred."
'What is that thing?'

"An ancient dragon, the Calamity Demon Dragon to be precise, and its strength is on par with Long Wuzhao." Zhu Lingyao frowned deeply after Zhang Fei [5] mentioned the identity of the dragon, and its name was enough to explain that it was dangerous. "You should go back now, and I'll check downstairs."
'No.' Zhu Lingyao vehemently refused. 'I am a vermilion bird, and I am much stronger than you.'
*Slap*
'Ahh!' Zhu Lingyao jumped back after Zhang Fei [5] spanked her ass. 'You are shameless and impudent!'
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "Your buttocks are plump and bouncy; they make me itch to spank them."
Zhu Lingyao's face turned red with anger and shame, but she immediately turned around and walked down the staircase. 'Let's go!'
"Stubborn!"

Unlike when he climbed to the mountain peak, Zhang Fei [5] and Zhu Lingyao arrived at the last step below much faster. However, the temperature in that place was extremely cold, and a pitch-black aura covered the entire area, which stemmed from the hatred of the Calamity Demon Dragon.
Zhu Lingyao trembled at that, but Zhang Fei [5] pulled her into a hug to calm her down. "I told you not to come here, but you were stubborn!"
'The dragon's hatred was beyond my imagination, and it frightened me so much.' Zhu Lingyao looked up at him. 'Don't you feel anything from either of them?'
"Perhaps my feelings have become numb after I killed too many living beings, so the dragon's hatred doesn't affect me in the slightest."

A man figure with blood-red eyes full of hatred suddenly appeared in front of them, and he attacked the two directly. Zhang Fei [5] immediately activated his light element, and the light angel appeared behind them, forcing him to move away.
Zhu Lingyao looked at the light angel in amazement. 'Did you create it by materializing your light element?'

"You're right, and I used one of my women as a model." Zhang Fei [5] summoned the demon extermination sword and slashed it toward the man, but the man stretched out his hand and countered his light element, dispelling it. "Just the manifestation of his hatred is already this powerful; I dare not imagine the true power of the Calamity Demon Dragon."
Zhu Lingyao tried to attack the men with her vermilion flames, but he dispelled them directly. 'We should leave this place; we can't possibly defeat him.'
"You must go back now, and I will find a way to get rid of this person." Zhang Fei [5] said this as he shifted Zhu Lingyao behind him.
'No!' Zhu Lingyao grabbed Zhang Fei [5]'s hand. 'You must come back with me! This hatred will affect you if you stay here for too long.'
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Zhu Lingyao and gave her a quick kiss, stunning her. "Go back and don't worry about me; I'll be fine."
'But—'

"Don't argue with me." Zhang Fei [5] stopped Zhu Lingyao. "You're stronger than me, but you don't have the light element. You'll only burden me if you stay here, so please leave and don't tell anyone else about this place."
Zhu Lingyao bit her lower lip and turned to leave. 'Be careful!'
The man flew to chase after Zhu Lingyao, but Zhang Fei [5] intercepted him and slashed the demon extermination sword at him, causing him to let out an eerie shriek.
The man flew away while glaring at the demon extermination sword, making Zhang Fei [5] smile. "As expected! You are a demon, even though you are just the embodiment of his hatred."
"Attack him." The demon extermination sword shot out of Zhang Fei [5]'s hand and struck the man, but he flew further back, and the sword was stopped by a transparent barrier. "Return."
Zhang Fei [5] grabbed the demon extermination sword, but Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu suddenly came out of his soul sea, and they brought the female dark fairy with them.
Ma Kuangyu explained directly. "Kid, this place is the most suitable place to help this woman, and she will probably regain her consciousness after she absorbs this thick hatred."

"Since she has no consciousness, I have to possess her soul, and I will help her absorb it, Master." Nalan Yushu possessed the female dark fairy's soul and floated in the air in a cross-legged position. "Lure that guy here, Old Ma."
"All right." Ma Kuangyu immediately moved toward the man, but he flew away while fighting him, and the two of them fought around the area.

Nalan Yushu, who possessed the soul of the female dark fairy, quickly began to absorb the hatred. She spread the hatred into her soul while protecting her own, especially since the hatred was useless to her.

Zhang Fei [5], on the other hand, walked towards the last barrier, which blocked him from entering the place of the seal. However, his heart was pounding as he saw the true Calamity Demon Dragon curled up behind the barrier, and the golden chains tightly bound his body.

[Master, this barrier is too strong for the current you, and it can only be broken if several cultivators at the Divine Ascension Realm work together to destroy it. However, we don't need to do that, and you can ask Zhe Wuming to send you inside using his void element.]

"No." Zhang Fei [5] rejected Mei's idea immediately, especially since he didn't want too many people to know the existence of the Calamity Demon Dragon. 'Is there anything in the system shop that I can use to absorb his power from outside this barrier?'
[There are no items you can use for that, Master.]
Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh and turned towards Ma Kuangyu, who was still fighting with the man. "Old Ma has the upper hand against him."
*Zing... Zing... Zing...*
The demon's extermination sword vibrated quite strongly, as it was eager to absorb the man, so Zhang Fei [5] immediately flew towards them and helped Ma Kuangyu attack him.

The man repeatedly let out eerie screams every time the demon extermination sword injured him and absorbed his strength, and he wanted to escape from them. Zhang Fei [5] and Ma Kuangyu did not give him the chance to escape, and they managed to paralyze him a few minutes later.

"Absorb his strength to your heart's content, Hei'an and Guang'an." Zhang Fei [5] thrust the demon extermination sword right into the man's chest, nailing him to the ground. The sword greedily absorbed his strength. Nalan Yushu brought the dark fairy's soul to their side, and she helped her absorb his strength while absorbing hatred there.

Ma Kuangyu looked toward the seal of the Calamity Demon Dragon. "Kid, if you obtain this dragon's bloodline and physique, no cultivator in the three mortal realms will be able to match you. Unfortunately, I don't have my peak strength, so I can't help you deal with this dragon."

"It's okay, Old Ma." Zhang Fei [5] also turned that way. "For now, I have to think of a way to keep people from coming here, including the people from the Dragon Clan. If Long Aotian turns a blind eye and releases this dragon to fight the Phoenix Clan, all realms will face a greater danger than Xereth."
Ma Kuangyu immediately conveyed his solution. "You just need to cover the barrier with another barrier, and the people from the Xianjin Realm can help you with that."

"I will use my third clone to meet them." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly felt a call in his mind, and he knew that it came from the Calamity Demon Dragon. "If you call other people, they will probably answer your call and wake you up. Unfortunately, I am different from them, and I will not be tempted by you."
In the Xianjin Realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was cultivating in his room, immediately stopped and hurriedly left.
"Where are you going at this time of night, Junior Brother?" Lin Moxian, who was discussing with Qiao Liangren, asked.
"I need Gong Ren's help, so I'll go see him now." Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly disappeared, confusing the two men.

"What exactly does he want to do? He had locked himself in his room for a few days straight, but he suddenly ended his seclusion and wanted to see Senior Gong." Qiao Liangren shook his head at Lin Moxian. "How is Yue Qinhua doing?"

"Qinhua is doing well, and our master likes her enthusiasm in the soul cultivation path. Thanks to his help, her soul level has broken through to the half-perfection stage of the soul core level in just ten days, and she will probably break through to the perfection stage soon." Qiao Liangren then turned to Wang Yourou, who had just arrived. "Our junior brother just went to see Senior Gong."
"Sigh! That kid is like a ghost and difficult to find!" Wang Yourou grumbled in annoyance before sitting beside them. "Where are the others? Why is the house so quiet?"

"Old Cheng went to the defense center. Yan Yinqing and Aunt Lingyan joined the Yan and Tantai Clans in their temporary residence." Lin Moxian then asked her. "Have you fallen in love with our junior brother now? You keep coming here to see him, and you seem disappointed when he's not around."
"Humph." Wang Yourou snorted softly and did not want to answer Lin Moxian. 'Have I really fallen in love with him?'
*Tap... Tap... Tap...*
They suddenly heard the sound of light footsteps from outside, and a young woman soon walked into the residence, making Lin Moxian laugh. "You have finally arrived, Jing Qiuyue."

Jing Qiuyue was like a graceful fairy maiden. Her delicate figure was slender and elegantly curved, with a willowy waist and a modest yet prominent bust that added to her beauty. Draped in flowing violet and blue silk decorated with starry ornaments, her fair skin looked deliciously soft. Her long, lavender hair is cascaded in soft waves, braided with silver hairpins. She held a snow-white rabbit to her chest, and a gentle smile played upon her lips—calm, warm, and enchanting.

"I don't care about you, Moxian." Jing Qiuyue also ignored Wang Yourou and walked over to Qiao Liangren before sitting down by his side, which made him feel awkward. "Liangren, I've heard everything from Yinqing. Your revenge has been avenged, and your feelings are clear now. You already know my feelings for you, so I hope you won't reject me anymore, and I want to marry you as soon as possible."
"Senior Sister Jing, I—"

"I don't want to hear any rejection from you." Jing Qiuyue decisively interrupted. "In this entire universe, only you are worthy of being my husband. Moreover, our master has long since given his blessing for us to marry, but you keep thinking about the late Qin Yue. I have always understood your feelings, and I have never forced you before. However, the situation has changed now, and I will not hold my feelings back any longer."
'Is this woman always like this?' Wang Yourou asked Lin Moxian via voice transmission.
Lin Moxian simply nodded to her and spoke to Qiao Liangren directly. "Liangren, Qiuyue sincerely loves you, so I think you can accept her as your wife."
"Sigh." Qiao Liangren turned to Jing Qiuyue. "I'm sorry, Senior Sister Jing. I never loved you, and I always considered you as my sister."
"Did you reject me because of Yue Qinhua?" Qiao Liangren immediately guessed that Yan Yinqing told Jing Qiuyue about his disciple. "What if you marry us both at the same time?"
Not only was Qiao Liangren surprised by that, but Jing Qiuyue's question also surprised Lin Moxian. Wang Yourou, on the other hand, was stunned by that.
Jing Qiuyue immediately spoke again. "Take her as your first wife if you want, but you must marry me."
"I apologize, but I can't return your feelings, Senior Sister." Qiao Liangren immediately got up and left them, much to Jing Qiuyue's sadness.

"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just returned, was surprised by Jing Qiuyue's arrival. He wanted to say something to her, but Wang Yourou hurriedly pulled him into his room. 'This woman! He became more aggressive after not seeing me for a few days.'
Lin Moxian immediately told Jing Qiuyue. "Wang Yourou is similar to you, and she is crazy about our junior brother."
"I will see our master first." Jing Qiuyue immediately left Lin Moxian.

In the room, Wang Yourou directly lay down on the bed, causing Zhang Xiaolong [3] to let out a soft sigh. He immediately joined her on the bed, crawled over her, and held both his hands above her head. "What are you going to do to me?"

"What would happen if a man and a woman were in the bed together?" Wang Yourou's heart skipped a beat thinking about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s intentions. "I've helped you too many times, so you have to pay for your help, right?"
Wang Yourou turned her embarrassed face to the side, especially since they weren't lovers, so she was embarrassed to help Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"If you don't want to help me, I will never help you again." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately shifted to the side and sat cross-legged. "Don't disturb me for now."
Wang Yourou didn't say anything, but she thought about it in her mind. 'Should I do that for him?'
Zhang Fei [5] took out the two devices that Zhang Xiaolong [3] got from Gong Ren, and he installed them both on both sides of the wall. In an instant, a transparent barrier is formed between the two.

"This barrier is quite strong, and no cultivator below the Divine Ascension Realm can break it. This way, no one in this realm can break through it, so this dragon will be safe." Ma Kuangyu said with a satisfied nod.

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] then returned to the side of the demon extermination sword and pulled it out, especially since the man had disappeared. However, Nalan Yushu still possessed the dark fairy's soul, endlessly absorbing the hatred. "Old Ma, I will cultivate here while waiting for her to finish."
"All right."

"I met and talked to his avatar."
'As I expected.' Zhu Lingyao then asked. 'Do you want to go downstairs?'
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"I want to go, but you can't follow because it's too evil down there.
Long Wuzhao sealed the thing down there before he ascended to the higher realm, making it filled with hatred."
'What is that thing?'

"An ancient dragon, the Calamity Demon Dragon to be precise, and its strength is on par with Long Wuzhao." Zhu Lingyao frowned deeply after Zhang Fei [5] mentioned the identity of the dragon, and its name was enough to explain that it was dangerous.
"You should go back now, and I'll check downstairs."
'No.' Zhu Lingyao vehemently refused. 'I am a vermilion bird, and I am much stronger than you.'
*Slap*
'Ahh!' Zhu Lingyao jumped back after Zhang Fei [5] spanked her ass. 'You are shameless and impudent!'
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled.
"Your buttocks are plump and bouncy; they make me itch to spank them."
Zhu Lingyao's face turned red with anger and shame, but she immediately turned around and walked down the staircase. 'Let's go!'
"Stubborn!"
Unlike when he climbed to the mountain peak, Zhang Fei [5] and Zhu Lingyao arrived at the last step below much faster.
However, the temperature in that place was extremely cold, and a pitch-black aura covered the entire area, which stemmed from the hatred of the Calamity Demon Dragon.
Zhu Lingyao trembled at that, but Zhang Fei [5] pulled her into a hug to calm her down.
"I told you not to come here, but you were stubborn!"
'The dragon's hatred was beyond my imagination, and it frightened me so much.' Zhu Lingyao looked up at him. 'Don't you feel anything from either of them?'
"Perhaps my feelings have become numb after I killed too many living beings, so the dragon's hatred doesn't affect me in the slightest."
A man figure with blood-red eyes full of hatred suddenly appeared in front of them, and he attacked the two directly.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately activated his light element, and the light angel appeared behind them, forcing him to move away.
Zhu Lingyao looked at the light angel in amazement. 'Did you create it by materializing your light element?'

"You're right, and I used one of my women as a model." Zhang Fei [5] summoned the demon extermination sword and slashed it toward the man, but the man stretched out his hand and countered his light element, dispelling it.
"Just the manifestation of his hatred is already this powerful; I dare not imagine the true power of the Calamity Demon Dragon."
Zhu Lingyao tried to attack the men with her vermilion flames, but he dispelled them directly. 'We should leave this place; we can't possibly defeat him.'
"You must go back now, and I will find a way to get rid of this person." Zhang Fei [5] said this as he shifted Zhu Lingyao behind him.
'No!' Zhu Lingyao grabbed Zhang Fei [5]'s hand. 'You must come back with me!
This hatred will affect you if you stay here for too long.'
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Zhu Lingyao and gave her a quick kiss, stunning her.
"Go back and don't worry about me; I'll be fine."
'But—'
"Don't argue with me." Zhang Fei [5] stopped Zhu Lingyao.
"You're stronger than me, but you don't have the light element.
You'll only burden me if you stay here, so please leave and don't tell anyone else about this place."
Zhu Lingyao bit her lower lip and turned to leave. 'Be careful!'
The man flew to chase after Zhu Lingyao, but Zhang Fei [5] intercepted him and slashed the demon extermination sword at him, causing him to let out an eerie shriek.
The man flew away while glaring at the demon extermination sword, making Zhang Fei [5] smile.
"As expected!
You are a demon, even though you are just the embodiment of his hatred."
"Attack him." The demon extermination sword shot out of Zhang Fei [5]'s hand and struck the man, but he flew further back, and the sword was stopped by a transparent barrier.
"Return."
Zhang Fei [5] grabbed the demon extermination sword, but Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu suddenly came out of his soul sea, and they brought the female dark fairy with them.
Ma Kuangyu explained directly.
"Kid, this place is the most suitable place to help this woman, and she will probably regain her consciousness after she absorbs this thick hatred."

"Since she has no consciousness, I have to possess her soul, and I will help her absorb it, Master." Nalan Yushu possessed the female dark fairy's soul and floated in the air in a cross-legged position.
"Lure that guy here, Old Ma."
"All right." Ma Kuangyu immediately moved toward the man, but he flew away while fighting him, and the two of them fought around the area.
Nalan Yushu, who possessed the soul of the female dark fairy, quickly began to absorb the hatred.
She spread the hatred into her soul while protecting her own, especially since the hatred was useless to her.
Zhang Fei [5], on the other hand, walked towards the last barrier, which blocked him from entering the place of the seal.
However, his heart was pounding as he saw the true Calamity Demon Dragon curled up behind the barrier, and the golden chains tightly bound his body.
[Master, this barrier is too strong for the current you, and it can only be broken if several cultivators at the Divine Ascension Realm work together to destroy it.
However, we don't need to do that, and you can ask Zhe Wuming to send you inside using his void element.]

"No." Zhang Fei [5] rejected Mei's idea immediately, especially since he didn't want too many people to know the existence of the Calamity Demon Dragon. 'Is there anything in the system shop that I can use to absorb his power from outside this barrier?'
[There are no items you can use for that, Master.]
Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh and turned towards Ma Kuangyu, who was still fighting with the man.
"Old Ma has the upper hand against him."
*Zing...
Zing...
Zing...*
The demon's extermination sword vibrated quite strongly, as it was eager to absorb the man, so Zhang Fei [5] immediately flew towards them and helped Ma Kuangyu attack him.
The man repeatedly let out eerie screams every time the demon extermination sword injured him and absorbed his strength, and he wanted to escape from them.
Zhang Fei [5] and Ma Kuangyu did not give him the chance to escape, and they managed to paralyze him a few minutes later.
"Absorb his strength to your heart's content, Hei'an and Guang'an." Zhang Fei [5] thrust the demon extermination sword right into the man's chest, nailing him to the ground.
The sword greedily absorbed his strength.
Nalan Yushu brought the dark fairy's soul to their side, and she helped her absorb his strength while absorbing hatred there.
Ma Kuangyu looked toward the seal of the Calamity Demon Dragon.
"Kid, if you obtain this dragon's bloodline and physique, no cultivator in the three mortal realms will be able to match you.
Unfortunately, I don't have my peak strength, so I can't help you deal with this dragon."
"It's okay, Old Ma." Zhang Fei [5] also turned that way.
"For now, I have to think of a way to keep people from coming here, including the people from the Dragon Clan.
If Long Aotian turns a blind eye and releases this dragon to fight the Phoenix Clan, all realms will face a greater danger than Xereth."
Ma Kuangyu immediately conveyed his solution.
"You just need to cover the barrier with another barrier, and the people from the Xianjin Realm can help you with that."
"I will use my third clone to meet them." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly felt a call in his mind, and he knew that it came from the Calamity Demon Dragon.
"If you call other people, they will probably answer your call and wake you up.
Unfortunately, I am different from them, and I will not be tempted by you."
In the Xianjin Realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was cultivating in his room, immediately stopped and hurriedly left.
"Where are you going at this time of night, Junior Brother?" Lin Moxian, who was discussing with Qiao Liangren, asked.
"I need Gong Ren's help, so I'll go see him now." Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly disappeared, confusing the two men.
"What exactly does he want to do?
He had locked himself in his room for a few days straight, but he suddenly ended his seclusion and wanted to see Senior Gong." Qiao Liangren shook his head at Lin Moxian.
"How is Yue Qinhua doing?"
"Qinhua is doing well, and our master likes her enthusiasm in the soul cultivation path.

Thanks to his help, her soul level has broken through to the half-perfection stage of the soul core level in just ten days, and she will probably break through to the perfection stage soon." Qiao Liangren then turned to Wang Yourou, who had just arrived.
"Our junior brother just went to see Senior Gong."
"Sigh!
That kid is like a ghost and difficult to find!" Wang Yourou grumbled in annoyance before sitting beside them.
"Where are the others?
Why is the house so quiet?"
"Old Cheng went to the defense center.
Yan Yinqing and Aunt Lingyan joined the Yan and Tantai Clans in their temporary residence." Lin Moxian then asked her.
"Have you fallen in love with our junior brother now?
You keep coming here to see him, and you seem disappointed when he's not around."
"Humph." Wang Yourou snorted softly and did not want to answer Lin Moxian. 'Have I really fallen in love with him?'
*Tap...
Tap...
Tap...*
They suddenly heard the sound of light footsteps from outside, and a young woman soon walked into the residence, making Lin Moxian laugh.
"You have finally arrived, Jing Qiuyue."
Jing Qiuyue was like a graceful fairy maiden.
Her delicate figure was slender and elegantly curved, with a willowy waist and a modest yet prominent bust that added to her beauty.
Draped in flowing violet and blue silk decorated with starry ornaments, her fair skin looked deliciously soft.
Her long, lavender hair is cascaded in soft waves, braided with silver hairpins.
She held a snow-white rabbit to her chest, and a gentle smile played upon her lips—calm, warm, and enchanting.
"I don't care about you, Moxian." Jing Qiuyue also ignored Wang Yourou and walked over to Qiao Liangren before sitting down by his side, which made him feel awkward.
"Liangren, I've heard everything from Yinqing.
Your revenge has been avenged, and your feelings are clear now.
You already know my feelings for you, so I hope you won't reject me anymore, and I want to marry you as soon as possible."
"Senior Sister Jing, I—"
"I don't want to hear any rejection from you." Jing Qiuyue decisively interrupted.
"In this entire universe, only you are worthy of being my husband.
Moreover, our master has long since given his blessing for us to marry, but you keep thinking about the late Qin Yue.
I have always understood your feelings, and I have never forced you before.
However, the situation has changed now, and I will not hold my feelings back any longer."
'Is this woman always like this?' Wang Yourou asked Lin Moxian via voice transmission.
Lin Moxian simply nodded to her and spoke to Qiao Liangren directly.
"Liangren, Qiuyue sincerely loves you, so I think you can accept her as your wife."
"Sigh." Qiao Liangren turned to Jing Qiuyue.
"I'm sorry, Senior Sister Jing.
I never loved you, and I always considered you as my sister."
"Did you reject me because of Yue Qinhua?" Qiao Liangren immediately guessed that Yan Yinqing told Jing Qiuyue about his disciple.
"What if you marry us both at the same time?"
Not only was Qiao Liangren surprised by that, but Jing Qiuyue's question also surprised Lin Moxian.
Wang Yourou, on the other hand, was stunned by that.
Jing Qiuyue immediately spoke again.
"Take her as your first wife if you want, but you must marry me."
"I apologize, but I can't return your feelings, Senior Sister." Qiao Liangren immediately got up and left them, much to Jing Qiuyue's sadness.
"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just returned, was surprised by Jing Qiuyue's arrival.
He wanted to say something to her, but Wang Yourou hurriedly pulled him into his room. 'This woman!
He became more aggressive after not seeing me for a few days.'
Lin Moxian immediately told Jing Qiuyue.
"Wang Yourou is similar to you, and she is crazy about our junior brother."
"I will see our master first." Jing Qiuyue immediately left Lin Moxian.
In the room, Wang Yourou directly lay down on the bed, causing Zhang Xiaolong [3] to let out a soft sigh.
He immediately joined her on the bed, crawled over her, and held both his hands above her head.
"What are you going to do to me?"
"What would happen if a man and a woman were in the bed together?" Wang Yourou's heart skipped a beat thinking about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s intentions.
"I've helped you too many times, so you have to pay for your help, right?"
Wang Yourou turned her embarrassed face to the side, especially since they weren't lovers, so she was embarrassed to help Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"If you don't want to help me, I will never help you again." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately shifted to the side and sat cross-legged.
"Don't disturb me for now."
Wang Yourou didn't say anything, but she thought about it in her mind. 'Should I do that for him?'
Zhang Fei [5] took out the two devices that Zhang Xiaolong [3] got from Gong Ren, and he installed them both on both sides of the wall.
In an instant, a transparent barrier is formed between the two.
"This barrier is quite strong, and no cultivator below the Divine Ascension Realm can break it.
This way, no one in this realm can break through it, so this dragon will be safe." Ma Kuangyu said with a satisfied nod.
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] then returned to the side of the demon extermination sword and pulled it out, especially since the man had disappeared.
However, Nalan Yushu still possessed the dark fairy's soul, endlessly absorbing the hatred.
"Old Ma, I will cultivate here while waiting for her to finish."
"All right."

chapters.title: Chapter 868: Yin-Yang Twin Swords
paragraphs: Jing Qiuyue was already in front of Hun Di and whining to him, especially after Qiao Liangren rejected her again, even though she was willing to be his second wife. "Master, you must help me convince Liangren to accept me. I only love him and want to be his wife, but he keeps rejecting me."
"Unfortunately, I have no solution to help you with Liangren." Hun Di replied with a soft sigh. "I know someone who can help you, and he might be able to assist in convincing him."
"Who is that person, Master?"
"Your junior brother, Zhang Fei."
"Eh?" Jing Qiuyue looked at Hun Di, blinking her eyes. "I've heard from Yinqing about him, and he has dozens of women by his side, but I'm not sure he can help me convince Liangren."
"Haha." Hun Di softly laughed and stroked her head. "Why don't you try talking to him first? I believe that he has a solution for you."

"Zhang Fei is busy with Wang Yurou now, so I will go see him tomorrow. Moreover, I haven't seen you for several months, so I wanted to accompany you first, Master." Jing Qiuyue then looked at Yue Qinhua, who was cultivating her soul. "Is she really the reincarnation of Qin Yue, Master?"

Hun Di shook his head slightly. "Feng Yao said that this little girl is a reincarnator, but she doesn't know whether she is Qin Yue's reincarnation or not, and we can only wait for her to regain her past memories."
"How could Feng Yao know that this girl is a reincarnator?" Jing Qiuyue asked in confusion.

"Feng Yao is a reincarnator herself, or her abilities wouldn't be that high, and her progress is also too fast even for a senior cultivator like me." Hun Di then took out a book and gave it to her. "I found this Mystic Heart Mirror Technique in the Sun Tower, and I think it suits you."
Jing Qiuyue immediately received the book and read its contents. "You are right, Master. This technique suits me, and it can complement my Soul Mirror Technique."
"All right, you can learn it now."
"Yes, Master."
On the mountain slope, Zhu Lingyao sat on a rock in front of the entrance of the secret passage. Her palms were clenched together, and her expression was filled with anxiety.

'What is that kid doing down there? Why hasn't he come out yet? Was he affected by the hatred in that place? Should I go back and bring the others here? I've been waiting here for several hours, but he hasn't shown any signs of coming out.' Zhu Lingyao suddenly remembered someone, and she immediately contacted that person to meet her. 'Feng Xishui brought him here, so it shouldn't be a problem if I ask him to come here.'
In a few minutes, Feng Xishui arrived at the place, and Zhu Lingyao explained Zhang Fei [5]'s situation to him.

Feng Xishui was momentarily shocked after hearing about the Calamity Demon Dragon being sealed under the mountain, but he wasn't too worried about Zhang Fei [5]. Instead, he was curious about his relationship with Zhu Lingyao, especially since she seemed worried about him. 'That kid! He previously said he didn't want to think about this woman yet, but he had already unknowingly captured her heart.'
'Shall we go down there to check his condition?' Zhu Lingyao inquired in a concerned manner.

Feng Xishui put on a confident smile and replied to her. "Senior Lingyao, you don't need to worry about him. He possesses numerous tricks up his sleeve, and I have witnessed his combat on multiple occasions, including his battles against cultivators in the Divine Ascension Realm. Since he is confident in handling the situation himself, I am sure he will come back soon, so you just need to wait patiently."
'Are you sure about that?'
"Yes." Feng Xishui nodded at her. "If you want to get to know Zhang Fei [5] better, you can leave this realm and go on an adventure with him, and you will witness many amazing things with him."

Zhu Lingyao furrowed her brows as she stared at Feng Xishui, but the male phoenix just smiled and disappeared from her sight. 'What did he mean by that? Why did he ask me to go on an adventure with that kid?'

Red hues suddenly adorned Zhu Lingyao's cheeks, and she rubbed her lips, recalling Zhang Fei [5]'s kiss earlier. His speed when he kissed her astonished her, especially since she didn't have time to react to reject his kiss.
After Zhang Chen had prepared everything for several days, Zhang Fei held his wedding with Bai Shushi and Bai Tian'er at the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion.

Although she was initially not interested in Zhang Fei, Bai Shushi slowly fell for his temptation, especially since he had been teasing and seducing her for the past few months. Moreover, Zhang Chen and the others had always treated her like their family since she lived with them, which made her comfortable by their side.

Slightly different from her mother, Bai Tian'er originally wanted to take advantage of Zhang Fei when they first met, and she rejected him repeatedly because of it. However, her feelings changed after she dual-soul cultivated with him and shared their kiss for the first time at the Star Tower, and she began to fall in love with him, but he still rejected her at that time.

Their situation began to change after Bai Shushi persuaded Zhang Fei to give her daughter a chance to prove her feelings, which she agreed to. However, their relationship did not progress at that time, and they only met a few times to dual-soul cultivate. Their situation changed after he was intimate with them for the first time, and he decided to take Bai Tian'er to the training space.
[Build a good relationship with a member of the royal family of the fifth kingdom.]
[Quest rank: Hard.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Hard gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]

The notification appeared after Zhang Fei completed his wedding ceremony with Bai Shushi and Bai Tian'er, but the result was different from his previous thoughts, especially since there was no follow-up quest.

'The system doesn't include members of the beast, demon, and natural race royal families in the quests, huh?' Zhang Fei was a little disappointed by that, but he had obtained many valuable and priceless items from the system, including the pavilion. 'This way, the remaining quests in the Nine Stars Realm are only quests regarding the lightning element and the star tower. Open the gift pack, Mei.'
[Obtained the Yin-Yang Twin Swords. Grade: Celestial.]
[Obtained the Yin-Yang Sword Technique. Grade: Celestial.]
'The Yin-Yang Twin Swords?'

[The Yin-Yang Twin Swords: These two swords were created by a pair of lovers who were experienced dual cultivators. The two also created the Yin-Yang Sword Techniques, which are a pair of sword techniques. The two swords are only effective if the couple fights together and uses the sword technique. Downside: The swords will absorb both Yin and Yang Qi, and both must have excess Yin and Yang Qi, or they will die from Qi depletion.]

Zhang Fei let out a sigh in his heart and put it aside for now, especially since there were several female swordmasters by his side. Unfortunately, not all of them had excess Yin Qi capacity, so he had to think things through carefully before choosing one of them.
Zhang Fei then kissed the Bai mother and daughter in turn before asking Bai Tian'er. "Are you happy now that you are my wife?"

"Hehe." Bai Tian'er giggled as she nodded. "I'm happy because my feelings are reciprocated with our marriage. Unfortunately, we can't have our first night yet, so you have to break through to the Seven Divine Realms soon. Otherwise, Big Sis Yumei, Shang Yaolin, Xian Xianqin, Zhou Shenxin, and I will wait too long."
"I will try harder to reach that stage." Zhang Fei suddenly received a voice transmission. "I will be back soon."
When Zhang Fei arrived at his residence in the Nine Stars Realm, Hong Xinxin was already waiting for him there, and she brought the frightened Xiu Hanyu with her.

Just like what he did to Huoyun Zhiyan and Sun Jianming, Zhang Fei also enslaved Xiu Hanyu. He had no intention of using her to help his cultivation, and he only wanted to use her to concoct pills with his two companions.

After that, Zhang Fei took Xiu Hanyu and Hong Xinxin to the alchemy union, and Shang Yumei gave him some Nine Revolutions Pills concocted by Huoyun Zhiyan and Sun Jianming. Although the grade of their pills was not as good as Lin Jingxia's, they were more than enough to stabilize his already half-stable cultivation.

Zhang Fei asked them to stop concocting the Nine Revolutions Pills, and he asked them to concoct the True Foundation Pill instead, especially since the effect was much better. He gave them several batches of Azure Spirit Grass, Dragon Blood Ginseng, Spirit Vein Grass, Flowing Essence Herb, and Foundation Fortifying Leaf to concoct the pill.
Unfortunately, the True Foundation Pill was no ordinary pill, and the process of concocting it took half a year even for an alchemist of Lin Jingxia's caliber.

Since the situation in the Alchemy Union was already under control, Zhang Fei brought Hong Xinxin and Shang Yumei to the Red Sun Realm before taking the two of them to the pavilion. He wanted to take them to the Star Tower, but their numbers were too few to challenge the second floor, so he wanted them to focus on their cultivation while waiting for the matters in the Xianjin Realm to be resolved.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei accompanied the Bai mother and daughter, especially since today was their wedding day. However, Bai Shushi wanted to wait for Bai Tian'er to be ready for their first night, so they were just casually intimate.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels sent to the inventory.]

Along with the appearance of the three notifications, Zhang Fei [5] stopped cultivating, especially since it was already morning outside. He opened his eyes and looked at the female dark fairy, but she still looked like a doll without consciousness.

Nalan Yushu, through the female dark fairy, spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Master, she was dead for too long, so the process of bringing her consciousness back cannot be done in a short time. You can leave us here, and I will continue to help her absorb this hatred."
"All right." After Ma Kuangyu entered his soul sea, Zhang Fei [5] immediately rushed up and left the secret passage.
Upon arriving outside, Zhang Fei [5] found Zhu Lingyao waiting for him while cultivating. 'She's been waiting for me all this time, huh?'
Zhu Lingyao immediately opened her eyes as soon as she noticed his presence, and she moved to check on him. 'Are you right? Does the hatred not affect you?'

"Do you see a difference in me?" Zhu Lingyao shook her head at Zhang Fei [5]. "My light element has reached the peak stage, and my light elemental law has also reached the intermediate stage, so the hatred doesn't work on me. However, that's only a small part of his hatred, and I might be affected by it if I enter the barrier."
Zhu Lingyao nodded in understanding. 'Are you thinking of subduing the Calamity Demon Dragon?'

"Nope." Zhang Fei [5] denied her guess. "I have other plans for him, but I can't do it now. By the way, did your sect accept cultivators from the middle realms a few hundred years ago? Did any of them have the surnames Xian, Zhou, Yun, and Bai?"
'My sect accepted many cultivators from the middle realms, but I'm sure there weren't any of those four surnames among them.' Zhu Lingyao then asked him. 'Which realm do they come from?'
"The Nine Stars Realm."
Zhu Lingyao immediately thought of a few people. 'In my sect, only Huangfu Xiaoping and Qin Shuren came from that realm, and the two of them are husband and wife.'

"I have no relationship with their clans, so I can't care about them." Zhang Fei [5] grabbed her hand and took her back to the floating island immediately. Then, Zhu Lingyao rushed back to her Vermilion Sect.
Zhang Fei [5] returned to his room at the Phoenix Clan, but he found Ning Zhuan'er asleep on the garden chair, and her alchemy equipment was still in disarray.

Zhang Fei [5] then checked several pill bottles on the table, and there were several Five Elemental Pills of different grades inside. Even though Ning Zhuan'er had not succeeded in concocting a superior grade one, he was quite satisfied with her success in concocting several of them.
Feng Wushen suddenly appeared beside him. "Brother, I told this girl to stop if she's tired, but she didn't listen to me and kept doing alchemy until the herbs ran out."

"Zhuan'er liked alchemy so much, and she wanted to prove her ability to me, so she forced herself to like that. She managed to concoct the pill in several grades, proving that her talent is indeed good." Zhang Fei [5] cleaned everything up and carried Ning Zhuan'er. "Brother, I won't be going anywhere today, so you can take care of your other matters."
"If you need anything, you can contact me directly, Brother."

After Feng Wushen left, Zhang Fei [5] took Ning Zhuan'er into his room before sending her to the training space, especially since he didn't want her to get involved in his troubles with the Dragon Clan.
Zhang Fei [5] asked Zhang Lingxue to take care of Ning Zhuan'er, and he also asked her to teach her more about alchemy, especially her alchemy knowledge, which she got from Lin Jingxia.

Zhang Fei [5] then sat cross-legged on his bed and swallowed two Nine Revolutions Pills; he began to stabilize his cultivation again, which was accelerated by the effects of the pills. 'This way, I can break through to the 4-Star Heaven Realm soon.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes after someone knocked on his room door, but he found Wang Yourou still fast asleep on his bed. He smiled in amusement when he saw her drooling and mumbling something that was difficult to hear even for his sensitive sense of hearing.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately got out of bed and opened the door, especially since Jing Qiuyue was waiting in front. "What can I do for you, Senior Sister Jing?"

"Let's talk inside." Jing Qiuyue immediately burst into the room and sat on the side of the bed, observing Wang Yourou with an amused smile. "Can you help my relationship with Liangren, Junior Brother?"
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by that. He immediately closed the door and sat on the chair beside the bed. "Why are you asking me that?"
Jing Qiuyue immediately explained. "Last night, our master told me that you could help me with that, so I came here to ask you directly."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "I can indeed help you, Senior Sister. But the outcome may not be what you expect, and Senior Brother Liangren may be upset with you or himself, so think about this first.
"What do you mean when you say the results will be different?" Jing Qiuyue inquired in a bewildered tone.

"Senior Sister, we both know that Senior Brother Liangren has no feelings for you, and he only regards you as a sister of the same master." Jing Qiuyue sighed in disappointment and nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I can help you, but my method involves force, and the results won't end well if you use force on him."
Jing Qiuyue raised her eyebrows. "Using force? Do you mean using an aphrodisiac to force him?"
"Kind of." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded. "My power is like an aphrodisiac; few can resist it, regardless of gender. I believe you and Senior Brother Liangren won't be able to resist it either."
