Hun Di shook his head slightly.
"Feng Yao said that this little girl is a reincarnator, but she doesn't know whether she is Qin Yue's reincarnation or not, and we can only wait for her to regain her past memories."
"How could Feng Yao know that this girl is a reincarnator?" Jing Qiuyue asked in confusion.
"Feng Yao is a reincarnator herself, or her abilities wouldn't be that high, and her progress is also too fast even for a senior cultivator like me." Hun Di then took out a book and gave it to her.
"I found this Mystic Heart Mirror Technique in the Sun Tower, and I think it suits you."
Jing Qiuyue immediately received the book and read its contents.
"You are right, Master.
This technique suits me, and it can complement my Soul Mirror Technique."
"All right, you can learn it now."
"Yes, Master."
On the mountain slope, Zhu Lingyao sat on a rock in front of the entrance of the secret passage.
Her palms were clenched together, and her expression was filled with anxiety.
'What is that kid doing down there?
Why hasn't he come out yet?
Was he affected by the hatred in that place?
Should I go back and bring the others here?

I've been waiting here for several hours, but he hasn't shown any signs of coming out.' Zhu Lingyao suddenly remembered someone, and she immediately contacted that person to meet her. 'Feng Xishui brought him here, so it shouldn't be a problem if I ask him to come here.'
In a few minutes, Feng Xishui arrived at the place, and Zhu Lingyao explained Zhang Fei [5]'s situation to him.
Feng Xishui was momentarily shocked after hearing about the Calamity Demon Dragon being sealed under the mountain, but he wasn't too worried about Zhang Fei [5].
Instead, he was curious about his relationship with Zhu Lingyao, especially since she seemed worried about him. 'That kid!
He previously said he didn't want to think about this woman yet, but he had already unknowingly captured her heart.'
'Shall we go down there to check his condition?' Zhu Lingyao inquired in a concerned manner.
Feng Xishui put on a confident smile and replied to her.
"Senior Lingyao, you don't need to worry about him.
He possesses numerous tricks up his sleeve, and I have witnessed his combat on multiple occasions, including his battles against cultivators in the Divine Ascension Realm.
Since he is confident in handling the situation himself, I am sure he will come back soon, so you just need to wait patiently."
'Are you sure about that?'
"Yes." Feng Xishui nodded at her.
"If you want to get to know Zhang Fei [5] better, you can leave this realm and go on an adventure with him, and you will witness many amazing things with him."
Zhu Lingyao furrowed her brows as she stared at Feng Xishui, but the male phoenix just smiled and disappeared from her sight. 'What did he mean by that?
Why did he ask me to go on an adventure with that kid?'
Red hues suddenly adorned Zhu Lingyao's cheeks, and she rubbed her lips, recalling Zhang Fei [5]'s kiss earlier.
His speed when he kissed her astonished her, especially since she didn't have time to react to reject his kiss.
After Zhang Chen had prepared everything for several days, Zhang Fei held his wedding with Bai Shushi and Bai Tian'er at the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion.
Although she was initially not interested in Zhang Fei, Bai Shushi slowly fell for his temptation, especially since he had been teasing and seducing her for the past few months.
Moreover, Zhang Chen and the others had always treated her like their family since she lived with them, which made her comfortable by their side.
Slightly different from her mother, Bai Tian'er originally wanted to take advantage of Zhang Fei when they first met, and she rejected him repeatedly because of it.

However, her feelings changed after she dual-soul cultivated with him and shared their kiss for the first time at the Star Tower, and she began to fall in love with him, but he still rejected her at that time.
Their situation began to change after Bai Shushi persuaded Zhang Fei to give her daughter a chance to prove her feelings, which she agreed to.
However, their relationship did not progress at that time, and they only met a few times to dual-soul cultivate.
Their situation changed after he was intimate with them for the first time, and he decided to take Bai Tian'er to the training space.
[Build a good relationship with a member of the royal family of the fifth kingdom.]
[Quest rank: Hard.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Hard gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]

The notification appeared after Zhang Fei completed his wedding ceremony with Bai Shushi and Bai Tian'er, but the result was different from his previous thoughts, especially since there was no follow-up quest.

'The system doesn't include members of the beast, demon, and natural race royal families in the quests, huh?' Zhang Fei was a little disappointed by that, but he had obtained many valuable and priceless items from the system, including the pavilion. 'This way, the remaining quests in the Nine Stars Realm are only quests regarding the lightning element and the star tower.
Open the gift pack, Mei.'
[Obtained the Yin-Yang Twin Swords.
Grade: Celestial.]
[Obtained the Yin-Yang Sword Technique.
Grade: Celestial.]
'The Yin-Yang Twin Swords?'
[The Yin-Yang Twin Swords: These two swords were created by a pair of lovers who were experienced dual cultivators.
The two also created the Yin-Yang Sword Techniques, which are a pair of sword techniques.
The two swords are only effective if the couple fights together and uses the sword technique.
Downside: The swords will absorb both Yin and Yang Qi, and both must have excess Yin and Yang Qi, or they will die from Qi depletion.]
Zhang Fei let out a sigh in his heart and put it aside for now, especially since there were several female swordmasters by his side.
Unfortunately, not all of them had excess Yin Qi capacity, so he had to think things through carefully before choosing one of them.
Zhang Fei then kissed the Bai mother and daughter in turn before asking Bai Tian'er.
"Are you happy now that you are my wife?"
"Hehe." Bai Tian'er giggled as she nodded.
"I'm happy because my feelings are reciprocated with our marriage.
Unfortunately, we can't have our first night yet, so you have to break through to the Seven Divine Realms soon.
Otherwise, Big Sis Yumei, Shang Yaolin, Xian Xianqin, Zhou Shenxin, and I will wait too long."
"I will try harder to reach that stage." Zhang Fei suddenly received a voice transmission.
"I will be back soon."
When Zhang Fei arrived at his residence in the Nine Stars Realm, Hong Xinxin was already waiting for him there, and she brought the frightened Xiu Hanyu with her.
Just like what he did to Huoyun Zhiyan and Sun Jianming, Zhang Fei also enslaved Xiu Hanyu.
He had no intention of using her to help his cultivation, and he only wanted to use her to concoct pills with his two companions.
After that, Zhang Fei took Xiu Hanyu and Hong Xinxin to the alchemy union, and Shang Yumei gave him some Nine Revolutions Pills concocted by Huoyun Zhiyan and Sun Jianming.
Although the grade of their pills was not as good as Lin Jingxia's, they were more than enough to stabilize his already half-stable cultivation.
Zhang Fei asked them to stop concocting the Nine Revolutions Pills, and he asked them to concoct the True Foundation Pill instead, especially since the effect was much better.
He gave them several batches of Azure Spirit Grass, Dragon Blood Ginseng, Spirit Vein Grass, Flowing Essence Herb, and Foundation Fortifying Leaf to concoct the pill.
Unfortunately, the True Foundation Pill was no ordinary pill, and the process of concocting it took half a year even for an alchemist of Lin Jingxia's caliber.
Since the situation in the Alchemy Union was already under control, Zhang Fei brought Hong Xinxin and Shang Yumei to the Red Sun Realm before taking the two of them to the pavilion.

He wanted to take them to the Star Tower, but their numbers were too few to challenge the second floor, so he wanted them to focus on their cultivation while waiting for the matters in the Xianjin Realm to be resolved.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei accompanied the Bai mother and daughter, especially since today was their wedding day.
However, Bai Shushi wanted to wait for Bai Tian'er to be ready for their first night, so they were just casually intimate.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels sent to the inventory.]
Along with the appearance of the three notifications, Zhang Fei [5] stopped cultivating, especially since it was already morning outside.
He opened his eyes and looked at the female dark fairy, but she still looked like a doll without consciousness.
Nalan Yushu, through the female dark fairy, spoke to Zhang Fei [5].
"Master, she was dead for too long, so the process of bringing her consciousness back cannot be done in a short time.
You can leave us here, and I will continue to help her absorb this hatred."
"All right." After Ma Kuangyu entered his soul sea, Zhang Fei [5] immediately rushed up and left the secret passage.
Upon arriving outside, Zhang Fei [5] found Zhu Lingyao waiting for him while cultivating. 'She's been waiting for me all this time, huh?'
Zhu Lingyao immediately opened her eyes as soon as she noticed his presence, and she moved to check on him. 'Are you right?
Does the hatred not affect you?'
"Do you see a difference in me?" Zhu Lingyao shook her head at Zhang Fei [5].
"My light element has reached the peak stage, and my light elemental law has also reached the intermediate stage, so the hatred doesn't work on me.
However, that's only a small part of his hatred, and I might be affected by it if I enter the barrier."
Zhu Lingyao nodded in understanding. 'Are you thinking of subduing the Calamity Demon Dragon?'
"Nope." Zhang Fei [5] denied her guess.
"I have other plans for him, but I can't do it now.
By the way, did your sect accept cultivators from the middle realms a few hundred years ago?
Did any of them have the surnames Xian, Zhou, Yun, and Bai?"
'My sect accepted many cultivators from the middle realms, but I'm sure there weren't any of those four surnames among them.' Zhu Lingyao then asked him. 'Which realm do they come from?'
"The Nine Stars Realm."
Zhu Lingyao immediately thought of a few people. 'In my sect, only Huangfu Xiaoping and Qin Shuren came from that realm, and the two of them are husband and wife.'
"I have no relationship with their clans, so I can't care about them." Zhang Fei [5] grabbed her hand and took her back to the floating island immediately.
Then, Zhu Lingyao rushed back to her Vermilion Sect.
Zhang Fei [5] returned to his room at the Phoenix Clan, but he found Ning Zhuan'er asleep on the garden chair, and her alchemy equipment was still in disarray.
Zhang Fei [5] then checked several pill bottles on the table, and there were several Five Elemental Pills of different grades inside.
Even though Ning Zhuan'er had not succeeded in concocting a superior grade one, he was quite satisfied with her success in concocting several of them.
Feng Wushen suddenly appeared beside him.
"Brother, I told this girl to stop if she's tired, but she didn't listen to me and kept doing alchemy until the herbs ran out."
"Zhuan'er liked alchemy so much, and she wanted to prove her ability to me, so she forced herself to like that.
She managed to concoct the pill in several grades, proving that her talent is indeed good." Zhang Fei [5] cleaned everything up and carried Ning Zhuan'er.
"Brother, I won't be going anywhere today, so you can take care of your other matters."
"If you need anything, you can contact me directly, Brother."

After Feng Wushen left, Zhang Fei [5] took Ning Zhuan'er into his room before sending her to the training space, especially since he didn't want her to get involved in his troubles with the Dragon Clan.
Zhang Fei [5] asked Zhang Lingxue to take care of Ning Zhuan'er, and he also asked her to teach her more about alchemy, especially her alchemy knowledge, which she got from Lin Jingxia.

Zhang Fei [5] then sat cross-legged on his bed and swallowed two Nine Revolutions Pills; he began to stabilize his cultivation again, which was accelerated by the effects of the pills. 'This way, I can break through to the 4-Star Heaven Realm soon.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes after someone knocked on his room door, but he found Wang Yourou still fast asleep on his bed.
He smiled in amusement when he saw her drooling and mumbling something that was difficult to hear even for his sensitive sense of hearing.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately got out of bed and opened the door, especially since Jing Qiuyue was waiting in front.
"What can I do for you, Senior Sister Jing?"
"Let's talk inside." Jing Qiuyue immediately burst into the room and sat on the side of the bed, observing Wang Yourou with an amused smile.
"Can you help my relationship with Liangren, Junior Brother?"
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by that.
He immediately closed the door and sat on the chair beside the bed.
"Why are you asking me that?"
Jing Qiuyue immediately explained.
"Last night, our master told me that you could help me with that, so I came here to ask you directly."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding.
"I can indeed help you, Senior Sister.
But the outcome may not be what you expect, and Senior Brother Liangren may be upset with you or himself, so think about this first.
"What do you mean when you say the results will be different?" Jing Qiuyue inquired in a bewildered tone.

"Senior Sister, we both know that Senior Brother Liangren has no feelings for you, and he only regards you as a sister of the same master." Jing Qiuyue sighed in disappointment and nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"I can help you, but my method involves force, and the results won't end well if you use force on him."
Jing Qiuyue raised her eyebrows.
"Using force?
Do you mean using an aphrodisiac to force him?"
"Kind of." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded.
"My power is like an aphrodisiac; few can resist it, regardless of gender.
I believe you and Senior Brother Liangren won't be able to resist it either."

chapters.title: Chapter 869: Family Reunion
paragraphs: "Can you use your abilities on me?" Jing Qiuyue's request stunned Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I want to know its effect, and I will make a decision whether or not to ask for your help regarding Liangren after experiencing it."
"Be prepared, Senior Sister." Zhang Xiaolong [3] released his pink gas after Jing Qiuyue nodded.

Jing Qiuyue's expression instantly turned lustful, like a female tiger in heat. Pink heart symbols appeared on both of her eyes, and her chest heaved up and down. She wanted to pounce on Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he swiftly expelled his pink gas from her body, and she quickly returned to normal.

"Hah... Hah..." Jing Qiuyue breathed heavily as she stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in shock. "Your ability's effect is overwhelming, Junior Brother. I was able to maintain a strand of my consciousness before, but then my lust took over, making me eager to pounce on you."

"You realize it now, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with a soft sigh. "If I use it on Senior Brother Liangren, he will pounce on you straight away. However, he will regret it once he comes back to his senses, and he will feel extremely guilty toward you. Therefore, I won't help you, and you must try your best to convince him to accept you."
Jing Qiuyue nodded before asking. "Have you ever used that ability on all your women?"

"My relationship with my first woman happened because of it, but I was unconscious at that time because I was in my awakening process." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told Jing Qiuyue the identities of several women, such as Hong Xinxin, Murong Qianying, and Shang Yumei. "Apart from some of my official wives, I used my abilities on several of my clones' partners, and they stayed with my clones since then."

Jing Qiuyue shook her head. "Back then, I thought my father's wives were already too many with twenty of them, but your women were far more numerous than his. Yinqing told me that you have five clones, and four of them have their own partners."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed awkwardly. "Is your father also a dual cultivator?"

"Yes." Jing Qiuyue then shared her family story with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Even though my father had twenty wives, he didn't impregnate all of them, and some of them were just like dual cultivation partners for him. He only had four sons, and I was his only daughter. What about you? Are you going to impregnate them?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "Whether my official wives or my clones' partners, I want to have children from all of them, but I will only impregnate them once our lives are completely peaceful."
"Are you capable of having such a big family?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded with a simple smile, while Jing Qiuyue gestured at Wang Yourou with her index finger. "Is this woman also your partner?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Wang Yourou before explaining to Jing Qiuyue about their relationship. "She's not bad, but I haven't thought about taking her as my partner."
"I see." Jing Qiuyue then stood up. "I'm going to see Liangren now."

After Jing Qiuyue left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] activated the Mind Connect to speak to Feng Yichen. The female Dark Phoenix told him that she and Xereth would arrive at the Blue Water Realm in two days. He then contacted Serpentera, informed him about the demon, and asked him to take action against it. "My fourth clone and Feng Yao will arrive at the Scorching Earth Realm in about a week, and I will immediately look for the Earth Flames there. My first clone and the others will arrive at the Demon Purgatory Realm in about ten days, and I hope that realm is calmer than the other realms."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then checked the map to confirm everyone's location. He saw Jing Qiuyue and Qiao Liangren leaving Cheng Gaoji's residence, and Lin Moxian was with Xi Hongyan in her inn. Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan were in the temporary residence of the Yan and Tantai Clans. Feng Jiu and most of them were busy with their own affairs, as were the people from the Red Sun Realm.

"Interesting." Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered under his breath as he examined several red dots on the map, one of which was Zhu Shanniang. He was not surprised that the female Vermilion Bird hated him, but several other names raised questions in his mind. "Long Qiang should have heard about my actions in the Sky Dragon Realm from Long Aotian, but I don't understand why some of them suddenly hated me, especially since their names were previously green."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then closed the map and woke Wang Yourou up, but she slept like a dead pig and did not respond to him. 'This woman! She's old, but she always acts like a little girl.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] let Wang Yourou continue sleeping, and he contacted Jin Ruyue, asking her to come see him to dual-soul cultivate with him. After the woman came, they immediately started their activities.
In the pavilion, Ning Zhuan'er finally woke up from her sleep, but she was confused after seeing the bedroom.

"Where am I? How did I get here?" Ning Zhuan'er then got out of bed and went out of the room, but the scenery around the pavilion area stunned her. "I've never seen a place as beautiful as this, and the Qi is also stronger than in the Sky Dragon Realm."
After all, the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion is equipped with a divine dual cultivation array, the Boundless Yin-Yang Array.

"Did you just wake up?" Ning Zhuan'er turned to Zhang Lingxue, who was walking towards her together with Chu Ying and Chu Qing. "You don't have to be confused about this place because this place is your master's private place, and the three of us are some of his wives."
"Oh." Ning Zhuan'er then asked. "What are the names of you three, Big Sisters?"
"Zhang Lingxue, and you can call me Big Sis Lingxue." Zhang Lingxue then pointed to the Chu Sisters. "They are Chu Ying and Chu Qing, and our husband asked us to teach you more about alchemy."
Hearing alchemy, Ning Zhuan'er immediately became excited, making Zhang Lingxue smile. "Where is Big Brother Fei now?"

"He is accompanying his other wives, Bai Shushi and Bai Tian'er." Zhang Lingxue took Ning Zhuan'er's hand and led her with them. "You are part of our big family now, so I will introduce you to the others."
"Uhm." Ning Zhuan'er nodded slightly.
When they arrived at the main garden, Ning Zhuan'er was stunned by the number of women in the place, and Zhang Fei immediately introduced all of them to her.
'Ugh! Big Brother Fei is a playboy, and he has dozens of women.' Unfortunately, Ning Zhuan'er still hadn't met all of them, especially since some of them were with Zhang Fei's clones.
After they chatted for quite a while, Zhang Lingxue took Ning Zhuan'er to the room that Zhang Fei had specially prepared for alchemy, followed by Chu Ying and Chu Qing.

Zhang Lingxue naturally knew that Zhang Fei had other intentions for Ning Zhuan'er, especially since he gave the Divine Alchemy Method to her. She decided to impart the Yin-Yang Flawless Art to her, and she also gave her the Yang Qi.

Ning Zhuan'er was shocked by all of this, but Zhang Lingxue asked her to drink Zhang Fei's Yang Qi, especially since her cultivation was still too low. "Don't be shy and drink it. The faster your cultivation increases, the faster your improvement in alchemy will be, and the easier it will be for you to concoct high-grade pills."

"Uhm." Ning Zhuan'er shyly took a sip of Zhang Fei's Yang Qi before downing it clean. Zhang Lingxue then gave her the five basic pills and some other pills, including the Youthful Retaining Pill and the Beauty Restoring Pill.
"Swallow them in order, and you will experience significant changes."
"Yes, Big Sister."

Sometime later, Ning Zhuan'er had finished swallowing all the pills, and Zhang Lingxue gave back her furnace. She also gave her the ingredients to concoct the Five Elemental Pill according to Zhang Fei's instructions. "For now, you only need to concoct the pills until you successfully concoct the superior-grade one. After you successfully concoct it, I will teach you how to concoct the rank 2 pill."
"Yes." Ning Zhuan'er immediately started preparing the ingredients.

Then, Zhang Lingxue took out a few other ingredients and spoke to the Chu sisters. "You two have successfully concocted the rank 3 pill, so it's time for you to concoct the rank 4 pill. Our husband wants you two to concoct the Ethereal Bliss Pill because it will enhance our cultivation speed during dual cultivation with him."

After his cultivation was completely stable, Zhang Fei [5] immediately activated the Demon Eye's orb and sent it to the Dragon Clan. He saw Long Aotian discussing with Long Qichao and the others, and he heard them planning to send assassins to kill him.
From their conversation, Zhang Fei [5] knew that Long Aotian was afraid of clashing directly with the Phoenix Clan, especially after Long Wuzhao refused to give a bit of his strength to help them.
Since their Dragon Clan had no assassins, and there were none on the floating island, Long Aotian sent Long Jishan and Long Yingwu to the lower land to look for them.

"Phew!" Zhang Fei [5] let out a heavy breath before contacting Feng Xishui, and he asked the male phoenix for help to take care of the two dragons. However, he forbade her to kill them, especially since he needed both of them for other things.
A while later, Zhang Fei [5] had already arrived in front of Feng Qingmeng. "I heard from Feng Yao that there are cultivators from the Nine Stars Realm in this sect, so I came here to meet them."
Feng Qingmeng directly told him. "If I recall correctly, there are two cultivators who came from that realm. They are Xian Xianjue and his wife, Shi Baoyin."
"Are there any cultivators with the Zhou, Yun, Shi, Guo, and Bai surnames who came from that realm here?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.

"There are no cultivators with those surnames in this sect." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding to Feng Qingmeng. "If they also ascended to this realm, they might have joined the other sects, so you can try asking Yan Jinwu and the others about them. However, I'm not sure if they also ascended to this realm, and they may ascend to other realms."

"Please call Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin for me." Feng Qingmeng immediately asked someone to bring the two people to her room, and Zhang Fei [5] tried to ask the other leaders about the other cultivators from the Nine Stars Realm, but they told her that there were no cultivators from that realm in their sect. 'If they weren't members of my wives' families, I wouldn't bother looking for them.'
"They'll be here soon." Feng Qingmeng then asked him. "Are you interested in joining this sect?"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately refused. "This realm is just a stepping stone for me, and I won't stay here for too long. By the way, what is the status of Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin in this sect? Are they still outer disciples?"

"No." Feng Qingmeng immediately explained to Zhang Fei [5]. "In the upper realms, the outer disciples are inhabited by cultivators from the first two stages of the Seven Divine Realms. Cultivators in the third and fourth stages are inner disciples, and cultivators in the fifth stage are core disciples. Sect Master and elders are those who have broken through to the Divine Ascendant Realm, just like me and Feng Shanxi."
"Doesn't that mean my status will be lower than the outer disciple if I join this sect?"

"If you are an ordinary cultivator." Zhang Fei [5] furrowed his brows in response to Feng Qingmeng. "You have a close relationship with our Phoenix Clan, and our princess is your best friend, so your status is above all of us."
Zhang Fei [5] did not respond to that and asked another question. "Why are you and Feng Shanxi still not married?"

"A marriage is just a burden to my cultivation, so I have no interest in it. As for Feng Shanxi, I don't know her reasons, so you have to ask her yourself." Feng Qingmeng then warned him. "You have to forget your desire to seduce me because it won't work on me, or you'll just waste your time."
"Is that so?" Feng Qingmeng's heart pounded as Zhang Fei [5] utilized the enhanced demon charm. "If I find an attractive woman, I will definitely try to get her."
"Did you use a charm technique on me?" Feng Qingmeng frowned.

"I don't use any techniques, and my charm has long been a part of me. All this time, I kept it suppressed, but now I've let it go." Feng Qingmeng did not believe Zhang Fei [5], and she tried to suppress the effects of his charm, but her heart was beating even faster.
Struggling to resist the effects, Feng Qingmeng begged him. "Please stop it."

"Why should I stop it?" Zhang Fei [5] then walked to Feng Qingmeng's side, but she immediately used her aura to keep a distance between them. "Hey, you are an attractive woman, and I want you. You may consider marriage a hassle, but I am sure you have an interest in sex, right?"

'This brat is too shameless! His face is thicker than anything! How could he possibly ask me something like that?' Feng Qingmeng turned her face to the side and did not want to answer Zhang Fei [5], but she was shocked when her aura was dispelled for no reason.
Zhang Fei [5] took advantage of that by lifting Feng Qingmeng to her feet, and he gave her rose-colored lips a gentle kiss, shocking her.
'This damn brat!' Feng Qingmeng used her aura to push Zhang Fei [5] away, but he quickly hugged her, causing her to fall with him.
*Bam*

Zhang Fei [5] fell on his back with Feng Qingmeng lying on top of him. He immediately gave her a deeper kiss by sliding his tongue into her mouth. 'Ugh! If he wasn't a best friend of my princess, I would burn him alive!'
*Crack*
Hearing the door open, Feng Qingmeng pressed Zhang Fei [5]'s chest and pushed herself away from him. She hurriedly wiped her lips, which made him smile in amusement.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately stood up, turning to the old man and old woman.

Feng Qingmeng, whose heart was still pounding because of Zhang Fei [5]'s actions, immediately spoke to them. "Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin, this kid is Zhang Fei, and he comes from the Nine Stars Realm like the two of you."

Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin looked at him in surprise, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened a portal to the training space, and Xian Xianqin quickly came out of it, surprising the two of them. "Xin'er?"
"Grandpa! Grandma!" Xian Xianqin ran over and hugged them. "Hehehe! I'm glad you two are still alive! We all missed you two!

"We miss you and the others too, Xin'er." Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin immediately hugged Xian Xianqin back, but they looked at Zhang Fei [5] with confused looks, especially since he could bring their granddaughter to them just like that.
"What is your relationship with him, Xin'er?" Shi Baoyin asked.

"Haha." Xian Xianqin released her embrace from them. "Grandpa! Grandma! Zhang Fei is my husband, and we got married half a year ago. By the way, my brother is also married to Yao Yin, but they are in our realm now."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Qingmeng, who nodded in understanding and left them. Then, he went to the Nine Stars Realm before returning with five other people a few moments later.
Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin were stunned to see their family members, whom they had missed for a long time. "Feng'er, Yue'er, Zhuang'er, Wu'er, and Yin'er."
"Father! Mother!"
"Grandpa! Grandma!"

"My relationship with my first woman happened because of it, but I was unconscious at that time because I was in my awakening process." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told Jing Qiuyue the identities of several women, such as Hong Xinxin, Murong Qianying, and Shang Yumei.
"Apart from some of my official wives, I used my abilities on several of my clones' partners, and they stayed with my clones since then."
Jing Qiuyue shook her head.
"Back then, I thought my father's wives were already too many with twenty of them, but your women were far more numerous than his.
Yinqing told me that you have five clones, and four of them have their own partners."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed awkwardly.
"Is your father also a dual cultivator?"
"Yes." Jing Qiuyue then shared her family story with Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Even though my father had twenty wives, he didn't impregnate all of them, and some of them were just like dual cultivation partners for him.
He only had four sons, and I was his only daughter.
What about you?
Are you going to impregnate them?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her.
"Whether my official wives or my clones' partners, I want to have children from all of them, but I will only impregnate them once our lives are completely peaceful."
"Are you capable of having such a big family?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded with a simple smile, while Jing Qiuyue gestured at Wang Yourou with her index finger.
"Is this woman also your partner?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Wang Yourou before explaining to Jing Qiuyue about their relationship.
"She's not bad, but I haven't thought about taking her as my partner."
"I see." Jing Qiuyue then stood up.
"I'm going to see Liangren now."
After Jing Qiuyue left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] activated the Mind Connect to speak to Feng Yichen.
The female Dark Phoenix told him that she and Xereth would arrive at the Blue Water Realm in two days.
He then contacted Serpentera, informed him about the demon, and asked him to take action against it.
"My fourth clone and Feng Yao will arrive at the Scorching Earth Realm in about a week, and I will immediately look for the Earth Flames there.
My first clone and the others will arrive at the Demon Purgatory Realm in about ten days, and I hope that realm is calmer than the other realms."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then checked the map to confirm everyone's location.
He saw Jing Qiuyue and Qiao Liangren leaving Cheng Gaoji's residence, and Lin Moxian was with Xi Hongyan in her inn.
Yan Yinqing and Tantai Lingyan were in the temporary residence of the Yan and Tantai Clans.
Feng Jiu and most of them were busy with their own affairs, as were the people from the Red Sun Realm.
"Interesting." Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered under his breath as he examined several red dots on the map, one of which was Zhu Shanniang.
He was not surprised that the female Vermilion Bird hated him, but several other names raised questions in his mind.

"Long Qiang should have heard about my actions in the Sky Dragon Realm from Long Aotian, but I don't understand why some of them suddenly hated me, especially since their names were previously green."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then closed the map and woke Wang Yourou up, but she slept like a dead pig and did not respond to him. 'This woman!
She's old, but she always acts like a little girl.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] let Wang Yourou continue sleeping, and he contacted Jin Ruyue, asking her to come see him to dual-soul cultivate with him.
After the woman came, they immediately started their activities.
In the pavilion, Ning Zhuan'er finally woke up from her sleep, but she was confused after seeing the bedroom.
"Where am I?
How did I get here?" Ning Zhuan'er then got out of bed and went out of the room, but the scenery around the pavilion area stunned her.
"I've never seen a place as beautiful as this, and the Qi is also stronger than in the Sky Dragon Realm."
After all, the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion is equipped with a divine dual cultivation array, the Boundless Yin-Yang Array.
"Did you just wake up?" Ning Zhuan'er turned to Zhang Lingxue, who was walking towards her together with Chu Ying and Chu Qing.
"You don't have to be confused about this place because this place is your master's private place, and the three of us are some of his wives."
"Oh." Ning Zhuan'er then asked.
"What are the names of you three, Big Sisters?"
"Zhang Lingxue, and you can call me Big Sis Lingxue." Zhang Lingxue then pointed to the Chu Sisters.
"They are Chu Ying and Chu Qing, and our husband asked us to teach you more about alchemy."
Hearing alchemy, Ning Zhuan'er immediately became excited, making Zhang Lingxue smile.
"Where is Big Brother Fei now?"
"He is accompanying his other wives, Bai Shushi and Bai Tian'er." Zhang Lingxue took Ning Zhuan'er's hand and led her with them.
"You are part of our big family now, so I will introduce you to the others."
"Uhm." Ning Zhuan'er nodded slightly.
When they arrived at the main garden, Ning Zhuan'er was stunned by the number of women in the place, and Zhang Fei immediately introduced all of them to her.
'Ugh!
Big Brother Fei is a playboy, and he has dozens of women.' Unfortunately, Ning Zhuan'er still hadn't met all of them, especially since some of them were with Zhang Fei's clones.
After they chatted for quite a while, Zhang Lingxue took Ning Zhuan'er to the room that Zhang Fei had specially prepared for alchemy, followed by Chu Ying and Chu Qing.
Zhang Lingxue naturally knew that Zhang Fei had other intentions for Ning Zhuan'er, especially since he gave the Divine Alchemy Method to her.
She decided to impart the Yin-Yang Flawless Art to her, and she also gave her the Yang Qi.
Ning Zhuan'er was shocked by all of this, but Zhang Lingxue asked her to drink Zhang Fei's Yang Qi, especially since her cultivation was still too low.
"Don't be shy and drink it.
The faster your cultivation increases, the faster your improvement in alchemy will be, and the easier it will be for you to concoct high-grade pills."
"Uhm." Ning Zhuan'er shyly took a sip of Zhang Fei's Yang Qi before downing it clean.
Zhang Lingxue then gave her the five basic pills and some other pills, including the Youthful Retaining Pill and the Beauty Restoring Pill.
"Swallow them in order, and you will experience significant changes."
"Yes, Big Sister."
Sometime later, Ning Zhuan'er had finished swallowing all the pills, and Zhang Lingxue gave back her furnace.
She also gave her the ingredients to concoct the Five Elemental Pill according to Zhang Fei's instructions.
"For now, you only need to concoct the pills until you successfully concoct the superior-grade one.
After you successfully concoct it, I will teach you how to concoct the rank 2 pill."
"Yes." Ning Zhuan'er immediately started preparing the ingredients.
Then, Zhang Lingxue took out a few other ingredients and spoke to the Chu sisters.
"You two have successfully concocted the rank 3 pill, so it's time for you to concoct the rank 4 pill.
Our husband wants you two to concoct the Ethereal Bliss Pill because it will enhance our cultivation speed during dual cultivation with him."
After his cultivation was completely stable, Zhang Fei [5] immediately activated the Demon Eye's orb and sent it to the Dragon Clan.
He saw Long Aotian discussing with Long Qichao and the others, and he heard them planning to send assassins to kill him.
From their conversation, Zhang Fei [5] knew that Long Aotian was afraid of clashing directly with the Phoenix Clan, especially after Long Wuzhao refused to give a bit of his strength to help them.
Since their Dragon Clan had no assassins, and there were none on the floating island, Long Aotian sent Long Jishan and Long Yingwu to the lower land to look for them.
"Phew!" Zhang Fei [5] let out a heavy breath before contacting Feng Xishui, and he asked the male phoenix for help to take care of the two dragons.
However, he forbade her to kill them, especially since he needed both of them for other things.
A while later, Zhang Fei [5] had already arrived in front of Feng Qingmeng.
"I heard from Feng Yao that there are cultivators from the Nine Stars Realm in this sect, so I came here to meet them."
Feng Qingmeng directly told him.
"If I recall correctly, there are two cultivators who came from that realm.
They are Xian Xianjue and his wife, Shi Baoyin."
"Are there any cultivators with the Zhou, Yun, Shi, Guo, and Bai surnames who came from that realm here?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.
"There are no cultivators with those surnames in this sect." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding to Feng Qingmeng.
"If they also ascended to this realm, they might have joined the other sects, so you can try asking Yan Jinwu and the others about them.
However, I'm not sure if they also ascended to this realm, and they may ascend to other realms."

"Please call Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin for me." Feng Qingmeng immediately asked someone to bring the two people to her room, and Zhang Fei [5] tried to ask the other leaders about the other cultivators from the Nine Stars Realm, but they told her that there were no cultivators from that realm in their sect. 'If they weren't members of my wives' families, I wouldn't bother looking for them.'
"They'll be here soon." Feng Qingmeng then asked him.
"Are you interested in joining this sect?"
Zhang Fei [5] immediately refused.
"This realm is just a stepping stone for me, and I won't stay here for too long.
By the way, what is the status of Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin in this sect?
Are they still outer disciples?"
"No." Feng Qingmeng immediately explained to Zhang Fei [5].
"In the upper realms, the outer disciples are inhabited by cultivators from the first two stages of the Seven Divine Realms.
Cultivators in the third and fourth stages are inner disciples, and cultivators in the fifth stage are core disciples.
Sect Master and elders are those who have broken through to the Divine Ascendant Realm, just like me and Feng Shanxi."
"Doesn't that mean my status will be lower than the outer disciple if I join this sect?"
"If you are an ordinary cultivator." Zhang Fei [5] furrowed his brows in response to Feng Qingmeng.
"You have a close relationship with our Phoenix Clan, and our princess is your best friend, so your status is above all of us."
Zhang Fei [5] did not respond to that and asked another question.
"Why are you and Feng Shanxi still not married?"
"A marriage is just a burden to my cultivation, so I have no interest in it.
As for Feng Shanxi, I don't know her reasons, so you have to ask her yourself." Feng Qingmeng then warned him.
"You have to forget your desire to seduce me because it won't work on me, or you'll just waste your time."
"Is that so?" Feng Qingmeng's heart pounded as Zhang Fei [5] utilized the enhanced demon charm.
"If I find an attractive woman, I will definitely try to get her."
"Did you use a charm technique on me?" Feng Qingmeng frowned.
"I don't use any techniques, and my charm has long been a part of me.
All this time, I kept it suppressed, but now I've let it go." Feng Qingmeng did not believe Zhang Fei [5], and she tried to suppress the effects of his charm, but her heart was beating even faster.
Struggling to resist the effects, Feng Qingmeng begged him.
"Please stop it."
"Why should I stop it?" Zhang Fei [5] then walked to Feng Qingmeng's side, but she immediately used her aura to keep a distance between them.
"Hey, you are an attractive woman, and I want you.
You may consider marriage a hassle, but I am sure you have an interest in sex, right?"
'This brat is too shameless!
His face is thicker than anything!
How could he possibly ask me something like that?' Feng Qingmeng turned her face to the side and did not want to answer Zhang Fei [5], but she was shocked when her aura was dispelled for no reason.
Zhang Fei [5] took advantage of that by lifting Feng Qingmeng to her feet, and he gave her rose-colored lips a gentle kiss, shocking her.
'This damn brat!' Feng Qingmeng used her aura to push Zhang Fei [5] away, but he quickly hugged her, causing her to fall with him.
*Bam*
Zhang Fei [5] fell on his back with Feng Qingmeng lying on top of him.
He immediately gave her a deeper kiss by sliding his tongue into her mouth. 'Ugh!
If he wasn't a best friend of my princess, I would burn him alive!'
*Crack*
Hearing the door open, Feng Qingmeng pressed Zhang Fei [5]'s chest and pushed herself away from him.
She hurriedly wiped her lips, which made him smile in amusement.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately stood up, turning to the old man and old woman.
Feng Qingmeng, whose heart was still pounding because of Zhang Fei [5]'s actions, immediately spoke to them.
"Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin, this kid is Zhang Fei, and he comes from the Nine Stars Realm like the two of you."
Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin looked at him in surprise, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened a portal to the training space, and Xian Xianqin quickly came out of it, surprising the two of them.
"Xin'er?"
"Grandpa!
Grandma!" Xian Xianqin ran over and hugged them.
"Hehehe!
I'm glad you two are still alive!
We all missed you two!

"We miss you and the others too, Xin'er." Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin immediately hugged Xian Xianqin back, but they looked at Zhang Fei [5] with confused looks, especially since he could bring their granddaughter to them just like that.
"What is your relationship with him, Xin'er?" Shi Baoyin asked.
"Haha." Xian Xianqin released her embrace from them.
"Grandpa!
Grandma!
Zhang Fei is my husband, and we got married half a year ago.
By the way, my brother is also married to Yao Yin, but they are in our realm now."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Qingmeng, who nodded in understanding and left them.
Then, he went to the Nine Stars Realm before returning with five other people a few moments later.
Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin were stunned to see their family members, whom they had missed for a long time.
"Feng'er, Yue'er, Zhuang'er, Wu'er, and Yin'er."
"Father!
Mother!"
"Grandpa!
Grandma!"

chapters.title: Chapter 870: 4-Star And Archduke Rank
paragraphs: Since they had not seen each other for hundreds of years, Zhang Fei [5] did not disturb them. He sat on Feng Qingmeng's seat, listening to Xian Feng and the others recount all the events that had happened in the Xian Kingdom and the Nine Stars Realm after Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin ascended several hundred years ago. He was also thinking about his next plans for the Dragon Clan, his other plans, and his journey to the Sovereign Heaven Realm.

On his map, Zhang Fei [5] could see that Long Jishan and Long Yingwu had already arrived in the lower land, and they were on their way to the northern area, followed by Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng behind them. 'So, the assassins' hideout is in the north, eh?'
[Are you considering subduing them, Master?]

'I want to see their abilities and strengths first. If they are expert assassins, I will subdue them and recruit them into my Demon Fox group, and they will help me with my affairs in the upper realms.' Zhang Fei [5] then contacted Feng Xishui and asked him not to do anything to those assassins.
[Ding.]
[Congratulations! The host's ice elemental law has reached the intermediate stage.]

The appearance of the notification satisfied Zhang Fei [5], especially since his second clone had been staying in the ice lake in the Phoenix Realm for quite a while. Thereafter, Feltia [2] moved to the sea of fire to increase his fire elemental law to the half-perfection stage.

Sometime later, Xian Feng and the others had told everything to Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin, which made both of them sorrowful, especially the decision of their first son, Xian Hong, to defect to the demons. Moreover, their second son had already crippled Li Yiping and her two children, Xian Yu and Xian Mu.
"I'm sorry, I had to do it to protect our kingdom."

"No need." Xian Xianjue replied with a shake of his head. "Even though I am sad about their situation, you have done the right thing regarding them. If I were still in our kingdom, I would have done the same."
Shang Baoyin then asked. "What about Hong'er? Have you done anything to him?"
"Not yet." Xian Feng turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "He locked Xian Hong in the Star Tower together with Ximen Gongwu and Zheng Moyue."

Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin turned to Zhang Fei [5] in surprise, especially since the two of them had challenged the Star Tower in the past, so they knew that it was no ordinary tower. Moreover, their family told them that he had united all the kingdoms in their realm; even the beast and natural race kingdoms were also related to him.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained. "Coincidentally, I caught the attention of the person in charge of the Star Tower when I challenged it a few months ago, and he was willing to help me lock them up. He also helped me lock up several people from the Huangfu Clan, such as Huangfu Fanbo and Huangfu Song."
"What are your plans for them?" Xian Xianjue asked.

"At first, I still don't have any plans for them, but I have some ideas for them now." All of them immediately focused their attention on Zhang Fei [5]. "I won't do anything to Xian Hong, and I will hand him over to you guys so that you can decide his fate. Ximen Gongwu and Zheng Moyue are fairly strong, but I don't need them. I will kill them, and I will use their demon essence to strengthen myself."
"Hmm? What do you mean by that?"

"Grandpa! Grandma! Fei is also a demon." Xian Xianqin's revelation shocked Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin. "Don't misunderstand him. He is a human, a demon, and a beast. Otherwise, he wouldn't be able to establish relationships with all races, and he managed to unite our realm also because of his three identities."

Seeing their expressions, Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his lust demon form and complete fox form in turn, shocking both Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin. He then returned to his human form. "Back when I started my path of cultivation, I often hid my other two identities, but I will no longer hide them. Not only do people in the Nine Stars Realm know my three identities, but many people in the lower and upper realms do as well, especially those who have a close relationship with me."
"Are you going to take care of them now, Fei?" Xian Changyue asked him.

"The situation in our realm has completely stabilized now, so I don't need to lock them up in the Star Tower anymore. Moreover, my demon rank will soon rise to the archduke rank, and their demon essence is likely enough for that, so I'll do it now." After saying that, Zhang Fei [5] immediately left them and went to the Nine Star Realm.
"How can he switch realms so easily?" Xian Xianjue asked them.
Xian Changyue immediately explained it to him. "Father, Zhang Fei [5] is a heavenly fox, and the ability to change realms is one of his beast abilities."
"I see."
"Grandpa, how is your life and my grandma's in the sect? I want to hear your stories after you arrived here."
As he rubbed Xian Xianqin's head, Xian Xianjue laughed and recounted their journey from ascending to the Sky Dragon Realm to joining the Blazing Phoenix Sect today.
Zhang Fei [5] was already on the first floor of the Star Tower, waiting for the old man to send Xian Hong and the others to him.
A few minutes later, Sima Yun appeared before Zhang Fei [5], and he brought several unconscious people with him.
"Long time no see, Old Brat." Zhang Fei [5] greeted Sima Yu with a wide grin.
"They are yours." Sima Yun threw the five people in front of Zhang Fei [5] and disappeared again.

Zhang Fei [5] first squatted at the side of the people from the Huangfu Clan, and he used some of his demon abilities on them. After that, he woke them up and gave them some orders, and they hurriedly left the Star Tower after that.

Then, Zhang Fei [5] sent Xian Hong to the Xian Kingdom, especially since he couldn't possibly bring him to the Sky Dragon Realm. He brought Ximen Gongwu and Zheng Mohei to an empty island, especially since his cultivation would instantly break through if he absorbed their cultivation.
Upon arriving there, Zhang Fei [5] immediately used his demon-absorbing on Ximen Gongwu and Zheng Mohei. He sucked their cultivation and demon power dry, leading to their demise.
[You gained 5,000,000 demon essences from Ximen Gongwu.]
[You gained 3,000,000 Qi from Ximen Gongwu.]
[You gained 6,000,000 demon essences from Zheng Moyue.]
[You gained 3,500,000 Qi from Zheng Moyue.]
[Ding.]
[Congratulations! The host's cultivation broke through to 4 Star Heaven Realm.]
[Congratulations! The host's demon rank has been upgraded to archduke rank.]

In a matter of seconds, the sky in the Nine Stars Realm turned dark, especially above the island, with lightning bolts flashing above. Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned Lei Que out of the beast space, and the thunderbird quickly brought him into the source of its lightning tribulation.
"Your cultivation broke through again?" Bai Shushi, who was curled up in Zhang Fei's embrace, asked.

"My fifth clone just killed Zheng Moyue and Ximen Gongwu, and my cultivation broke through immediately after absorbing their cultivation." Zhang Fei released her and Bai Tian'er from his embrace. "You two rest now."

After Zhang Fei left, Bai Tian'er asked Bai Shushi. "Will he be okay, Mother? He uses shortcuts to break through too often, and it worries me. I'm afraid he'll get addicted to doing it, and it'll twist his character."

"Sigh." Bai Shushi sighed softly. "I'm also worried that he will get addicted to using a shortcut, but he is too eager to strengthen himself, and he won't listen to us. I hope he doesn't get addicted to it, or he will become a heretic cultivator."
"I hope so, Mother." Bai Tian'er then closed her eyes. "I'm too tired because he made me orgasm too many times, so I want to sleep now."
"Yeah." Bai Shushi nodded to his daughter, and the two slept in each other's arms.

On the flying artifact, Feng Yao could only shake her head as she watched Zhang Fei [4], who was sitting cross-legged with his eyes closed. 'He began to become dependent on the Nine Revolutions Pills, and he repeatedly absorbed other people's cultivation to improve himself. If he continues doing this, he will face a huge obstacle when he is about to break through to the Seven Divine Realms.'
[If that happens, he is not worthy of going to the Paradise Realm, let alone to our realm, Master.]

Feng Yao chose not to respond to Huo Ling and focused on watching Zhang Fei [4]. 'I hope you know when to stop using a shortcut, or you will sink deeper and deeper, and you will never be able to escape its trap.'
In the Pandora Odyssey, Yan Zhixiu and the other women stood around Zhang Fei [1], and they were worried about his methods for improving himself.
"Zhixiu, we have to ask him to stop his crazy actions." Xi Zihua spoke.

Yan Luan'er also spoke. "Since his cultivation was still at the 4-Star Earth Realm, he has been using the shortcut of absorbing other people's cultivation, and I'm afraid he won't be able to stop using it."

"Yes." Yan Zhixiu nodded in agreement with them. "I understand his desire to become strong and help us, but he has gone too far, and he will be trapped in a path of no return if this continues. After he completes his breakthrough, we will talk to him, and I hope he is willing to listen to us."

At Cheng Gaoji's residence, Wang Yourou had woken up from her sleep and was sitting opposite Zhang Xiaolong [3], watching him with a serious expression. She decided to contact the others, especially since she felt that he was too careless with his breakthrough.
In a while, Hun Di and several others had arrived at the room, and all of them let out a heavy sigh, feeling the fluctuation of Qi and lightning elements in Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s body.
"I already warned him not to rely on the Nine Revolutions Pills, but this kid was too stubborn and didn't listen to me." Lin Jingxia commented with a shake of her head.
"Master, you should advise my junior brother." Yan Yinqing spoke to Hun Di. "If he continues like this, he will only harm himself."
Lin Moxian and the others also spoke to Hun Di, who responded to them with a nod. "Let's wait for him to finish first, and I'll talk to him after that."

A few hours later, Zhang Fei [5] had completed his breakthrough, and he immediately returned to the Blazing Phoenix Sect in the Sky Dragon Realm. He asked Feng Qingmeng for permission to bring Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin to the Phoenix Clan so they could gather together with Xian Xianqin and the others.
Feng Qingmeng immediately agreed to it, and she asked the people in the Phoenix Clan to prepare guest rooms for them.
Zhang Fei [5] did not join them, and he went to his room to stabilize his cultivation. Meanwhile, in other places, many people advise his real body and other clones to stop his crazy actions.

"Kid, I understand your situation and your wishes, but I forbid you from using shortcuts." Hun Di spoke with a heavy sigh. "You should already be aware that the results achieved by such means will not end well, so you should stop it. You may not experience the side effects now, but you will definitely experience them someday. If that happens, your cultivation will never be able to advance without using shortcuts, and you will eventually turn into a heretic cultivator because of your addiction."

Feng Jiu also tried to advise Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "They may be bad people, but they are still living beings, and your karma will accumulate even more if you use them as sacrifices. You yourself should already be aware that your lightning tribulations become stronger every time you break through, right? Once the heavens deem you evil, they will bring down the strongest lightning tribulation to kill you. Even if your body is incredibly strong, you won't be able to withstand it, and it has already struck down someone stronger than you in the past."

"Far in the past, there was a body cultivator with an invincible physique, and he was able to reach his level by using shortcuts like you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Feng Xueying. "Back then, he managed to defeat many cultivators, including me and Feng Shen. Unfortunately, his efforts ended in vain when the heavens decided to punish him using the strongest lightning tribulation, which not only destroyed his body but also his soul."

Hong Quan then spoke. "Kid, you have to remember that there are so many people by your side, including my granddaughter. If you die, all of them will be miserable because of your death, so you have to be more careful in doing everything."
"Becoming strong by using shortcuts is not good, and you have to strengthen yourself with your efforts." Feng Tian spoke.

"Sigh." Zhe Wuming patted Zhang Xiaolong [3] on the shoulder. "You are a grown-up man, so you should be able to think much better. Seniors like us can only give you advice, but all the decisions are in your hands."
Gong Ren then spoke to him. "We have seen the rise and fall of many cultivators, and we do not wish to see a genius like you end up like them, so I hope you will be willing to listen to our advice."
Zhang Xialong [3] stood up and cupped his hands toward them. "Seniors, thank you all for your advice. I will definitely listen to your words, and I will no longer use shortcuts to improve myself."
"We hope you can really do that."
Zhe Wuming then asked. "Do you have any recent information about Xereth?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told them about Xereth, who was on his way with Feng Yichen to the Blue Water Realm. "They will arrive there in two days, and I have already asked someone to do something about him. However, that demon is quite cunning, and he has numerous statues hidden across various realms."
"How did you track them down? Who is the person you are referring to in the Blue Water Realm?"

"That person is a powerful demon beast, but I won't say much about him." Zhang Xiaolong [3] stole a glance at Feng Jiu for a moment. "As for how I can track their location, Feng Yao helped me subdue Feng Yichen, and she has become my contract beast."

The Phoenix Clan members were shocked to hear the name, and Feng Shen's expression became serious. "Kid, tell me, did she give the Divine Phoenix Totem to you? If she did, you must return it to us, especially since it is our clan treasure."

'As expected.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly muttered as soon as he saw Feng Shen's name turn red on the map. "Old Phoenix, the Divine Phoenix Totem was not in Feng Yichen's hands, and it disappeared when she tried to subdue it. Whether you believe me or not is your business, but I've told you the truth."
"You—"

Feng Xueying immediately interjected. "Old Shen, Feng Yichen is this kid's contract beast now, so she can't lie to him. Moreover, the aura of the Divine Phoenix Totem is strong. It will stick to his body if he ever sees it, yet I can't sense it from him."
Feng Shen glared fiercely at Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he didn't say anything and left the room immediately, followed by many others.
"You must remember my words some time ago." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Feng Jiu, who immediately followed the others, leaving him and the few others there.
