Sometime later, Xian Feng and the others had told everything to Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin, which made both of them sorrowful, especially the decision of their first son, Xian Hong, to defect to the demons.
Moreover, their second son had already crippled Li Yiping and her two children, Xian Yu and Xian Mu.
"I'm sorry, I had to do it to protect our kingdom."
"No need." Xian Xianjue replied with a shake of his head.
"Even though I am sad about their situation, you have done the right thing regarding them.
If I were still in our kingdom, I would have done the same."
Shang Baoyin then asked.
"What about Hong'er?
Have you done anything to him?"
"Not yet." Xian Feng turned to Zhang Fei [5].
"He locked Xian Hong in the Star Tower together with Ximen Gongwu and Zheng Moyue."
Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin turned to Zhang Fei [5] in surprise, especially since the two of them had challenged the Star Tower in the past, so they knew that it was no ordinary tower.
Moreover, their family told them that he had united all the kingdoms in their realm; even the beast and natural race kingdoms were also related to him.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained.
"Coincidentally, I caught the attention of the person in charge of the Star Tower when I challenged it a few months ago, and he was willing to help me lock them up.
He also helped me lock up several people from the Huangfu Clan, such as Huangfu Fanbo and Huangfu Song."
"What are your plans for them?" Xian Xianjue asked.
"At first, I still don't have any plans for them, but I have some ideas for them now." All of them immediately focused their attention on Zhang Fei [5].
"I won't do anything to Xian Hong, and I will hand him over to you guys so that you can decide his fate.
Ximen Gongwu and Zheng Moyue are fairly strong, but I don't need them.
I will kill them, and I will use their demon essence to strengthen myself."
"Hmm?
What do you mean by that?"
"Grandpa!
Grandma!
Fei is also a demon." Xian Xianqin's revelation shocked Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin.
"Don't misunderstand him.
He is a human, a demon, and a beast.
Otherwise, he wouldn't be able to establish relationships with all races, and he managed to unite our realm also because of his three identities."
Seeing their expressions, Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his lust demon form and complete fox form in turn, shocking both Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin.
He then returned to his human form.
"Back when I started my path of cultivation, I often hid my other two identities, but I will no longer hide them.
Not only do people in the Nine Stars Realm know my three identities, but many people in the lower and upper realms do as well, especially those who have a close relationship with me."
"Are you going to take care of them now, Fei?" Xian Changyue asked him.
"The situation in our realm has completely stabilized now, so I don't need to lock them up in the Star Tower anymore.

Moreover, my demon rank will soon rise to the archduke rank, and their demon essence is likely enough for that, so I'll do it now." After saying that, Zhang Fei [5] immediately left them and went to the Nine Star Realm.
"How can he switch realms so easily?" Xian Xianjue asked them.
Xian Changyue immediately explained it to him.
"Father, Zhang Fei [5] is a heavenly fox, and the ability to change realms is one of his beast abilities."
"I see."
"Grandpa, how is your life and my grandma's in the sect?
I want to hear your stories after you arrived here."
As he rubbed Xian Xianqin's head, Xian Xianjue laughed and recounted their journey from ascending to the Sky Dragon Realm to joining the Blazing Phoenix Sect today.
Zhang Fei [5] was already on the first floor of the Star Tower, waiting for the old man to send Xian Hong and the others to him.
A few minutes later, Sima Yun appeared before Zhang Fei [5], and he brought several unconscious people with him.
"Long time no see, Old Brat." Zhang Fei [5] greeted Sima Yu with a wide grin.
"They are yours." Sima Yun threw the five people in front of Zhang Fei [5] and disappeared again.
Zhang Fei [5] first squatted at the side of the people from the Huangfu Clan, and he used some of his demon abilities on them.
After that, he woke them up and gave them some orders, and they hurriedly left the Star Tower after that.
Then, Zhang Fei [5] sent Xian Hong to the Xian Kingdom, especially since he couldn't possibly bring him to the Sky Dragon Realm.
He brought Ximen Gongwu and Zheng Mohei to an empty island, especially since his cultivation would instantly break through if he absorbed their cultivation.
Upon arriving there, Zhang Fei [5] immediately used his demon-absorbing on Ximen Gongwu and Zheng Mohei.
He sucked their cultivation and demon power dry, leading to their demise.
[You gained 5,000,000 demon essences from Ximen Gongwu.]
[You gained 3,000,000 Qi from Ximen Gongwu.]
[You gained 6,000,000 demon essences from Zheng Moyue.]
[You gained 3,500,000 Qi from Zheng Moyue.]
[Ding.]
[Congratulations!
The host's cultivation broke through to 4 Star Heaven Realm.]
[Congratulations!
The host's demon rank has been upgraded to archduke rank.]
In a matter of seconds, the sky in the Nine Stars Realm turned dark, especially above the island, with lightning bolts flashing above.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned Lei Que out of the beast space, and the thunderbird quickly brought him into the source of its lightning tribulation.
"Your cultivation broke through again?" Bai Shushi, who was curled up in Zhang Fei's embrace, asked.
"My fifth clone just killed Zheng Moyue and Ximen Gongwu, and my cultivation broke through immediately after absorbing their cultivation." Zhang Fei released her and Bai Tian'er from his embrace.
"You two rest now."
After Zhang Fei left, Bai Tian'er asked Bai Shushi.
"Will he be okay, Mother?
He uses shortcuts to break through too often, and it worries me.
I'm afraid he'll get addicted to doing it, and it'll twist his character."
"Sigh." Bai Shushi sighed softly.
"I'm also worried that he will get addicted to using a shortcut, but he is too eager to strengthen himself, and he won't listen to us.
I hope he doesn't get addicted to it, or he will become a heretic cultivator."
"I hope so, Mother." Bai Tian'er then closed her eyes.
"I'm too tired because he made me orgasm too many times, so I want to sleep now."
"Yeah." Bai Shushi nodded to his daughter, and the two slept in each other's arms.

On the flying artifact, Feng Yao could only shake her head as she watched Zhang Fei [4], who was sitting cross-legged with his eyes closed. 'He began to become dependent on the Nine Revolutions Pills, and he repeatedly absorbed other people's cultivation to improve himself.
If he continues doing this, he will face a huge obstacle when he is about to break through to the Seven Divine Realms.'
[If that happens, he is not worthy of going to the Paradise Realm, let alone to our realm, Master.]

Feng Yao chose not to respond to Huo Ling and focused on watching Zhang Fei [4]. 'I hope you know when to stop using a shortcut, or you will sink deeper and deeper, and you will never be able to escape its trap.'
In the Pandora Odyssey, Yan Zhixiu and the other women stood around Zhang Fei [1], and they were worried about his methods for improving himself.
"Zhixiu, we have to ask him to stop his crazy actions." Xi Zihua spoke.
Yan Luan'er also spoke.
"Since his cultivation was still at the 4-Star Earth Realm, he has been using the shortcut of absorbing other people's cultivation, and I'm afraid he won't be able to stop using it."
"Yes." Yan Zhixiu nodded in agreement with them.
"I understand his desire to become strong and help us, but he has gone too far, and he will be trapped in a path of no return if this continues.
After he completes his breakthrough, we will talk to him, and I hope he is willing to listen to us."
At Cheng Gaoji's residence, Wang Yourou had woken up from her sleep and was sitting opposite Zhang Xiaolong [3], watching him with a serious expression.
She decided to contact the others, especially since she felt that he was too careless with his breakthrough.
In a while, Hun Di and several others had arrived at the room, and all of them let out a heavy sigh, feeling the fluctuation of Qi and lightning elements in Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s body.
"I already warned him not to rely on the Nine Revolutions Pills, but this kid was too stubborn and didn't listen to me." Lin Jingxia commented with a shake of her head.
"Master, you should advise my junior brother." Yan Yinqing spoke to Hun Di.
"If he continues like this, he will only harm himself."
Lin Moxian and the others also spoke to Hun Di, who responded to them with a nod.
"Let's wait for him to finish first, and I'll talk to him after that."
A few hours later, Zhang Fei [5] had completed his breakthrough, and he immediately returned to the Blazing Phoenix Sect in the Sky Dragon Realm.
He asked Feng Qingmeng for permission to bring Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin to the Phoenix Clan so they could gather together with Xian Xianqin and the others.
Feng Qingmeng immediately agreed to it, and she asked the people in the Phoenix Clan to prepare guest rooms for them.
Zhang Fei [5] did not join them, and he went to his room to stabilize his cultivation.
Meanwhile, in other places, many people advise his real body and other clones to stop his crazy actions.
"Kid, I understand your situation and your wishes, but I forbid you from using shortcuts." Hun Di spoke with a heavy sigh.
"You should already be aware that the results achieved by such means will not end well, so you should stop it.
You may not experience the side effects now, but you will definitely experience them someday.
If that happens, your cultivation will never be able to advance without using shortcuts, and you will eventually turn into a heretic cultivator because of your addiction."
Feng Jiu also tried to advise Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"They may be bad people, but they are still living beings, and your karma will accumulate even more if you use them as sacrifices.
You yourself should already be aware that your lightning tribulations become stronger every time you break through, right?
Once the heavens deem you evil, they will bring down the strongest lightning tribulation to kill you.
Even if your body is incredibly strong, you won't be able to withstand it, and it has already struck down someone stronger than you in the past."
"Far in the past, there was a body cultivator with an invincible physique, and he was able to reach his level by using shortcuts like you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Feng Xueying.
"Back then, he managed to defeat many cultivators, including me and Feng Shen.
Unfortunately, his efforts ended in vain when the heavens decided to punish him using the strongest lightning tribulation, which not only destroyed his body but also his soul."
Hong Quan then spoke.
"Kid, you have to remember that there are so many people by your side, including my granddaughter.
If you die, all of them will be miserable because of your death, so you have to be more careful in doing everything."
"Becoming strong by using shortcuts is not good, and you have to strengthen yourself with your efforts." Feng Tian spoke.
"Sigh." Zhe Wuming patted Zhang Xiaolong [3] on the shoulder.
"You are a grown-up man, so you should be able to think much better.
Seniors like us can only give you advice, but all the decisions are in your hands."
Gong Ren then spoke to him.
"We have seen the rise and fall of many cultivators, and we do not wish to see a genius like you end up like them, so I hope you will be willing to listen to our advice."
Zhang Xialong [3] stood up and cupped his hands toward them.
"Seniors, thank you all for your advice.
I will definitely listen to your words, and I will no longer use shortcuts to improve myself."
"We hope you can really do that."
Zhe Wuming then asked.
"Do you have any recent information about Xereth?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told them about Xereth, who was on his way with Feng Yichen to the Blue Water Realm.
"They will arrive there in two days, and I have already asked someone to do something about him.
However, that demon is quite cunning, and he has numerous statues hidden across various realms."
"How did you track them down?
Who is the person you are referring to in the Blue Water Realm?"
"That person is a powerful demon beast, but I won't say much about him." Zhang Xiaolong [3] stole a glance at Feng Jiu for a moment.
"As for how I can track their location, Feng Yao helped me subdue Feng Yichen, and she has become my contract beast."
The Phoenix Clan members were shocked to hear the name, and Feng Shen's expression became serious.
"Kid, tell me, did she give the Divine Phoenix Totem to you?
If she did, you must return it to us, especially since it is our clan treasure."
'As expected.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly muttered as soon as he saw Feng Shen's name turn red on the map.
"Old Phoenix, the Divine Phoenix Totem was not in Feng Yichen's hands, and it disappeared when she tried to subdue it.
Whether you believe me or not is your business, but I've told you the truth."
"You—"
Feng Xueying immediately interjected.
"Old Shen, Feng Yichen is this kid's contract beast now, so she can't lie to him.
Moreover, the aura of the Divine Phoenix Totem is strong.
It will stick to his body if he ever sees it, yet I can't sense it from him."
Feng Shen glared fiercely at Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he didn't say anything and left the room immediately, followed by many others.
"You must remember my words some time ago." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Feng Jiu, who immediately followed the others, leaving him and the few others there.

chapters.title: Chapter 871: Thunder And Rain Dragon Bloodlines
paragraphs: Yan Yinqing sat down beside Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Hey, Junior Brother! What did Empress Feng mean by that just now? She didn't say it out loud, but I know there's something behind her words."
"I agree with Senior Sister Yan." Shang Yingyue also asked him. "Did Empress Feng warn you of any danger?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded. "Empress Feng warned me about several people, and one of them was Feng Shen. You must have seen his reaction just now, especially after I mentioned the Divine Phoenix Totem."
"What is the Divine Phoenix Totem?"
"The totem is the Phoenix Clan's best treasure, and if a fire phoenix race manages to get it and become its master, he or she will gain the strength of the first fire phoenix."
"Is that totem really not in Feng Yichen's hands?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "Feng Yichen's soul has merged with mine, so I know she is not lying. She speculated that the totem had returned to the Phoenix Realm, but despite my extensive searches, I was unable to locate it. At first, I thought it was in the Phoenix Castle, but Feng Xueying's words just now dismissed my guess. The banner might be hiding in other areas or even other realms."
"Who exactly is Feng Yichen?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told Jing Qiuyue about the Dark Phoenix. "Wow! You are lucky to get such a powerful contract beast, Junior Brother."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled wryly. "You're right, I was indeed lucky, especially since I wouldn't have been able to contract her if it weren't for Feng Yao."

"Phew." Lin Moxian suddenly sighed. "Feng Shen is too powerful, and he is much stronger than our master. Therefore, you have to be careful and guard against him, or no one will be able to save you if he attacks you."

"Not only Feng Shen, but you also have to be wary of Zhu Shanniang." Wang Yourou's words did not surprise them because they knew the female Vermilion Bird's hatred towards the Heavenly Fox Race, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a heavenly fox.

"In fact, not only the two of them are targeting me, but there are several others, one of whom is Long Qiang." All of them looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a frown, prompting him to explain the situation between him and the Dragon Clan in the Sky Dragon Realm. "I'm not afraid of Long Aotian or his subordinates, but the main Dragon Clan will give me trouble. However, you don't need to worry about me, especially since I can escape from this realm whenever I want. If the situation forces me, I will leave this realm, and I will enter seclusion."
Since they already knew Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s abilities and the fact that he was just a clone, Lin Moxian and the others believed that he could avoid the danger from those senior cultivators.
"I will go see Xi Hongyan again; that woman is still difficult to conquer even though I have used a little underhanded method." Lin Moxian immediately left the room.

Jing Qiuyue pulled Qiao Liangren away with her, making him sigh helplessly. Shang Yingyue first asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] to send Wu Lianzhi to his private space before leaving the room together with Yan Yinqing.
"Aren't you going back to your Wang Clan? I want to stabilize my cultivation now, so I don't have time for you." Wang Yourou pursed her lips before leaving.

After they left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went straight to the Divine Flame Realm to meet Jiang Shen and inform him about his cooperation with Ji Changlan. This way, he could join his Demon Fox group, but he would also remain a member of the Blacksmith Union specifically for blacksmithing matters.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not stay in the Divine Realm for too long. After speaking with Jiang Shen, he returned to the Xianjin Realm, and he began to stabilize his cultivation after sending Wu Lianzhi to his training space.

In the Sky Dragon Realm, Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng had already arrived at the northern area of the lower land, but they did not immediately move to ambush Long Jishan and Long Yingwu. Instead, they watched them from a distance, especially since Zhang Fei wanted information about the strength of the assassins.
"What is that kid's plan for them?" Feng Xiushi immediately explained to Feng Yongheng about Zhang Fei's Demon Fox group. "Does that mean he wants to dominate the lower, middle, and upper realms?"

Feng Xiushi shook his head. "Zhang Fei is not that kind of person, and he just wants to collect as many resources as possible. The three realms are vast and contain numerous planets, prompting him to recruit many people and send them to each planet."
"I see."

Feng Xiushi and Feng Yongheng landed in the distance when they saw Long Jishan and Long Yingwu landing in one of the cities in the northern area. They saw the two enter a large but shabby and abandoned residence. "That residence must be the assassins' base, so we'll wait for those two to leave first."

About an hour later, Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng saw two people from the Dragon Clan come out of the residence, accompanied by an old man with cultivation at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, who they believed was the leader of the assassins.
The old man told Long Jishan and Long Yingwu that some of his best members would be heading to the floating island in a few days, especially since they were still on missions elsewhere.
"That person is pretty strong, even though he's not as strong as us. Zhang Fei will probably have a hard time subduing him." Feng Yongheng spoke.

Unlike him, Feng Xishui had already watched Zhang Fei fight, so he believed that he was capable of subduing the old man by himself. "Let him take care of the old man and his subordinates, and our task is to capture Long Jishan and Long Yingwu. However, we have to do it quickly, or they will warn Long Aotian about our actions."

"I think I have an idea for that." Feng Xishui turned to Feng Yongheng, who smiled evilly and took out two identical artifacts. "Before I can use this artifact on them, we have to catch them both off guard , and their minds will be trapped in a powerful cage that even Long Aotian cannot dispel."
"Where did you get these artifacts?"

"Ruins in another realm, and that place is very ancient." Feng Yongheng then told Feng Xishui about the ruins. "Do you want to go there? There are many unexplored places in those ruins, and I'm sure there are many other artifacts or valuable items there."

"Zhang Fei will be interested in those ruins, so we'll tell him about them later." Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng then followed Long Jishan and Long Yingwu, who had already flown away from the area to return to the floating island. "I will distract them, and you should hurry and use the artifact on them."
"All right."
Long Jishan and Long Yingwu immediately stopped flying as Feng Xishui appeared before them with a flame spear in his hand. "What do you mean by blocking our path?"

"I should be the one asking what your Dragon Clan means by wanting to harm my young master." Feng Xishui pointed his flame spear at them. "He never sought trouble with your clan, but Long Qichao sent you two to capture him. He was just retaliating for your mistreatment of him, yet you chose not to acknowledge your mistake and sought to kill him instead."
"Your young master?" Long Jishan and Long Yingwu's expressions looked shocked.

Feng Xishui decided to brag further. "Zhang Fei is my princess's lover, and they will get married in the future, so he is my young master. Have you forgotten how our ancestors taught your ancestors a lesson? They didn't even dare to fight our Phoenix Clan anymore after that incident, yet a leader of your branch clan wanted to attack him."
Long Jishan and Long Yingwu exchanged glances with expressions full of confusion, especially since the problem would only get bigger if the main Phoenix Clan got involved in it.
"Too late." Feng Xishui thrust his flame spear toward Long Jishan and Long Yingwu, and a fire phoenix shot out to attack them.

Long Yingwu immediately countered Feng Xishui's attack with her water element, and a water dragon shot out from her palm. Long Jishan did not stay idle, and a thunder dragon quickly descended from the sky, shooting toward Feng Xishui.

The water dragon exploded and evaporated as soon as it collided with the fire phoenix, and it quickly headed toward Feng Yingwu. She blocked it with several water shields, but her shields shattered one by one, forcing her to dodge it.
Feng Xishui thrust his flame spear into the sky, and another fire phoenix shot out toward Long Jishan's thunder dragon before colliding with each other, resulting in a huge explosion.
*Boom*
Feng Xishui immediately flew towards Long Jishan, but the male dragon hurriedly moved away from him, especially since his strength was below his.
Long Yingwu wanted to help Long Jishan, but Feng Yongheng suddenly appeared in front of her, and he quickly stuck the other artifact to her chest, causing her pupils to shrink and her eyes to blank.
Then, Feng Yongheng chased after Long Jishan, who was still trying to escape from Feng Xishui while avoiding his half-hearted attacks.
As soon as he reached Long Jishan's side, Feng Yongheng immediately attached the other artifact to his back, and his expression became the same as Long Yingwu's. "Shall we bring them to our clan?"
"Long Tian will notice if we bring them there." Feng Xishui immediately contacted Zhang Fei's clone in the Phoenix Clan.

In a few minutes, Zhang Fei [5] arrived before them with a satisfied smile in his eyes. "Thank you for your help, seniors. By the way, let's take the two of them to a quiet place, and I'll do something about them."
"Over there." Feng Yongheng pointed to a lower area not far from their location. "There's no one in that area."
"Let's go."
"What are you going to do with them?" After placing Long Jishan and Long Yingwu on the ground, Feng Xishui posed this question.
"Can you guys extract their dragon origin bloodline?"
Both phoenixes shook their heads at Zhang Fei. "A beast origin bloodline can only be extracted by its owner, so you have to do something to them if you want their bloodline."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. 'Can we use the science capsule to extract their dragon origin bloodline, Mei?'

[We've never tried it before, but I think it's possible. However, we can't do it here, but we can't take them away either, especially since there's a possibility that Long Aotian will notice their disappearance. The easiest way is to use your memory manipulation to force them to give you their dragon origin bloodline, and you can restore their memories after that.]

Zhang Fei [5] immediately used his memory manipulation on them, but he locked away their original memories first. After that, he asked Feng Yongheng to remove his two artifacts from their bodies before waking them up. "Give me your dragon origin bloodline."
Like puppets, Long Jishan and Long Yingwu immediately followed Zhang Fei [5]'s order, and two blood clots quickly appeared in front of them, which caused both of them to look pale.
'This kid can control other people, huh?' Feng Yongheng inwardly muttered.

Zhang Fei [5] quickly stored their dragon origin bloodline in two special containers before storing both of them in the system's inventory. Then, he knocked both of them unconscious again before restoring their memories, and he also erased their memories of Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng.
"Do you want to implant their bloodline in your body?"

"I am a heavenly fox, so I will give their bloodline to my two wives, and they will become strong enough to help me." Zhang Fei [5] then looked north after Feng Xishui told him about the assassins' hideout. "My cultivation hasn't stabilized after I broke through, so we should go back now, and I'll take care of that old man later."
"All right."
Upon their arrival at the Phoenix Clan, Zhang Fei [5] returned to his room and focused on stabilizing his cultivation. As usual, Mei helped him to monitor the residence area.
Sometime after they left, Long Jishan and Long Yingwu finally woke up, but they looked confused about their situation.
"What happened to us? Why are we in this place?"

"I don't know; I remember we were on our way home from that old man's residence." Long Jishan immediately stood up while lifting Long Yingwu. "We should return to our clan now, and we will report this matter to our patriarch."
"Let's go."

As soon as they arrived at the Dragon Clan, Long Jishan and Long Yingwu went to meet Long Aotian. They reported everything to him, which caused him to frown. He then checked their memories, but he didn't find anything strange in them. "Was there anyone following you two before?"

"We have confirmed that no one followed us, Patriarch." Long Aotian did not believe Long Yingyu, and he was sure that something was going on without them knowing. "The old man's subordinates will arrive here in a few days, and they will definitely be able to take care of that kid."
Long Aotian gave a light nod. "Go back now."
"Yes, Patriarch."

"Who did that to them? I'm sure they encountered something, and that person erased their memories of it." Long Aotian then contacted someone and asked for help to check on his two subordinates. "Who exactly is that kid? Long Qiang told me that he is also in the Xianjin Realm now, but it is impossible for two people to be in different realms at the same time, so one of them should be a clone. Tch! Whatever the risk, he must die. If that foolish assassin fails to kill them, I will kill him myself."
At the pavilion, Zhang Fei asked Zhong Yan and Shen Yu to meet him. He then showed them the thunder dragon bloodline and the rain dragon bloodline.

"Yan'er, you are weaker than Ye Lian and Yun Xinyue, so I want you to implant the thunder dragon bloodline into your body to strengthen you." Zhang Fei then spoke to Shen Yu. "Your mother and grandmother are stronger than you, so I want you to use this rain dragon bloodline, Yu'er."

Since their husband had decided like that, Zhong Yan and Shen Yu followed his wishes. Then, Zhang Fei took out the science capsule, and Mei helped the two women to inherit the two dragon bloodlines in turn.

Even though her cultivation did not immediately experience any immediate changes after Mei implanted the thunder dragon bloodline into her body, Zhong Yan felt that her new bloodline had strengthened her physique.

The effects of the change were more obvious for Shen Yu, especially since she was basically a sea serpent beast. The rain dragon bloodline that she received not only strengthened her physique, but it also enhanced her original bloodline, elevating her beast rank to the divine beast level.
After that, Zhang Fei gathered all his official women, and he helped them cultivate in turn while stabilizing his cultivation.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels.]

Unknowingly, two days passed quickly. Zhang Fei [5], who was cultivating, immediately contacted Feng Yichen. The Dark Phoenix told him that she and Xereth were already outside the Blue Water Realm, and they would soon enter it.
Zhang Fei [5] quickly went to the Blue Water Realm in invisible mode, but he did not encounter Serpentera, who was already waiting for Xereth and Feng Yichen to arrive.
In a few minutes, Zhang Fei [5] saw the two enter the realm, and Xereth immediately brought Feng Yichen to the surface of the sea right above the Sunken Empire. 'So, that's Xereth, huh?'

"In fact, not only the two of them are targeting me, but there are several others, one of whom is Long Qiang." All of them looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a frown, prompting him to explain the situation between him and the Dragon Clan in the Sky Dragon Realm.
"I'm not afraid of Long Aotian or his subordinates, but the main Dragon Clan will give me trouble.
However, you don't need to worry about me, especially since I can escape from this realm whenever I want.
If the situation forces me, I will leave this realm, and I will enter seclusion."
Since they already knew Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s abilities and the fact that he was just a clone, Lin Moxian and the others believed that he could avoid the danger from those senior cultivators.
"I will go see Xi Hongyan again; that woman is still difficult to conquer even though I have used a little underhanded method." Lin Moxian immediately left the room.
Jing Qiuyue pulled Qiao Liangren away with her, making him sigh helplessly.
Shang Yingyue first asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] to send Wu Lianzhi to his private space before leaving the room together with Yan Yinqing.
"Aren't you going back to your Wang Clan?
I want to stabilize my cultivation now, so I don't have time for you." Wang Yourou pursed her lips before leaving.
After they left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went straight to the Divine Flame Realm to meet Jiang Shen and inform him about his cooperation with Ji Changlan.
This way, he could join his Demon Fox group, but he would also remain a member of the Blacksmith Union specifically for blacksmithing matters.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not stay in the Divine Realm for too long.
After speaking with Jiang Shen, he returned to the Xianjin Realm, and he began to stabilize his cultivation after sending Wu Lianzhi to his training space.
In the Sky Dragon Realm, Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng had already arrived at the northern area of the lower land, but they did not immediately move to ambush Long Jishan and Long Yingwu.
Instead, they watched them from a distance, especially since Zhang Fei wanted information about the strength of the assassins.
"What is that kid's plan for them?" Feng Xiushi immediately explained to Feng Yongheng about Zhang Fei's Demon Fox group.
"Does that mean he wants to dominate the lower, middle, and upper realms?"
Feng Xiushi shook his head.
"Zhang Fei is not that kind of person, and he just wants to collect as many resources as possible.
The three realms are vast and contain numerous planets, prompting him to recruit many people and send them to each planet."
"I see."
Feng Xiushi and Feng Yongheng landed in the distance when they saw Long Jishan and Long Yingwu landing in one of the cities in the northern area.
They saw the two enter a large but shabby and abandoned residence.
"That residence must be the assassins' base, so we'll wait for those two to leave first."

About an hour later, Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng saw two people from the Dragon Clan come out of the residence, accompanied by an old man with cultivation at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm, who they believed was the leader of the assassins.
The old man told Long Jishan and Long Yingwu that some of his best members would be heading to the floating island in a few days, especially since they were still on missions elsewhere.
"That person is pretty strong, even though he's not as strong as us.
Zhang Fei will probably have a hard time subduing him." Feng Yongheng spoke.
Unlike him, Feng Xishui had already watched Zhang Fei fight, so he believed that he was capable of subduing the old man by himself.
"Let him take care of the old man and his subordinates, and our task is to capture Long Jishan and Long Yingwu.
However, we have to do it quickly, or they will warn Long Aotian about our actions."
"I think I have an idea for that." Feng Xishui turned to Feng Yongheng, who smiled evilly and took out two identical artifacts.
"Before I can use this artifact on them, we have to catch them both off guard , and their minds will be trapped in a powerful cage that even Long Aotian cannot dispel."
"Where did you get these artifacts?"
"Ruins in another realm, and that place is very ancient." Feng Yongheng then told Feng Xishui about the ruins.
"Do you want to go there?
There are many unexplored places in those ruins, and I'm sure there are many other artifacts or valuable items there."

"Zhang Fei will be interested in those ruins, so we'll tell him about them later." Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng then followed Long Jishan and Long Yingwu, who had already flown away from the area to return to the floating island.
"I will distract them, and you should hurry and use the artifact on them."
"All right."
Long Jishan and Long Yingwu immediately stopped flying as Feng Xishui appeared before them with a flame spear in his hand.
"What do you mean by blocking our path?"
"I should be the one asking what your Dragon Clan means by wanting to harm my young master." Feng Xishui pointed his flame spear at them.
"He never sought trouble with your clan, but Long Qichao sent you two to capture him.
He was just retaliating for your mistreatment of him, yet you chose not to acknowledge your mistake and sought to kill him instead."
"Your young master?" Long Jishan and Long Yingwu's expressions looked shocked.
Feng Xishui decided to brag further.
"Zhang Fei is my princess's lover, and they will get married in the future, so he is my young master.
Have you forgotten how our ancestors taught your ancestors a lesson?
They didn't even dare to fight our Phoenix Clan anymore after that incident, yet a leader of your branch clan wanted to attack him."
Long Jishan and Long Yingwu exchanged glances with expressions full of confusion, especially since the problem would only get bigger if the main Phoenix Clan got involved in it.
"Too late." Feng Xishui thrust his flame spear toward Long Jishan and Long Yingwu, and a fire phoenix shot out to attack them.
Long Yingwu immediately countered Feng Xishui's attack with her water element, and a water dragon shot out from her palm.
Long Jishan did not stay idle, and a thunder dragon quickly descended from the sky, shooting toward Feng Xishui.
The water dragon exploded and evaporated as soon as it collided with the fire phoenix, and it quickly headed toward Feng Yingwu.
She blocked it with several water shields, but her shields shattered one by one, forcing her to dodge it.
Feng Xishui thrust his flame spear into the sky, and another fire phoenix shot out toward Long Jishan's thunder dragon before colliding with each other, resulting in a huge explosion.
*Boom*
Feng Xishui immediately flew towards Long Jishan, but the male dragon hurriedly moved away from him, especially since his strength was below his.
Long Yingwu wanted to help Long Jishan, but Feng Yongheng suddenly appeared in front of her, and he quickly stuck the other artifact to her chest, causing her pupils to shrink and her eyes to blank.
Then, Feng Yongheng chased after Long Jishan, who was still trying to escape from Feng Xishui while avoiding his half-hearted attacks.
As soon as he reached Long Jishan's side, Feng Yongheng immediately attached the other artifact to his back, and his expression became the same as Long Yingwu's.
"Shall we bring them to our clan?"
"Long Tian will notice if we bring them there." Feng Xishui immediately contacted Zhang Fei's clone in the Phoenix Clan.
In a few minutes, Zhang Fei [5] arrived before them with a satisfied smile in his eyes.
"Thank you for your help, seniors.
By the way, let's take the two of them to a quiet place, and I'll do something about them."
"Over there." Feng Yongheng pointed to a lower area not far from their location.
"There's no one in that area."
"Let's go."
"What are you going to do with them?" After placing Long Jishan and Long Yingwu on the ground, Feng Xishui posed this question.
"Can you guys extract their dragon origin bloodline?"
Both phoenixes shook their heads at Zhang Fei.
"A beast origin bloodline can only be extracted by its owner, so you have to do something to them if you want their bloodline."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. 'Can we use the science capsule to extract their dragon origin bloodline, Mei?'
[We've never tried it before, but I think it's possible.
However, we can't do it here, but we can't take them away either, especially since there's a possibility that Long Aotian will notice their disappearance.
The easiest way is to use your memory manipulation to force them to give you their dragon origin bloodline, and you can restore their memories after that.]
Zhang Fei [5] immediately used his memory manipulation on them, but he locked away their original memories first.
After that, he asked Feng Yongheng to remove his two artifacts from their bodies before waking them up.
"Give me your dragon origin bloodline."
Like puppets, Long Jishan and Long Yingwu immediately followed Zhang Fei [5]'s order, and two blood clots quickly appeared in front of them, which caused both of them to look pale.
'This kid can control other people, huh?' Feng Yongheng inwardly muttered.
Zhang Fei [5] quickly stored their dragon origin bloodline in two special containers before storing both of them in the system's inventory.
Then, he knocked both of them unconscious again before restoring their memories, and he also erased their memories of Feng Xishui and Feng Yongheng.
"Do you want to implant their bloodline in your body?"

"I am a heavenly fox, so I will give their bloodline to my two wives, and they will become strong enough to help me." Zhang Fei [5] then looked north after Feng Xishui told him about the assassins' hideout.
"My cultivation hasn't stabilized after I broke through, so we should go back now, and I'll take care of that old man later."
"All right."
Upon their arrival at the Phoenix Clan, Zhang Fei [5] returned to his room and focused on stabilizing his cultivation.
As usual, Mei helped him to monitor the residence area.
Sometime after they left, Long Jishan and Long Yingwu finally woke up, but they looked confused about their situation.
"What happened to us?
Why are we in this place?"
"I don't know; I remember we were on our way home from that old man's residence." Long Jishan immediately stood up while lifting Long Yingwu.
"We should return to our clan now, and we will report this matter to our patriarch."
"Let's go."
As soon as they arrived at the Dragon Clan, Long Jishan and Long Yingwu went to meet Long Aotian.
They reported everything to him, which caused him to frown.
He then checked their memories, but he didn't find anything strange in them.
"Was there anyone following you two before?"
"We have confirmed that no one followed us, Patriarch." Long Aotian did not believe Long Yingyu, and he was sure that something was going on without them knowing.
"The old man's subordinates will arrive here in a few days, and they will definitely be able to take care of that kid."
Long Aotian gave a light nod.
"Go back now."
"Yes, Patriarch."
"Who did that to them?
I'm sure they encountered something, and that person erased their memories of it." Long Aotian then contacted someone and asked for help to check on his two subordinates.
"Who exactly is that kid?
Long Qiang told me that he is also in the Xianjin Realm now, but it is impossible for two people to be in different realms at the same time, so one of them should be a clone.
Tch!
Whatever the risk, he must die.
If that foolish assassin fails to kill them, I will kill him myself."
At the pavilion, Zhang Fei asked Zhong Yan and Shen Yu to meet him.
He then showed them the thunder dragon bloodline and the rain dragon bloodline.
"Yan'er, you are weaker than Ye Lian and Yun Xinyue, so I want you to implant the thunder dragon bloodline into your body to strengthen you." Zhang Fei then spoke to Shen Yu.
"Your mother and grandmother are stronger than you, so I want you to use this rain dragon bloodline, Yu'er."
Since their husband had decided like that, Zhong Yan and Shen Yu followed his wishes.
Then, Zhang Fei took out the science capsule, and Mei helped the two women to inherit the two dragon bloodlines in turn.

Even though her cultivation did not immediately experience any immediate changes after Mei implanted the thunder dragon bloodline into her body, Zhong Yan felt that her new bloodline had strengthened her physique.
The effects of the change were more obvious for Shen Yu, especially since she was basically a sea serpent beast.
The rain dragon bloodline that she received not only strengthened her physique, but it also enhanced her original bloodline, elevating her beast rank to the divine beast level.
After that, Zhang Fei gathered all his official women, and he helped them cultivate in turn while stabilizing his cultivation.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels.]
Unknowingly, two days passed quickly.
Zhang Fei [5], who was cultivating, immediately contacted Feng Yichen.
The Dark Phoenix told him that she and Xereth were already outside the Blue Water Realm, and they would soon enter it.
Zhang Fei [5] quickly went to the Blue Water Realm in invisible mode, but he did not encounter Serpentera, who was already waiting for Xereth and Feng Yichen to arrive.
In a few minutes, Zhang Fei [5] saw the two enter the realm, and Xereth immediately brought Feng Yichen to the surface of the sea right above the Sunken Empire. 'So, that's Xereth, huh?'

chapters.title: Chapter 872: Xereth Injured
paragraphs: Sensing the aura of Xereth and Feng Yichen, none of the aquatic demon beasts of the Blue Water Realm dared to leave their residence. Zhang Fei [5] had warned Balena's family to avoid and hide as far as possible, especially since the male demon was simply too powerful.

Xereth checked under the ocean using his senses, but his senses could not detect the formation that covered the entrance to the Sunken Empire. "I should have destroyed this realm along with their old empire in the past, so this damn beast wouldn't hide here, and I wouldn't waste my time going to this realm again."
"Why did you destroy them back then?" Feng Yichen asked.

"That idiot kraken wasn't willing to give their Abyssal Moonlit Pearl to me, so I destroyed their kingdom and stole it." Xereth then took out his black scythe and slashed it, splitting the sea in two before blocking the seawater on both sides.

A large and long tail suddenly whipped towards Xereth, and the demon tried to ward it off. Instead, he was knocked backwards, sending him tumbling through the air several times, and the seawater immediately merged again.

"Damn it!" Xereth cursed after stabilizing himself, but Serpentera suddenly appeared a short distance away from him. The ancient beast's aura shook his confidence. 'Shit! This beast's cultivation and demon rank have far surpassed mine.'

Serpentera casually stood in his spot while staring at Xereth without caring about Feng Yichen, who was trembling in his presence. Moreover, Zhang Fei [5] had already told him that the Dark Phoenix was his contract beast, so he wouldn't attack her. "The 3-Sun Celestial Lord and Demon Monarch Rank, huh? I've met too many demons, including the ten Demon Gods. None of them dared to challenge me openly, yet a weakling demon like you dared to come here to capture me. What should I do with you?"
Xereth tightly gripped his black scythe and slashed it towards Serpentera, but the demon beast casually flicked his finger and dispelled his attack.

"Taotie can't descend to the three mortal realms by himself, so he deliberately used a demon like you because your origin is from here." Serpentera spoke as several black water balls appeared behind him.

Those black water balls launched toward Xereth, and the demon repeatedly swung his scythe to break them. Unfortunately, Serpentera's strength simply overpowered him, and they penetrated several parts of his body, leaving a few bloody holes.

"Guah!" Xereth turned to Feng Yichen for help, but the Dark Phoenix was too frightened to move. 'Shit! I have no other choice but to run away, or I will suffer serious injuries because of this beast.'
Just before Xereth left his current body, a few black water balls penetrated his body once again, and the black demon statue shattered immediately after.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately appeared by Serpentera's side. "Why didn't you kill that demon?"

"Did you really not notice, Kid?" Zhang Fei [5] turned to Serpentera in confusion. "The demon's body wasn't his real body, and he was a kind of avatar that could move from one statue to another, so I couldn't kill him."
"So, he deliberately hid his real body on one of the planets in the upper realms."

"That's right." Serpentera nodded to him. "If you want to kill the demon, you must first find the location of his real body. Even though it's not his real body, his soul will suffer heavy injuries if someone attacks him. My attack just now was enough to make him suffer, and he won't be able to move for some time, so you have plenty of time to find his real body. Unfortunately, I can't help you with that, so you have to do it yourself, or you can ask your acquaintances for help."
"All right, I'll talk to them after this." Zhang Fei [5] then asked Feng Yichen to come to his side. "Do you know the location of Xereth's real body?"
"No." Feng Yichen shook her head before speaking. "Xereth did not come to me using his real body, and he only contacted me through voice transmission, ordering me to go to our gathering place."
"Where is your gathering location?"

"The Death Star Realm." Zhang Fei [5] raised his eyebrows as he remembered Long Jiutian's departure that time, but he was able to return to the Xianjin Realm quickly, so the Death Star Realm shouldn't be too far from that realm. "Do you want to go to that realm?"
"It would just waste my time." Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Serpentera. "I'll take her with me."

"Go." After Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Yichen disappeared, Serpentera turned toward the Sunken Empire with a soft sigh. He did not return to that place and left the Blue Water Realm directly, looking for a new hiding place in the upper realms.
At the top of the mountain in a ruined realm, Xereth lay on the ground as he clutched his chest, and his blood flowed profusely from his mouth.

"Fuck! My master didn't tell me that the Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast was that powerful! His previous attack had a detrimental impact on my soul and body strength, and I couldn't use my technique to possess my other statues for a while. Feng Yichen must have fallen into the hands of that damn beast, and there's no way I can save her from him." Xereth wiped the blood from his mouth and sat there. He then looked at the area below, which was only filled with ruins. "Back then, I made sure that I had killed everyone in this realm before I destroyed it, but it turns out there was one person who survived, and he even forged that damn sword specifically to kill me. I would have been dead a long time ago if not for my meeting with my master's avatar, who warned me about the existence of that sword."
After that, Xereth closed his eyes, swallowed some pills, and began to heal his injuries.

Feng Yichen was not surprised when he saw Chao Mojie and the frozen Long Jiutian. "What do you want to do with them? Xereth already suspects that you or someone else captured them, so you won't be able to use them against him."

"I can't use them against Xereth, but I can still use them against his other subordinates, right?" Feng Yichen did not refute Zhang Fei [5], especially since all of them had almost equal strength. "I've enslaved Chao Mojie, but I haven't done anything to Long Jiutian. I want you to melt this ice, and you have to help me to weaken him before I can enslave him."

"All right." Feng Yichen directly touched the ice and used her dark flames, causing the ice to melt quickly. "If I were an ordinary fire phoenix, I wouldn't be able to melt her ice. My dark flames are different from ordinary phoenix flames, so the task isn't difficult for me."
"I know."

After a while, the ice encasing Long Jiutian had completely melted, allowing the Blood Dragon Demon to regain consciousness. Feng Yichen immediately restrained him. "You traitor! Our lord trusted you completely, but you betrayed him!"
"You knew nothing." Long Jiutian's expression turned pained as Feng Yichen's black flames poured into his body, making his entire body burn hot, including his internal organs.
"Argh! Stop! You're going to kill me!"

With Feng Yichen's cultivation being at the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, it was useful for Long Jiutian to struggle with his cultivation being four minor stages below him. Her black flames also tortured his soul, quickly weakening him.

"You bitch! Our lord will kill you for your betrayal!" Long Jiutian helplessly lay on the ground a few minutes later, and his entire body was blackish red, just like burnt charcoal. Once he was at his lowest point, Zhang Fei [5] immediately moved to enslave him.
At first, Zhang Fei [5] wanted Long Jiutian's Blood Dragon Origin Bloodline, but he changed his mind because the blood dragon was just an ordinary dragon, and there was nothing special about it.

Zhang Fei [5] then forced Long Jiutian to swallow healing and recovery pills. He then ordered him and Chao Mojie to hunt down Xereth's other ordinates, starting with Fa Ling, who was still on her way to Earth.
To make things easier for them, Zhang Fei [5] sent Long Jiutian and Chao Mojie to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since the planet was also in the lower realms.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] had Feng Yichen suppress her cultivation and took her away to the Sky Dragon Realm. However, his presence was noticed by Feng Qingmeng and the others, and they immediately met the two at the Phoenix Clan.
With her old age and high cultivation, Feng Yichen couldn't care about those people, and he sat leisurely on the park bench, thinking about Zhang Fei [5]'s next plan for her.
"Who is this woman? I can feel that she is a phoenix, but she is not a Fire Phoenix or an Ice Phoenix." Feng Qingmeng spoke.
Feng Xishui then asked. "Is she the Dark Phoenix?"
"Dark Phoenix?" Feng Qingmeng and the others gasped when they heard that.

Zhang Fei [5] explained it to them directly. "Feng Yichen used to be a Fire Phoenix, but she was contaminated by darkness and turned into a Dark Phoenix. She is of the same generation as Feng Shen and Feng Xueying, so she is one of your ancestors."
"Did you bring her here specifically to deal with the Dragon Clan?" Feng Shansi asked.

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "This way, you guys don't need to think about the Dragon Clan, and she will help us deal with them. However, she will only make a move if the Long Aotian makes a move first, so we won't have any problems with the main Dragon Clan, especially since we are only protecting ourselves."
"I think it's a good choice." Feng Qingmeng then asked the others to disperse. "I will return to the sect now."
"Sect Master." Feng Qingmeng turned to Xian Xianjue and his family. "Can my wife and I return to our home realm for a few days?"

"Zhang Fei is your grandson-in-law, and he is my princess's best friend, so I will make an exception for you two. Since you two have not returned home for hundreds of years, you can go back with them for a few days." Feng Qingmeng then invited Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang. "How about you two join my Blazing Phoenix Sect? You two are close to breaking through to the Divine Manifestation Realm, and the world laws of your current realm will force you to ascend once you achieve that breakthrough. If you guys break through there, you will be sent to a random realm, so I think you should break through in this realm."

"We are willing to join your sect, Senior." Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang decided without the slightest hesitation. First, they don't want to ascend to the random realm, and it would be troublesome for Zhang Fei [5] looking for them. Second, their father and mother were disciples of that sect, so it was the best decision for them.
Zhang Fei [5] then pointed at Xian Changyue. "She is my fiancée, so I want her to join your sect as well."
"Hey! Don't talk nonsense! I never agreed to be your fiancée!" Xian Changyue shouted in protest.

"Hehe." Xian Xianqin giggled at her reaction. "My dear aunt, you have lived with us for a year, and he clearly wants you to be his wife. You will never be able to escape from him, and you will definitely be his wife someday."
"Tch!" Xian Changyue chose not to reply to her niece.

Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang laughed at their sister's expression, but Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin looked confused by their daughter's relationship with Zhang Fei [5], especially since their granddaughter was already his wife.
'This little brat is truly a womanizer!' Feng Qingmeng then spoke. "All right, I will accept her into my sect, and they can live together as one family."
After saying that, Feng Qingmeng hurriedly left the Phoenix Clan, especially after she noticed Zhang Fei [5]'s flirtatious glance.
After he sent the people from the Xian family to the Nine Stars Realm, Zhang Fei [5] sent Feng Yichen to the training space before returning to his room to stabilize his cultivation.

Feng Yichen looked confused when he saw the training space and several women training in it, such as Fan Qinyuan, Murong Qianying, Shang Yumei, and Hong Xinxin. "What happened to them? Why are they having so much trouble moving?"

"This place is my special training space, and you will train like them soon. You are my contract beast now, so you have to become stronger." Feng Yichen turned to Zhang Fei, who had just come out of the pavilion. "The one you met before was my fifth clone, and this is my real body."
"How can you create such a realistic clone?"

"One of my demon abilities, but I can't teach it to anyone." Zhang Fei then touched Feng Yichen's forehead, imparting the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique. "You can learn that technique and train with them later, but you must follow me now."

As they walked into the pavilion, Zhang Fei explained to Feng Yichen the identities of all the women who lived there, making the Dark Phoenix finally realize his next plan for her. "The Qi in this place is much stronger than in the outside world, but it is not enough to break through to the Five Celestial Realms."

"I know." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "To break through to that stage, one must understand and know how to absorb the Celestial Qi. Unfortunately, the qi does not exist in the three mortal realms, and it only exists in the Paradise Realm, so no cultivator can break through to that stage. I have a way to go to that realm, but we won't be able to go there anytime soon, and we have to wait for my cultivation to break through to the Divine Ascension Realm first."
"I see." Feng Yichen nodded in understanding.

When they arrived at the main bedroom, Feng Yichen was stunned by the presence of several mattresses arranged side by side. She then turned to Zhang Fei, who was starting to take off her black dress. "I thought I was lucky to have you; you are powerful and a virgin. You've been following Xereth for so long, but I didn't expect him to have never touched you before."
"Xereth never thought about such a thing, and he only thought about how to rule this universe." Feng Yichen's face was quite red after she was naked.

"Xereth is such an idiot!" Zhang Fei quickly took off his clothes and took Feng Yichen to the bed. "Unlike him, I'm not interested in ruling this universe, and I'm more interested in having lots of beautiful and strong women by my side."

Zhang Fei then imparted the Yin-Yang Flawless art to Feng Yichen, who averted her gaze to the side. Her heart skipped a beat when he placed her hand on his sleeping dick. 'This guy is truly shameless.'

"Since you're still a virgin, you've never experienced it, right?" Zhang Fei pushed Feng Yichen to lie down and held her hands up. "You are my contract beast, so you are also my woman. I can't take your virginity yet, but I can still teach you about sexual pleasure. Once you experience it, you will continue to crave it."

After saying that, Zhang Fei immediately planted a gentle kiss on Feng Yichen's black lips, making her sigh helplessly in her heart. She didn't want to return his kiss, but she knew that he wouldn't back down, and he could force her.

Feng Yichen eventually closed her eyes and parted her lips, especially when Zhang Fei's tongue tried to invade her mouth. She felt awkward at first, but she slowly enjoyed their kiss. Her lips and tongue moved following his guidance, and she sucked his tongue in her mouth. 'His kiss is too good for me.'
