Zhang Fei [1] sighed in his heart after they all said that.
Back then, he only wanted to use them to increase his cultivation, but he changed his mind about them and wanted to have them by his side forever.
Despite this, he didn't expect that they would choose to become demons for his sake.
"Are you all sure about that?"
Tang Rou was the first to answer.
"Master, my brother is already living peacefully in the Sky Jade Realm, and you have cured his illness, so I will focus on you.
Furthermore, becoming a demon like Sister Zhixiu is not that bad, and I will become stronger by becoming one."
"Master, my children have grown up now, and they live well in the Chu Clan , which is thanks to you and the others.
I want to repay you by making myself more useful to you, even if I have to become a demon." Cheng Yu's words made Zhang Fei [1] sigh again.
"Moreover, you can teach me the transformation technique, so they will never know that I became a demon."
Zhang Fei [1] looked at Xia Qianqian and the others, and they nodded with determination.
"Have you discussed this matter with Luan'er, Yi Na?"
"Luan'er has already agreed to me becoming a demon." Yi Na's answer surprised Zhang Fei [1].
"If things were still like before, she would never have agreed to the idea.
However, we have been living with so many demons for quite some time now, and she has already gotten used to their presence."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding before speaking to them.
"I appreciate your desire to help me, but I hope you guys will reconsider this matter.
People around us no longer hate demons, but there are still many people out there who hate them.
If you become demons, you will no longer be able to live freely like now, and people who claim to be righteous cultivators will hunt you down."
"We have decided on this matter, and we will not reconsider it again!"
"You guys!" Zhang Fei [1] sighed helplessly at their determination.
"Unfortunately, there aren't many powerful demon races in the three mortal realms, and with so many of you, I can't find the best demon bloodline for each one."
Gu Yan pointed at Yan Zhixiu.
"Big Sis Zhixiu turned into a random demon, right?
Therefore, there's no need for you to worry, and we will transform into random demons just like her.
We will become demon cultivators, and with you by our side, we will be stronger than other demons, even if our demon forms are weak."
"Hehe." Huan Ya chuckled.
"Master, there are many types of demons by your side, and not all of them come from powerful demon races, so we have no problem with that."
"You're right." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement as he remembered Eve and the others.
"In that case, we will wait until we arrive at the Demon Purgatory Realm, and I hope you all turn into great demons."
After speaking with them, Zhang Fei [1] sent Balena to the pavilion, and he helped all his partners afterwards.
[You gained 500,000 Beast Essence from Feng Yichen.]
On the bed, Feng Yichen fell limp after Zhang Fei made her orgasm again and again to harvest her beast's essence.
He then gave her a recovery pill before getting out of bed.
"You can rest for now, and I'll see the others first."
"Yes, Master." Feng Yichen closed her eyes immediately, and her experience with Zhang Fei just now left a deep impression on her.
'I was able to get ten million beast essences in a short time thanks to Yichen.
If I continue harvesting her beast essence, I will evolve to seven tails in two to three weeks.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered as he got dressed.
[Do you wish to subdue Tianguo now, Master.]
'I'm not in a hurry to subdue Tianguo, and my cultivation is not completely stable, so I'll do it later.' Zhang Fei then left the room and went to Balena's room.
He helped her to increase her cultivation, demon rank, and soul power at the same time.
Zhang Fei had long wanted to eat Balena, but her cultivation was still too low, and she lagged far behind her other official wives.
Therefore, he chose to postpone it and wait for his cultivation to improve first, at least until he reached the Earth Realm like the others.
Four days passed quickly, and nothing bad happened in all the realms.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels.]
In the past four days, the situation in the Sky Dragon Realm was peaceful because the assassins had yet to appear, even though Zhang Fei [5] was waiting for them.
He spent most of his time stabilizing his cultivation, and Mei helped him monitor the situation on the floating island.
Zhang Fei [5] did not forget to visit Zhu Lingyao and Feng Qingmeng, but the female phoenix deliberately avoided him by entering seclusion.
She also sealed off her seclusion room with a powerful formation, making it impossible for him to disturb her.
Zhu Lingyao initially refused to be intimate with Zhang Fei [5], but he did not give up and used some tricks to seduce her, and the two eventually got intimate once a day.
However, she asked him not to do anything excessive to her, and she also didn't want to do anything strange to him.
Long Zhenxia contacted Zhang Fei [5] several times, but he paid her no mind, especially since his problems with the Dragon Clan had not been resolved.

Elsewhere, Feng Jiu and the others continued to wait for Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he still had not exited the sword's soul space, and he was fully focused on helping the two sword spirits, Jian Hei'an and Jian Guang'an.

In the Pandora Odyssey, Zhang Fei [1] never stopped helping all his partners to increase their cultivation and soul power, especially since their journey to the Demon Purgatory Realm still took several days.
Regarding Feltia [2], he concentrated on enhancing his fire elemental law, which was still in the intermediate stage.
Unlike in the outside world, eight days had passed in the pavilion.
Zhang Fei focused on helping Balena and his other women, but he didn't forget to have fun with Feng Yichen, which made her even more addicted to her orgasm.
Thanks to their intimacy, he obtained eighty million beast essences from her, bringing him closer to his next evolution.
Meanwhile, Feng Yao and Zhang Fei [4] had arrived not far from a planet that was almost completely red, and there was almost no ocean there.
After Zhang Fei [4] sent Orith and the others back to the training space and transformed into his half-fox form but red in color, Feng Yao immediately flew her flying artifact into that realm.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Scorching Earth Realm, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Scorching Earth Realm.]
[Quest: Obtaining the Earth Flame.]
[Quest rank: Special]
[Reward: Special gift pack x 1]
'Oh?
A new quest, huh?' Zhang Fei [4] then asked Feng Yao.
"Which one is the Hellblaze Volcano?"
"Over there." Feng Yao pointed to the north.
"My Phoenix Clan lives not far from that location, so I think we should go there first."

"I don't think that's necessary, and we should just go to the volcano directly." Zhang Fei [4] couldn't wait to get the Earth Flame, and there were no other quests in that realm, so he didn't want to waste too long there.
"All right then." Feng Yao immediately took Zhang Fei [4] with her and stored the flying artifact.
"I don't want to attract those people's attention, so we'll go there by normal flying."
"Let me take you there." Using the nine cloud steps, the two arrived at the foot of the Hellblaze Volcano in no time.
Zhang Fei [4] saw hundreds of people from the human, demon, natural, and beast races gathered there.
Moreover, all of them were cultivators in the Divine Seven Realms with various levels, and their highest cultivation was in the Divine Ascendant Realm.
"It won't be easy to obtain the Earth Flame."
"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed.
"I warned you, right?
Moreover, climbing to the top of the volcano will not be easy, and you will encounter many obstacles on your way up."
"Obstacles?"
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him.
"I've never climbed it myself, and I've only heard about those obstacles from members of my Phoenix Clan.
Are you sure you want to climb alone?"
Zhang Fei [4] first observed the mountain, but the system still didn't show anything because the mapping process was still not finished.
"I will climb myself, but I will not rush into it, and I will observe the situation of these people first."
"In that case, I will leave you here, and I will go to my Phoenix Clan." After saying that, Feng Yao quickly disappeared from the place.
Zhang Fei [4] looked for the tallest tree, jumped up there, and sat down while watching the people.
Mei swiftly displayed the data of the powerful cultivators present there, be they humans, demons, natural races, or beasts.
"Hey." Zhang Fei [4] turned to the red-haired man who called him from the tree across the way.
"Are you alone?"
"No." Zhang Fei [4] shook his head at the man, who was a male Skyflame Wolf.
His name was Lan Huoyan, and his cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm.
"What about you?
Did you come alone?"
Lan Huoyan pointed to the ten people under the tree.
"They are members of my race, and we want to try climbing together.
Where are the members of your race?
Have they not arrived in this realm yet?"
"They'll be here soon, so I'll wait for them before climbing." Zhang Fei [4] lied on purpose.
"Hey!
Huoyan!
We have to go now!" A man suddenly shouted from below.
"Dang!
They called me, so I have to go now."
"All right." After Lan Huoyan left, Zhang Fei [4] monitored the people below once again. 'Sigh!
I would rather not waste time with them, so I'll avoid them and climb as soon as possible.'

chapters.title: Chapter 876 876: Sovereign Heaven Realm Cultivators
paragraphs: "Princess." All the members of the Phoenix Clan immediately greeted her as soon as Feng Yao walked in.
An old woman approached Feng Yao. "Why did you come to this realm without telling us first, Princess?"

"Feng Haiyan, I came to drop off a friend who wants to look for the Earth Flame." The old woman and the others were surprised by Feng Yao's answer. "Do you have any information about all those people?"

"Yes." Feng Haiyan informed Feng Yao about the people, particularly those of significant status and notable strength. "Princess, we detected the presence of five people we have never seen before, and their strength is much higher than it looks from the outside. Furthermore, the Qi in their bodies is slightly different from that of ordinary cultivators, but I cannot discern where the difference lies."

Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "Their Qi is slightly mixed with the Celestial Qi, but it's barely noticeable because it no longer exists in the upper realm, and it is just a leftover from the past."
"What do you mean by the Celestial Qi, Princess?" An old man asked her.

Feng Yao did not want to explain it to the old man and instead used her senses to search for the five people Feng Haiyan was referring to. "They are cultivators from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, but it is unusual for them to leave their realm and appear in front of so many people."
"The Sovereign Heaven Realm?"

"That's right, Feng Zhennan." Feng Yao nodded at them. "The Sovereign Heaven Realm is located near the wall of the universe, and it is the oldest planet in the upper realms. However, their realm is covered by a special formation, so not many people know about it, including the Nameless One."
Feng Zhennan and Feng Haiyan exchanged glances in disbelief, especially since the Nameless One was the strongest in their eyes.

"The Nameless One is known as the strongest because those stronger than him almost never appear on the surface, just like our ancestors and the ancestors of the other mythical beast races. People in the Sovereign Heaven Realm are much stronger than them, and they are the true rulers of the upper realms." Feng Yao then walked away, followed by the two. "Assign some people to monitor my friend, instruct them not to intervene, and allow him to attempt obtaining the Earth Flame on his own."
After instructing several people, Feng Haiyan proceeded to question Feng Yao. "Are you sure your friend will succeed in getting the Earth Flame, Princess?"
"For hundreds of thousands of years, many fire cultivators have wanted to obtain it, but no one has succeeded." Feng Zhennan added.

Feng Yao simply smiled. "Instead of thinking about my friend, you two should prepare to return to the Phoenix Realm, especially since this realm will no longer be useful after the Earth Flame disappears."

"The Earth Flame is this realm's lifeblood, and all fire elements will vanish with it." Feng Zhennan and Feng Haiyan murmured. "Since you believe your friend will succeed in obtaining the Earth Flame, we will prepare for our clan's return now, Princess."
"Yes."

After they left, Feng Yao stood by the window and looked towards the Hellblaze Volcano. "Zhang Fei, the five people from the Sovereign Heaven Realm will be your toughest opponents in obtaining the Earth Flame, but I believe you will find a way to deal with them."
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels sent to the inventory.]
[Ding]
[Mapping of the area of the Scorching Earth Realm has been completed; the host can check the entire area via the map.]

As soon as the system finished mapping the realm, Zhang Fei [4] immediately jumped down and entered an invisible state. He rushed to climb the Hellblaze Volcano, but he felt a strong gravitational pull from below. "Oh? They can't fly and must climb manually because this mountain has heavier gravity than other areas. Unfortunately, this gravity is light compared to the sixteen times heavier gravity in my training space, so it's not a big deal for me."

While paying attention to the map to avoid those people, Zhang Fei [4] used his teleportation again and again. The Hellblaze Volcano itself is very tall and wide, but the entire area is filled with people of various races, from humans to demons, beasts, and natural races.

In a few minutes, Zhang Fei [4] had already reached the location of Lan Huoyan and the Skyflame Wolf members, who seemed to have difficulty moving because the gravity was getting heavier the higher they went up.

Zhang Fei [4] did not stop to help them and continued his journey, and he came across people from several mythical beast clans, such as the Dragon Clan and the Phoenix Clan. He also encountered several demons with fire elements, and their conditions were slightly better than those of several human cultivators not far from them.
Boom

A giant explosion suddenly sounded from a distant area, causing the people who were climbing to immediately stop and turn their attention toward that location, including Zhang Fei [4]. Since the mountain's gravity was already holding them back, it was rare for races to clash; they were usually focused on reaching the top.

Through his map, Zhang Fei [4] could see that there was a clash between several groups in that area, and the majority of them were demons because their names on the map were black. However, he saw five green human names in that area, and they overwhelmed the demons.
Intrigued by that, Zhang Fei [4] decided to go to that area and check out their fight.
To Zhang Fei [4]'s surprise, the five humans were able to move freely and fluidly under the strong pull of gravity, indicating that they had trained in stronger gravity before.

Based on the system scan, Zhang Fei [4] discovered that they came from the same Yuan Clan. The three men are Yuan Tianxie, Yuan Tianjie, and Yuan Tiankong. The other two are women, Yuan Tianling and Yuan Tianhua. 'What the hell with their names? They are like quintuplets with different last names!'
[Master, these five people seem to come from the Ancient Heaven Realm, especially since the system detected a slightly different Qi in their bodies.]

Zhang Fei [4] himself had already guessed their identities, especially since Xia Tian had once told him that the gravity in the Ancient Heaven Realm was five times heavier than all the planets in the upper realms. Since they could move so smoothly and freely, they were definitely cultivators of that realm.
Before long, they had killed dozens of demons, but Yuan Tianxie suddenly shot a small dagger at Zhang Fei [4]. "Come out!"
Zhang Fei [4] caught the dagger and canceled his invisibility. "Senior Brothers and Senior Sisters, I was just curious about your battle with these demons, so I decided to take a look."
"A scarlet fox race?" Zhang Fei [4]'s disguised form made them guess wrong.
Zhang Fei [4] jumped down and returned the dagger to Yuan Tianxie. "You are right; I am indeed a scarlet fox race, and I came here alone."

"Are you crazy? There are so many powerful cultivators here, and they can all kill you easily." Yuan Tianjie pointed at the pile of demon corpses. "You're lucky we killed them, or they would have eaten you alive."

"Senior Brother, I am indeed weak, but I have good escaping abilities, and I am sure they will not be able to catch me." Zhang Fei [4]'s answer caused them to scowl at him. "Since your fight is over, I will continue my journey."
"Wait a minute." Yuan Tianling stopped him. "How about you join us, little fox?"
Zhang Fei [4]'s lips twitched. "Senior Sister, I'm not a little fox, but I'm a grown-up fox."
"Hehe." Yuan Tianling chuckled. "Even though you are an adult, you are still a child compared to us, so I will call you little fox."

"My name is Zhang Xiaolong, and I appreciate your offer, Senior Sister. However, I am not accustomed to living in a crowd, so I plan to travel alone." After he said that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately ran off at high speed, leaving the five people dumbfounded.
A few moments later, Yuan Tianhua posed the question. "How can that little fox run that fast? Even if I use my high speed, I may not be able to catch up with him."

"Let alone you; I'm not confident that I can catch up with him." With a serious expression, Yuan Tianxie spoke. "As our master often says, there are so many hidden dragons in this universe, and that kid is one of them."
"What if we chase him?" Yuan Tiankong asked.
"I agree!" Yuan Tianling was the first to answer. "I want that little fox, so we have to chase him, and I will bring him back to our realm."

Yuan Tianxie and the others smiled in amusement, seeing the eagerness on Yuan Tianling's face. "All right, we will chase that little fox, but you can't force him to go with us. If our master finds out that you took him by force, he will punish you. Additionally, we must kill all the demons we encounter without leaving any of them, or they will become an unexpected threat to us."
"Let's go!" Yun Tianling immediately ran in the direction Zhang Fei [4] had gone.
Yun Tianhua and the others let out soft gasps, and they hurriedly followed behind Yun Tianling.
[Master, they are chasing behind you.]
'They obviously don't have any bad intentions, and they're just hostile toward the demons, so it doesn't matter if they follow me.'
[They don't have any evil intentions right now, but they might turn hostile if you get the Earth Flame, so you should still be careful of them.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei [4] then accelerated his speed, but the mountain suddenly shook violently, causing him to lose his balance slightly.
*Rumble... Rumble...*

Several lava pillars shot out of the ground before shooting lava balls in various directions. Instead of dodging them, Zhang Fei [4] punched the lava balls that were heading towards him, making them splash all around him.
Zhang Fei [4] then summoned the salamander out, and it helped him deal with those lava balls while absorbing the fire element in their area.
*Scree*

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] looked up at the mountain peak and saw several giant lava birds flying out of the volcano. They immediately sprayed lava balls toward the people climbing the mountain, including him. "I think the spirit inside the Earth Flame is controlling them."

As one of the lava balls headed towards him, Zhang Fei [4] immediately took out the moonlit whisper sword and channeled his ice element into it before slashing it out. However, his ice sword qi disappeared as soon as the two collided with each other, and the lava ball continued flying towards him.
Zhang Fei [4] wanted to attack again, but the fire salamander suddenly jumped up with its mouth wide open, and it immediately devoured the lava ball before belching. "Burp."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed at that. "Huo Yan! Another two lava balls are heading this way."
The fire salamander looked at the two lava balls with a disgusted look, and it shot out two fireballs towards them, which immediately collided with each other and produced a loud explosion.

Seeing that its attack failed, one of the giant lava birds dived sharply towards Zhang Fei [4] and the fire salamander, but both of them attacked it simultaneously. A fireball and the hellflame frost lotus shot towards the giant lava bird.
The giant lava bird let out a long screech after being hit by the salamander's attack, followed by an explosion from the hellflame frost lotus, which instantly killed it.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] saw a red crystal coming out of the bird's body, and he immediately flew over to grab it. Since he had never seen the crystal, he stored it in the inventory straight away.
[Obtained 1 Lava Heart Crystal.]

[The Lava Heart Crystal is a fiery gemstone forged in the depths of volcanoes where the qi's veins flow with molten spirit fire; it is infused with the condensed essence of both lava and terrestrial fire qi.]
"What's the use of this crystal, Mei?"
[Master, you can use it for many things, from forging and alchemy to increasing your fire element.]

Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "No wonder fire cultivators like this realm; this realm offers many resources that can aid their growth. I think I should bring Feltia [2] here, and my fire elemental law will break through to the half-perfection stage sooner."
[Master, the best place to do that is inside the volcano, so you should focus on getting up there first.]

Despite this, Zhang Fei [4] still opened the portal leading to the Phoenix Realm, and Feltia [2] walked out from inside in half red fox form. Wasting no time, the two ran towards the top, followed by the fire salamander.

Their journey was not easy, as they had to deal with repeated disturbances emerging from the ground, and those giant lava birds kept coming out from inside the volcano to attack the mountain climbers, even though all the powerful cultivators present there repeatedly killed them.
Quite far behind them, the five cultivators from the Ancient Heaven Realm continued to follow them, but they felt that Zhang Fei [4] was still too far away from them.
"Do you think the previous attack belonged to that little fox? How did he use ice and fire elements together?" Yuan Tianhua asked them.

Yuan Tianxie nodded at her. "Based on the distance, I'm sure that attack belonged to that little fox, but I couldn't sense any ice elements in his body before. However, his fire element seemed to have reached the peak rank, and it was inversely proportional to his low cultivation."
"Brother, that little fox also understands the fire elemental law, and his level seems to have reached the intermediate stage or above." Yuan Tianjie spoke.
"I agree with you, Brother." Yuan Tiankong suddenly shouted to warn them. "Be careful! Something powerful will appear soon!"
A few moments later, hundreds of lava beasts flew out of the volcano, and they immediately attacked the cultivators climbing the mountain.

Quite far ahead of them, Yuan Tianxie and the others saw a giant Hellflame Frost Lotus flying toward those lava beasts, and it immediately exploded after reaching a sufficient height, wiping out quite a number of them.

"Hehehe!" Yuan Tianling suddenly laughed loudly. "That little fox is truly amazing! I've never met a living creature that can combine fire and ice elements before! I'm getting more and more eager to get him and bring him home with us!"

"Unfortunately, your wish is not easy, Tianling." Yuan Tianxie pointed in several directions, where quite a few people flew towards Zhang Fei [4]'s location. "That little fox was too careless to use such a technique in front of so many people, and his action attracted everyone's attention to him."

"Humph!" Yuan Tianling snorted. "If they dare to stop me from getting that little fox, and if they dare to hurt her, I will use a bit of my Sky Flame to wipe out their souls, so they will never be able to reincarnate again."
The other four sighed heavily after Yuan Tianling said that, and Yuan Tianxie asked them to move faster so that they could catch up to Zhang Fei [4] before those people.
[Master, dozens of people are moving towards here from several directions, and most of them are demons.] Mei warned him.
"Demons, huh?" Zhang Fei [4] muttered as he smirked, and Feltia [2] immediately moved away from him before entering an invisible state. "How much demon essence do I need to reach the Emperor Rank?"
[Nine hundred million, Master.]
Zhang Fei [4] exhaled heavily. "Since I can't absorb their cultivation, I have to find a way to cripple them, and I'll absorb their demon essence."

"You are right; I am indeed a scarlet fox race, and I came here alone."
"Are you crazy?
There are so many powerful cultivators here, and they can all kill you easily." Yuan Tianjie pointed at the pile of demon corpses.
"You're lucky we killed them, or they would have eaten you alive."
"Senior Brother, I am indeed weak, but I have good escaping abilities, and I am sure they will not be able to catch me." Zhang Fei [4]'s answer caused them to scowl at him.
"Since your fight is over, I will continue my journey."
"Wait a minute." Yuan Tianling stopped him.
"How about you join us, little fox?"
Zhang Fei [4]'s lips twitched.
"Senior Sister, I'm not a little fox, but I'm a grown-up fox."
"Hehe." Yuan Tianling chuckled.
"Even though you are an adult, you are still a child compared to us, so I will call you little fox."
"My name is Zhang Xiaolong, and I appreciate your offer, Senior Sister.
However, I am not accustomed to living in a crowd, so I plan to travel alone." After he said that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately ran off at high speed, leaving the five people dumbfounded.
A few moments later, Yuan Tianhua posed the question.
"How can that little fox run that fast?
Even if I use my high speed, I may not be able to catch up with him."
"Let alone you; I'm not confident that I can catch up with him." With a serious expression, Yuan Tianxie spoke.
"As our master often says, there are so many hidden dragons in this universe, and that kid is one of them."
"What if we chase him?" Yuan Tiankong asked.
"I agree!" Yuan Tianling was the first to answer.
"I want that little fox, so we have to chase him, and I will bring him back to our realm."
Yuan Tianxie and the others smiled in amusement, seeing the eagerness on Yuan Tianling's face.
"All right, we will chase that little fox, but you can't force him to go with us.
If our master finds out that you took him by force, he will punish you.
Additionally, we must kill all the demons we encounter without leaving any of them, or they will become an unexpected threat to us."
"Let's go!" Yun Tianling immediately ran in the direction Zhang Fei [4] had gone.
Yun Tianhua and the others let out soft gasps, and they hurriedly followed behind Yun Tianling.
[Master, they are chasing behind you.]
'They obviously don't have any bad intentions, and they're just hostile toward the demons, so it doesn't matter if they follow me.'
[They don't have any evil intentions right now, but they might turn hostile if you get the Earth Flame, so you should still be careful of them.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei [4] then accelerated his speed, but the mountain suddenly shook violently, causing him to lose his balance slightly.
*Rumble...
Rumble...*
Several lava pillars shot out of the ground before shooting lava balls in various directions.
Instead of dodging them, Zhang Fei [4] punched the lava balls that were heading towards him, making them splash all around him.
Zhang Fei [4] then summoned the salamander out, and it helped him deal with those lava balls while absorbing the fire element in their area.
*Scree*
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] looked up at the mountain peak and saw several giant lava birds flying out of the volcano.
They immediately sprayed lava balls toward the people climbing the mountain, including him.
"I think the spirit inside the Earth Flame is controlling them."
As one of the lava balls headed towards him, Zhang Fei [4] immediately took out the moonlit whisper sword and channeled his ice element into it before slashing it out.
However, his ice sword qi disappeared as soon as the two collided with each other, and the lava ball continued flying towards him.
Zhang Fei [4] wanted to attack again, but the fire salamander suddenly jumped up with its mouth wide open, and it immediately devoured the lava ball before belching.
"Burp."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed at that.
"Huo Yan!
Another two lava balls are heading this way."
The fire salamander looked at the two lava balls with a disgusted look, and it shot out two fireballs towards them, which immediately collided with each other and produced a loud explosion.
Seeing that its attack failed, one of the giant lava birds dived sharply towards Zhang Fei [4] and the fire salamander, but both of them attacked it simultaneously.
A fireball and the hellflame frost lotus shot towards the giant lava bird.
The giant lava bird let out a long screech after being hit by the salamander's attack, followed by an explosion from the hellflame frost lotus, which instantly killed it.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [4] saw a red crystal coming out of the bird's body, and he immediately flew over to grab it.
Since he had never seen the crystal, he stored it in the inventory straight away.
[Obtained 1 Lava Heart Crystal.]

[The Lava Heart Crystal is a fiery gemstone forged in the depths of volcanoes where the qi's veins flow with molten spirit fire; it is infused with the condensed essence of both lava and terrestrial fire qi.]
"What's the use of this crystal, Mei?"
[Master, you can use it for many things, from forging and alchemy to increasing your fire element.]
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding.
"No wonder fire cultivators like this realm; this realm offers many resources that can aid their growth.
I think I should bring Feltia [2] here, and my fire elemental law will break through to the half-perfection stage sooner."
[Master, the best place to do that is inside the volcano, so you should focus on getting up there first.]
Despite this, Zhang Fei [4] still opened the portal leading to the Phoenix Realm, and Feltia [2] walked out from inside in half red fox form.
Wasting no time, the two ran towards the top, followed by the fire salamander.

Their journey was not easy, as they had to deal with repeated disturbances emerging from the ground, and those giant lava birds kept coming out from inside the volcano to attack the mountain climbers, even though all the powerful cultivators present there repeatedly killed them.
Quite far behind them, the five cultivators from the Ancient Heaven Realm continued to follow them, but they felt that Zhang Fei [4] was still too far away from them.
"Do you think the previous attack belonged to that little fox?
How did he use ice and fire elements together?" Yuan Tianhua asked them.
Yuan Tianxie nodded at her.
"Based on the distance, I'm sure that attack belonged to that little fox, but I couldn't sense any ice elements in his body before.
However, his fire element seemed to have reached the peak rank, and it was inversely proportional to his low cultivation."
"Brother, that little fox also understands the fire elemental law, and his level seems to have reached the intermediate stage or above." Yuan Tianjie spoke.
"I agree with you, Brother." Yuan Tiankong suddenly shouted to warn them.
"Be careful!
Something powerful will appear soon!"
A few moments later, hundreds of lava beasts flew out of the volcano, and they immediately attacked the cultivators climbing the mountain.

Quite far ahead of them, Yuan Tianxie and the others saw a giant Hellflame Frost Lotus flying toward those lava beasts, and it immediately exploded after reaching a sufficient height, wiping out quite a number of them.
"Hehehe!" Yuan Tianling suddenly laughed loudly.
"That little fox is truly amazing!
I've never met a living creature that can combine fire and ice elements before!
I'm getting more and more eager to get him and bring him home with us!"
"Unfortunately, your wish is not easy, Tianling." Yuan Tianxie pointed in several directions, where quite a few people flew towards Zhang Fei [4]'s location.
"That little fox was too careless to use such a technique in front of so many people, and his action attracted everyone's attention to him."
"Humph!" Yuan Tianling snorted.
"If they dare to stop me from getting that little fox, and if they dare to hurt her, I will use a bit of my Sky Flame to wipe out their souls, so they will never be able to reincarnate again."
The other four sighed heavily after Yuan Tianling said that, and Yuan Tianxie asked them to move faster so that they could catch up to Zhang Fei [4] before those people.
[Master, dozens of people are moving towards here from several directions, and most of them are demons.] Mei warned him.
"Demons, huh?" Zhang Fei [4] muttered as he smirked, and Feltia [2] immediately moved away from him before entering an invisible state.
"How much demon essence do I need to reach the Emperor Rank?"
[Nine hundred million, Master.]
Zhang Fei [4] exhaled heavily.
"Since I can't absorb their cultivation, I have to find a way to cripple them, and I'll absorb their demon essence."

chapters.title: Chapter 877 877: The Holy Radiance Sword
paragraphs: "Oh? Why did you suddenly decide to wake up?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned the demon extermination sword into his body before answering Hun Di. "Master, my two clones are in the Scorching Earth Realm right now to search for the Earth Flame, and there are many powerful demons there, so they need my sword to fight them."
"Kid, remember not to absorb their cultivation; do you understand?" Hun Di reminded Zhang Xiaolong [3] in a stern tone.
"Don't worry, Master. I will not absorb their cultivation, and I will only absorb their demon essence." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer caused Hun Di to let out a heavy breath. "Hmm?"
A mass of golden light suddenly appeared before them, dazzling all of them. Once the golden light disappeared, Tian Huangjin appeared before them, shocking all of them except Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Can you tell us your identity, Senior?" Hun Di asked Tian Huangjin while cupping his hands.
Zhe Wuming, Feng Jiu, Gong Ren, and Ji Changlan also did the same.

Tian Huangjin didn't take them into consideration and asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly. "Did you manage to find Xereth? I've been looking for him in many realms for the past two weeks, but I've had a difficult time finding him because his avatar keeps changing to his other statues."
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "We are on our way to Xereth's location now."
"Tell me."
"The Starry Sky Realm."
"Which direction?"
"Over there." Feng Jiu answered her while pointing in another direction. "The Starry Sky Realm is three days' journey from this place at our current speed."
Tian Huangjin turned that way and wanted to go there, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly stopped her. "Senior, please wait a minute; I have a few questions for you."
"What are your questions?"

"Did you come from the Radiance Domain?" Since Zhang Xiaolong [3] had told her about his acquaintance from the Paradise Realm, Tian Huangjin immediately admitted it. "You should be a winged race, right?"
"That's right." Tian Huangjin nodded to him. "My Radiance Domain is the home of my winged race."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked her again. "Since you are a winged race, you should know about your ancestor, Tian Huangjin, right?"
"How did you know that name?" Tian Huangjin immediately landed in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and frowned at him.
"I have met her before, and she told me her name."

"Impossible!" Tian Huangjin said with a shake of her head. "Ancestor Huangjin was the first winged race that was born in this universe, and she died billions of years ago. In fact, my name is Tian Huangjin, and my parents took it from her name."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt at a loss to explain it to her. "Senior, I have no reason to lie to you. I have indeed met Tian Huangjin before, but she is not the real her, and the real her is still sleeping inside someone's body."
"Let me read your memories." After Zhang Xiaolong [3], Tian Huangjin touched his forehead and delved into his memories.

Tian Huangjin's expression changed to a mixture of shame and anger, especially since there were too many memories of Zhang Xiaolong [3] dual cultivating with dozens of women. After she searched for a long time, she found the memories of when the Holy Radiance Crown chose Xu Ling'er as its owner, and she also turned into her ancestor at that time.
Tian Huangjin removed her hand and posed a question. "Where is the little girl?"
"Wait." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the portal to the training space.

Soon, Xu Ling'er walked out of the training space and stood beside Zhang Xiaolong [3], but her eyes were only focused on Tian Huangjin. "Who is this woman, Big Brother? Why do I feel a familiar aura from her?"
"Her name is Tian Huangjin." Xu Ling'er was stunned after Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned the name. "She is different from that Tian Huangjin, as she is her distant descendant."
"Oh." Xu Ling'er nodded slightly, but she suddenly felt sleepy. As soon as she fell asleep, her body floated on its own, and a golden light quickly enveloped her body, dazzling the area once again.

Since he had witnessed Xu Ling'er's transformation before, Zhang Xiaolong [3] hurriedly took out a spare piece of clothing and covered her body with it, or else Hun Di and the others would see her naked body.
Once the golden light disappeared, Xu Ling'er had already turned into Tian Huangjin. As Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s expected, her mature body was fully naked.

Zhe Wuming, Hun Di, Gong Ren, and Ji Changlan were stunned in their places as soon as they saw Xu Ling'er's adult figure. As normal men, they felt attraction towards her, but they immediately suppressed those feelings, especially since she was originally still an underage girl.

Feng Jiu smiled in amusement seeing their reactions. 'This kid never ceased to bring surprises, but I didn't expect that there is such a powerful reincarnator by his side, and this woman should be stronger than Yao'er.'
Tian Huangjin immediately knelt on one leg. "Huangjin pays respects to the Ancestor."

"Get up." Xu Ling'er lifted her feet with her aura. "I didn't expect to meet one of my descendants in the three mortal realms, especially after our race faced a terrible calamity in the past, and I died at that time."

Tian Huangjin nodded at her. "I've heard all your stories from my great-grandparents, and my parents named me after you. The calamity caused our race to decline greatly, but we managed to survive and rebuild, and now there are millions of us in our domain."
"I see." Xu Ling'er nodded with a relieved smile on her face. "Have any of you found the other parts of my Holy Radiance equipment?"

Hearing that, Tian Huangjin took out her golden sword, but the sword immediately flew around Xu Ling'er in joy. "No one has ever gained this sword's recognition, including me. I can use it because my job is to chase down the demons that caused our race to almost become extinct in the past."

Xu Ling'er swiftly seized the Holy Radiance Sword, a golden aura enveloping them as they connected. "Old friend, I'm glad to see you again, but the current me does not have the ability to wield you. Therefore, I want you to go with my descendant, and you must help her to get rid of our old enemies. Once I return to our domain, we will reunite once again, and we will fight together like in the past."
*Zing... Zing... Zing...*
The Holy Radiance Sword vibrated a few times before returning to Tian Huangjin's hands, and Xu Ling'er asked her again. "Are there any other parts?"

"Ancestor, we found your Holy Radiance War Armor in the Forgotten Realm." Tian Huanjing's revelation made Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s expression turn shocked mixed with seriousness. "Unfortunately, we couldn't get close to it, so it is still there, and some people from our race are guarding it. As for the gauntlet, shield, and boots, we haven't managed to find them."
Xu Ling'er exhaled softly. "My current body is still too weak, so I must return now, and you can go to carry out your duties."
"Yes, Ancestor." Tian Huangjin looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others for a moment before flying toward the Starry Sky Realm.
Xu Ling'er's body quickly shrank and returned to her true form, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly sent her back to the training space so that Ru Xue could take care of her.
"We're much more senior than you, but your connections and knowledge surpass us, kid." Gong Ren said while shaking his head.

Ji Changlan joined in. "Not only do you know about the Paradise Realm, but you also have many acquaintances from that realm, not to mention that the little girl just now is the reincarnator of an ancient powerhouse."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed awkwardly. "I was lucky enough to know about the Paradise Realm and the people from that realm, and I also never expected that Ling'er was Tian Huangjin's reincarnation. Even before becoming a cultivator, she was exceptionally intelligent and mature, which raised many questions for us. A few months ago, I accidentally found one of her pieces of equipment in the Star Tower, and it chose her as its master, which also gave us the answers to all our questions. Do you still want to continue your journey to the Starry Sky Realm? If not, I'll go there myself."
"We still have to go to that realm." Ji Changlan was the first to answer.

Zhe Wuming nodded in agreement with that. "Even though that female senior went to that realm to look for Xereth, we have to confirm whether she will succeed in getting rid of him or not. If she fails, we have to think of other plans to protect our realm and the three mortal realms."
"Hey, kid! I want two of your pills!" Xue Bao jumped onto Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his nose before giving the price of the pills. "Each pill is worth a hundred million purple jewels."
"You wanted to rob us on purpose!" Ji Changlan shouted at him in anger.

"Hahaha." Feng Jiu laughed at that. "Old Ji, no one can concoct such miraculous pills except him, and the ingredients are even harder to obtain since they are only available in the tower. Thus, I think it is reasonable if he opens that price for the pills, especially since their effects will last forever."

Ji Changlan's lips twitched in response, but he immediately took out that many purple jewels and handed them to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "It took me quite a while to get this many jewels, but I wasted it just for two pills."
"You stingy old man!" Feng Jiu said it with a shake of her head.
Xue Bao stretched out his front paw to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Give me the pills, and my master will pay you."
"Give me two of each." Zhe Wuming casually paid Zhang Xiaolong [3] four hundred million purple jewels, as well as Gong Ren, who paid him two hundred million purple jewels.
{800,000,000 purple jewels have been added to your balance.}

'Hahaha! I'm rich now!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately gave them the two pills, as many as they needed. He also gave Feng Jiu two pills, but he did not ask her to pay for them. "Don't be jealous of her, okay? Empress Feng is my future mother-in-law, so I can't possibly ask her to pay for my pills, right?"
"Cheapskate!" Ji Changlan and the others immediately sat cross-legged and swallowed the two pills, as did Feng Jiu.
Hun Di smiled and patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder. "Since we still need a few days to arrive at the Starry Sky Realm, I will teach you some new soul techniques."
"Yes, Master." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied excitedly.
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels sent to the inventory.]

After the two notifications appeared, Zhang Fei [5] immediately left the Blue Water Realm and returned to the Phoenix Clan in the Sky Dragon Realm. He found Zhu Lingyao waiting for him in the garden in front of his room, but he suddenly sensed killing intent from several people.

'They've finally arrived, huh? They shouldn't dare to act at this hour, so I'll lure them somewhere else.' Zhang Fei [5] immediately approached Zhu Lingyao and informed her about those assassins, and the two of them right away left the Phoenix Clan.
Zhu Lingyao then asked him. 'Do you need my help fighting them?'
'No.' Zhang Fei [5] refused immediately. 'I want to subdue them and bring them into my organization, so I have to show them my abilities, or they won't fully submit to me.'
Zhu Lingyao gave a light nod. 'I've heard a lot about you, but I've never seen you fight before, so I'll use this opportunity to analyze the depth of your strength.'
'Haha!' Zhang Fei [5] embraced her waist. 'This future husband of yours is not as weak as you imagine, and I will show you that I am worthy of being your husband.'
'You are not my future husband!' Zhu Lingyao glared at him.
Instead, Zhang Fei [5] looked her up and down. 'If I'm not your future husband, why are you enjoying our kisses? Why did you let me touch your body?'
'Humph!' Zhu Lingyao snorted and did not reply to him.

Sometime later, they had arrived at the forest on the edge of the floating island, and Zhu Lingyao sat on a large rock, watching Zhang Fei [5] fight with beasts of various ranks in the area. 'What exactly does he want from these beasts? Why does he always slaughter thousands of them?'

As he fought with those beasts, Zhang Fei [5] continued to monitor the assassins on the map. He knew that they would not dare to move with Zhu Lingyao by his side, so he chose to complete the third daily quest first.

In the Scorching Earth Realm, Feltia [2] hid himself in an invisible state as he jumped into every tree toward the mountain peak. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] climbed with effort due to the increased gravity on the mountain, skillfully avoiding the obstacles that kept appearing. He also fought off every lava beast that came his way, collecting as many Lava Heart Crystals as possible.
"Little Fox!"
Zhang Fei [4] turned to the group of cultivators from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and Yuan Tianling was the first to land before him, followed by the other four.

Yuan Tianling immediately grabbed Zhang Fei [4]'s hand and led him to sit on a large rock. "How can you move so fast? Have you trained in high gravity before? If I were here alone, I definitely wouldn't be able to catch up with you."

'This woman is lovely, but also annoying.' Zhang Fei [4] then answered her. "In the upper realm there are several planets with heavy gravity, and I have trained on some of them, so the gravity on this mountain is not too troublesome for me."
"Are there really such planets in the upper realm? Why have I never heard of them?" Yuan Tiankong suspiciously asked, and the others also looked suspicious of him.
Zhang Fei [4] asked back directly. "Have all of you explored the upper realms before? I don't think so, right?"
"Why do you think that?" Yuan Tianjie inquired.

"If you guys had explored the upper realms, I'm sure the five of you wouldn't be moving in a group right now, and you guys would be moving on your own." Yuan Tianjie and the others did not rebuff Zhang Fei [4]. "Unlike you all, I've been to many realms, and I've met many rogue cultivators. None of them move in groups, unless they go to a place that is much more dangerous than this mountain."

"Hehe." Yuan Tianling giggled. "You're not wrong about that, little fox. Actually, this planet was the first we visited, and we always focused on training in our realm, so we didn't know about other realms. By the way, do you want to come with us to our realm? Our realm is different from the others, and you will be able to cultivate and train better there."
"What is the name of your realm, Senior Sister?" Zhang Fei [4] pretended to be curious.

Yuan Tianhua answered him. "Our realm is the oldest in the upper realm, the Sovereign Heaven Realm. Not many cultivators know about our realm, and even those who do know about it won't be able to enter easily. If you go with us, our master can give you an exception, and you won't have to go through those troublesome tests."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded slightly. "I have never heard of that realm before, but your strength and ability to overcome the gravity on this mountain make me think it's interesting."
"So, are you willing to go with us?" Yuan Tianling asked with puppy eyes.
"No." Zhang Fei [4] rejected her outright.

"We're much more senior than you, but your connections and knowledge surpass us, kid." Gong Ren said while shaking his head.
Ji Changlan joined in.
"Not only do you know about the Paradise Realm, but you also have many acquaintances from that realm, not to mention that the little girl just now is the reincarnator of an ancient powerhouse."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed awkwardly.
"I was lucky enough to know about the Paradise Realm and the people from that realm, and I also never expected that Ling'er was Tian Huangjin's reincarnation.
Even before becoming a cultivator, she was exceptionally intelligent and mature, which raised many questions for us.
A few months ago, I accidentally found one of her pieces of equipment in the Star Tower, and it chose her as its master, which also gave us the answers to all our questions.
Do you still want to continue your journey to the Starry Sky Realm?
If not, I'll go there myself."
"We still have to go to that realm." Ji Changlan was the first to answer.
Zhe Wuming nodded in agreement with that.
"Even though that female senior went to that realm to look for Xereth, we have to confirm whether she will succeed in getting rid of him or not.
If she fails, we have to think of other plans to protect our realm and the three mortal realms."
"Hey, kid!
I want two of your pills!" Xue Bao jumped onto Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his nose before giving the price of the pills.
"Each pill is worth a hundred million purple jewels."
"You wanted to rob us on purpose!" Ji Changlan shouted at him in anger.
"Hahaha." Feng Jiu laughed at that.
"Old Ji, no one can concoct such miraculous pills except him, and the ingredients are even harder to obtain since they are only available in the tower.
Thus, I think it is reasonable if he opens that price for the pills, especially since their effects will last forever."
Ji Changlan's lips twitched in response, but he immediately took out that many purple jewels and handed them to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"It took me quite a while to get this many jewels, but I wasted it just for two pills."
"You stingy old man!" Feng Jiu said it with a shake of her head.
Xue Bao stretched out his front paw to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Give me the pills, and my master will pay you."
"Give me two of each." Zhe Wuming casually paid Zhang Xiaolong [3] four hundred million purple jewels, as well as Gong Ren, who paid him two hundred million purple jewels.
{800,000,000 purple jewels have been added to your balance.}
'Hahaha!
I'm rich now!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately gave them the two pills, as many as they needed.
He also gave Feng Jiu two pills, but he did not ask her to pay for them.
"Don't be jealous of her, okay?
Empress Feng is my future mother-in-law, so I can't possibly ask her to pay for my pills, right?"
"Cheapskate!" Ji Changlan and the others immediately sat cross-legged and swallowed the two pills, as did Feng Jiu.
Hun Di smiled and patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder.
"Since we still need a few days to arrive at the Starry Sky Realm, I will teach you some new soul techniques."
"Yes, Master." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied excitedly.
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels sent to the inventory.]
After the two notifications appeared, Zhang Fei [5] immediately left the Blue Water Realm and returned to the Phoenix Clan in the Sky Dragon Realm.
He found Zhu Lingyao waiting for him in the garden in front of his room, but he suddenly sensed killing intent from several people.
'They've finally arrived, huh?

They shouldn't dare to act at this hour, so I'll lure them somewhere else.' Zhang Fei [5] immediately approached Zhu Lingyao and informed her about those assassins, and the two of them right away left the Phoenix Clan.
Zhu Lingyao then asked him. 'Do you need my help fighting them?'
'No.' Zhang Fei [5] refused immediately. 'I want to subdue them and bring them into my organization, so I have to show them my abilities, or they won't fully submit to me.'
Zhu Lingyao gave a light nod. 'I've heard a lot about you, but I've never seen you fight before, so I'll use this opportunity to analyze the depth of your strength.'
'Haha!' Zhang Fei [5] embraced her waist. 'This future husband of yours is not as weak as you imagine, and I will show you that I am worthy of being your husband.'
'You are not my future husband!' Zhu Lingyao glared at him.
Instead, Zhang Fei [5] looked her up and down. 'If I'm not your future husband, why are you enjoying our kisses?
Why did you let me touch your body?'
'Humph!' Zhu Lingyao snorted and did not reply to him.

Sometime later, they had arrived at the forest on the edge of the floating island, and Zhu Lingyao sat on a large rock, watching Zhang Fei [5] fight with beasts of various ranks in the area. 'What exactly does he want from these beasts?
Why does he always slaughter thousands of them?'
As he fought with those beasts, Zhang Fei [5] continued to monitor the assassins on the map.
He knew that they would not dare to move with Zhu Lingyao by his side, so he chose to complete the third daily quest first.
In the Scorching Earth Realm, Feltia [2] hid himself in an invisible state as he jumped into every tree toward the mountain peak.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] climbed with effort due to the increased gravity on the mountain, skillfully avoiding the obstacles that kept appearing.
He also fought off every lava beast that came his way, collecting as many Lava Heart Crystals as possible.
"Little Fox!"
Zhang Fei [4] turned to the group of cultivators from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and Yuan Tianling was the first to land before him, followed by the other four.
Yuan Tianling immediately grabbed Zhang Fei [4]'s hand and led him to sit on a large rock.
"How can you move so fast?
Have you trained in high gravity before?
If I were here alone, I definitely wouldn't be able to catch up with you."
'This woman is lovely, but also annoying.' Zhang Fei [4] then answered her.
"In the upper realm there are several planets with heavy gravity, and I have trained on some of them, so the gravity on this mountain is not too troublesome for me."
"Are there really such planets in the upper realm?
Why have I never heard of them?" Yuan Tiankong suspiciously asked, and the others also looked suspicious of him.
Zhang Fei [4] asked back directly.
"Have all of you explored the upper realms before?
I don't think so, right?"
"Why do you think that?" Yuan Tianjie inquired.

"If you guys had explored the upper realms, I'm sure the five of you wouldn't be moving in a group right now, and you guys would be moving on your own." Yuan Tianjie and the others did not rebuff Zhang Fei [4].
"Unlike you all, I've been to many realms, and I've met many rogue cultivators.
None of them move in groups, unless they go to a place that is much more dangerous than this mountain."
"Hehe." Yuan Tianling giggled.
"You're not wrong about that, little fox.
Actually, this planet was the first we visited, and we always focused on training in our realm, so we didn't know about other realms.
By the way, do you want to come with us to our realm?
Our realm is different from the others, and you will be able to cultivate and train better there."
"What is the name of your realm, Senior Sister?" Zhang Fei [4] pretended to be curious.
Yuan Tianhua answered him.
"Our realm is the oldest in the upper realm, the Sovereign Heaven Realm.
Not many cultivators know about our realm, and even those who do know about it won't be able to enter easily.
If you go with us, our master can give you an exception, and you won't have to go through those troublesome tests."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded slightly.
"I have never heard of that realm before, but your strength and ability to overcome the gravity on this mountain make me think it's interesting."
"So, are you willing to go with us?" Yuan Tianling asked with puppy eyes.
"No." Zhang Fei [4] rejected her outright.

chapters.title: Chapter 878: Facing The Five
paragraphs: "Why? Why did you refuse my invitation?" Yuan Tianling asked in an irritated and angry tone.

'What a childish old woman!' Zhang Fei [4] then explained. "Senior Sister, your realm may be good, but there are no free lunches in this world, and there are few good cultivators. You guys could live there comfortably, but only because of your families or master, right? Meanwhile, I don't have a high status like the five of you, and the powerful cultivators there will look down on and suppress me. Thus, I don't want to go there, and the best way for me to improve myself is to go on adventures. This way, I can face many things that I haven't experienced before, and all those real battles will help me to improve myself."
"But—"

"Since he has made up his mind, you have to respect this kid's decision." Yuan Tianxie intervened to prevent Yuan Tianling from continuing. "Furthermore, all of his words are true, and we would never be able to live comfortably in our realm if it weren't for our families and master. Honestly, I want to enjoy a free life like him and go on adventures to see many new things, but unfortunately, I can't do that, and my family will send people to bring me back if I do that."

Yuan Tiankong nodded before saying. "My great-grandfather once told me about many things, including his adventures in the past. Unfortunately, the situation in our realm has changed compared to his era, and we are no longer allowed to go on adventures like him."
"If we want to go against the rules in our realm, we ourselves will lose and suffer." Yuan Tianjie added with a gloomy expression.

Yuan Tianhua sighed softly before speaking. "The only way for us to go adventuring is to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm first, but we will never be able to reach that stage in hundreds or thousands of years, and we might need tens of thousands of years or even hundreds of thousands of years to reach it."

'Isn't their life too boring? Their current cultivation is already very high, and not many people can fight them in the upper realms, but they live like birds in a cage.' Zhang Fei [4] immediately took out the demon extermination sword. "The demons will be here soon, and some of them are as strong as the five of you."
"Do you know our cultivation level?" Yuan Tianling asked him.

"No." Zhang Fei [4] shook his head. "Even though I can't detect your cultivation, I can distinguish everyone's auras. Those demons' auras are just as strong as yours, so I suspect their strength is on par with yours."
"Humph! Those demons' aura may be strong, but they won't be able to match our strength." Yuan Tianling immediately stood up and took out a pair of round chakrams.
Yuan Tianxie and the others also took out their own weapons, but the five of them looked relaxed because they were confident in killing those demons.
"Here they come."
In a few moments, dozens of demons swarmed them, led by a giant demon with a head like a black dog but a body like a cow. "You were the ones who killed my subordinates before, right?"
Yuan Tianxie didn't reply and attacked him head-on, but the male demon deftly swung his spiked black cudgel toward him, knocking him backward.

Yuan Tianxie and the other four were shocked by the male demon's strength and speed, especially since his body was so huge and the gravity in their area was quite heavy, yet he was able to parry his attack and knock him back.

"Hahaha! You weak humans underestimate me, Niu Guo, too much! My body is indeed huge, yet I excel in both physical strength and speed cultivation. Moreover, my true cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, so you guys won't be able to defeat me with your cultivation still at the Divine Ascendant Realm." The male demon then looked at Zhang Fei [4]. "Were you the one who used that lotus technique?"
"What if I used that technique?" Zhang Fei [4] asked with a calm smile.
"You must die." However, Niu Guo's face turned to shock as soon as Zhang Fei [4] disappeared from his sight. "Hmm?"

Just like Niu Guo, Yuan Tianxie and the other four also tried to search for Zhang Fei [4]'s whereabouts, but they couldn't sense his presence in the slightest, as if he had disappeared into the earth.

"Damn it! I didn't expect a weak ant like him to have such a swift speed!" A black-red aura suddenly enveloped Niu Guo's body, and the demons surrounding the five cultivators experienced a significant increase in strength, prompting Yuan Tianxie and the others to increase their vigilance. "Kill them!"
*Splurt*
*Bam*
"Arghh." Niu Guo let out a roar filled with pain as his right arm was suddenly severed, causing black blood to gush out from the cut. In the next second, his left arm was also severed. "Arghh!"
Yuan Tianxie and the others were stunned to see that, but they then looked at Zhang Fei [4], who had reappeared behind Niu Guo with his sword stained with the blood of the demon.
"You talk too much." Zhang Fei [4] punched Niu Gao in the back of the head, causing him to stagger before falling forward.
*Bam*

After they avoided Niu Gao, Yuan Tianxie and the others immediately moved to attack his subordinates. Without their leader's support, the demons were overwhelmed by their attack power and speed, and some of them quickly fell lifeless to the ground.

"Argh!" Niu Gao once again let out a painful groan as Zhang Fei [4] chopped off both of his legs, leaving his lower area drenched in his blood. "Who the fuck are you? How can you attack me with such a low cultivation?"
Zhang Fei [4] threw the demon extermination sword, which immediately pierced Niu Gao's body and shattered his cultivation core, causing his cultivation to quickly disappear.
Zhang Fei [4] then landed in front of the male demon and touched his head. "Your body is strong, but my sword is the nemesis of demons."
"Argh!" Niu Gao groaned in pain as soon as Zhang Fei [4] used all three absorption techniques simultaneously. 'Fuck! He absorbed my demon power, life force, and soul power!'

The five cultivators from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, who were fighting Niu Gao's subordinates, immediately turned to look at Zhang Fei [4]. They immediately noticed his actions, making them think that he was a heretic cultivator.
In just a few minutes, Niu Gao had already died in Zhang Fei [4]'s hands with his entire body dried up.
[You gained 30,000,000 demon essences from Niu Gao.]
At the same time, Yuan Tianxie and the other four had already killed all of Niu Gao's subordinates, and they immediately surrounded Zhang Fei [4] with their weapons pointed at him.
Zhang Fei [4] didn't think much about them and pulled out the demon extermination sword. "Do you guys want to be my enemy?"
"Are you a heretic cultivator, little fox?" Yuan Tianling asked with a trembling voice.

"Righteous or evil depends on each individual's perception. I constantly have to go through life-and-death battles, unlike the five of you who have always lived in cages and under the protection of your families. Therefore, I have to use whatever means necessary to survive, including using the techniques of the heretics." Zhang Fei [4] then pointed his sword at them. "You guys are strong, but you should have realized that I am not a weak persimmon. If all of you consider me an enemy and want to attack me, then I will serve you, but I promise, you will regret your decision."
Yuan Tianxie stared at Zhang Fei [4] for some time before lowering his weapon and walking away. "Let's go! We must continue our journey."

Yuan Tianjie and the other two immediately followed Yuan Tianxie, but Yuan Tianling was still standing at her spot and looking at Zhang Fei [4] complicatedly. She wanted to take him with her, but his action of using a heretic technique just now disappointed her.
"Tianling!"

Yuan Tianling immediately ran after the other four, but she repeatedly looked back at Zhang Fei [4]. He paid no attention to her and went through another path, catching up with Feltia [2], who was already quite far ahead.
[Master, I detected something from Yuan Tianling's body.]
'Hmm? What did you detect from that woman's body?'
[A flame.] Zhang Fei [4] raised an eyebrow slightly. [If I'm not mistaken, the flame should be the Sky Flame, but it's not the original one, and it's just a fragment of it.]
'A fragment of the Sky Flame, huh? Do you think I can get it from her, Mei?'

[I don't think you can do it, Master. Yuan Tianling only has a tiny fragment of the Sky Flame, and you have to find the original one to get the flame, so you still have to go to the Sovereign Heaven Realm.]

Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. 'I'll think about that later, and I'll focus on getting the Earth Flame first. However, the situation will not be easy, especially since Yuan Tianxie and the others might attack me once I get it. Not to mention, there are still many powerful fire cultivators in this place, and they all have strong ambitions to get it.'
[Well? You have many escape techniques, and you can move 500 miles in one fell swoop using the nine cloud steps, so I don't think you need to worry about them.]

'We don't know the abilities of those people yet, so we can't underestimate them. If any of them have the void element, that person might be able to capture me, so I still have to be careful of them.' After that, Zhang Fei [4] increased his speed while teleporting again and again.

Sometime later, many people arrived at the location of the previous battle, and they immediately looked for their footprints. After they found it, they immediately went in that direction, which was the direction the five cultivators from the Sovereign Heaven Realm had gone.
"Are we really going to let that kid go, Tianxie?" Yuan Tiankong asked.
Yuan Tianjie also spoke to him. "No matter what his reasons are, he has become a heretic once he uses their technique, so I think we should get rid of him before he gets any stronger."

Yuan Tianling wanted to refute them, but Yuan Tianhua immediately stopped her and shook her head. 'I know you want that kid by your side, but he is a heretic. If our master and the others find out that you contradict our brothers because of a heretic, they will send you to the Soul Withering Valley to punish you, so you should not say anything and try to forget him.'
'I know.' Yuan Tianling nodded slightly, but her expression was full of disappointment.

"Are you two still not aware of that kid's abilities and experience?" Yuan Tianxie stopped walking and looked at them. "That kid is much weaker than us in matters of cultivation, but he is much more experienced than us in life and death battles. That demon is stronger than us, and we won't be able to defeat him even if we join forces to attack him. However, that kid managed to outwit him and cut off his arms without him having time to react, showing that his speed far surpasses ours. He didn't even hesitate to challenge us even though he already knew a little about our identities, which means that he had faced cultivators far stronger than him far too many times. I wanted to kill him because he was a heretic, but we would be the ones to die if we fought him, so I chose to back down."

Yuan Tiankong and Yuan Tianjie nodded in understanding at him, but one of them immediately asked again. "What are we going to do later? Are we going to run away again if he manages to get the Earth Flame? That kid clearly wants to find the flame, and our master requires us to bring it back, so we will face him again up there."

"Hmm?" Yuan Tianxie thought seriously as he looked at the mountain peak. "I can't decide now, especially since that kid may not be able to get the Earth Flame. Moreover, we are not the only group that wants to get the flame, and there are many others besides us. If he manages to get it, those people will definitely gang up on him. Perhaps we can take advantage of the situation, and we will kill him when the opportunity arises."

Listening to their conversation, Yuan Tianling clenched both her fists and bit her lower lip. Even though she didn't like the fact that Zhang Fei [4] was a heretic, she still didn't want him to die, and she immediately sent a voice transmission to warn him about her three brothers.
"Day will turn into night soon, so we should continue our journey, and we should find a place to take shelter." Yuan Tianxie immediately led them up again.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
'What exactly do you need from these beasts?' Zhu Lingyao asked as she approached Zhang Fei [5].
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Zhu Lingyao. "Their beast cores can be used for alchemy, and their body parts can be sold or cooked."
'Cooked? Do you have a restaurant business?'

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Zhu Lingyao. "I haven't told you that I have several restaurants in several realms, and their number will continue to increase in the future. Moreover, my restaurants are always full, so I have to supply them with beast meat every day. Unfortunately, not all beast meat is delicious, and some beast parts also cannot be sold."
Zhu Lingyao released a soft sigh. 'As a beast, I find it quite frustrating watching you kill them, especially since you kill thousands of them every day.'
"I understand how you feel." Zhang Fei [5] pulled Zhu Lingyao into a hug. "You better not follow me when I hunt beasts, or you will continue to feel like this."
Zhu Lingyao simply nodded before asking. 'Are you going to make a move against those assassins now?'
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei [4] glanced in several directions. 'Long Jishan and Long Jinwu have been monitoring us since earlier, so I hope you can block them, and I will take care of those assassins myself.'

'I actually didn't want to get involved in this matter, but they must have thought that I have a relationship with you.' Zhu Lingyao immediately broke free from Zhang Fei [5]'s embrace and disappeared from his sight.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood casually with the moonlit whisper sword in his hand. "Are you two still unwilling to come out? I have known of your presence since the Phoenix Clan, so you don't need to bother hiding."

Soon, two male assassins appeared in front and behind Zhang Fei [5] with daggers in their hands, but he smiled casually seeing their murderous expressions and killing intents. The two exchanged glances for a moment before dashing towards him and attacking him directly, but their attacks passed through his body, which was merely an illusion.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Thorny tree branches suddenly emerged from the ground and tied the legs of the two male assassins, but they quickly cut them down and flew into the sky.
*Slash... Slash...*
"Argh!" The two male assassins screamed in pain after their backs were slashed by the swords, and they immediately thrust their daggers backwards, but only hit empty air.
Zhang Fei [5] appeared not far from them with the Hellflame Frost Lotus circling above his palm. "Take my attack."
"Shit!" The two male assassins hastily flew away as soon as the Hellflame Frost Lotus shot towards them, and it immediately exploded a few moments later.
*Boom*
