[If I'm not mistaken, the flame should be the Sky Flame, but it's not the original one, and it's just a fragment of it.]
'A fragment of the Sky Flame, huh?
Do you think I can get it from her, Mei?'
[I don't think you can do it, Master.
Yuan Tianling only has a tiny fragment of the Sky Flame, and you have to find the original one to get the flame, so you still have to go to the Sovereign Heaven Realm.]
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. 'I'll think about that later, and I'll focus on getting the Earth Flame first.
However, the situation will not be easy, especially since Yuan Tianxie and the others might attack me once I get it.
Not to mention, there are still many powerful fire cultivators in this place, and they all have strong ambitions to get it.'
[Well?
You have many escape techniques, and you can move 500 miles in one fell swoop using the nine cloud steps, so I don't think you need to worry about them.]
'We don't know the abilities of those people yet, so we can't underestimate them.
If any of them have the void element, that person might be able to capture me, so I still have to be careful of them.' After that, Zhang Fei [4] increased his speed while teleporting again and again.
Sometime later, many people arrived at the location of the previous battle, and they immediately looked for their footprints.
After they found it, they immediately went in that direction, which was the direction the five cultivators from the Sovereign Heaven Realm had gone.
"Are we really going to let that kid go, Tianxie?" Yuan Tiankong asked.
Yuan Tianjie also spoke to him.
"No matter what his reasons are, he has become a heretic once he uses their technique, so I think we should get rid of him before he gets any stronger."
Yuan Tianling wanted to refute them, but Yuan Tianhua immediately stopped her and shook her head. 'I know you want that kid by your side, but he is a heretic.

If our master and the others find out that you contradict our brothers because of a heretic, they will send you to the Soul Withering Valley to punish you, so you should not say anything and try to forget him.'
'I know.' Yuan Tianling nodded slightly, but her expression was full of disappointment.
"Are you two still not aware of that kid's abilities and experience?" Yuan Tianxie stopped walking and looked at them.
"That kid is much weaker than us in matters of cultivation, but he is much more experienced than us in life and death battles.
That demon is stronger than us, and we won't be able to defeat him even if we join forces to attack him.
However, that kid managed to outwit him and cut off his arms without him having time to react, showing that his speed far surpasses ours.
He didn't even hesitate to challenge us even though he already knew a little about our identities, which means that he had faced cultivators far stronger than him far too many times.
I wanted to kill him because he was a heretic, but we would be the ones to die if we fought him, so I chose to back down."
Yuan Tiankong and Yuan Tianjie nodded in understanding at him, but one of them immediately asked again.
"What are we going to do later?
Are we going to run away again if he manages to get the Earth Flame?
That kid clearly wants to find the flame, and our master requires us to bring it back, so we will face him again up there."
"Hmm?" Yuan Tianxie thought seriously as he looked at the mountain peak.
"I can't decide now, especially since that kid may not be able to get the Earth Flame.
Moreover, we are not the only group that wants to get the flame, and there are many others besides us.
If he manages to get it, those people will definitely gang up on him.
Perhaps we can take advantage of the situation, and we will kill him when the opportunity arises."
Listening to their conversation, Yuan Tianling clenched both her fists and bit her lower lip.
Even though she didn't like the fact that Zhang Fei [4] was a heretic, she still didn't want him to die, and she immediately sent a voice transmission to warn him about her three brothers.
"Day will turn into night soon, so we should continue our journey, and we should find a place to take shelter." Yuan Tianxie immediately led them up again.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
'What exactly do you need from these beasts?' Zhu Lingyao asked as she approached Zhang Fei [5].
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Zhu Lingyao.
"Their beast cores can be used for alchemy, and their body parts can be sold or cooked."
'Cooked?
Do you have a restaurant business?'
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Zhu Lingyao.
"I haven't told you that I have several restaurants in several realms, and their number will continue to increase in the future.
Moreover, my restaurants are always full, so I have to supply them with beast meat every day.
Unfortunately, not all beast meat is delicious, and some beast parts also cannot be sold."
Zhu Lingyao released a soft sigh. 'As a beast, I find it quite frustrating watching you kill them, especially since you kill thousands of them every day.'
"I understand how you feel." Zhang Fei [5] pulled Zhu Lingyao into a hug.
"You better not follow me when I hunt beasts, or you will continue to feel like this."
Zhu Lingyao simply nodded before asking. 'Are you going to make a move against those assassins now?'
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei [4] glanced in several directions. 'Long Jishan and Long Jinwu have been monitoring us since earlier, so I hope you can block them, and I will take care of those assassins myself.'

'I actually didn't want to get involved in this matter, but they must have thought that I have a relationship with you.' Zhu Lingyao immediately broke free from Zhang Fei [5]'s embrace and disappeared from his sight.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood casually with the moonlit whisper sword in his hand.
"Are you two still unwilling to come out?
I have known of your presence since the Phoenix Clan, so you don't need to bother hiding."
Soon, two male assassins appeared in front and behind Zhang Fei [5] with daggers in their hands, but he smiled casually seeing their murderous expressions and killing intents.
The two exchanged glances for a moment before dashing towards him and attacking him directly, but their attacks passed through his body, which was merely an illusion.
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
Thorny tree branches suddenly emerged from the ground and tied the legs of the two male assassins, but they quickly cut them down and flew into the sky.
*Slash...
Slash...*
"Argh!" The two male assassins screamed in pain after their backs were slashed by the swords, and they immediately thrust their daggers backwards, but only hit empty air.
Zhang Fei [5] appeared not far from them with the Hellflame Frost Lotus circling above his palm.
"Take my attack."
"Shit!" The two male assassins hastily flew away as soon as the Hellflame Frost Lotus shot towards them, and it immediately exploded a few moments later.
*Boom*

chapters.title: Chapter 879: Capture The Two Assassins
paragraphs: After the explosion occurred, the two people from the Dragon Clan, who were lurking from a distance, immediately moved to help the two assassins, but Zhu Lingyao swiftly appeared in front of them.
Long Jishan immediately questioned her. "What do you mean by this, Sect Master Zhu? Do you want to interfere in our Dragon Clan's affairs with that kid?"

"We know that you have a relationship with that kid, but you must not interfere in our affairs, or your Vermilion Clan will have to leave our realm." Zhu Lingyao furrowed her brows at Long Yingwu. "Furthermore, we all know that your sister doesn't like the Heavenly Fox Race, and she should already know about her presence in this realm."

'No wonder Zhu Shanniang knew about Zhang Fei's presence in this realm; you guys were the ones who told her about him. I prefer not to get involved in your issues with him, yet your clan's arrogance prevents you from acknowledging your mistakes. If Long Qichao hadn't sent the two of you to him, this matter wouldn't have happened.' Long Jishan and Long Jingwu were furious as they listened to Zhu Lingyao's words. 'Actually, he doesn't need my protection against your clan, but you guys need someone to protect yourselves from him.'
"Are you looking down on our Dragon Clan?" Long Jishan and Long Yingwu summoned their weapons, pointing them at Zhu Lingyao.

Zhu Lingyao just smiled and waved her hand, creating a flame sphere to enclose the two of them. 'Not even Long Aotian can destroy my vermilion sphere, so you two don't need to bother trying to destroy it. After Zhang Fei finishes his business with those two assassins, I will let you two go.'
"You bitch! How dare you look down on us!" In that instant, a powerful thunder struck Zhu Lingyao's vermilion sphere, but it did not budge in the slightest, enraging Long Jishan further.

Long Yingwu helped her friend by using her water dragon power, but her water evaporated as soon as it touched Zhu Lingyao's vermilion sphere. The two people from the Dragon Clan kept trying to destroy it, but their efforts were only a waste of qi.
Ignoring the two assassins on both sides, Zhu Lingyao turned his attention to Zhang Fei [5]. 'His technique just now was powerful, and I would definitely suffer serious injuries if hit by it.'

Zhang Fei [5] casually stood between the two assassins with the moonlit whisper sword in his hand and the hongxi dagger circling him. "Aren't you two strong cultivators and experienced assassins, Ying Yuan and Ying Huan? Why are you two so afraid to approach me now? If you don't want to move, then I will."

Ying Yuan and Ying Huan heard their names from his mouth, and they increased their vigilance once Zhang Fei [5] disappeared from their sight, and they tried to detect his presence to no avail, which made them think that he was an assassin like them. It was justified, especially since he had practiced assassination with Liu Hua and the Wen Twins.
"Argh!" Ying Yuan suddenly screamed after Zhang Fei [5] slashed his back, causing fresh blood to flow out of the long and deep wound.
Ying Huan wanted to help his partner, but Zhang Fei [5] suddenly appeared in front of him and slashed his chest directly, leaving a long sword wound. "Argh!"
Ying Huan immediately stabbed his dagger toward Zhang Fei [5], but his attack only hit his illusion.
Zhang Fei [5] reappeared behind Ying Huan, grabbed his neck, and pressed his sword against it, causing it to bleed. "One move and you're dead."
As an assassin, Ying Huan naturally does not fear death. He attacked Zhang Fei [5] by stabbing his dagger into his stomach, but he blocked it with the hongxi dagger.
A darkness instantly enveloped them as soon as Zhang Fei [5] used his demon corruption, quickly weakening Ying Huan.

Ying Yuan suddenly moved behind him and tried to stab his back, but Zhang Fei [5] disappeared once again, causing his dagger to stab Ying Huan's back. "Fuck! What the hell are you doing? Why are you attacking me?"

"Damn it! I didn't mean to stab you!" Ying Yuan pulled his dagger out, causing Ying Huan to grimace. "This kid is more troublesome than we thought before, so we should leave first, and we will rearrange our strategy to kill him."

As he endured the pain in his body, Ying Huan nodded in agreement with his partner. However, Zhang Fei [5] immediately appeared behind them with two Yin-Yang Absorbing Shackles in his hands, and he swiftly put them both into their hands, sealing their cultivation.
"Shit!"
"Fuck!"
Ying Yuan and Ying Huan cursed as their bodies shot towards the ground, and both of them slammed down quite hard.
*Bam... Bam...*
"Cough... Cough..."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately landed in front of them, took out the moonlit whisper sword again, and pointed it at them. "Even though you two attacked me because of the Dragon Clan's request, I will still give you two choices: obey me, or I will kill you both and everyone close to you."
"Haha." Ying Huan laughed at that. "I will never submit to you, so you can kill me if you want!"
"We are assassins, and we have no family, so we will have no regrets in dying." Ying Yuan uttered these with sneers.

"Like you two, I am an assassin myself, but I will never throw away my life for nothing like you guys. Since you don't want to obey me, I will force you to obey me." Zhang Fei [5] crouched down in front of them and grabbed their heads. He quickly implanted his demon slave mark into their souls, causing Ying Yuan and Ying Huan to tremble violently as soon as his mark appeared in their souls. "From today onwards, you two are my slaves, and you will help me to take over your assassin group."

Afterwards, Zhang Fei [5] removed the Yin-Yang Absorbing Shackles from their hands, but Ying Huan and Ying Yuan immediately attacked him. Unfortunately, they made a fatal mistake, and the demon slave mark in their souls immediately activated, causing both of them to roll and scream in pain on the ground.
"Argh!"
"Fuck!"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed as he stored the shackles. "I can change your memories if I want, but I want you guys to realize that it's useless for you to oppose me. Let alone attack me; if you two have the slightest negative thought towards me, my slave mark will torture you guys right away. Oh! You don't need to try to commit suicide, especially since my mark will prevent it."
Hearing that, Ying Yuan and Ying Huan immediately calmed themselves down, and the pain in their bodies quickly disappeared by itself. "You're evil!"
"You're right, I'm evil." Zhang Fei [5] then threw a bottle in front of them. "Return to your group, use the pill, and tell me right after."

After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Ying Yuan immediately took the bottle. Even though he and Ying Huan didn't want to do it, his order was absolutely due to his demon slave mark in their souls, and they immediately left the place to carry out his order.
Zhang Fei [5] appeared by Zhu Lingyao's side and stared at the two people from the Dragon Clan. 'What are you going to do about them?'

"I already spared them once, but they still want to find trouble with me, so I won't spare them anymore." Zhang Fei [5] then thought of a suitable way to use Long Jishan and Long Yingwu to deal with their Dragon Clan.
Long Jishan immediately threatened him. "If you kill us, all the dragons will hunt you down all over the universe, including our main Dragon Clan, and they will kill everyone close to you."
"You better let us go, or they will die because of you." Long Yingwu also threatened him.

"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei [5] laughed loudly before his expression turned murderous, and his killing intent suffocated the two people from the Dragon Clan; even Zhu Lingayo flew away from him. "I didn't expect that two dragons like you were shameless and had no pride! You were the one who was looking for trouble with me first, and I was just responding to your actions. Since you dare to threaten me like that, you have to suffer the consequences."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately took out the Abyssal Mirror and forced them to look at it. Long Jishan and Long Yingwu's bodies trembled in fear, and their pupils shrank as their souls were trapped in the depths of the mirror. "Ever since I used it against Zhou Fang, I have never used it again until today."
'What happened to them?' Zhu Lingyao returned to his side.

"This mirror is a demon artifact, and it traps their souls." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer surprised Zhu Lingyao, but she didn't dare look in the mirror. "They are not soul cultivators, and their souls will remain trapped within until I liberate them."

'What will you do to them? Are you going to enslave them like those two assassins? If you do that, Long Aotian and some others will notice your actions.' Zhu Lingyao asked after she canceled her technique.

"I knew there were soul cultivators among the dragons, so I couldn't enslave them." Zhang Fei [5] kept the mirror and stared coldly at Long Jishan. "I'm eager to kill this guy because he threatened me like that before, but I can't do it now. Although I am confident in my abilities and speed, I can't possibly face so many dragons at once, and it would also endanger the people around me."
'Why only Long Jishan? Aren't you going to kill Long Yingwu too?'
"Why should I kill Long Yingwu?" Zhang Fei [5] posed the question with a playful smile.

Zhu Lingyao massaged her forehead as she thought that Zhang Fei [5] wanted to take Long Yingwu as his woman. 'You are such a perverted fox! You already have so many women by your side, but you are never satisfied with them.'

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] responded with a laugh. "I have no interest in Long Yingwu, okay? She is a female dragon, so it would be a loss if I killed her. Once my business with the Dragon Clan is finished, I will give her to one of my wives, and she will be her mount."
'Isn't Long Jishan also a dragon? Why don't you give him to one of them?' Zhu Lingyao asked in confusion.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head before replying. "I will never allow any of my wives to be close to other men, even if they are just their mounts, and I am the only man who can be by their side."

Zhu Lingyao couldn't help but shake her head. 'Being a human's mount is the most humiliating thing for all mythical beasts, especially dragons. Are you also thinking of doing the same to the other female dragons?'

"Only if they choose to be my enemy." Zhang Fei [5] immediately pressed his palms onto Long Jishan's chest, and he injected the pink gas from his hormone manipulation into his body. He didn't do that to Long Yingwu, but he used a different technique on her. "Let's go back to the Phoenix Clan."
'You can go back yourself, and I will return to my sect.' Zhu Lingyao hurriedly disappeared.
Zhang Fei [5] could have stopped Zhu Lingyao, but he didn't, and he rushed back to the Phoenix Clan to cultivate.
Several hours later, Long Aotian, Long Qichao, and two other Dragon Clan members arrived at the location, finding Long Jishan and Long Yingwu standing like frozen statues.
"Are they dead, Brother?"
Long Aotian immediately examined Long Jishan and Long Yingwu carefully, both their bodies and souls. "They are still alive, but they seem to have lost their souls."
"Lost their souls? Wouldn't they die if that happened?" Long Qichao asked in confusion.

"That kid is Hun Di's disciple, but I'm sure he wouldn't dare to kill our Dragon Clan members. Thus, I believe he used his soul abilities on them, and he probably used something to imprison their souls." Long Aotian then gave an order to his two clan members. "Bring them back to our clan."
"Yes, Patriarch." The two immediately took Long Jishan and Long Yingwu away.

"Go back to our sect." Long Qichao just nodded and left. Long Aotian immediately began searching for the bodies of the two assassins. "Did that kid kill them? I've paid that old man to send his best assassins, but they failed to kill that kid. Since they've already failed once, there's no point in using their services anymore because he must be prepared for them."

Long Aotian immediately contacted Long Qiang using an interspatial communication device, and he informed him about the failure of the assassins, as well as about the conditions of Long Jishan and Long Yingwu.
Long Aotian smiled evilly after Long Qiang replied to his message, and he told him that he would send some people from the main Dragon Clan to the Sky Dragon Realm.

Thereafter, Long Aotian returned to the Dragon Clan and went to Long Jishan's room to find a way to free his soul. The pink gas that Zhang Fei [5] instilled in his body immediately came out and filled the room, and the patriarch subconsciously inhaled it, making him horny.

Basically, a dragon was a lustful creature, and Zhang Fei [5]'s pink gas burned Long Aotian's lust to its peak, causing him to become even more lustful. Realizing his condition, he hurriedly left Long Jishan's room and summoned his three wives to his room to relieve his lust.

Unfortunately, Long Aotian's departure caused the pink gas to spread to several areas of the Dragon Clan, and it affected many members of the clan, especially those who lived near Long Jishan's room. Moreover, they would never be able to quell their lust, and Zhang Fei [5] was the only person who could remove the effects of the pink gas from them, causing the situation there to become quite chaotic.
"Princess."
Feng Yao nodded to Feng Haiyan. "I already know the situation, but I believe they will not dare to attack Zhang Fei [4] openly, especially after he demonstrated his power in killing that demon."
"How could he kill a demon at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm with his low strength, Princess?" Feng Haiyan still found it difficult to believe that Zhang Fei [4] could do such a thing.

Feng Yao turned to her. "That demon was strong, but its body was no different from the tofu in front of his sword. As long as Zhang Fei [4] could trick those demons and attack them first, he could kill them easily, but he couldn't use such methods against humans or other races. Moreover, his sword was still not perfect, and it would be a terrifying scourge for all demons if it were perfect."
"I've never encountered such a sword before." Feng Haiyan then asked. "Do our people need to keep monitoring him?"
Feng Yao nodded at her. "Let them monitor him, and they only need to move if he's in danger."
"Yes, Princess."

At the Hellblaze volcano, Zhang Fei [4] had already reached the mountain slope, but he was still quite far from the peak due to its height. He deliberately did not move too fast because so many cultivators were watching him, especially those from the Sovereign Heaven Realm. This way, they would not notice the movement of his second clone, who continued his journey to the peak in an invisible state.

Zhang Fei [4] decided to rest on a hard tree, especially since the ground was getting hotter due to the actions of the Earth Flame. "Yuan Tianling and Yuan Tianhua are not bad, but those three men are different from them, and they even plan to do such a thing against me."
[Are you thinking about approaching those two women, Master? By the way, some phoenixes were monitoring you from the start, and they must have done it on Feng Yao's orders.]

"Perhaps I will approach them in the future, but not now." Zhang Fei [4] then looked at the mountain peak. "They are too ambitious to get the Earth Flame, but I will not let them get it, and Feltia [2] will be the one to get it."

"Why should I kill Long Yingwu?" Zhang Fei [5] posed the question with a playful smile.
Zhu Lingyao massaged her forehead as she thought that Zhang Fei [5] wanted to take Long Yingwu as his woman. 'You are such a perverted fox!
You already have so many women by your side, but you are never satisfied with them.'
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] responded with a laugh.
"I have no interest in Long Yingwu, okay?
She is a female dragon, so it would be a loss if I killed her.
Once my business with the Dragon Clan is finished, I will give her to one of my wives, and she will be her mount."
'Isn't Long Jishan also a dragon?
Why don't you give him to one of them?' Zhu Lingyao asked in confusion.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head before replying.
"I will never allow any of my wives to be close to other men, even if they are just their mounts, and I am the only man who can be by their side."
Zhu Lingyao couldn't help but shake her head. 'Being a human's mount is the most humiliating thing for all mythical beasts, especially dragons.
Are you also thinking of doing the same to the other female dragons?'
"Only if they choose to be my enemy." Zhang Fei [5] immediately pressed his palms onto Long Jishan's chest, and he injected the pink gas from his hormone manipulation into his body.
He didn't do that to Long Yingwu, but he used a different technique on her.
"Let's go back to the Phoenix Clan."
'You can go back yourself, and I will return to my sect.' Zhu Lingyao hurriedly disappeared.
Zhang Fei [5] could have stopped Zhu Lingyao, but he didn't, and he rushed back to the Phoenix Clan to cultivate.
Several hours later, Long Aotian, Long Qichao, and two other Dragon Clan members arrived at the location, finding Long Jishan and Long Yingwu standing like frozen statues.
"Are they dead, Brother?"
Long Aotian immediately examined Long Jishan and Long Yingwu carefully, both their bodies and souls.
"They are still alive, but they seem to have lost their souls."
"Lost their souls?
Wouldn't they die if that happened?" Long Qichao asked in confusion.
"That kid is Hun Di's disciple, but I'm sure he wouldn't dare to kill our Dragon Clan members.
Thus, I believe he used his soul abilities on them, and he probably used something to imprison their souls." Long Aotian then gave an order to his two clan members.
"Bring them back to our clan."
"Yes, Patriarch." The two immediately took Long Jishan and Long Yingwu away.
"Go back to our sect." Long Qichao just nodded and left.
Long Aotian immediately began searching for the bodies of the two assassins.
"Did that kid kill them?
I've paid that old man to send his best assassins, but they failed to kill that kid.
Since they've already failed once, there's no point in using their services anymore because he must be prepared for them."

Long Aotian immediately contacted Long Qiang using an interspatial communication device, and he informed him about the failure of the assassins, as well as about the conditions of Long Jishan and Long Yingwu.
Long Aotian smiled evilly after Long Qiang replied to his message, and he told him that he would send some people from the main Dragon Clan to the Sky Dragon Realm.
Thereafter, Long Aotian returned to the Dragon Clan and went to Long Jishan's room to find a way to free his soul.
The pink gas that Zhang Fei [5] instilled in his body immediately came out and filled the room, and the patriarch subconsciously inhaled it, making him horny.
Basically, a dragon was a lustful creature, and Zhang Fei [5]'s pink gas burned Long Aotian's lust to its peak, causing him to become even more lustful.
Realizing his condition, he hurriedly left Long Jishan's room and summoned his three wives to his room to relieve his lust.
Unfortunately, Long Aotian's departure caused the pink gas to spread to several areas of the Dragon Clan, and it affected many members of the clan, especially those who lived near Long Jishan's room.

Moreover, they would never be able to quell their lust, and Zhang Fei [5] was the only person who could remove the effects of the pink gas from them, causing the situation there to become quite chaotic.
"Princess."
Feng Yao nodded to Feng Haiyan.
"I already know the situation, but I believe they will not dare to attack Zhang Fei [4] openly, especially after he demonstrated his power in killing that demon."
"How could he kill a demon at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm with his low strength, Princess?" Feng Haiyan still found it difficult to believe that Zhang Fei [4] could do such a thing.
Feng Yao turned to her.
"That demon was strong, but its body was no different from the tofu in front of his sword.
As long as Zhang Fei [4] could trick those demons and attack them first, he could kill them easily, but he couldn't use such methods against humans or other races.
Moreover, his sword was still not perfect, and it would be a terrifying scourge for all demons if it were perfect."
"I've never encountered such a sword before." Feng Haiyan then asked.
"Do our people need to keep monitoring him?"
Feng Yao nodded at her.
"Let them monitor him, and they only need to move if he's in danger."
"Yes, Princess."
At the Hellblaze volcano, Zhang Fei [4] had already reached the mountain slope, but he was still quite far from the peak due to its height.
He deliberately did not move too fast because so many cultivators were watching him, especially those from the Sovereign Heaven Realm.
This way, they would not notice the movement of his second clone, who continued his journey to the peak in an invisible state.
Zhang Fei [4] decided to rest on a hard tree, especially since the ground was getting hotter due to the actions of the Earth Flame.
"Yuan Tianling and Yuan Tianhua are not bad, but those three men are different from them, and they even plan to do such a thing against me."
[Are you thinking about approaching those two women, Master?
By the way, some phoenixes were monitoring you from the start, and they must have done it on Feng Yao's orders.]
"Perhaps I will approach them in the future, but not now." Zhang Fei [4] then looked at the mountain peak.
"They are too ambitious to get the Earth Flame, but I will not let them get it, and Feltia [2] will be the one to get it."

chapters.title: Chapter 880 880: Gathering I
paragraphs: [Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels.]
In the main garden of the pavilion, Zhang Fei was gathering together with all his official and unofficial women, but he also invited Ning Zhuan'er to join them.

Although she had spent a few days with them and knew all of them by now, Ning Zhuan'er was still awkward to be among them, especially since she was not Zhang Fei's woman but her disciple. However, she was amazed by the closeness and lack of seniority among them, which made their relationship as warm as a large family. 'They are all gorgeous, but they belong to Big Brother. If people met them, the men would definitely be jealous of them.'

As he hugged the two little girls, who were sitting on his lap, Zhang Fei looked at them one by one while reading their statuses in the system. 'Xu Ling'er, Lin Dong'er, Mu Lingshu, and Angela will break through to the Earth Realm in a few weeks. Guo Lan, Shi Wu, and Shi Xi were still a little far from that stage, but they weren't that far off either. Meng Tianshi, Jiang Yinghua, and Daniella were quite late cultivators, but theirs had already reached the foundation realm ; they would break through to the core realm soon. Huang Rong and the others turned into beasts a month ago, so their cultivation is the lowest among them, but their progress is not bad thanks to those beast pills and my Yang Qi.'
[Fortunately, all of them have already learned the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique, and their avatars never stopped cultivating, which accelerated their development.]
Zhang Fei gave a light nod. 'You're right.'
"What are you thinking about, Long'er?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at Wu Lianzhi. "I was just observing the progress of all of you, and you guys have been working hard all this time."
"Haha." Xu Ling'er giggled and kissed Zhang Fei. "Big Brother, we were able to develop this fast thanks to all the facilities you gave us, especially your pills and Yang Qi."
Wu Lianzhi suddenly kissed Zhang Fei, too. "Big Brother, is it okay if my parents train in your training space?"
"I did plan to bring them to my training space, but they are still busy guarding the Xianjin realm, especially since Empress Feng and the other seniors are away looking for Xereth."
"Uhm." Wu Lianzhi nodded in understanding.
Zhang Lin then spoke to him. "Big Brother, since those powerful cultivators are not in the Xianjin Realm, we all want to go there for sightseeing."
"I agree with Lin'er, Fei!" Lin Dong'er joined in. "We have all been training hard since we left the Sky Jade Realm, and we have barely had a vacation, so we wanted to refresh ourselves."
Mu Lingshu nodded slightly. "Can you take us there, Fei?"

The other women also agreed with them, but Zhang Fei seemed hesitant about it. Therefore, Hong Xinxin immediately spoke to persuade him. "I think it's okay if you take them there, Fei. Sister Qianying, Feng Yichen, Fei Qinyuan, Shang Yumei, and I are strong enough to protect them. Moreover, the Nameless One and the others have already cleaned out the evil cultivators, so I think they'll be fine there."
"I know you want to keep them away from danger, but danger is a part of our lives as cultivators, and they can't hide here forever." Murong Qianying joined in persuading Zhang Fei.
Fen Qinyuan then asked. "It should still be midnight outside, right?"

"You're right, it's midnight outside. However, the Xianjin Realm is never quiet, even at this hour, especially since the people in the realm almost never sleep." Zhang Fei then lowered Xu Ling'er and Wu Lianzhi from his lap. "Even so, the situation in the realm is quite calm now, especially since so many of them fled after Zhe Wuming declared an emergency situation. I will pick up my big sister in the Phoenix Realm first, and we will go to that realm after."

Sometime later, Zhang Fei had brought all his women to the Xianjin Realm. Additionally, he brought some of his family members, such as Zhang Chen, Zhang Hanzhi, Qing Tan, Ming Yanyu, Wang Zhuxian, and Duo Luotian.

Even though they had heard about the Xianjin Realm from Zhang Fei, all the women who came from Earth were amazed by the situation in that realm. Earth was an advanced planet, but all the technology there was completely incomparable to that of this realm.
"Fei, can you buy some of this realm's technology?" Zhang Fei turned to Huang Rong directly. "If we can develop them on Earth, we can influence global markets and get more money."

"Mom, your idea is good, but it will only make the situation on Earth more chaotic." Yang Lu'er spoke with a shake of her head. "Moreover, our government will attack us if we have a lot of equipment with much better technology, and they will try to snatch them from us."

"I agree with Lu'er, Huang Rong." Zhong Yan spoke. "All the equipment in this realm is several hundred or even several thousand years more advanced than Earth's, so we can't carelessly bring them to Earth, or the impact will be too significant. We can buy some for our company there, but we must ensure they remain hidden from the public."
"I just want to buy some medical equipment from this realm, Fei." Ru Xue said this.
"Ha ha." Zhang Fei had expected that. "Do you want to meet the best doctor in this realm? Senior Tian Yishen lives in that area, and there are many types of equipment in his hospital."
"Yes!" Ru Xue nodded with excitement. "I want to go there to look at all the medical equipment."
"Me too." After all, Liu Qingyu, Hu Yue, Jiang Yinghua, Meng Tianshi, and Daniella also had light elements, which made them curious about their medical equipment.
"Big Brother, I will go with my mother and the others."
Hong Xinxin immediately spoke. "I know Senior Yishen and Xiao Laoshu, so I will take them to see them."
"Big Brother! Tasha, Wu Lianzhi, and I will go with my mother and the others." Xu Ling'er immediately floated into Ru Xue's arms.
"All right."
After Zhang Fei agreed, Hong Xinxin led Ru Xue and the others to Tian Yishen's hospital.

Zhong Yan, Qing Yi, Zhang Lin, Tang Ziyu, and the other women from Earth wanted to buy things that they could sell on their planet so their company there could grow bigger, and Zhang Fei could earn more money. Murong Qianying immediately took them to the trading area in the Xianjin Realm; Zhang Chen and the others also joined them.

Fei Qinyuan, Shang Yumei, and Shang Yaolin led the female cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm and the Nine Stars Realm to look around other areas of the Xianjin Realm. After all, the situation in the Xianjin Realm was entirely different from their two realms; even old women like Lian Xiang, Shen Huang, Shen Xinya, Han Yuanzhi, and Bai Shushi were also curious about that realm.

However, not all of them went to see the Xianjin Realm, and they chose to stay by Zhang Fei's side, such as Zhang Yue, Ning Zhuan'er, and Feng Yichen. "Yichen, I want you to protect them from a distance, and you can kill those who have bad intentions toward them."
"Yes, Master." Feng Yichen disappeared instantly.
"Are you not interested in this realm, Big Sis?" Zhang Fei asked Zhang Yue.

Zhang Yue shook her head. "I don't know why, but I've never been interested in other things since I got Feng Gongxue's soul, and I just want to focus on my cultivation so that I can be ready to undergo the Ice Phoenix Trials."

"But you're still interested in having sex with me, right?" Zhang Yue's pale face turned red, and she punched Zhang Fei's chest lightly, making him smile. "Hehe! I haven't eaten you for a long time, so I will eat you after this."
Zhang Yue shyly nodded. "I missed doing it with you too."
On their side, Ning Zhuan'er could only watch Zhang Fei and Zhang Yue flirting in silence. 'Big Brother Fei, you shouldn't talk about such things in front of me.'

A while later, they had arrived at Cheng Gaoji's residence, where Lin Moxian and the others were gathered. Wang Yourou was also present among them, especially since she kept waiting for Zhang Fei to return. Even though the others had told her that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had gone with the others, she insisted on waiting for him.
Apart from Wang Yourou, young cultivators from the Red Sun Realm who knew Zhang Fei also gathered there, such as Murong Mengying, Miao Miao, Lai Minhua, and Tie Xuan.

Wang Yourou looked jealous as soon as she saw the three women by Zhang Fei's side, especially the cold beauty Zhang Yue. 'Zhang Lingxue and the other two are already beautiful, but their beauty cannot compare to this woman's beauty.'
Not only Wang Yourou, but Miao Miao and Lai Minhua were also jealous of Zhang Yue's beauty.
"Who are these two women, Zhang Fei?" Miao Miao asked him.

"The one with light blue hair is my wife, Zhang Yue." Zhang Fei introduced them one by one to the two women, but he then embraced Ning Zhuan'er's shoulders, causing her to blush. "This girl is my disciple, Ning Zhuan'er."
"Oh? Is she your disciple in the soul cultivation path?" Shang Yingyue asked in surprise.

Zhang Fei shook his head and explained. "Senior Sister Yingyue, Zhuan'er's cultivation is still in the core realm, so she can't learn about the soul cultivation path yet. Instead, she is my disciple in alchemy, and I found her in the Sky Dragon Realm. By the way, Lianzhi is also in this realm, but she went to Senior Yishen's hospital with the others."
"It's okay." Shang Yingyue and Wu Xueming responded.
"The Sky Dragon Realm? Isn't that the outermost realm of the upper realms?" Lai Minhua asked.

Zhang Fei nodded at Lai Mahua before explaining to them all about his meeting with Zhuang Qiaoming and Ying Wu two weeks ago up until his meeting with Ning Zhuan'er in the Sky Dragon Realm, or more precisely in the Blazing Phoenix Sect in that realm. "I am an emperor-rank alchemist now, and her talent in alchemy is extraordinary, so I took her as my disciple. Once she breaks through to the Soul Realm, I will teach her about the soul cultivation path."

Hearing that, Yan Yinqing deftly pulled Ning Zhuan'er to sit between her and Jing Qiuyue. "Little girl, Senior Sister Jing and I are his senior sisters. Once you learn the soul cultivation path in the future, you will be our junior niece in that path. However, we are still young, so you should call us big sisters."
"Junior Niece, you can call Jing Qiuyue big sister, but you should call Yan Yinqing old sage." Ning Zhuan'er looked at Lin Moxian in confusion as she did not understand the meaning of the term.

"Senior brother! You are an old virgin yourself, so you can stop mocking me!" Yan Yinqing then pointed to Wang Yourou, Murong Mengying, Miao Miao, and Lai Minhua. "They are also old virgins like me, so you insult them too."
"Yinqing, you're the only one who feels insulted." Miao Miao and the other two nodded in agreement with Murong Mengying, making Yan Yinqing glare at them.
Lin Moxian shrugged his shoulders. "In this room, only our junior brother and Wu Xueming are married, so Qiao Liangren and Tie Xuan are old bachelors like me."

"Hahaha." Wu Xueming laughed at that. "Instead of you making a fuss about each other's status, you guys should quickly find your respective partners, and you will realize the advantages of having a family."

"Senior Brother Wu, she is my future woman." All of them turned to Murong Mengying, who was pointed at by Zhang Fei, making her lips twitch. "Our souls have merged into one, and Senior Xia has already handed her over to me, so she will become my wife sooner or later."
"Since when do you two have such a relationship?" Miao Miao suspiciously asked.

Murong Mengying released a soft sigh. "I learned about the Sun Tower from him, and our souls have merged into one since then. However, I had not accepted him, and my master made a unilateral decision to hand me over to him."
"You won't reject your master's decision, right, Mengying?" Zhang Fei asked with a wide grin.
Murong Mengying sharpened her eyes as she stared at Zhang Fei, but she knew that she would never win an argument with him. "My master is my father, and I will follow his decision."
"Haha! That's good!" Zhang Fei laughed with satisfaction. "Since you're all gathered here, I'll bring someone over, and she'll cook for us."
"Quick! Bring Zhu Yan over! I can't wait to eat her dishes again." Yan Yinqing urged him.

Zhang Fei immediately summoned Zhu Yan out of the training space, and he asked her to cook some dishes for them. The other women, except for Wang Yourou, helped her in the kitchen, leaving the men to chat.
"What about your disciple, Senior Brother?" Zhang Fei asked Qiao Liangren as he sat beside Lin Moxian.

Qiao Liangren pointed to one of the rooms on the second floor. "Yue Qinhua is diligent, and she focuses on increasing her soul power in her room now. Although Ning Zhuan'er has not broken through to the soul realm, I can see that she is a girl who is focused on her goals, so you must teach her well once she breaks through to that stage."

"You are right, Senior Brother." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "When I found Ning Zhuan'er, I could see the seriousness in her. She has been staying with me for a few days now, and she has always been serious about studying alchemy. Thus, I believe she will also be serious about studying the soul cultivation path, and she might become a better soul cultivator than us in the future."
"What about your blacksmithing?" Tie Xuan suddenly asked.

Zhang Fei shook his head at him. "I've succeeded in forging earth-grade equipment, but I haven't succeeded in forging the perfect one. Moreover, I'm still busy with other matters, and my materials have long run out, so I haven't been able to forge other equipment."
"I see." Tie Xuan then offered him. "How about you take me back to the Red Sun Realm? There are many materials in my clan, and my father won't mind if you use them."

Zhang Fei agreed with that, especially since he was eager to increase his blacksmith rank. He then brought Tie Xuan to the Tie Clan in the Red Sun Realm, but they did not stay there for long, returning to the Xianjin Realm after collecting enough materials.
Zhang Fei did not immediately return to the training room to forge, and he chatted with the men while waiting for Zhu Yan and the others to finish their cooking.

Sometime later, the women had finished cooking, and they immediately ate together while talking about light things. Once they were done, they went back to their respective rooms, but Yan Yinqing and Jing Qiuyue took Zhang Yue and Ning Zhuan'er with them.
Zhang Fei wanted to see Murong Mengying, but Wang Yourou suddenly pulled him into his room at Cheng Gaoji's residence, especially since she had been waiting for him for a few days.
In the room, Zhang Fei immediately pressed Wang Yourou to her buttocks and held her hands above her head. "I told you that I won't help you anymore if you aren't willing to help me, right?"
"Why are you so stingy?" Wang Yourou complained with a pout.
Zhang Fei shook his head. "I am not stingy, but everything has its reciprocity, and we should benefit each other from everything we do."
"Don't you have many women by your side? You can ask them to help you, right?" Wang Yourou was reluctant to do such a thing for him.
Zhang Fei let go of her hands, walked to the bed, and sat there. "The choice is yours, and I will not force you."

At first, I was not interested in him, but his face was as thick as a tower wall. He shamelessly kept approaching me, even though I repeatedly rejected him."

"That kid did such a thing to you guys, huh?" Tian Yishen then looked at Daniella, but she didn't want to explain her relationship with Zhang Fei to him. "I guess he used bad methods on you, right?"
"Kind of." Daniella answered briefly.

"Fei'er has already told me about the Heavenly Rejuvenation Jade, and she has already obtained information on how to obtain it." Ru Xue's response surprised Tian Yishen and Xiao Laoshu, but they were not too surprised either, considering Zhang Fei's ability to move from one realm to another. "That realm is in the upper realms, but not everyone knows about it. According to him, only Senior Xia Tian has ever been to that realm, and he got that information from him."
"What is the name of that realm?"

"The Sovereign Heaven Realm." Tian Yishen and Xiao Laoshu immediately admitted that they had never heard of that realm, and Ru Xue told them about the realm based on Zhang Fei's conversation with Xia Tian some time ago. "Senior, please give me a cost estimate for all those medical devices, and I will discuss it with my husband."
Tian Yishen nodded at her. "I will calculate everything after this, and I will have Laoshu send it to Cheng Gaoji's residence after I finish it."

"Since you two have made a decision, Yulei and I will approve of your relationship, and we will start preparing for your wedding."
"Hehehe." Wang Yourou giggled and pulled Zhang Fei away.
"Father!
Mother!
I will gather with his family first."
After they left, Gong Yulei rubbed her husband's back.
"Even though their relationship seemed to happen so suddenly, I'm glad that our daughter has finally found the man of her choice."
"However, I'm a little worried about our daughter, especially since Zhang Fei's wife has too many." Wang Xiaotang replied with a heavy sigh.
"I'm afraid he will show favoritism toward them, and our daughter will suffer if that happens."
"I've thought about that too, but I'm sure our daughter has already thought about their relationship seriously.
Moreover, she's been around for thousands of years now, so she should know what's best for her." Gong Yulei immediately got down from his chair.
"I will prepare the wedding dress, and you can prepare other things for their wedding."
"All right."
After completing the two daily quests at the Hellblaze Volcano, Zhang Fei [4] immediately resumed his journey.
Unlike other cultivators, he did not rush to the summit, but instead, he chose to fight the lava beasts that were starting to appear again.

Meanwhile, Feltia [2] had already arrived at the top of the mountain in an invisible state, especially since she had not stopped climbing since yesterday in order to get ahead of the other cultivators.
However, there was only a lava crater in front of him, and countless lava beasts continued to come out of it.
"Can you detect the presence of the Earth Flame, Mei?"
[Master, the Earth Flame is hidden deep within the lava, and its location is almost at the core of this realm.]
Feltia [2] raised an eyebrow.
"That place must be extremely hot."
[Hehehe!
Master, this place is much hotter than the sea of fire in the Phoenix Realm.
The temperature at the location of the Earth Flame reaches thousands of degrees Celsius.
Instead of considering taking the flame, you should take advantage of this place to increase your fire elemental law first.
Once your fire elemental law reaches the half-perfection stage, it will be easier for you to dive into this sea of lava.]
Feltia [2] agreed with that, but the fire salamander suddenly burst out of his body, and it jumped immediately into the sea of lava below them.
"Huo Yan is too eager to improve himself."
Thereafter, Feltia [2] immediately activated her fire element and fire elemental law, and he jumped into the lava.
However, he chose to cultivate just above the surface rather than diving into the lava.
Unlike Feltia [2], the fire salamander continued to dive into the lava until it reached the location of the Earth Flame.
The Earth Flame itself was huge with a molten gold color, and it was enveloped by a faint golden-red barrier that separated it from the lava.
The fire salamander's eyes sparkled when it saw the Earth Flame and tried to approach it, but a small figure like a five-year-old boy suddenly materialized in front of it and attacked it.
"Hiss." The fire salamander hissed under the small boy figure's attack, but it didn't give up and tried to approach the Earth Flame again.
"Stay away, ugly creature!" The small boy attacks the fire salamander again, but it immediately dodges his attack by swimming in the lava before attacking him back with a fireball.
"If you insist on getting my flame, I will kill you even if you are a fire spirit like me."
The little boy's threat forced the fire salamander to stop, but its eyes continued to stare at the Earth Flame, as it was eager to absorb its power.
The little boy then spoke again.
"If you want to get my flame power, you must wait for your master to come here.
He must pass my tests to get my flame, and it will not be easy for him."
The fire salamander stared at the small boy for quite some time before swimming back to the surface to pick up Feltia [2], but it repeatedly looked back at him.
The small boy ignored the fire salamander and looked at the surface.
"That kid is really weird!
He is a human, demon, and fox beast.
Moreover, he is just one of his clones, and his other clone is climbing my mountain.
I don't understand why he still wants to obtain my flame when he already possesses the phoenix, soul, and dragon flames.
Regardless, I won't surrender my flame to him that easily.
If he fails my tests, he will die here, and his strength will be mine."

chapters.title: Chapter 883: Informations
paragraphs: The flame salamander had returned to Feltia [2]'s side and informed him about the Earth Flame's soul. However, he didn't want to be bothered with it now, and he asked Huo Yan to forget about the flame for now.
The flame salamander was disappointed by that, but it still followed Feltia [2]'s wishes, and it began to absorb the fire element inside the volcano.

In the area below, the cultivators began to have difficulty climbing once they reached half the area of the Hellblaze Volcano, and most of them could barely move due to the heavy gravity pressure in the area.

The five cultivators from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, who were accustomed to the five times gravity, began to experience difficulties, particularly Yuan Tianling and Yuan Tianhua. They were forced to take repeated breaks to rest their bodies, but they were lucky because the number of lava beasts that appeared was not as many as before, and the obstacles were also starting to decrease.
"I didn't expect the gravity to be heavier than in our realm." Yuan Tianhua said as she wiped her sweat.
Yuan Tianling repeatedly checked other areas for Zhang Fei [4], but he intentionally hid himself from her group. "How many more days until we reach the peak?"

Yuan Tiankong and Yuan Tianjie shook their heads at him, but Yuan Tianxie immediately gave his estimate. "The gravity in the upper area will be heavier than this, so I think we will only be able to reach the peak in two to three days."
"I'm afraid that fox has already reached that place, and he might be ahead of us in getting the Earth Flame." Yuan Tiankong said this.

"Why should you worry about him?" Yuan Tianjie asked. "Even if he managed to arrive there faster than us, he wouldn't necessarily be able to obtain the Earth Flame. That flame is not an ordinary flame, and it has a soul spirit, so I'm sure the process of obtaining it won't be easy."

"All right, you guys don't need to think about that kid and the flame, and you should focus on recovering your condition. Once we recover, we will start climbing again." The other four nodded in agreement with Yuan Tianxie, and they immediately closed their eyes, focusing on recovering their condition.

Unlike them, Zhang Fei [4] climbed at a leisurely pace, and Mei told him the whereabouts of several locations with abundant cultivation resources. Since there weren't many people in those areas, he decided to check them one by one.

The two assassins, Ying Yuan and Ying Huan, had returned to their base and reported to the old man about the results. However, the old man didn't seem to believe their story about Zhang Fei [5], so he asked them to share their memories with him.

After he witnessed their fight with Zhang Fei [5], the old man immediately contacted Long Jishan and Long Yingwu. Unfortunately, their souls were still imprisoned within the Abyssal Mirror, and they gave him no answers.
The old man ordered Ying Yuan and Ying Huan to recover their condition first, and he left their base for the floating island.
Ying Yuan and Ying Huan informed Zhang Fei [5] of the old man's departure, and the two immediately moved to use his pills on their other members.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
Zhang Fei [5] immediately checked the last beast's corpse, took the beast core, and opened the map to track the old man.
Feng Xishui suddenly appeared in front of him. "Did you do something to the Dragon Clan? I just got information that they sealed their clan since yesterday."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] then told him about his actions against the Dragon Clan, leaving him stunned for a while. "Their lust will continue to spiral out of control as long as I don't withdraw my pink gas from their bodies, and they will continue to have sex until they die. Luckily, they are dragons with high stamina, so they won't die anytime soon."
"Haha." Feng Xishui laughed out loud as he imagined the situation in the Dragon Clan. "Does that mean all of them are in that kind of condition now?"

"Not really." Zhang Fei [5] looked toward the Dragon Clan. "I injected a little into Long Jishan's body, so only a few should be affected." Since they sealed their clan, that means Long Aotian and the important people of the clan were affected by it. By the way, we have to be prepared because I'm sure Long Qiang will send members from their main clan to this realm, and they will probably arrive in a few days or weeks."

Feng Xishui nodded and patted his shoulder. "You don't need to worry about them because Feng Yongheng and I have already prepared everything. We will fight them if they decide to go to war with us. It might be more effective to take alternative actions against Long Aotian and others to reduce the number of individuals we need to fight."

Zhang Fei [5] had already arrived at the Phoenix Clan, and he found Feng Qingmeng already waiting for him there. However, he was confused by the presence of some of the leaders of the other beast clans, so he checked the map, finding that their names were still green. "Why are you all gathered here?"
"Do you have a problem with their main clans, Zhang Fei?" Yan Jinwu, the matriarch of the Golden Crow Clan, asked him back.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I met some of them when they left the Sun Tower, but I haven't met them since then. However, I can feel hostility from some of them, such as Wang Wugui, Dai Hubai, and Huli Xianniang."
"Dai Hubai asked me to find a way to capture you, but he didn't explain the details to me." Dai Baihu, the patriarch of the White Tiger Clan, told him.

Wang Guzhe also informed him. "Wang Wugui also asked me to do the same, but I will not follow his wishes without a detailed explanation. Since you said you never had any problems with them, I will ignore his order even if he punishes me later."
"Thank you, Old Wang." Wang Guzhe waved his hand while shaking his head at Zhang Fei [5].

"I think I know the reason behind Huli Xianniang's hostility toward you." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Huli Haohao. "She has a close relationship with Zhu Shanniang, and that woman has always hated the Heavenly Fox Race for no apparent reason."

Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that. "Isn't it ridiculous that Huli Xianniang is hostile to me for such a reason? I've already told Zhu Shanniang that I'm not part of the Heavenly Fox Race, and I've also told her about my intention to defeat their two ancestors, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing."

'Haohao isn't wrong about that, Fei.' Zhang Fei [5] looked at Zhu Lingyao, who had just arrived. 'I had a big fight with my sister last night because she asked me to capture you, but as usual, she was unwilling to give me a clear reason. Thus, I refused her request, and I asked her to capture you herself.'

Feng Qingmeng then spoke. "Zhang Fei, I think Dai Hubai and Wang Wugui's hostility toward you is because of Long Qiang. The three of them are not close friends, but they also need each other. That dragon knows that he cannot attack you by himself because of your status, so he probably asked them to work together with him to fight you. However, they won't possibly help him just like that, and I think there is something else behind this problem."
"I agree with Qingmeng, Zhang Fei." Dai Baihu and Wang Guzhe simultaneously spoke.

Zhang Fei [5] fell into thought after hearing that, especially since he had no problems with the other mythical beast races, except for his problem with the Dragon Clan. Moreover, they didn't know anything about him, except for his status as a heavenly fox. 'What really happened? What was the reason behind Wang Wugui and Dai Hubai's decision to help Long Qiang?'
[Master, I think I know the answer.]
'What's that?'

[The ten-tailed fox's prophecy about you.] Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow. [Since Long Huang and Long Baiyun know about it, I'm sure they also know about it, especially their ancestors. They should have known about your three identities, so they know that you are his heir. You yourself know that the ten-tailed fox is powerful, and its strength far surpasses theirs. Some mythical beast races might not worry too much about it, but some of them may not want a beast more powerful than them to exist in this universe, mainly because of their pride.]
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. 'They are afraid that I will suppress them if I become as strong as the ten-tailed fox, so some of them want to get rid of me before I become stronger.'
[That's right.]

'If that's true, I'm sure Huli Xianniang is hostile toward me not only because of Zhu Shanniang, but she hates me because she's afraid that I'll surpass and suppress her.' Zhang Fei [5] then recalled certain events. 'However, the names of Huli Jinhu and Huli Zhishen were still green on the map before they left the Xianjin Realm, so they were not hostile to me, and it was probably her own decision.'

[I think so, Master. So far, we know the ancestors of the Dragon Clan, the Black Tortoise Clan, and the White Tiger Clan are hostile towards you. Meanwhile, the ancestors of the other mythical beast clans have not shown any hostility towards you at all. From the Phoenix Clan, only Feng Shen is hostile towards you, which is because of the Divine Phoenix Totem.]

'I'm not too worried about Feng Shen, and I'm confident that I can defeat him if we fight one-on-one. However, the situation will be a little complicated if he asks the others to help him, and I can't possibly defeat them all at once.' Zhang Fei [5] stole a glance at Huli Haohao and the others. 'They are not hostile towards me now, but they might change sides if their ancestors order them to make a move against me. I have to think of something about them so they won't interfere in this matter.'

[Hehehe! Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao will definitely not be hostile to you, especially since one is loyal to Feng Yao and the other has already halfway fallen for you. As for the Golden Crow and Golden Fox Clans, you can try to approach Huli Haohao and Yan Jinwu first, and they will definitely be loyal to you if you manage to subdue them.]
"Zhang Fei?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at them. "I think I know their reasons for being hostile towards me, but I don't want to think about them right now. If they come at me one by one, I'll fight them head-on. If they intend to gang up on me, I just need to hide for a few years in seclusion, and I'll fight them once I come out."
Dai Baihu released a heavy sigh. "Kid, I don't know what really happened, but I hope we will never become enemies."

"I hope the same." Wang Guzhe said as he walked to the exit. "The cultivation world is never calm, and problems always come and go. I don't know if my wish will come true, but I hope for the presence of someone who can bring peace to this universe. Some people still continue to follow their ambitions, but some want to live in peace, like me. The older I get, the more I want a peaceful life."

"Hahaha." Yan Jinwu laughed upon hearing that and walked to Wang Guzhe's side. "Peace is the rarest thing in the cultivation world, and many people hope that peace will come one day. If the peacemaker is going to appear, I hope he or she will appear soon."
After that, Dai Baihu, Wang Guzhe, and Yan Jinwu immediately left the Phoenix Clan.
Huli Haohao wanted to leave, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately stopped her. "Senior, I want to know something about your golden fox clan."
"What do you want to know about my clan?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately asked Huli Haohao about a male golden fox who married a moon fox, causing her to frown. "How did you know about that?"
Zhang Fei [5] couldn't possibly tell Huli Haohao the truth. "I learned about this matter from Feng Yao, and I was curious about it."

"I see." Huli Haohao nodded in understanding. "Feng Yao is right; there was a male golden fox who married a moon fox. They had several descendants, but our race rejected their descendants because they were of mixed blood. Since then, they have lived in exile, and they should still be alive now."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised to hear that, as he thought that the golden fox race would kill them.

As if knowing Zhang Fei's thoughts, Huli Haohao spoke to him again. "Our race is not that cruel, and we will not kill those who choose to marry other fox races. In fact, there were many of them in the past, but some of them are dead now."
"Do you know where they live?"

"The male golden fox marries the moon fox, right?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Huli Haohao. "If I remember correctly, they live in the Hidden Mist Forest in the Mirage Heaven Realm. Why are you so curious about them?"
"Nothing." Huli Haohao suspiciously looked at Zhang Fei [5], but he responded with a tease. "Compared to them, I am more curious about you, Senior."
'Here we go again!' Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao said in their hearts.
"Are you thinking of seducing me, Kid?" Huli Haohao stole a glance at Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao. "You can seduce them, but you won't be able to seduce me."

"Is that true, Senior?" Zhang Fei [5] then stood in front of Huli Haohao and silently activated his enhanced demon charm, causing her heart to flutter. "Nothing is impossible in my dictionary, especially concerning women. You are beautiful and sexy, but you waste both of them in your solitude. Why don't you open yourself to your happiness? There are many beautiful places in this universe, and traveling through them with the one we love would be so much fun."

"Happiness, huh?" Huli Haohao muttered under her breath. "I once had my happiness, but my lover destroyed it. Since then, I no longer have any trust in men, and I will never give my heart to any man, including you. Therefore, you must get rid of your desire to seduce me from your mind, especially since you will never succeed."

Huli Haohao frowned as Zhang Fei [5] grabbed her hand, but her heartbeat quickened due to the effects of his enhanced demon charm. "Why don't you give me a chance, Senior? I'm sure I can help you regain your happiness, and I'll make you happier than you were in the past."
"Forget it." Huli Haohao immediately pulled her hand back. "I'm happy with my life, so I don't need your help."
Zhang Fei [5] smiled to himself after Huli Haohao disappeared. Then, he turned to Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao. The female phoenix wanted to escape, but he moved faster than her.
Zhang Fei [5] embraced Feng Qingmeng's waist and kissed her directly. 'This little bastard forcefully kissed me again!'
Feng Qingmeng wanted to push him back, but Zhang Fei [5] suddenly teleported and grabbed Zhu Lingyao. He then teleported again, taking the two women to another place.
A while later, they arrived at the mountain slope, and Zhang Fei [5] released them.
"Why did you bring us here?" Feng Qingmeng asked in confusion as she looked around the area.
Instead, Zhang Fei [5] approached a rock and pressed it, surprising Feng Qingmeng as the door to the hidden staircase opened. "Let's go in."
