As if knowing Zhang Fei's thoughts, Huli Haohao spoke to him again.
"Our race is not that cruel, and we will not kill those who choose to marry other fox races.
In fact, there were many of them in the past, but some of them are dead now."
"Do you know where they live?"
"The male golden fox marries the moon fox, right?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Huli Haohao.
"If I remember correctly, they live in the Hidden Mist Forest in the Mirage Heaven Realm.
Why are you so curious about them?"
"Nothing." Huli Haohao suspiciously looked at Zhang Fei [5], but he responded with a tease.
"Compared to them, I am more curious about you, Senior."
'Here we go again!' Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao said in their hearts.
"Are you thinking of seducing me, Kid?" Huli Haohao stole a glance at Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao.
"You can seduce them, but you won't be able to seduce me."
"Is that true, Senior?" Zhang Fei [5] then stood in front of Huli Haohao and silently activated his enhanced demon charm, causing her heart to flutter.
"Nothing is impossible in my dictionary, especially concerning women.
You are beautiful and sexy, but you waste both of them in your solitude.
Why don't you open yourself to your happiness?
There are many beautiful places in this universe, and traveling through them with the one we love would be so much fun."
"Happiness, huh?" Huli Haohao muttered under her breath.
"I once had my happiness, but my lover destroyed it.
Since then, I no longer have any trust in men, and I will never give my heart to any man, including you.
Therefore, you must get rid of your desire to seduce me from your mind, especially since you will never succeed."
Huli Haohao frowned as Zhang Fei [5] grabbed her hand, but her heartbeat quickened due to the effects of his enhanced demon charm.
"Why don't you give me a chance, Senior?
I'm sure I can help you regain your happiness, and I'll make you happier than you were in the past."
"Forget it." Huli Haohao immediately pulled her hand back.
"I'm happy with my life, so I don't need your help."
Zhang Fei [5] smiled to himself after Huli Haohao disappeared.
Then, he turned to Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao.
The female phoenix wanted to escape, but he moved faster than her.
Zhang Fei [5] embraced Feng Qingmeng's waist and kissed her directly. 'This little bastard forcefully kissed me again!'
Feng Qingmeng wanted to push him back, but Zhang Fei [5] suddenly teleported and grabbed Zhu Lingyao.
He then teleported again, taking the two women to another place.
A while later, they arrived at the mountain slope, and Zhang Fei [5] released them.
"Why did you bring us here?" Feng Qingmeng asked in confusion as she looked around the area.
Instead, Zhang Fei [5] approached a rock and pressed it, surprising Feng Qingmeng as the door to the hidden staircase opened.
"Let's go in."

chapters.title: Chapter 884: The Dark Fairy
paragraphs: "Why aren't you surprised by this place?" Feng Qingmeng questioned Zhu Lingyao as they followed Zhang Fei [5] down the stairs.

Zhu Lingyao smiled at her. 'You were occupied with your seclusion, so you didn't know about this place, and I've been here several times. The stairs up lead to the five-clawed golden dragon shrine, and the stairs down lead to his seal.'
'The five-clawed golden dragon once existed in this realm, huh?' Feng Qingmeng inwardly muttered as she looked toward the stairs leading up. "What do you mean by seal? What's sealed under there?"

"The Calamity Demon Dragon was born after the five-clawed golden dragon, and he is the second strongest dragon. For millions of years, he has remained sealed there, brimming with hatred." Zhang Fei [5]'s explanation shocked Feng Qingmeng, but his next explanation shocked her further. "I have added a protection device created by Gong Ren down below for safety, and the people from the Dragon Clan will not be able to free Long Zhaihuo. If not, the upper realms will encounter a more formidable threat than Xereth's, resulting in the destruction of everything."
Feng Qingmeng took a deep breath. "Have you told my princess about that dragon?"

"I told Feng Yao about Long Zhaihuo, but she asked me to take care of him myself." Feng Qingmeng felt strange about the Phoenix Princess's decision, and she felt that Zhang Fei [5] was not yet capable of facing such a monster. "As long as no one frees him, he will never be free. Moreover, Long Wuzhao has already prepared a way to stop him, but the outcome depends on the Dragon Clan's decision."
"What do you mean by that?"
"Only the Dragon Clan can summon Long Wuzhao's avatar, and the results will be determined if they want to use Long Zhaohuo for their purposes."
Feng Qingmeng nodded in understanding. "That's why you added an additional layer of protection there, right?"
"Yeah."
When they arrived there, Nalan Yushu immediately released the female dark fairy's soul, shocking Feng Qingmeng, who had just seen the two for the first time.
Unlike before, the female dark fairy was no longer like a doll, and her black eyes had regained their luster. "Thank you, Zhang Fei."
"I should be the one thanking you, especially since you helped me understand the darkness elemental law." Zhang Fei [5] then asked her. "What's your name?"
"Ling Xiannu."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "You still can't reshape your body, right?"

Feng Qingmeng was even more shocked once Ma Kuangyu came out of Zhang Fei [5]'s soul space. "Kid, she has been dead for too long, and her soul power is at rock bottom. If she wants to reform her body, she must increase her soul power first, and she also needs many precious treasures to reshape her body."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I can help her increase her soul power, but I don't know what kind of precious treasure she needs to reshape her body."
Ma Kuangyu mentioned a few things directly. "The Rebirth Soul Grass, the Phoenix Nirvana Herb, the Dragonblood Pearl, the Golden Vein Earth Ginseng, Fresh Human Bone Marrow, and Body Reshaping Pond."
Mei immediately recorded all of that in the system, and Zhang Fei asked Ma Kuangyu. "Don't tell me that the Body Reshaping Pond only exists in the Paradise Realm."

"That's right." Ma Kuangyu nodded at him. "Usually, we cultivators can reshape our bodies without using them. Even I can do that, but I still need some other materials. Unfortunately, Ling Xiannu can't do it, especially since she died ages ago. Actually, you can use a shortcut to help her, but I don't recommend that."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately realized what Ma Kuangyu meant. "The shortcut is to let her take over another woman's body, especially a woman who has just died."

"Hehehe! You are clever, Master." Nalan Yushu then embraced Ling Xiannu's soul. "If you like, I can help her with that. You just need to find the body of a beautiful, powerful, virgin woman for her. The best choice is a female beast, as their bodies are generally stronger than those of humans."
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Ling Xiannu before rejecting Nalan Yushu's idea. "I prefer to look for those treasures for her, and she can be her true self after reshaping her body."

"Most cultivators decide to take the hard path because they want to be themselves, but many of them decide to take the easy path by taking over other people's bodies, especially heretics. After all, they have to restart their cultivation from the beginning if they reshape their bodies, but they don't have to do that if they take over other people's bodies, and they will obtain their cultivation." Nalan Yushu then asked Ling Xiannu. "What about you? Do you want to take the hard path or the easy path?"
"I leave the decision to Zhang Fei." Ling Xiannu replied with a smile.
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly remembered something. "Hey! We cultivators can store our strength in our soul space, like Feng Yao and you two, right?"

Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao were shocked when Zhang Fei [5] mentioned Feng Yao's name in their conversation, raising several questions in their minds. 'Doesn't that mean she has died before? How and when did she die?'

"Master." Nalan Yushu called out softly. "Not all cultivators can do that, especially those in the three mortal realms. We need a special method to store our strength and memories in our soul, and we have to do it right before we die; only then can we regain our past strength and memories. Even if we do that, we won't immediately become as strong as before we die, and we have to strengthen ourselves gradually like Feng Yao did."

"After reincarnation, our body strength was at its lowest point, unable to immediately accommodate our past strength. That's why Feng Yao didn't immediately raise her strength to her past peak but instead gradually increased it." Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] sent Nalan Yushu, Ma Kuangyu, and Ling Xiannu into his soul space. "What are you two thinking?"
"Has my princess ever died before?" Feng Qingmeng asked back.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Feng Yao never died in this life, but she died in her past life. You don't need to ask me about her past life, especially since she still kept it a secret from me."

"Then, who were those three people just now? Were they all just souls?" Zhang Fei [5] told Feng Qingmeng about his meeting with Nalan Yushu, Ma Kuangyu, and Ling Xiannu. "So, the man helped you suppress Long Aotian that time, right?"

Zhang Fei [5] pulled Feng Qingmeng into his arms and hugged her tightly. "Do you think I can suppress Long Aotian with my current strength? Not only is he stronger than me, but he is also a mythical beast, rendering my bloodline useless against him."

"Let me go." Zhang Fei [5] responded to Feng Qingmeng by kissing her lips, frustrating her because he always acted as he pleased. She wanted to push him back, but Zhu Lingyao suddenly spoke into her mind, causing her to sigh.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately separated their lips, took the two women by the arms, and led them back to the surface. However, he stopped after a few steps and turned his head towards the seal, frowning.
'Is that dragon talking to you?' Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Zhu Lingyao before walking off again.

Sometime later, they had arrived at the floating island, and Feng Qingmeng hurriedly returned to the Blazing Phoenix Sect. On the other hand, Zhang Fei [5] brought Zhu Lingyao to her room in the Vermilion Sect, and the two lay on the bed with her head on his chest. 'Are you thinking about your conversation with them earlier?'
"Yeah." Zhang Fei answered with a light nod. "You know about the ten-tailed fox's prophecy, right?"

'There's no beast that doesn't know about it, and all natural races know about it too. Honestly, I was shocked after finding out your three identities, especially since you were the man in the prophecy.'

"If my guess is right, Da Hubai, Wang Wugui, Huli Xianniang, and Zhu Shanniang are hostile toward me because of the prophecy. They are afraid that I will surpass them and oppress them, so they are thinking of capturing or killing me before that happens." Zhu Lingyao looked up at Zhang Fei [5] and thought about her sister's attitude towards the Heavenly Fox Race, and she knew for sure that her sister had never had any serious problems with them in the past, so her hatred was unfounded. "Will you also be hostile toward me one day?"
'Do you think I would let you be here if I were like that?' Zhu Lingyao asked with an irritated look.

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "Your soul is much better and more pure compared to Zhu Shanniang, so I want you to be my woman. However, our relationship is not that deep yet, and everyone's heart can still change. You can say that now, but you might betray me or try to kill me in the future."

Zhu Lingyao nodded in agreement. 'You're right; I might change my mind in the future. If I change my mind, I'll strip your fur and skin you alive. After that, I'll tie your body to the stake and roast your beast meat for myself to eat.'
"Hey! Since when do birds eat meat?"
'Since today.' Zhu Lingyao immediately bit Zhang Fei [5]'s neck.

"Ouch... Ouch... Stop biting me, Yaoyao." Zhu Lingyao immediately stopped and looked at Zhang Fei [5] with repeated blinks. "Hehe! Why are you looking at me like this? Somehow I feel that addressing you as Yaoyao is much nicer, so I'll call you that from now on."
Zhu Lingyao released a soft sigh. 'You can only call me that when we're together, okay?'

"Okay." Zhang Fei [5] pinned Zhu Lingyao beneath him and kissed her, which she immediately reciprocated while embracing his neck. He wanted to go further with her, but he realized that he was not ready for that yet.

In the residence of the Golden Fox Clan, Huli Haohao sat alone by the window of her room. She gazed towards the Phoenix Clan's location, pressing a hand to her chest. "What kind of demon is he, really? I'm sure that he used a charm technique on me earlier, or else my heart wouldn't be beating this fast, and his image wouldn't keep appearing in my mind. My race is renowned for our natural charm, but his charm is much stronger than mine, and I can't shake it off no matter how hard I try."
Huli Haohao raised an eyebrow as soon as she received a voice transmission from Huli Xianniang, who asked her to use all means to bring Zhang Fei [5] to her.

"Why did she ask me to bring him to her now? Has she changed her mind about him? Previously, she asked me to capture or kill him, but now she has given other orders." Huli Haohao immediately replied to Huli Xianniang's voice message by refusing her orders, enraging her. "Our ancestors didn't say anything, so if she wants to get Zhang Fei [5], she has to do it herself. I don't care if she will punish me or kill me, especially since my life is already too boring."

After they captured the old assassin, the two male phoenixes brought him to the Phoenix Clan. Feng Xishui then informed Zhang Fei [5] about him, but he did not give him an answer. "That kid seems to be having fun with Zhu Lingyao, so we can only wait for him to come back."
"It's not a big deal." Feng Yongheng then turned to the woman who had just arrived. "Why did you come here, Long Zhenxia? Didn't your patriarch forbid your clan members to have contact with us?"
"She must have come here for Zhang Fei [5]." Feng Xishui said.

"I am indeed looking for Zhang Fei [5]. Is he here, Senior?" Both men shook their heads, disappointing Long Zhenxin. "The situation in my Dragon Clan is chaotic right now, and many of them have turned lustful since yesterday, including my parents and brother. My brother even wanted to force himself on me, so I knocked him unconscious and ran away from there."
Feng Yongheng turned to Feng Xishui, who smiled strangely. 'Were you involved in that?'
'No.' Feng Xishui told him about Zhang Fei [5]'s action against the Dragon Clan. "If you want to meet that kid, you can wait for him here, and we will leave now."

"Yes, Senior." After they left, Long Zhenxia immediately sat down in front of Zhang Fei [5]'s room, leaned against the wall, and pondered. 'Could it be that he has something to do with the issues affecting my clan? How did he do that?'

As night fell, Zhang Fei decided to send all the women and his family members to the training space. Naturally, he did not forget Murong Mengying and Wang Yourou, especially since both of them had agreed to be his women. He originally wanted to bring Shang Yingyue and Wu Xueming, but they asked to wait for the situation to calm down first.

After he taught Murong Mengying and Wang Yourou to practice there, Zhang Fei immediately left and went to the Nine Stars Realm, especially since Xian Xianjue and Shi Baoyin had stayed there for several days, and Feng Qingmeng asked him to take them back to the Sky Dragon Realm.

As they had originally planned, Zhang Fei sent Xian Feng, Shi Qingzhuang, and Xian Changyue to the Sky Dragon Realm with their parents. Afterwards, he sent Xian Xianqin back to the training space, instructing her to cultivate in the pavilion, while he personally went to see his other wife.
When he arrived at the residence on the small island, Zhang Fei found Helian Yueyi contemplating something on a park bench. "Are you thinking about me?"

Startled, Helian Yueyi looked directly at Zhang Fei, her feelings complicated, particularly regarding their status as husband and wife. They got married two weeks ago, but he has never come to see her since then, making her feel strange. "Why did you come here all of a sudden?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei lifted Helian Yueyi and embraced her waist. "You are my wife, remember? It's only natural that I met you, right? I actually wanted to meet you, but I know your feelings haven't calmed down, even though Huangfu Shou has been dead for quite some time. Thus, I gave you time to think about everything calmly, and I think you should have calmed down by now."

Helian Yueyi nodded at Zhang Fei. "I'm calm now, but I still have many questions in my mind. We never had a good relationship, and you always considered my family enemies, but we're married now. Did you marry me just for my body?"

"Do you really think so?" Zhang Fei then caressed Helian Yueyi's cheeks. "If I only wanted your body, I wouldn't have bothered giving you time to calm down, and I would have claimed you since our wedding two weeks ago."
Helian Yueyi silently looked at Zhang Fei, thinking about his words just now.
Zhang Fei gave Helian Yueyi's lips a gentle and brief kiss. He then took out the two beauty pills, placed them into her mouth, and helped her swallow them.
"What are those two pills?" Helian Yueyi knew that Zhang Fei would not harm her.
Zhang Fei smiled. "You will know their effects in a few minutes."

Minutes later, Helian Yueyi panicked when her body was filled with a smelly black liquid, but Zhang Fei immediately stripped her naked and cleaned it off her body. He then took out a mirror and asked her to look at her new appearance, which shocked her.
As she stared at her reflection, Helian Yueyi groped her face in disbelief, especially since she had regained her youth in just a few minutes. "Where did you get your pills?"

Lao Renshi took him to one of the cities in the lower land, which was the city where Zhuang Qiaoming and his Zhuang Clan lived.
However, the man still had not arrived in that realm, and he told him that he would arrive in a few days.
Since it was already midnight, Zhang Fei [5] decided to spend the night in the city, and he asked Lao Renshi to explain many things to him.
[Daily Quest: Killing 2000 beasts or demon beasts at the Heaven Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 demon auras.]
[Reward: 100 advanced demon cores.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 100 purple jewels.]

Quickly, another two days passed, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] stood in front of the flying artifact with the Demon Extermination Sword in his hand, especially since the realm in front of him was the birthplace of that sword, the Starry Sky Realm.
To Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s surprise, Tian Huangjin had also just arrived in that realm.
"Why did you only arrive today, Senior?
I thought you arrived a few days ago."

"On the way here, I sensed something unusual from the dead realm, but I didn't find anything there after checking it for two days." Tian Huangjin then landed beside Zhang Xiaolong [3] and pointed toward a mountain in the realm.
"Xereth should be there, so we should enter the realm slowly.
Besides, I think we should attack him together, or he will escape again."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Zhe Wuming and the others behind them.
"What do you guys think about that?"
"I think that's the best idea." Zhe Wuming then spoke to Gong Ren.
"Prepare the device, and we'll use it to restrict Xereth's movements.
All of you better be careful, especially you, Feng Jiu.
You are a fire phoenix, and that demon might target you, especially since everything about you is too valuable."
Feng Jiu nodded to him.
"I'll definitely be careful."
"Master, you can focus on that demon, and I will protect Jiujiu from that demon." Xue Bao immediately jumped onto Feng Jiu's shoulder and curled up there.
"Activate the concealment formation, and we will enter this realm now." Feng Jiu immediately followed Zhe Wuming's order, and her flying artifact slowly flew into that realm.
[Ding.]
[The system has already recorded the Starry Sky Realm, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Starry Sky Realm.]

'As expected, there are no quests in this realm.' The Demon Extermination Sword suddenly vibrated strongly in Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hand. 'I understand how you two feel, but you should calm yourselves down first, and I will find a way to help you guys take revenge on Xereth.'

chapters.title: Chapter 886: Taotie's Avatar
paragraphs: "You should wait here because Xereth is too strong for the current you." Tian Huangjin spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3] as she summoned her golden sword.

Zhe Wuming also spoke to him. "I know you want to help the spirit woman in your sword take revenge, but Xereth is different from all the enemies you have fought so far. Thus, you must be careful in your actions, or we cannot protect you."
"Here." Gong Ren gave a device to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I don't know if it will be useful in blocking Xereth's attacks, but you can keep it in case he finds you and attacks you."
"Thank you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] accepted the device.
Hun Di patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder. "You are still young, so I forbid you from pushing yourself, and you should run away if the situation is much worse than we expect."

"Master, you know that I'm not that weak, right?" Hun Di nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I may not be as strong as you all, but I have many tricks. I won't run away from battle, and I won't attack Xereth recklessly. If a good opportunity opens up, I'll help you all attack him from a distance."
Hun Di nodded again. "You can do it, but you must do it if the situation allows it."

"Yes, Master." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then opened the map, and Xereth was indeed at the mountain that Tian Huangjin had pointed out before. "There's a barrier protecting that place, but I don't know how strong it is."
"Leave that barrier to me, and you guys move immediately after I destroy it." Tian Huangjin confidently said.
The concealment formation on the mountain had prevented Xereth, still recovering from his injuries, from noticing their presence.

As soon as the flying artifact was close enough to the mountain, Tian Huangjin immediately flew out while holding the hilt of her golden sword. Golden light enveloped her body, and hundreds of golden swords materialized behind her. "Sacred Wing Severance."
Hearing the voice, Xereth opened his eyes immediately, but he was too late. In that instant, those golden swords stabbed into the barrier protecting the area, shattering it into pieces.
*Boom*
"Fuck!" Xereth flew away and took out his black scythe. 'How did this bitch find me in this realm?'
"Judgment lights." Dozens of golden rays immediately shot toward Xereth as soon as Tian Huagjin said that.
"Shit!" Xereth wanted to counter Tian Huangjin's attacks, but he was shocked by the sudden appearance of Zhe Wuming, Gong Ren, Hun Di, Ji Changlan, and Feng Jiu.
They surrounded Xereth, and Gong Ren swiftly threw the device he had prepared beforehand. Several chains quickly shot towards him, binding his hands and feet.

Feng Jiu shot several small fire phoenixes toward Xereth, and Hun Di used his soul technique to control his soul. Meanwhile, Ji Changlan had already grasped a large hammer, and he smashed it towards the demon.
Meanwhile, Zhe Wuming made several symbols with both his hands, and their area was quickly enveloped by a transparent wall that was almost invisible to the eye.

"Heh!" Xereth sneered as he shot dozens of black lights toward Tian Huangjin's golden rays, and they collided with each other. The golden rays vanished instantly, and the black lights shot toward her, which she immediately deflected.

"You guys look down on me too much, you lowly bastards!" Xereth screamed loudly as he shook off Hun Di's control over his soul, causing the Soul Emperor to spurt blood from his mouth. He also destroyed Gong Ren's device with one attack before he counterattacked Ji Changlan with his black scythe, leaving a deep slash wound on the old blacksmith's chest.
Xereth flew towards Feng Jiu to capture her, but Xue Bao returned to his beast form and swung his tail at the demon.
"Arghh!" Xue Bao screamed in pain as Xereth cut off his tail.
"Bao'er!" Zhe Wuming immediately moved in front of them and thrust both swords in his hands toward Xereth, but the demon swiftly broke them both and swung the black scythe at him.
*Clang*
Xereth immediately flew away as his attack on Zhe Wuming failed because of the invisible wall that suddenly appeared between them, and he knew that it was a void wall.
"You won't get away with it this time." Xereth spun around and blocked Tian Huangjin's golden sword.
*Clang*
"Heh! Coward!"

Xereth unleashed his darkness, forcing Tian Huangjin to stay away from him, especially since it was not ordinary darkness. He then slashed his scythe a few times, shattering the invisible wall around them. After that, he flew high into the sky, firing several attacks at them.
Zhe Wuning and the others hurriedly parried Xereth's attacks, but they were knocked back quite a distance due to the vast difference in their strength, spurting blood from their mouths.
Unlike them, Tian Huangjin easily repelled Xereth's attack, and she hurriedly flew towards him while covered in golden light.

Xereth spread his darkness as far as possible, especially since he knew that Tian Huangjin would not dare to approach him in such a situation. "I don't know how you all managed to find me in this realm, but you're underestimating me, bitch! I'm much stronger when I use my real body, and I can also use all my abilities with this."
Tian Huangjin frowned as she shot her golden rays, but they were instantly absorbed by Xereth's darkness. 'His darkness is stronger than I imagined.'
"Hahaha!" Xereth laughed at Tian Huangjin's expression. "You could defeat me easily when I used my spare bodies, but you won't be able to do it this time."
Xereth suddenly felt something coming from behind, and he immediately swung his scythe behind him, but his attack only hit empty air.

"Another rat, huh? A fast rat." Xereth muttered as he tried to find the whereabouts of Zhang Xiaolong [3], who decided to make a move after he helped Hun Di and the others. "Your ability should be an invisibility ability, right? I don't know how you can have such an ability, and I also can't track you anywhere because of your high speed, but you will never be able to get close to me or hurt me with such an ability."

After he said that, Xereth looked at Gong Ren and the others, but he was only interested in Feng Jiu. "Someone has captured Feng Yichen, so I will capture you and turn you into a dark phoenix, and you will become my plaything."
Feng Jiu shuddered upon hearing that, but Zhe Wuming and the others immediately flew to her side to protect her.

"Hey! Foolish demon! Can you get an erection?" Xereth frowned as Zhang Xiaolong [3] said this using his Qi from afar so that the demon couldn't track him. "Feng Yichen has been by your side for hundreds of thousands of years, but she is still a virgin to this day. Thus, I doubt your status as a man, and I am sure you cannot have an erection."
"Pfftt." Feng Jiu and the others burst into laughter hearing that.

"You bastard!" Xereth immediately attacked in various directions, including towards Feng Jiu and the others. However, Tian Huangjin immediately flew in front of them and protected them from his attacks.

"Hahahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed loudly. "Oh, by the way, Feng Yichen's moans sounded erotic, did you know that? Unlike you, I was a healthy man, and he couldn't stop writhing beneath me, and he kept begging me to satisfy her."
Xereth suddenly realized something. "You must be the damn brat who has disrupted all my plans, including my plans in the Blue Water Realm."
"It's good that you noticed, but you won't be able to do anything to me."
"Hmm?" Xereth looked up at the sky as a giant, ethereal demon claw appeared above him. "A demon? Impossible! How can a demon like you hold that damn sword?"
"Because I'm a special demon."
Xereth instantly shattered Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s demon claw, but it was quickly replaced by a bright white circle with many symbols on it, causing the male demon to gasp in shock.
"Exorcismus!"

Countless white lights immediately rained down towards Xereth, and the male demon tried to thwart them with his darkness. However, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s light element is different from other light elements, and those white lights instantly purify the darkness.

"What the fuck!" Xereth immediately flew away from Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s attack range, causing those white lights to rain down on the mountain below. "How is this possible? How can a demon like you use the light element?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] said nothing, took out his Qi gun, channeled his light and fire elements into it, and fired it towards Xereth.
*Swoosh*
"What the hell is that?" Xereth immediately swung his scythe and shot a crescent-shaped darkness at it, and the two immediately collided in the air.
*Boom*
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] overcame the demon's attack, and it continued speeding towards Xereth, forcing the demon to avoid it.
*Boom*
Another explosion was heard as Zhang Xiaolong [3] hit the mountain, leaving a large hole there. 'Shit! I will be seriously injured if I get hit by that attack.'

Xereth gasped in shock as the white circle appeared again, and it was not just one but several of them, followed by several ethereal demon claws. Spiral flames also shot towards him, especially after Zhang Xiaolong [3] used the Hellflame Incantation.

A light female figure of a winged race appeared in the distance with a white bow and arrow in her hand, and she shot it toward Xereth. He easily destroyed the white arrow, but she continued to shoot her arrows at him.
"Exorcismus!"

Those white circles immediately dropped countless white lights towards Xereth, forcing the demon to flee away. 'Shit! I have to think of a way to find that bastard's whereabouts, or he will continue to attack me without me being able to fight him back.'

Unbeknownst to Xereth, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already moved behind Feng Jiu and the others, and he gave them some instructions. 'Senior Huangjin, I know you don't dare to approach his darkness, but you can attack him without worrying about it, and I will absorb it into my body.'
"All right." Tian Huangjin immediately led them to fly towards Xereth, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] stopped Feng Jiu, especially since the demon was going to target her.
Xereth, who was busy avoiding the white light, frowned after sensing their movement. He shot his darkness toward them, but it quickly disappeared as it was absorbed by Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Shit." Xereth accelerated his flight speed as a golden light shot out from Tian Huangjin's golden sword. Without his darkness, he did not dare to face her attack directly, especially since she was stronger than him. 'Damn it! I'm going to die here if I don't do something.'
Tian Huangjin immediately stopped flying as she stopped the others, especially after Xereth took a device. "Send us back! Otherwise, we will die!"
Zhe Wuming and the others looked confused by that, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked her. 'What do you mean by that?'
"Do as I say!" Tian Huangjin urgently shouted.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] instantly enveloped their bodies with his aura, and he teleported them to Feng Jiu's side. Then, he opened the gate to the Xianjin Realm and pushed them into it, and he followed behind them.
Xereth realized it was too late, and the gate had disappeared from the realm. Moreover, he had already activated his device and couldn't cancel it. "Shit!"

A black light shot out from Xereth's device towards the sky, causing the sky in the realm to rumble violently. Soon, a giant beast descended from the sky, which was none other than Taotie, one of the four perils.

Taotie is a mythical evil beast, embodying endless greed and insatiable hunger. Its hideous body is a chaotic amalgamation of various beasts. The strong, muscular limbs of a lion, the scaled back of a dragon, and the twisted horns of an ancient ram. Its thick, matted fur changes color from old charcoal to molten orange, and bright red markings circle its body like cursed runes.

Taotie is known to devour whatever it encounters, from enemies to entire landscapes, leaving nothing behind but barren wastelands. Legends say it can never be truly satisfied, cursed to an eternal hunger that fuels its monstrous rampages.
'Damn it!' Xereth immediately stowed his scythe and prostrated himself in the air as Taotie's figure fully appeared, causing him to tremble violently due to his miscalculation.

Taotie looked at Xereth with its ember eyes before looking around the area around the realm. "Why did you summon my avatar to such a disgusting place? Have you succeeded in carrying out all your duties?"

"M... master, I haven't managed to find them." Xereth answered in a trembling voice. "Master... please forgive me... I... I made a miscalculation, and I had already summoned your avatar when they disappeared."

Taotie narrowed its eyes at Xereth before shooting a blackish-red light at him, and it latched onto his head directly. It read all his memories, including his battle with Tian Huangjin and the others just now. "I didn't expect the situation of the three mortal realms to have changed so much compared to the last time I came down here. Moreover, there is a living being who can use light and dark elements simultaneously, and the ability to open the gate is familiar to me."
"Master... the ability to open the gate is an ability belonging to the Heavenly Fox Race, and that race is the direct descendant of the ten-tailed fox."
"Did you fail to catch those two foxes?" Xereth nodded, explaining to Taotie about Tian Baixing and Tian Baixing.
"What a useless slave!"
"Gahh!" As soon as Taotie attacked him, Xereth cried out in pain. "Master... please give me a chance. I will definitely find them and capture them, and I will also take care of the others."

"Humph!" Taotie snorted disdainfully. "You are lucky that I can't come down here, so I will give you another chance to complete all your tasks. If you fail to complete them when the time is up, I will eat you alive, and you will never be able to reincarnate."

After saying that. Taotie's avatar immediately disappeared, allowing Xereth to breathe a sigh of relief. He immediately stood up and attacked the entire area of the realm to vent his frustration. "Fuck! All of this happened because of that damn kid! I have to find him and capture him as soon as possible, or he will continue to ruin my plans.
Since they already knew where he was hiding in that realm, Xereth decided to leave that place and go to another realm.
"What exactly happened? Why did you ask me to take us away?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] questioned Tian Huangjin.
Tian Huangjin let out a soft sigh before explaining to them. "The device that Xereth took out earlier was a device to summon Taotie's avatar."
"Taotie!" Zhang Xiaolong [3], Feng Jiu, and Xue Bao shouted at the same time.

"That's right." Tian Huangjin then continued. "Taotie is one of the ancient evil mythical beasts, and his strength is not inferior to the five-clawed golden dragon, Long Wuzhao. Even if it's just his avatar, he can kill all of us, and we won't be able to reincarnate if he swallows us alive."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "I've heard that Taotie is the embodiment of greed and insatiable hunger, and he will swallow everything in front of him, be it living or non-living things."

"Yes." Tian Huangjin nodded at him. "Taotie's abilities are far beyond your imagination; not even the ten demon gods in the Paradise Realm dare to face him head-on. No humans, natural races, or demons are able to defeat him. The only ones who can fight him and the other three evil mythical beasts are those ancient mythical beasts like Long Wuzhao."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh. "I'm sure Xereth will leave the Starry Star Realm after today's incident, so we have to track his whereabouts again. By the way, can he still use that device?"
"Yes." Tian Huangjin then turned around. "I will track Xereth's whereabouts, and I will contact you if I manage to find him."

"I didn't expect the situation of the three mortal realms to have changed so much compared to the last time I came down here.
Moreover, there is a living being who can use light and dark elements simultaneously, and the ability to open the gate is familiar to me."
"Master... the ability to open the gate is an ability belonging to the Heavenly Fox Race, and that race is the direct descendant of the ten-tailed fox."
"Did you fail to catch those two foxes?" Xereth nodded, explaining to Taotie about Tian Baixing and Tian Baixing.
"What a useless slave!"
"Gahh!" As soon as Taotie attacked him, Xereth cried out in pain.
"Master... please give me a chance.
I will definitely find them and capture them, and I will also take care of the others."
"Humph!" Taotie snorted disdainfully.
"You are lucky that I can't come down here, so I will give you another chance to complete all your tasks.
If you fail to complete them when the time is up, I will eat you alive, and you will never be able to reincarnate."
After saying that.
Taotie's avatar immediately disappeared, allowing Xereth to breathe a sigh of relief.
He immediately stood up and attacked the entire area of the realm to vent his frustration.
"Fuck!
All of this happened because of that damn kid!
I have to find him and capture him as soon as possible, or he will continue to ruin my plans.
Since they already knew where he was hiding in that realm, Xereth decided to leave that place and go to another realm.
"What exactly happened?
Why did you ask me to take us away?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] questioned Tian Huangjin.
Tian Huangjin let out a soft sigh before explaining to them.
"The device that Xereth took out earlier was a device to summon Taotie's avatar."
"Taotie!" Zhang Xiaolong [3], Feng Jiu, and Xue Bao shouted at the same time.
"That's right." Tian Huangjin then continued.
"Taotie is one of the ancient evil mythical beasts, and his strength is not inferior to the five-clawed golden dragon, Long Wuzhao.
Even if it's just his avatar, he can kill all of us, and we won't be able to reincarnate if he swallows us alive."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding.
"I've heard that Taotie is the embodiment of greed and insatiable hunger, and he will swallow everything in front of him, be it living or non-living things."
"Yes." Tian Huangjin nodded at him.
"Taotie's abilities are far beyond your imagination; not even the ten demon gods in the Paradise Realm dare to face him head-on.
No humans, natural races, or demons are able to defeat him.
The only ones who can fight him and the other three evil mythical beasts are those ancient mythical beasts like Long Wuzhao."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh.
"I'm sure Xereth will leave the Starry Star Realm after today's incident, so we have to track his whereabouts again.
By the way, can he still use that device?"
"Yes." Tian Huangjin then turned around.
"I will track Xereth's whereabouts, and I will contact you if I manage to find him."

chapters.title: Chapter 887: Earth Flame Tests
paragraphs: "Master! I'm going to see Tian Yishen to recover my tail!"

"All right." Zhe Wuming then released a heavy sigh and looked up at the barrier protecting the Tianjin Realm. "Xereth destroyed my void barrier and void swords so easily. This barrier is also made of my void element, so it is not enough to protect us from him, and he will destroy it once he arrives in this realm."
"Xereth's attack was extremely painful; it fractured my arm bones." Ji Changlan spoke as he held his right arm.

"I always boasted of my abilities in the soul cultivation path, but Xereth shook off my control over his soul and attacked me back with a soul attack, and my soul was injured because of him." Hun Di spoke with disappointment in his tone.

"Master, Xereth's cultivation is at the 3-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, and your cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, remember?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] patted Hun Di on the shoulder to comfort him. "The difference between the two stages is too extreme, so there's no need to be disappointed in yourself. However, we have to think of other plans now, especially since we will never be able to stop him from attacking us, let alone if he summons Taotie's avatar like before."
"Who can stop Xereth and Taotie's avatar? Even if all the cultivators in the upper realms join forces, we will never be able to stop them." Ji Chang spoke pessimistically.

"Feng Yao." Ji Changlan and the others turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Honestly, I don't know for sure the depth of her strength, but I know that she still hides her true strength, and her true strength should have already surpassed the limit of the Seven Divine Realms."
Hun Di and the two men turned to Feng Jiu, who shook her head helplessly. "My daughter will never interfere in matters in the three mortal realms, and she wants us to deal with Xereth ourselves."
"Why is Feng Yao so selfish? She is part of the upper realms, so she should help us to stop Xereth." Ji Changlan spoke with a frown.

"I've persuaded Yao'er, but she's already made up her mind." Feng Jiu herself was disappointed with her daughter's decision. "She said that if we fail to stop her and the upper realm is destroyed because of it, we are not worthy of ascending to the Paradise Realm."

Ji Changlan frowned deeper after Feng Jiu said that, but Zhe Wuming stopped him immediately. "Since Feng Yao has already decided, we don't need to force her to help us. Xereth's strength made me realize that there is still a much higher sky up there, and we will never be able to reach it if we rely on others. I don't know when he will attack this realm, but I will enter seclusion starting today, and you guys should do the same."
"I plan to return to the Phoenix Realm, especially since my realm is the best place for me to do seclusion." Feng Jiu informed them
Zhe Wuming had no problem with that, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] could pick Feng Jiu up if they needed her strength. "What about the three of you?"
"Gong Ren and I will enter seclusion together." Ji Changlan answered him.
Gong Ren nodded in agreement. "We will enter seclusion in this realm."

"Master, you can perform seclusion in my private place, and I will bring the others with us." Hun Di immediately agreed with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Let's go back; we'll pick up the others, and I'll send you all there after."
"Please send me back to my realm first." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened the gate to the Phoenix Realm, Feng Jiu immediately disappeared into it.
Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Hun Di went to Cheng Gaoji's residence. Gong Ren and Ji Changlan went to their secret place, and Zhe Wuming sealed his room to enter seclusion.
After they arrived there, Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought everyone into his training space, including Tantai Lingyan, Cheng Gaoji, and Yue Qinhua.
"Where did you get this kind of place?" Hun Di immediately asked as soon as they arrived at the training space.

"Master, this place was given to me by the young girl who killed and revived me." Since Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already told them about the early events before he became a cultivator, Hun Di and the others were no longer surprised to hear him mention the young girl. He then explained to them about the device in the middle of the room, including every feature of it.

"You cheated, junior brother!" Yan Yinqing and Jing Qiuyue exclaimed at the same time. "No wonder you can be this strong with your cultivation still in the Ten Mortal Realms; it's all because of this training ground."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed while rubbing his nose. "Senior Sisters, after you two train here, you will become stronger than me, and I won't be able to defeat you anymore."
"Do you live there?" Lin Moxian pointed to the pavilion.

"I and all my women live there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then pointed at the portable mansion and the cloud mansion. "All my family and the families of my wives live there, and all my acquaintances live in the other mansion."

"In that case, Senior Sister Jing, Yue Qinhua, and I will stay with your family members. As for my mother, you can bring her to your pavilion, and you can spend more time together." Tantai Lingyan glared fiercely at Yan Yinqing, but she responded by sticking out her tongue before pulling the other two women into the Portable Mansion.
Tantai Lingyan wanted to follow them, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly grabbed her hand and brought her into the Heavenly Bliss Pavilion straight away, leaving Hun Di and the others behind.
"Where will we live, husband?" Shang Yingyue asked her husband.

"There." Wu Xueming pointed to the Portable Mansion. "Sooner or later, we will be his family, especially if our daughter marries him in the future. Thus, we must familiarize ourselves with his family members."
Shang Yingyue let out a soft sigh, especially since Wu Lianzhi was only 12 years old, so it was still too early to talk about her marriage with Zhang Fei. "Let's go there to meet them."
"Yeah."
After they left, Lin Moxian spoke to Hun Di and the other two men. "I think we should stay in the other mansion together with my junior brother's acquaintances."

"I have no problem with that." Qiao Liangren and Cheng Gaoji nodded their heads in response. They then went to check out the Cloud Mansion and met the people inside, most of whom were dual cultivators.

Unlike them, Hun Di did not go to the Cloud Mansion, and he sat on one side of the training space to recover from his soul injury first. 'Fortunately, Zhang Fei has such a place, and my injuries will recover faster if I stay here.'
Tantai Lingyan was furious after Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought her to the pavilion, but he left her and went to the rooms of his two partners, where he dual-cultivated with Xie Jingxian and Ba Shuxiang.

Although she had met all of Zhang Fei's wives before, Tantai Lingyan was still uncomfortable with the situation in the pavilion, especially since it was too absurd with dozens of naked women walking around casually there.
Despite her feelings, Tantai Lingyang was curious to cultivate there, as she could feel that the Qi inside was much better than in the training space thanks to the Boundless Yin-Yang Array.
"Sister Lingyan." Tantai Lingyan turned to Liu Hua and Liu Qingyu, who were approaching them. "I'm glad our husband finally brought you here, and you will be a part of us sooner or later."
Tantai Lingyan let out a heavy sigh. "Can you guys get me out of here?"

"Our husband has expressed his feelings for you, and we decided to support him in getting you as his wife." Liu Qingyu then pointed to one of the rooms. "If you are not used to our situation, you can stay in that room. No one will bother you there, and you can think about everything."
"All right, I'll go there now." Tantai Lingyan hurriedly went into the room and sealed it from the inside so that Zhang Fei wouldn't be able to disturb her.
Liu Hua smiled at seeing her like that. "How long will it take for her to fall into Fei'er's arms, Big Sis?"

"I don't know." Liu Qingyu turned to the main room. "Our husband still focused on Helan Yueyi and Feng Yichen even after four days had passed. Perhaps he will come out after he evolves into seven tails, and it shouldn't be long."
"You're right." Liu Hua hugged her big sister's arm. "Let's go; we'll cultivate on our own while waiting for Fei'er to finish with them."
"Yeah."

'Perfect timing!' Feltia [2] immediately opened the map to track the cultivators. Zhang Fei [4] had already reached the mountain peak, while several other cultivators were nearing it, particularly the five from the Sovereign Heaven Realm.

Thereafter, Feltia [2] entered the training space and went to the pavilion to dual cultivate with her female demon partners. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] replaced him and dived into the lava together with Huo Yan.
Sometime later, the two of them arrived not far from the Earth Flame, and the small boy immediately came out to meet them. "You have finally arrived."
"How can I get the Earth Flame?" Zhang Fei [4] bluntly posed the question.

"First things first, you have to bring your real body here, or you can forget about your wish to get the Earth Flame." Zhang Fei [4] frowned at the small boy, especially since he wanted to help all his wives after he was done with Helian Yueyi and Feng Yichen. "After your real body arrives here, I will give you some tests to determine your worthiness to receive my flame."
[Master, you can still harvest Feng Yichen's beast essence using your clone, and you only need to use your enhanced demon touch on him.]
'I know.' In a few moments, Zhang Fei had replaced his fourth clone, and Zhang Fei [4] focused on dual cultivating with Ilsath, Orith, and Zilvora.
Zhang Fei then asked the small boy. "What should I do now? What kind of tests should I undergo?"

"You have passed the first and second tests by bringing your original body here and reached the half-perfection stage in the fire elemental law." The small boy extracted a small portion of the Earth Flame. "The third test is simple, but I don't know if you have the courage to take it, especially since my flame will baptize your internal body by destroying and reshaping it. Thus, you will undergo excruciating pain, and there is a possibility that you will die in the process."
"Destroying and reshaping my internal body, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself.

[Kid, this Earth Flame is not an ordinary flame, and it can do such things. As this little guy said, the process is excruciating, but your internal body will become stronger if you get through it, and your affinity with the fire element will further increase, making it easier for you to reach the perfection stage of fire elemental law.]
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "How long will the third test take? I have an enemy who is much stronger than all living creatures in the upper realms, including you."
"A month." The small boy looked up. "If you don't want to do it, I will let them come in here and take the tests, especially since many of them have the qualifications to take them."
Just as Zhang Fei was hesitating about it, Huo Ling suddenly appeared beside them, causing the little boy to tremble and move away from her.
Huo Ling immediately pulled the little boy in front of her and lifted him up. "A low-class fire spirit like you dares to act up, huh? Do you want me to eat you?"
"Senior... I am the Earth Flame, and the Earth Flame is me, so the flame will disappear if you eat me." The little boy explained tremblingly.

"Humph!" Huo Ling snorted softly as she already knew about it, and she just wanted to threaten the little boy. She then spoke to Zhang Fei. "You have already witnessed Xereth's strength, and there are countless cultivators who are much stronger than him in the Paradise Realm. You can't even defeat a weak demon like him, and you ran away from him, so you can forget about wanting to go to that realm. Additionally, you can forget about my master, especially since you are not worthy of being with her."

'This bitch! She always looks down on me just because she's lived for so long! When I surpass her in the future, I'll fuck her every day!' Zhang Fei then spoke to the little boy. "A month, right? Let's do it! I'll take your third test, and I'll get your flame!"
"Heh!" Huo Ling then disappeared from that place.

"I didn't expect you to know an ancient fire spirit like her." The little boy showed the flame on his finger. "Be prepared because this will be very painful, and you don't have to think about the people on the surface, especially since they won't be able to come in here without my permission."
"Just do it; I don't have much time." Zhang Fei immediately curled up in pain as soon as the small boy shot the flame into his body. "Arghhhh!"

Even though Zhang Fei's fire element had reached the peak stage and his fire elemental law had reached the half-perfection stage, he still couldn't endure the heat that was burning his internal body. Just like him, his five clones also felt the pain, but their condition was much better than his because their internal bodies were not burned directly.
"Fuck!" Zhang Fei cursed as the pain continued to increase as time passed, but he did not want to back down from obtaining the Earth Flame.
At the mountain peak, the five cultivators from the Sovereign Heaven Realm had already arrived there, and they immediately looked for Zhang Fei, especially Yuan Tianling.

Yuan Tianjie walked to the edge of the crater and looked into the lava. "Could it be that kid has already entered this lava? According to our master, the Earth Flame should be deep in the lava, and there is no other way to get it except to go in there."
"He was way ahead of us before, and he should have arrived earlier than us, so I'm sure he's already entered this lava." Yuan Tiankong said these.

Yuan Tianxie and the two women nodded in agreement with that, but they suddenly saw a flame barrier covering the top of the lava. "Our guess was right, and that kid was there to take the Earth Flame."
"Are we just going to wait here?" Yuan Tianhua asked.

"Yes." Yuan Tianxie pointed at the barrier. "This barrier should have been created by the spirit of the Earth Flame, so it doesn't want us to go in because of that kid. Therefore, we can only wait for now, and the other cultivators will definitely attack him once he comes out. We will use that opportunity to capture him, and we will hand him over to our master. That way, she will be able to extract the flame from his body, and we will get a good reward for our success."

Yuan Tiankong and Yuan Tianjie agreed with that. However, the two women had different thoughts, especially Yuan Tianling, who was worried about Zhang Fei. 'Little fox, if you have another way to escape, you must use it if you succeed in obtaining the Earth Flame.'

Sometime later, many other cultivators had also arrived at the mountain peak, and the existence of the flame barrier irritated them, especially since they were also eager to obtain the Earth Flame. They asked the group of five, but they would rather not talk to them.

Some of them who were impatient tried to destroy the flame barrier, but they were burned to death instead. Witnessing that, the other cultivators decided to wait, especially since they did not want to die in the same way.

Outside, Yuan Tianhua looked at Yuan Tianling with suspicion, especially since she kept smiling to herself. 'Hey, did something happen between you and that little fox in the lava?'
'Huh?' Yuan Tianling looked up at her in surprise. 'What do you mean by that?'
Yuan Tianhua shook his head at him. 'We've known each other since we were toddlers, remember? I know you well, and I'm sure something has happened between you two.'
'Haha.' Yuan Tianling laughed with an embarrassed look. 'Something did happen between us, but I did it of my own free will, especially since he was seriously absorbing the Earth Flame at that time.'
'As expected!' Yuan Tianhua then turned to the three women who had approached them. "What happened, Mother? Why are your expressions so serious?"

"We won't be returning to our realm directly, and we will go to another realm first." Yuan Tianhua, Yuan Tianling, and the three young men looked at Ruan Xiaoqi in confusion, prompting her to explain the situation. "We have no other choice now, and we are doing this to buy time so that Leng Xueyan will not be able to find her in a short time."

As Leng Yueyan's disciples, Yuan Tianxie and the others naturally knew their master's character. "I think that's the best idea, Aunt Xiaoqi. Tianling will suffer if she returns to our realm now, and our master won't leave our realm for such a trivial matter, so she can hide from her for now."
"But—"

"Don't argue, okay?" Ren Ziwei interrupted her daughter. "Leng Xueyan is a selfish bitch, and she is one of the strongest in our realm. She will not look at our family status, and she will never hesitate to punish you severely, especially since you were in the lava with that kid."
Yuan Tianling let out a soft sigh and nodded to her mother. "Okay then, I will follow your plan."
"Tianxie and the others, you all have to keep this matter under wraps, understand? Yuan Tianxie and the others nodded in agreement to Duanmo Luolan.
Thereafter, their flying artifacts turned around and headed for the Vermilion Realm at full speed.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei is at the Phoenix Castle with Feng Yao, Feng Tian, and Feng Jiu. The Phoenix Princess informed her parents that she would take them to the Paradise Realm in a few days, asking them to prepare for their departure.

Feng Yao's sudden decision shocked Feng Tian and Feng Jiu, especially since she had previously said she would take them away after Xereth's business was finished. "Regardless of what you do, you will never be able to defeat him, especially if he summons Taotie's avatar once again. That beast is one of the strongest in the universe, and no one in the three mortal realms can beat him. However, Zhang Fei has a way to defeat that demon, but he can't do it before all the mythical beast races unite."
"Uniting all the mythical beast races is not an easy matter, especially since their egos are too high." Feng Tian said with a heavy sigh.

Feng Jiu then added. "Long Qiang, Dai Hubai, Wang Wugui, Zhu Shanniang, and Huli Xianniang are targeting Zhang Fei now. Their ancestors seem to be helping them hunt him down, so he will face many tough opponents soon. Therefore, I think we should delay our departure, and we will help him deal with them."

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed. "Zhu Shanniang and Huli Xianniang may be strong, but they are still women, and no woman stands a chance against him, especially with his abilities as a lust demon. Mother, even a woman like you will fall for him if he uses them on you, let alone those two women."

Feng Jiu looked at Zhang Fei, who scratched his nose awkwardly. "So far, there are only two women who can withstand my lust demon ability, and one of them is Feng Yao. Therefore, I am not worried about Zhu Shanniang or Huli Xianniang, and I will face them by myself if they attack me first. Long Qiang, Wang Wugui, and their two beast races are strong, but I'm not too afraid of them. I have Feng Yichen by my side, and she alone can eliminate them. Moreover, I still have another trick, and that will help me to surpass them, so you don't have to worry about my safety."
"Please show it to us."

One of Zhang Fei's clones sent Feng Yichen, who was staying in the pavilion, into the beast space. He then activated the Soul Connect III to borrow the power of the Dark Phoenix. In that instant, his strength became equal to a cultivator at the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, especially since the feature allowed him to borrow her full strength.
The Phoenix Emperor and Empress were shocked as soon as they sensed Zhang Fei's current strength.

"Incredible!" Feng Tian shouted in shock. "I don't know how you managed to do that, but your strength is truly extraordinary! This way, you don't have to be afraid of them, and you should be able to force them to submit to you."
"That's right." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Honestly, I can still increase my strength further, but I don't know whether it will be on par with Xereth's strength or not."
"How did you do it?" Zhang Fei enveloped the three of them with his aura, and they disappeared from the room.

The Beast Space stretched endlessly, filled with towering ancient trees and vast open fields. Qi flows through the land like a gentle breeze, nourishing the beasts that live within. In the distance, a tall mountain pierced the clouds, its peak hidden by mist. Clear rivers spread throughout the area, and rare plants grew abundantly on the riverbanks.
On a large tree branch, they saw Lei Qiu, the thunderbird, resting peacefully. Lan Zhen, the frost lynx, lay relaxed on the riverbank. Hi Ma, the hippocampus, was swimming in the river as usual.

In the distance, Jiu Yuan, the golden monkey, focused on her cultivation. The two tigresses, Hu Yi and Hu Er, circled around her and tried to disturb her. Boitata was alone on the mountain, not paying attention to the other beasts.
Meanwhile, Feng Yichen stood leaning against a tree, with her eyes closed and her arms crossed over her chest.
"Wow!" Feng Jiu exclaimed as she attempted to absorb Qi within the Beast Space. "The Qi here is truly pure without a single speck of impurity."
Feng Tian then added. "Somehow I feel that the flow of time inside here is different from outside."

"Your feeling is not wrong, Emperor Feng." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "The flow of time in this place is two times faster than in the outside world, allowing all my contract beasts to recover themselves and cultivate faster. This beast space also has another function, which is directly connected to me."
Feng Tian and Feng Jiu turned to Zhang Fei. "Another function?"

"I can borrow the power of all the beasts living here at the same time." Zhang Fei's answer caused their jaws to drop. "The more powerful beasts that live here, the greater the power I can borrow. Thus, I have never been afraid of Long Qiang and the others, but that doesn't mean I will blatantly look for trouble with them, especially in a crisis situation like now. However, I will not remain silent if they dare to attack me, and I will destroy them if they dare to do so."

Feng Jiu nodded in understanding. "I heard that you already got Feng Qingmeng and Zhu Lingyao, and they are quite strong. Even though they are still not as strong as Feng Yichen, they can still help you fight them. Additionally, you can ask for help from our Phoenix Clan members, including Feng Xueying."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "You two don't need to think about the situation in the upper realms and go to the Paradise Realm with Feng Yao, and we will meet again in the future."

"Since you have such an awesome trick, I won't worry about the upper realms anymore." Feng Jiu then took out her phoenix token and gave it to Zhang Fei. "This token is to open the most sacred place in our realm, but I checked that place a month ago, and I didn't manage to find the Divine Phoenix Totem there. Since you are sure that the totem is in our realm, you can use it to check that place."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei immediately received the token and observed it. "What place is that?"

"It is a resting place for our phoenix race." Feng Yao answered him. "I also often entered that place in the past, but I never saw the existence of the totem there. If you like, you can check it, but you must be prepared to face Feng Shen."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Let's go out; we'll check out the place. If Feng Shen attacks me, I'll beat him out of his shit."

They were already standing in front of the sacred place of the Phoenix Clan, and Feng Shen immediately appeared before them as they expected. "Why did you three bring this kid here? He may have close ties with our Phoenix Clan, but he is not worthy of setting foot on our sacred ground."

Feng Jiu and Feng Tian wanted to say something to Feng Shen, but Feng Yao stopped them. Instead, she asked Zhang Fei to handle the old phoenix by herself. "After you settle the business in this realm, you should go see Tianguo and subdue him."

"I had planned that." Zhang Fei was about to put the token in the wall hole when the old phoenix grabbed his shoulder. He briefly frowned and slapped the old phoenix's hand away. "Old man, I'm already annoyed with your attitude! I already told you that the Divine Phoenix Totem is not in my hands or Feng Yichen's, but you didn't believe me and turned against me instead. If you believe your strength is superior, I will fight you now, and I will instill in your mind not to judge a book by its cover."
"How dare you, brat!" Feng Shen immediately unleashed his strength, and he punched his fist toward Zhang Fei with the intention of killing him.
However, Zhang Fei immediately activated the Soul Connect III, borrowed Feng Yichen's full strength, and teleported behind Feng Shen.
Then, Zhang Fei grabbed Feng Shen's right shoulder, and he dislocated it directly.
*Crack... Crack...*
"Arghh!" Feng Shen flew away from him, but Zhang Fei teleported right in front of him. He grabbed his left arm and dislocated it as well, causing both his arms to dangle down. "Arghh!"
Afterwards, Zhang Fei powerfully kicked Feng Shen's chest, causing him to roll in the air several times before slamming onto the ground at quite a distance.
*Bam*
*Splurt*
Feng Shen spat out quite a lot of blood from his mouth, especially since Zhang Fei's kick was simply too strong even for a beast at his level. "Cough... Cough..."
*Swoosh*

Feng Xueying instantly appeared above them as soon as she sensed their fight. She looked at Zhang Fei in shock, especially after she sensed his current strength. 'This kid can borrow the strength of other beasts, huh? If I'm not mistaken, he should have borrowed Feng Yichen's strength, or he wouldn't have been able to beat Old Zhen like this.'
'Fuck! How could a snotty brat like him hurt me like this?' Feng Shen forcibly reconnected his shoulders, took a few pills, and swallowed them directly.
Zhang Fei briefly glanced at Feng Xueying, but the ice phoenix shook her head at him, signaling to him that she would not interfere in their affairs.

Zhang Fei then floated in front of Feng Shen, with the moonlit whisper sword in his hand. He activated his fire and ice elements at once, pointing his sword at him. "I respect you as a senior, but you disrespect me and try to suppress me. Since you showed such an attitude towards me, you have lost my respect, and I will beat you to a pulp today."
*Boom*
"Bastard!" Feng Shen shouted as he unleashed his full strength. "I will kill you today!"

Feng Shen immediately took out his flame sword and flew towards him, but Zhang Fei effortlessly parried it with his. Despite the old phoenix's high cultivation, he had never trained in sixteen times heavier gravity. Besides, he trained in such heavy gravity by carrying a 5000-pound hammer on his back, which made the old phoenix's speed pale in comparison to his.
Furthermore, Zhang Fei himself was borrowing Feng Yichen's full strength, which made his own strength equal to Feng Shen's. "Is this all you have? It's my turn to attack."

chapters.title: Chapter 894: Defeat Feng Shen
paragraphs: "Guah!" Feng Shen screamed in pain as Zhang Fei's hard fist slammed into his chest, propelling him backward.

Zhang Fei teleported behind Feng Shen and landed another hard fist into his back, causing his spine to crack. He didn't stop there, and he moved as fast as possible, punching him again and again. "Gahh!"

Feng Shen slashed his flame sword at Zhang Fei, but his attack only hit an illusion. Soon, six illusion figures surrounded the old phoenix, and he shot six fireballs to attack them. All of them passed through the illusions, causing them to disappear.
Feng Shen tried to find him using his senses, but Zhang Fei suddenly appeared right in front of him and attacked his abdomen directly using his knee.

"Gah!" Feng Shen bent forward because of the pain in his abdomen, but Zhang Fei launched an uppercut to his chin directly, sending him rolling in the air several times before stabilizing himself. 'Fuck! How can his speed surpass me? Moreover, his strength was on par with mine, and his attack was heavy, causing me a lot of pain.'
"Are you confused about the situation between us, Old Man?"
Hearing Zhang Fei's voice from behind, Feng Shen spun around and slashed his flame sword, but his slash once again only hit an illusion.

Zhang Fei didn't want to waste time with Feng Shen, and he reappeared in the distance. His dark flame appeared on his right hand, and his ice appeared on his left hand. In an instant, he fused the two, and the Hellflame Frost Lotus appeared before him. Unlike the usual one, the lotus was much bigger, especially since he borrowed Feng Yichen's strength.
"Take this attack on mine, old man." Zhang Fei pushed the lotus forward, and it quickly flew towards Feng Shen.
Feng Xueying and the others immediately shouted at Feng Shen. "Move away! Don't take that attack head-on!"

However, Feng Shen was too stubborn, summoned a huge fire phoenix behind him, and unleashed his full power attack. In a few seconds, a huge fireball collided with Zhang Fei's Hellflame Frost Lotus, but the old phoenix's attack was shrinking rapidly.
"Shit!" Feng Shen cursed when his attack vanished, and the lotus rapidly advanced toward him. Two fire wings immediately appeared behind his back, and he flew away from it at high speed.
Since the impact would be too great if he detonated his lotus, Zhang Fei canceled it and teleported above Feng Shen, slashing the moonlit whisper sword shrouded in darkness toward his back.
*Slash*

"Argh!" Zhang Fei's darkness quickly entered and spread throughout Feng Shen's body through the slash wound, but the old phoenix used his phoenix flame to counter his darkness, burning it without a trace. 'Damn it! If I didn't have my flame, I would be corrupted by his darkness.'
Zhang Fei then used his darkness corruption, and a mass of darkness quickly appeared before enclosing Feng Shen within it, but it was ineffective due to the effects of his phoenix flame.

Feng Shen intended to escape from the encirclement of the darkness by flying upwards, but a black, blazing chain suddenly wrapped around his body. In that moment, a black flame flared up and burned him, causing him to scream. "Argh!"
'Close your sense of hearing.' Zhang Fei rang the Cursed Demon Bell once Feng Yao and the others followed his orders.
*Ring... Ring... Ring...*

"Ahh! What the hell is this?" Chained by the hellfire chains, Feng Shen held his head. The effects of the bell quickly took over him, and his mind was filled with madness. "Argh! Stop! Get out of my mind!"
*Roar*
A deafening roar sounded as soon as Zhang Fei used the Demon King's roar toward Feng Shen, which strengthened the effect of the bell by instilling fear and confusion in the old phoenix.
Feng Xueying and the others looked up at the sky as soon as they sensed the change , and the sky had already darkened with black lightning bolts continuously striking there.
Zhang Fei gave a light smirk and swung his hand down. "Rain down on him!"
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*
Those black lightning bolts quickly descended from the sky, and they struck Feng Shen, who was in a mentally unstable state.

"Arghhh!" Once again, Feng Shen screamed in pain as his body simultaneously experienced electrocution and burns. In a few seconds, his body glided toward the ground like a broken kite, slamming there quite hard.
*Bam*
*Splurt*

Feng Yao and the others moved to Zhang Fei's side to stop him, but he had already stopped his action of absorbing Feng Shen's cultivation. He then pulled his soul out of his body, replicated it, and merged it with his own.
Feng Jiu, Feng Tian, and Feng Xueying expressed relief that Zhang Fei did not kill Feng Shen, particularly because his death would be a significant loss to their Phoenix Clan.
[Quest: Defeat the fire phoenix ancestor.]
[Quest rank: Hard]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Hard gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]

"What do you mean by that, Little Yao?" Feng Xueying asked with a raised eyebrow.

"In a few days, I will take my parents to the Paradise Realm, and we will never come back here again." Feng Yao's explanation shocked Feng Xueying, especially since she informed her too suddenly. "I have a lot of business in that realm, so we will leave first. I want to bring you along, but our clan still requires protection, so we must part ways for now. However, you can go with Zhang Fei in the future, and we will meet again there."
"What about Xereth?"
Feng Yao pointed at Zhang Fei. "You've seen his ability to defeat Feng Shen, so you should already be aware of his true strength, right?"
"Unfortunately, his strength just now was not his true strength, so I'm not sure he can defeat Xereth." Feng Xueying expressed her doubts.

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled in response. "You are right that he borrowed Feng Yichen's strength to defeat Feng Shen, but have you thought about what if he borrowed the strength of many powerful beasts in the upper realms?"

Feng Xueying turned to Zhang Fei directly. "Old Phoenix, I can not only borrow the power of one beast; I can also borrow the power of hundreds or even thousands of beasts. Currently, there are several powerful beasts by my side, but their strength is still not enough to help me fight Xereth, and we still have to convince the other mythical beast races."

"You realize that's not an easy thing, right?" Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Xueying. "The Dragon, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise Races want to eliminate you. Their ancestors will most likely help them, especially since they fear that you will surpass and suppress them. Besides, the Heavenly Fox Race has also been targeting you for a long time, and they want to get the thing inside your body."
"Do the ancestors of the Golden Fox, Vermilion Bird, Golden Crow, Qilin, and Kunpeng races also want to kill me?" Zhang Fei posed this serious question.

Feng Xueying shook her head before explaining. "I asked them about this, and most said they don't want to do anything to you. The Golden Fox race split in two because Huli Jinhu wanted to eliminate you, but Huli Zhishen rejected that. They wouldn't be able to make a decision without a unanimous vote."
"Huli Jinhu, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "Since he openly wanted to kill me, I naturally had to prepare something against him, and such a powerful beast like him would be useful to me."
Feng Xueying immediately asked. "Are you going to attack Huli Jinhu directly? If you do that, Huli Zhishen might change her mind, and she might turn against you."
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head. "They should also have entered seclusion, right?"
Feng Xueying answered him with a nod. "All of them are in the Xianjin Realm now, and they shouldn't make any moves anytime soon."
"That's good then." Zhang Fei was slightly relieved to hear that, especially since he wasn't ready to face them all at once.

"How did you manage to borrow Feng Yichen's strength before?" Zhang Fei immediately took Feng Xueying into his beast space, but they came out again a few moments later. "Honestly, I would rather not fight with Huli Jinhu and the others, but since you have such a method to borrow the strength of other beasts, I won't mind helping you fight them indirectly. If you work together with Feng Yichen, I'm sure you two can defeat them."

"As long as you are willing to help me, I have confidence in defeating them." Zhang Fei then walked to the entrance of the sacred ground. "Let's check inside first, and I'll go to the Wasteland Realm to subdue Tian Guo afterward."
"You can go inside yourself, and we will go back to the palace to prepare." Feng Yao then lifted Feng Shen and spoke to Feng Xueying. "Make sure you will catch up with us in the future."
"Yes." Feng Yao immediately took Feng Shen away, and her parents followed behind them. On the other hand, Feng Xueying followed Zhang Fei to enter the sacred ground.
As soon as they arrived inside, the little boy suddenly came out of Zhang Fei's body. "Master, there is something inside here, and it seems to come from a very distant era."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei was not surprised by that, but he was surprised by the appearance of the little boy. "I thought you would disappear after the Earth Flame merged with me, but you are here now."

"Haha." The little boy laughed. "Master, I am the spirit of the Earth Flame, remember? Naturally, I will not disappear, and I will continue to live in your body. By the way, I don't have a name yet, so you should give me one now."
Zhang Fei thought for a while before giving it a name. "Huo Diqiu, which means Earth Flame."
"I agree with that name!" Huo Diqiu then gestured toward the fire phoenix statues. "The thing split into several and hid within them."
Zhang Fei and Feng Xueying raised their eyebrows as several clouds of fire came out from all the statues, and they gathered in the middle of the room before forming the Divine Phoenix Totem.
[Quest: Finding the lost treasure of the phoenix race.]
[Quest rank: Special.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Special gift pack X1 sent to the inventory.]
