"Many old people are too stubborn, just like him." Zhang Fei replied with a shrug.
Soon, the totem glowed red, and a male figure materialized in front of them. "I have been waiting for you for a long time, the heir of the ten-tailed fox."
Zhang Fei cupped his hands toward the man. "If I'm not mistaken, you should be the first fire phoenix, right, senior?"

"That's right." The man nodded to Zhang Fei. "I am indeed the first fire phoenix, and I lived in the same era as the old ten-tailed fox. That old fox asked me and the other mythical beasts to leave some of our belongings for his successor, and you are his successor, especially with your three identities."
"Some of your belongings?"

The man raised his palm, and a blood clot appeared on it. "This is my origin fire phoenix bloodline, and whoever inherits it will inherit all my abilities. According to my promise to the old fox, I will give it to you, but I think you don't need it because your bloodline is already higher than mine, and you only need to evolve to the ten tails."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought for a moment before summoning Zhang Lingxue out of the training space. "What if my wife inherits your origin bloodline, senior?"

The man observed Zhang Lingxue for a while before nodding in agreement. "Get ready, little girl. I will help you merge with my origin bloodline, and you will become stronger by inheriting my abilities stored within it."
"Senior, I—"

"Accept it, Lingxue." Zhang Fei interrupted her. "The phoenix origin bloodline is more useful to you, especially since you already have a few drops in your body. Unlike you, I am a heavenly fox, and I can evolve into ten tails in the future. Moreover, you are my wife, and you will help me in many ways in the future. Therefore, you need it to improve yourself, so I want you to accept it."
Zhang Lingxue exhaled softly. "All right, I will accept your origin phoenix bloodline, Senior."
Feng Xueying smiled faintly upon hearing that. 'His big sister has the ice phoenix origin bloodline and soul, and his other wife will get the fire phoenix origin soon.'

"Let's do it." The man lifted Zhang Lingxue into the air and sent his fire phoenix origin bloodline into her body. The blood began to spread throughout her body, causing it to heat up and envelop her in phoenix flame as she quickly fell asleep. "Fortunately, she already has the fire phoenix bloodline in her body, so she won't feel the slightest pain."
Zhang Fei smiled at that. "Did the other mythical beasts leave their belongings in the three mortal realms, Senior?"

"What do you mean by the three mortal realms?" Zhang Fei recalled that their universe was once unified, and the first fire phoenix existed in a very distant era, which prompted him to explain this history. "I didn't expect this universe to change so drastically, but unfortunately, they didn't leave anything in the three mortal realms, and you have to look for them in the next realm."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.

The man then spoke to him again. "Once I finish helping your wife, I will give this fragment of my soul to you, and your soul power will be able to reach the perfection stage of the heavenly soul realm."
"What if—"
"No." The man immediately rejected Zhang Fei. "Your soul power is still too weak, so you need this soul to increase it. You can help your wife using other methods."
Zhang Fei inwardly sighed. "Thank you, Senior."

A few hours later, Zhang Lingxue had completed the process, and the man immediately lowered her to the ground. She quickly opened her eyes and felt a great change in herself, not only in her body but also in her cultivation, which was getting closer to the sovereign realm. "Thank you, senior."

"Hmm." The man nodded slightly. "Little girl, my phoenix techniques are different from those of other phoenixes, so you won't be able to use them all right away, and you can only use a few of them now. Once your cultivation breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms, you will be able to use more, and you will be able to use all of them after you break through to the Five Celestial Realms."
Zhang Lingxue nodded in understanding. "I understand, senior."

The man looked at Zhang Fei, who immediately released his soul. "Once this fragment of my soul merges with yours, I will disappear forever from this universe. The old fox placed his hopes on you to bring peace back to this universe, and I hope you will succeed in doing so in the future."

"Senior, I can't promise you anything, and I can only try my best to bring peace back to this universe." The man simply nodded, and Zhang Fei immediately sat on the floor to undergo the process of uniting their souls.
Feng Xueying directly spoke to Zhang Lingxue. "Go to the sea of fire, and you can learn those techniques there."
"Yes, Senior."

chapters.title: Chapter 895: Force Tianguo
paragraphs: Feng Shen finally woke up with a heavy and dizzy head, especially after he was affected by the Cursed Demon Bell earlier. 'Damn it! I didn't expect to be defeated by that bastard.'
*Tap... Tap...*
Feng Shen turned to Feng Yao, who walked into the room. "If you weren't blinded by your ambition and greed, you wouldn't have ended up like this."
"What do you mean by that?" Feng Shen asked with a frown.

Feng Yao waved her hand, and a fire screen appeared before them, showing Zhang Fei's activities. "The Divine Phoenix Totem was never in his or Feng Yichen's hands, and it was hiding in our sacred ground. It was so close to us, but none of us could feel its presence there. Legends aren't always true; the totem is different from what you think, and it merely serves as a vessel for the first fire phoenix's soul fragment."
"The soul fragment of the first fire phoenix?"

Feng Yao nodded at him. "The first fire phoenix promised the old ten-tailed fox to help his successor, and Zhang Fei was the chosen one to become his successor. The totem was destined to fall into his hands from the start, so no one could ever have it before."
"How did Feng Yichen steal it in the past?"

"Don't you already know the answer?" Feng Shen raised an eyebrow for a moment before nodding to Feng Yao. "After she stole the totem in the past, it decided to divide itself into several parts and hide in the statues of our ancestors. The totem immediately appeared when Zhang Fei entered, and the soul of the first fire phoenix began merging with his."
Feng Yao's explanation disappointed Feng Shen, especially since he was a pure fire phoenix, but the first fire phoenix actually chose someone from another mythical beast race to inherit his soul.
Feng Yao removed the fire screen and warned him. "Get rid of your negative thoughts toward Zhang Fei, especially since your life is in his hands now."
"Hmm?"

Feng Yao turned to leave without explaining. "Oh! My parents and I will leave the upper realms for the Paradise Realm in a few days, and Zhang Fei will have full authority over our Phoenix Clan, so you and Feng Xueying will have to help him to take care of our members."

After Feng Yao left, Feng Shen contacted Feng Tian and Feng Jiu, and both of them told him the same thing that their daughter said just now. "What were they thinking? Why did they make such a decision without discussing it with me and Xueying first?"
Feng Shen got up and left the room, heading towards the sacred ground. When he arrived there, Feng Xueying stopped him and warned him that his life was in Zhang Fei's hands.

"Instead of blaming him, you should reflect on everything, especially since all of this happened because of your fault." Feng Shen did not reply to Feng Xueying and continued to stare at Zhang Fei. "For now, our duty is to protect our clan members, and we will go to the Paradise Realm with him in the future."
Feng Shen finally turned to Feng Xueying. "Are you sure he can take us to that realm?"
"Yes." Feng Xueying gave him a nod. "Zhang Fei is the only one who can do that, so you should stop being hostile toward him. Otherwise, you will miss out on your opportunity and incur losses."
Feng Shen didn't say anything else and left , returning to his place in the sea of fire. However, Feng Xueying told him about Zhang Lingxue, who was training there, and asked him to guide her.
[Ding]
[The host's soul power level has increased to the half-perfection stage of the heavenly soul level.]
[The host's soul power level has increased to the perfection stage of the heavenly soul level.]
"Thank you for your help, Old Phoenix." Zhang Fei opened his eyes and stood up before grabbing the totem, which had lost its luster. Even though the totem was no longer useful, he decided to keep it.
"What are your plans now?" Feng Xueying asked.

Zhang Fei directly explained some of his plans. "Are you willing to help me take care of them? I can take care of them myself, but I will use force against them, especially since those two reported my presence in the upper realms to Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian."
"Da Xiongmao and Da Feiyue are such idiots." Feng Xueying then agreed to his request. "Let's go to the Wasteland Realm first, and we will go to the Evergreen Spirit Haven after."
Zhang Fei first summoned Feng Yichen out of the beast space before taking the two women to the Wasteland Realm.

The three of them had already arrived at the eastern island of the Wasteland Realm, and it was not difficult for them to find Tianguo, especially since the divine beast immediately appeared before them in his black fox form. "Hahaha! I didn't expect you to be such a coward! You even brought an ice phoenix and a dark phoenix with you to subdue me."

Lei Huoting looked at Zhang Fei [5] in distrust. "All right, you can try it."
